article.articleHeadline: %80 من إصابات "إيبولا" الجديدة مجهولة المصدر
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 80% of new Ebola cases are of unknown origin.
article.articleSummary: 80% of new Ebola infections in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo arise from transmission chains of unknown origin, signaling faster spread than health authorities’ ability to trace contacts. Government data show confirmed Ebola cases rising to 2,011, with 754 deaths. A total of 54 new infections were recorded last Monday across three provinces, including Ituri and North Kivu, as the outbreak linked to the Bundibugyo strain continues since May 15. The eastern DRC outbreak persists despite intensified response efforts, with the high share of cases from undetected chains underscoring surveillance and containment challenges. The World Health Organization continues to monitor and coordinate response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: 新規エボラ感染例の80%が感染源不明
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部でエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の流行が継続し、感染連鎖の80%が追跡不能な状態であり、感染者数・死亡者数も相当数に上るため、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が認められる。
triage.notes: WHOが監視・対応調整を継続中であり、感染連鎖の追跡困難性が示すサーベイランス能力の限界が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: चार हजार मुंबईकर तापाने फणफणले; डेंग्यू, मलेरिया, गॅस्ट्रोचा विळखा, काळजी घ्या!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Four thousand Mumbaikars stricken with fever; dengue, malaria, the grip of gastroenteritis, take care!
article.articleSummary: Four thousand Mumbai residents are hospitalized with fever as dengue, malaria, and gastroenteritis surge after heavy rains. Since January, Mumbai has recorded 938 dengue, 3,689 malaria, and 3,866 gastroenteritis cases, with over 4,000 patients currently receiving treatment in city hospitals. Leptospirosis cases climbed to 157 due to stagnant, contaminated water following downpours. The municipal health department has issued preventive guidelines to curb leptospira transmission. A June–July 'Special Construction Drive' tested 54,763 construction workers, uncovering 37 malaria cases. Ongoing counts include chikungunya 31, COVID-19 71, and swine flu 71. Residents are urged to take precautions, maintain hygiene, avoid standing water, and seek medical care promptly for fever and related symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: 4000人のムンバイ市民が発熱に苦しむ；デング熱、マラリア、胃腸炎の蔓延、注意が必要！
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の雨期に伴うデング・マラリア・レプトスピラ症等の症例増加だが、既知の風土病で国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低く、経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 毎年雨季に発生する季節性の媒介動物由来感染症・水系感染症の増加。地方自治体が既に対策を実施しており、外部支援の必要性は低いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : les prestataires de la riposte à Ebola annoncent la reprise des activités - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: the Ebola response providers announce the resumption of activities - ACP
article.articleSummary: In Ituri, Ebola virus disease response teams in Bunia and Rwampara resumed activities after assurances from the military governor. Dr. Isaac Mungenyi, head of the Ebola Treatment Center (ETC) in Rwampara, said teams were reassured that payment arrears would be regularized and that all response pillars are valued. The dispute centered on 45 days of unpaid work and pay disparities: while some pillars were paid, communication, laboratory, and psychosocial care were left unpaid, fueling discouragement. About 148 care agents perform patient care, and nearly 90% of responders in Bunia and Rwampara were affected by delays. The delays were attributed to irregular beneficiary lists and duplicate entries. The governor pledged personal action to regularize payments, with the provincial health division coordinating. Following the meeting, the strike was suspended and teams were urged to resume patient care calmly while the issue is resolved.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州：エボラ対応従事者らが活動再開を発表 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: 既知のエボラ出血熱対応におけるストライキ・支払い遅延問題であるが、疾患自体の重篤性が高く、対応継続に関わる社会的・行政的関心が高いためフルRRAでの確認が望ましい。
triage.notes: 記事は既存のエボラ対応チームの給与未払いによるストライキとその解決について述べており、新規症例数や感染拡大に関する具体的情報は記載なし。位置情報に含まれる『Kigali Province』『Rwanda』はRwampara（DRC国内地名）との混同と考えられ、記事本文では言及なしのため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Wabah Ebola RD Kongo Tembus 2.000 Kasus, Tewaskan 754 Korban : Okezone News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo Surpasses 2,000 Cases, Killing 754 People
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-07-16, Ebola virus disease cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have reached 2,011 confirmed infections with 754 deaths, government data show. The outbreak, centered in Bunia, is caused by Bundibugyo virus, a rare ebolavirus strain, and is described by Médecins Sans Frontières as the third-largest and fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record. Transmission occurs through direct contact with blood or body fluids of infected people or animals, with typical symptoms including high fever, vomiting, and internal and external bleeding. The absence of an approved vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo complicates response efforts, unlike outbreaks involving Zaire ebolavirus. Healthcare workers have faced added obstacles, including strikes at Bunia General Hospital over unpaid wages, hindering containment and care. MSF is urging an immediate scale-up of containment and patient care measures to address the ongoing outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、感染者2,000人を突破、死者754人
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで2,000例超・死者754人という大規模流行に達し、承認ワクチン・治療薬がないBundibugyo株であること、医療従事者ストライキで対応が困難化していることから、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: MSFが「史上3番目に大きく、最も急速に拡大しているエボラ流行」と評価。Bundibugyo株には承認ワクチン・治療薬がなく、対応が困難。医療従事者のストライキも containment を妨げている。

article.articleHeadline: Pemkab Gorontalo Utara meluncurkan Desa Siaga Aktif TBC dan KTR
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Gorontalo Regency Government launches Active TB and KTR Alert Village
article.articleSummary: North Gorontalo Regency government launched Active Tuberculosis (TB) Village and Smokefree Area Task Force (Satgas Kawasan Tanpa Rokok) in Sumalata, western Gorontalo Utara, Gorontalo Province, as of 16 July 2026. The program strengthens community health by empowering villages to actively identify TB cases, ensure patients complete treatment, and reduce transmission as part of national TB elimination efforts. Irwan Abudi Usman, speaking for Regent Thariq Modanggu, announced the launch at Sabuto Hall, with attendance from the Gorontalo Utara Health Office and local officials. The Smokefree Zone Task Force aims to protect the public’s right to clean air and educate on implementing smokefree environments in health facilities, schools, places of worship, offices, and public spaces, especially safeguarding children, pregnant women, and other vulnerable groups. The initiative emphasizes joint community responsibility across districts, villages, health workers, security, and residents to sustain TB control and smokefree culture.

triage.headline_ja: 北ゴロンタロ県政府、結核対策アクティブビレッジおよび禁煙地域タスクフォースを開始
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は結核対策プログラムの開始という行政施策の紹介であり、異常な流行や新規リスクの発生を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による結核撲滅・禁煙推進の通常の公衆衛生プログラム開始の報道であり、疫学的なシグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus DBD di Sumsel tembus 2.149 hingga Juli 2026, Kota Palembang jadi yang tertinggi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever cases in South Sumatra reach 2,149 as of July 2026, Palembang City tops the list.
article.articleSummary: 2,149 dengue fever (DBD) cases were recorded across 17 districts/cities in South Sumatra as of 14 July 2026, with 15 deaths. Palembang City accounted for the most cases (619), followed by Muara Enim (440), Ogan Ilir (185), Lubuk Linggau (139), Banyuasin (129), Lahat (128), and OKU Timur (118). Other districts reported lower counts, including Musi Banyuasin (89), OKI (67), Musi Rawas Utara (66), PALI (60), Musi Rawas (58), Prabumulih (21), OKU (16), Pagar Alam (7), Empat Lawang (4), and OKU Selatan (3). Dengue deaths were recorded in Lahat (4) and Lubuk Linggau (2), with one death in Musi Banyuasin, Banyuasin, Ogan Ilir, Palembang, PALI, and Musi Rawas Utara; others had none. El Niño may raise mosquito vectors later in 2026, risking higher cases October–December. Prevention focuses on PSN 3M Plus, larviciding/insecticiding, strengthened clinical care, and public education.

triage.headline_ja: 南スマトラのデング熱症例が2026年7月時点で2,149件に達し、パレンバン市が最多
triage.triage_reason: デング熱はインドネシアで季節性の流行を繰り返しており異常性は低いが、死亡例が複数出ており、エルニーニョによる今後の増加リスクが指摘されているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱は毎年季節性に発生している疾患であり、IHR基準には該当しないが、死亡例（15名）とエルニーニョによる今後の症例増加リスクがあるため、続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 防堵伊波拉病毒！美國限制剛果返美旅客搭乘商業航班 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: To curb Ebola virus! The United States restricts travelers returning from Congo from boarding commercial flights.
article.articleSummary: As of July 16, 2026, the United States announced a new entry restriction to curb the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo. U.S. citizens and nationals who have visited the DRC within the past 21 days are barred from entering the United States via commercial aviation. The policy, disclosed by the U.S. Department of State and reported by Reuters, aims to prevent importation of the Ebola virus amid the ongoing Congo outbreak. The ban targets air travelers with recent DRC travel history and represents a broader tightening of border controls to reduce cross-border transmission. The report provides no specific case counts or fatalities, nor details on the duration of the restriction.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ阻止！米国がコンゴ帰りの旅客の商業便搭乗を制限
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱流行を受け、米国が渡航制限を発動。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、国際的関心も高いためフルRRAへ。
triage.notes: 記事は米国の渡航制限措置に関する報道であり、感染症の発生地は一貫してコンゴ民主共和国。米国は発生地ではなく対応措置の実施国のため verified_locations から除外。具体的な症例数・死亡者数・制限期間は記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Evaluation of two inactivated vaccines against Campylobacter fetus in an experimental bovine model: immunological survey and genital clearance in heifers - Brazilian Journal of Microbiology
article.articleSummary: Campylobacter fetus subsp. venerealis (Cfv) causes bovine genital Campylobacteriosis, a venereal disease contributing to reproductive losses in natural-service herds. In Brazil, 44 heifers were allocated to four groups: G1 vaccine A, G2 vaccine B, G3 infected with placebo, G4 negative control. After intravaginal challenge with Cfv, animals were followed for 105 days. Culture of vaginal-cervical mucus showed lower positivity in vaccinated groups (G1 61.81%, G2 45.45%) versus G3 87.27% (p<0.05). Local IgA and systemic IgG responses were detected by ELISA in all challenged groups, with earlier increases in G1/G2. Agglutinating antibodies were observed post-vaccination, strongest in G2 (p=0.0316). qPCR indicated a lower bacterial load in vaccinated cattle during sampling. Conclusion: vaccines yielded significantly earlier clearance of Cfv from the reproductive tract, associated with elevated early humoral responses; vaccines merit field evaluation to assess reproductive performance.

article.articleHeadline: Goiás registra quase 6 mil casos de SRAG em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Goiás records nearly 6,000 cases of Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome in 2026.
article.articleSummary: In Goiás, Brazil, the State Health Secretariat reports almost 6,000 Severe Acute Respiratory Syndromes (SRAG) cases in 2026, reflecting high circulation of respiratory viruses such as Influenza and Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV). Surveillance indicates ongoing SRAG activity, with children under five, the elderly, pregnant women, and people with chronic diseases most at risk for complications. Authorities stress influenza vaccination and preventive measures—frequent handwashing, covering the nose and mouth when coughing or sneezing, well-ventilated spaces, and avoiding close contact with symptomatic individuals. Patients with warning signs (shortness of breath, persistent fever, or reduced oxygenation) should seek immediate medical evaluation. The government continues epidemiological monitoring and aims to expand vaccination coverage to reduce hospitalizations from severe respiratory diseases.

triage.headline_ja: ゴイアス州、2026年にSRAG（重症急性呼吸器症候群）が約6,000例に達し、呼吸器疾患への警戒強まる
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のインフルエンザ・RSVによる通常の呼吸器疾患サーベイランス報告であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 既知の季節性病原体（インフルエンザ、RSV）による通常の公衆衛生監視報告であり、新規性・異常性は見られない。

article.articleHeadline: Julho Amarelo alerta para os diversos casos de hepatite
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Yellow July raises awareness about the various cases of hepatitis.
article.articleSummary: Paraná, Brazil marks Yellow July to raise awareness of viral hepatitis. From 2019–2025, Paraná recorded 7,288 hepatitis B, 5,069 hepatitis C, and 846 hepatitis A cases, with 608 related deaths. Between 2014–2024, mortality fell 75.7% for hepatitis C and 21.6% for hepatitis B, linked to expanded diagnosis and treatment access. Nationwide, Brazil reports 826,292 confirmed viral hepatitis cases from 2000–2024; hepatitis C accounts for 41.5%, hepatitis B 36.6%, and hepatitis A 21.2%. The South region accounts for 30.9% of hepatitis B and 27% of hepatitis C cases, behind the Southeast overall. Early diagnosis is emphasized, using serology (HBsAg, Anti-HBs, Anti-HBc, Anti-HCV) and molecular tests (HBV-DNA, HCV-RNA) plus liver enzymes AST, ALT, and GGT to guide treatment. Vaccination prevents hepatitis A and B (free via SUS); there is no vaccine for hepatitis C. Prevention includes safe practices, treated water, sanitation, and biosafety in procedures.

triage.triage_reason: 啓発キャンペーンに関する定例的な統計報告であり、異常な流行や急性の公衆衛生上の脅威を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Flu Singapura di Sumsel tembus 628, Palembang tertinggi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Singapore flu cases in South Sumatra reach 628, with Palembang the highest.
article.articleSummary: Singapore flu, or Hand, Foot and Mouth Disease (HFMD), has reached 628 cases in South Sumatra up to June 2026, with Palembang the hotspot at 118 cases. Other districts include Penukal Abab Lematang Ilir 82; Musi Banyuasin 78; Prabumulih 78; Muara Enim 65; Lahat 62; Lubuklinggau 54; Empat Lawang, Ogan Komering Ulu Timur, and Musi Rawas Utara each with 3 cases. The health office notes a clear uptick beginning in April, with tens of new weekly cases through June, reflecting HFMD’s seasonal pattern around transitions between rainy and dry seasons. The disease primarily affects children under five to seven but can infect adults with poor hygiene. Symptoms: fever, mouth ulcers, and a rash around the mouth, on hands, feet, or buttocks, plus sore throat; incubation is about 3–6 days. Severe signs—lethargy, seizures, shortness of breath, or cold extremities—require prompt hospital care.

triage.headline_ja: 南スマトラ州でシンガポール風邪（手足口病）症例が628件に達し、パレンバンが最多
triage.triage_reason: 手足口病（HFMD）は季節性の流行パターンを示しており、重症例や異常な拡大は報告されていないため緊急のRRAは不要だが、症例数の推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: HFMDはインドネシアで季節性に流行する既知の疾患であり、今回の報告も雨季・乾季の変わり目に見られる典型的なパターンとされている。重症化例の増加や異常な拡大の兆候があれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 6月新增新冠确诊7.9万例，其中重症130例，专家：多为轻症，不必恐慌
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In June, 79,000 new confirmed COVID-19 cases, including 130 severe cases; experts say most are mild and there is no need to panic.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 in China: In June 2026, the country reported 79,000 new confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infections nationwide (June 1–30), including 130 severe cases and 1 death with underlying conditions. Local Genomic surveillance from 31 provinces and Xinjiang = 3,741 sequences, all Omicron variants. Sentinel surveillance (late June–early July) shows COVID-19 positivity at 9.6% among influenza-like illness respiratory samples, ranking second after influenza (11.6%). Beijing You’an Hospital’s Li Tongzeng notes cases rose as population immunity waned; SARS-CoV-2 lacks a fixed season, with summer indoor ventilation practices contributing to spread. Most infections are mild, presenting upper-respiratory symptoms (low fever, sore throat, cough, nasal symptoms; some diarrhea); pneumonia and severe disease are less common. High-risk groups (elderly, chronic diseases, immunocompromised) should seek early care and antiviral treatment if symptoms arise. Other circulating pathogens include influenza (mostly type B in the south), rhinovirus, and enterovirus; and public health guidance emphasizes masking in clinics and crowded settings, hand hygiene, and ventilation.

triage.headline_ja: 6月の新型コロナ新規確定症例7.9万例、うち重症130例。専門家:大半は軽症でパニックの必要なし
triage.triage_reason: 中国国内の定例COVID-19サーベイランス報告であり、専門家自身が軽症中心でパニック不要と説明。オミクロン株の季節的増加範囲内で異常性・重篤性ともに低い。
triage.notes: 既知のOmicron株による季節的増加であり、既存の免疫低下と屋内換気習慣が要因と分析されている。重症化率は低く、通常のサーベイランス活動の一環と判断。

article.articleHeadline: US says it is blocking Americans in DR Congo from immediate travel home, citing Ebola
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-07-16, the United States has imposed travel restrictions tied to an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). American citizens and nationals who have been in the DRC within the past 21 days are prohibited from entering the United States via commercial air travel. The policy, announced by the State Department, aims to curb potential importation of Ebola during the outbreak in the DRC. The report does not provide case or death counts. The measure underscores heightened concern over travel from Ebola-affected regions and applies to commercial aviation routes.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、コンゴ民主共和国滞在の米国人の即時帰国を阻止していると発表 ― エボラを理由に
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行に伴い米国が渡航制限を課すという、渡航・貿易制限とIHR基準に直接該当する事象であり、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が明確。
triage.notes: 米国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。症例数・死亡数は記事に記載なし。DRCでのエボラ流行の詳細（規模、地域）については続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Um terço das cidades da Grande SP registra alta de casos de SRAG, apesar de queda regional
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A third of the cities in Greater São Paulo report an increase in Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome cases, despite a regional decline.
article.articleSummary: Greater São Paulo’s RMSP recorded a significant drop in severe acute respiratory syndrome (SRAG) cases and deaths in 2026 vs 2025, with 11,406 SRAG cases and 520 deaths, down from 15,762 cases and 1,625 deaths last year. Thirteen of 39 municipalities showed increases, about one-third. The sharp rises occurred in Francisco Morato (+79%) and Franco da Rocha (+74%) in the north; Poá (+5%) in the east. In the western half, 10 of 13 growing municipalities were Carapicuíba (+56%), Barueri (+41%), Vargem Grande Paulista (+38%), Santana de Parnaíba (+33%), Juquitiba (+33%), Embu das Artes (+32%), Itapevi (+27%), Jandira (+23%), Cotia (+17%), Taboão da Serra (+3%). Officials cite multifactorial drivers: population density, circulating viruses, colder temperatures, and vaccination coverage. West RMSP influenza vaccination averages 43%, with Jandira and Juquitiba around one-third vaccinated. Influenza and COVID-19 vaccines are available at health units; RSV vaccine targets pregnant women from 28 weeks; SUS provides passive immunity for premature infants. Symptomatic individuals should seek medical evaluation.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ首都圏、地域全体では減少傾向も3分の1の市でSRAG(重症急性呼吸器症候群)症例が増加
triage.triage_reason: サンパウロ都市圏全体では前年比でSRAG症例・死亡数とも大幅減少しており、一部自治体での増加は季節性呼吸器感染症(インフルエンザ・COVID-19・RSV)による通常の変動範囲内と考えられる。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 地域全体としては前年より症例数・死亡数とも減少しており、既知の季節性呼吸器ウイルス（インフルエンザ、COVID-19、RSV）による通常の流行パターンと考えられる。ワクチン接種率の低さが一部地域での増加要因として挙げられているが、公衆衛生上の異常事態や国際的懸念には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: 獲CDE指標案件 高端二代腸病毒疫苗報捷
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Advanced second-generation enterovirus vaccine reports breakthrough after securing CDE milestone designation.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan-based High-end Vaccine announced a breakthrough for its second-generation multivalent enterovirus vaccine, designated as a Center Indicator Case (IDX) by the Center for Drug Evaluation (CDE) and qualifying for the TFDA’s drug project consultation and guidance. This enables early regulatory-science dialogue on clinical design, quality development, and manufacturing controls (CMC), accelerating evaluation and potential上市. The multivalent approach targets multiple enterovirus serotypes beyond EV71, addressing limitations of monovalent vaccines that leave Coxsackie A virus (CVA) and others to drive hand-foot-mouth disease, herpangina, rash, oral ulcers, and onychomadesis. The company’s first-generation EV71 vaccine achieved multinational phase III trials with up to 100% efficacy (statistical 96.8%) and has captured over 95% of Taiwan’s self-pay market, with nearly 600,000 doses administered, and Vietnam approved上市 in March. The multivalent vaccine will build on the platform, PIC/S GMP cell culture manufacturing, and international credentialing to meet domestic and international demand.

article.articleHeadline: US Restricts Commercial Flights From Congo Amid Ebola Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) continues to worsen, with Congolese authorities reporting 1,926 confirmed cases and 702 deaths across multiple provinces. In response, the United States imposes flight restrictions: U.S. citizens or nationals who have been in Congo within 21 days prior to departure are barred from boarding commercial flights bound for the United States. The policy also instructs Americans currently in the DRC to stay outside the country for at least 21 days before attempting to return. The measure applies regardless of citizenship. Dr. Daniel Jernigan described it as unprecedented for travelers with little infection risk, warning it could shift outbreak responsibilities abroad and hinder response recruitment. The restrictions reflect intensified border health controls amid the Congo Ebola crisis as of July 16, 2026.

article.articleHeadline: Thousands forced to use one water source from Ebola treatment site in Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: Two months into the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in eastern DRC, more than 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths have occurred across 42 health zones, per the DRC Ministry of Health, with about 70 new cases daily. The virus is spreading beyond the initial epicentre to Tshopo and Haut-Uélé provinces and Kisangani (a city of ~1.6 million), near South Sudan and the Central African Republic borders. Contact tracing stands at 80% (below 2018’s 90%), while health facilities in North Kivu and Ituri operate above 130% capacity, and workers report insufficient PPE. In Bunia, up to 20,000 people are forced to fetch drinking water from a single inside-treatment-centre source due to lack of alternatives, compromising transmission prevention. NGO outreach is only ~10% of targets; Oxfam warns funding shortages hinder response and calls for €10 million to restore water, sanitation and protective measures to contain spread.

article.articleHeadline: Due to Ebola, US restricts its citizens in Democratic Republic of Congo from immediate travel home
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) continues to expand, prompting the United States to restrict entry for US citizens and nationals who have been in the DRC within the past 21 days. Travelers will not be allowed to board US-bound flights and should plan to remain outside the DRC for 21 days before entering the United States. As of July 16, 2026, Doctors Without Borders (MSF) reports the epidemic advancing faster than containment, with confirmed infections surpassing 2,000. The virus has spread across 41 health zones two months after the outbreak began, according to a Health Ministry update. The latest tally shows 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths, a case fatality rate of 37.5%. The US restrictions accompany broader public health calls for expanded response to curb further transmission.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola breitet sich in Demokratischer Republik Kongo aus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spreads in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola spreads in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 2,011 infections and 754 deaths reported as of July 16, 2026. The outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo virus, is the fastest-growing since records began. About 90% of cases are concentrated in a province along the Uganda border, where conflict and limited healthcare access hinder containment. Case fatality varies by variant, cited at 25–90%. In Bunia General Hospital, the region’s largest medical center, staff recently went on strike over unpaid wages. The government reports 753 patients in isolation or in hospitals, and 366 have recovered. The WHO notes that at least 80% of new infections arise from unknown transmission chains, and authorities have not yet identified a Patient Zero in this outbreak.

article.articleHeadline: Có phải bệnh viêm não Nhật Bản tăng khi đến mùa quả vải?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Does Japanese encephalitis increase during lychee season?
article.articleSummary: Japanese encephalitis in Vietnam typically peaks May–July, aligning with lychee season, but fruit is not the source. Reservoirs include wild birds (waterfowl such as herons and egrets; cuckoo) with pigs as amplification hosts; Culex tritaeniorhynchus mosquitoes transmit the virus to humans. Transmission is not via eating lychee and there is no human-to-human spread. Incubation is 5–14 days (often ~7). Early manifestations: sudden high fever, headache, fatigue, vomiting; children may be irritable and eat poorly. Neurologic involvement causes neck stiffness, severe headache, vomiting, drowsiness, coma, seizures; fulminant disease can lead to meningitis, encephalitis, respiratory failure, multi-organ failure, shock, and death. No specific antiviral therapy; management is supportive. Prevention centers on vaccination and mosquito-control. Vaccines: Jevax (Vietnam) from 12 months via routine immunization with boosters every 3 years; Jeev (India) from 12 months via service vaccination with boosters during outbreaks or before exposure; Imojev (Thailand) from 9 months via service vaccination and does not require post-basic booster. Emphasize mosquito-bite precautions."

article.articleHeadline: Health Workers Strike in Congo's Ituri Province Over Unpaid Salaries Amid Ebola Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri Province persists since May 15, driven by a rare strain. In Bunia and Rwampara, frontline workers barricaded Bunia General Hospital amid a renewed strike over unpaid salaries, two months into the outbreak and two-and-a-half months after staff began duty. Health workers report no compensation despite high-risk Ebola response work, underscoring financial strain on care delivery and perceived pay inequities. The World Health Organization notes the outbreak is expanding, with at least 80% of new Ebola cases arising from unknown transmission chains, complicating containment. The strike highlights operational challenges for responders as transmission continues and staffing tensions persist. This developing situation underscores the need for timely remuneration to sustain frontline efforts while unknown-source transmission fuels ongoing spread.

article.articleHeadline: US imposes restrictions on Americans in Congo amid Ebola concern
article.articleSummary: US restricts entry for citizens and residents who have been in the Democratic Republic of the Congo within the previous 21 days, barring them from entering the United States by air and advising those who have been in DRC to stay outside the country for 21 days before attempting entry. The DHS measures accompany an ongoing Ebola outbreak in Congo, now with 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths across five provinces, led by the north-eastern Ituri region that borders Uganda and South Sudan. Uganda has reported Ebola cases, including two deaths. Ebola spreads through direct contact with infected people and bodily fluids. The Bundibugyo strain currently lacks a specific vaccine or targeted treatment; two antiviral therapies have been in clinical trials since early July, underscoring the outbreak's containment challenges.

article.articleHeadline: 国家疾控局：全国呼吸道传染病整体呈低流行水平
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: National Center for Disease Control and Prevention: Nationwide Respiratory Infectious Diseases Overall at a Low Epidemic Level.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-07-16, the National Center for Disease Control and Prevention reported nationwide respiratory infectious diseases remain at a low epidemic level, with COVID-19 also at a low level. Since summer, risks from vector-borne diseases have risen, and the risk of local transmission from imported cases increases. Southern provinces face aggregation risks for dengue fever and chikungunya fever. Rhinovirus and parainfluenza virus activity persists. Flood-control season enters the critical period 'seven-down, eight-up,' risking flood-related environmental hygiene problems, compromised food and drinking-water safety, and changes in the distribution and behavior of vectors and animal hosts. Affected areas face higher risks of gastrointestinal, respiratory, and vector-borne infections. Further updates and analyses are provided by Beijing Daily App.

article.articleHeadline: 新冠疫情升溫！門急診暴增34%　疾管署急籲快做「這1事」
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 on the rise! Outpatient and emergency visits surge 34%, Taiwan CDC urgently urges to do this one thing.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports rising COVID-19 activity. In week 27 (7/5–7/11), outpatient/emergency visits reached 2,811, up 34.4% from the prior week. Last week (7/7–7/13) added 17 new locally acquired severe cases; no new local deaths. Since October 2025, 136 local severe COVID-19 cases have been recorded, including 18 deaths, with 65+ seniors making up 72.1% of severe cases and 83.8% having chronic disease; 94.9% of these severe cases were unvaccinated for this season’s vaccine. Global circulation shows NB.1.8.1 as the dominant lineage, with rising cases in neighboring regions China, Hong Kong, Japan, Korea, and Singapore. By 7/12/2026, about 1.732 million seasonal vaccine doses have been administered; 65+ first-dose uptake is 20.97%, second-dose 0.51%. Public vaccination for those aged 6 months+ continues through 7/31/2026, with ~450,000 Moderna single-dose and ~6,000 Novavax doses in stock. Antivirals remain ample: Remdesivir, Paxlovid, and Xocova available; seek prompt medical evaluation for testing and potential antiviral treatment, and maintain masking in care facilities and crowded settings.

article.articleHeadline: Batam Leads Riau Islands in TB Cases: Community Task Forces Strengthened for 2030 Elimination Goal - Best Breaking News and Beyond: Singapore, Batam and some say JB
article.articleSummary: Batam remains the largest tuberculosis (TB) contributor in Indonesia's Riau Islands, prompting health authorities to strengthen community-based monitoring and prevention to meet the 2030 TB elimination target. Batam's high population density and mobility drive cases, making the city a critical focus in national TB control. Local authorities are expanding Kelurahan Siaga, community preparedness units, to become frontline defenders for early symptom identification and treatment adherence support. Health experts emphasize that TB is curable with early diagnosis; delays worsen outcomes and transmission. Treatment typically lasts several months, so sustained community support aids completion and reduces drug resistance. Indonesia aims to eliminate TB as a public health problem by 2030; achieving this requires cooperation among healthcare providers, local governments, and communities, especially in Batam. The report cites Batampos and Jawa Pos as sources; cross-border relevance with Indonesians and Singaporeans.

article.articleHeadline: US Says It Is Blocking Americans in DR Congo From Immediate Travel Home, Citing Ebola
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo triggers U.S. travel restrictions on Americans who have been in DRC within the previous 21 days. The State Department bars boarding of U.S.-bound commercial flights for travelers who spent time in the DRC in the 21 days before their flight, and advises U.S. citizens/national to remain outside the DRC for 21 days before entering the United States. The measure aims to curb cross-border transmission and potential imported cases. Congolese official data reported late Sunday show Ebola cases across the country at 1,926 with 702 deaths, as the outbreak spreads to multiple provinces. The article notes the restrictions are tied to the outbreak but does not provide details on symptoms, laboratory confirmation, or infection sources. Imported/exported case considerations are implied by the travel ban during the 21-day window.

article.articleHeadline: موارد ابولا در جمهوری کنگو از ۲۰۰۰ نفر گذشت
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in the Republic of the Congo surpassed 2,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Republic of the Congo (Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo provinces) caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus has surpassed 2,000 cases, with Ituri remaining the epicenter. To date, 366 patients have recovered, 753 are in isolation, and 754 have died. Transmission remains intense in Ituri, confirming it as the primary focus of spread, while new cases in Haut-Uele indicate geographic expansion that calls for urgent strengthening of surveillance, diagnostic capacity, and operational readiness. The outbreak is described as being in a sustained-transmission phase with a rapid rise in cases since its onset. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak was declared on May 15.

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola outbreak spreading faster than reported: UN
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak is accelerating; as of July 11 nearly 2,000 confirmed cases and more than 700 deaths across five provinces, making it the third-largest and fastest-growing Ebola epidemic in recent history. The outbreak centers in Ituri Province but has spread to Haut-Uele and Tshopo; about 95% of cases remain in Ituri. WHO cautions true case counts are likely 2–4 times higher than official figures, with more than 80 new infections in a 24-hour period recently. A critical concern is community deaths before care and undetected transmission, with ~80% of newly confirmed cases outside known contact lists. Healthcare workers have suffered: at least 112 infections and 35 deaths among frontline personnel. New EBO-PEP clinical trials launched in Ituri, recruiting nearly 1,000 high-risk contacts in DRC and Uganda; Africa CDC pledged $1M, with DR Congo/South Africa adding $5M. WHO views this as potentially game-changing.

article.articleHeadline: US imposes restrictions on Americans in Congo amid Ebola concern
article.articleSummary: US restricts entry for citizens and residents who have recently been in the Democratic Republic of the Congo within 21 days, barring boarding to the United States via commercial flights and advising a 21-day stay outside the DRC before entry. The move comes amid the Congo Ebola outbreak linked to the Bundibugyo strain, which currently has no vaccine or targeted treatment. The outbreak spans five provinces, with the north-eastern Ituri province as the center and Ituri's border with Uganda and South Sudan, where Uganda has also reported Ebola cases including two deaths. Congo's Information Ministry reports 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths as of July 16, 2026. Ebola spreads through direct contact with infected people and bodily fluids. Two antiviral therapies are in clinical trials since early July.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ懸念の中でコンゴ滞在歴のある米国人に渡航制限を課す
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（2,011症例、754死亡）が5州に拡大し、米国が渡航制限を課すなど国際的対応が発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数該当かつ社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも症例・死亡が報告されているが対象国リストにウガンダは含まれないため除外。米国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ワクチン・特異的治療法が存在しない致死率の高いブンディブジョ株によるアウトブレイクであり、致死率は約37.5%（754/2011）と高い。

article.articleHeadline: ההתפרצות המהירה בהיסטוריה: האבולה מתפשטת בקונגו - והעולם נדרך - וואלה חדשות
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Fastest Outbreak in History: Ebola Spreading in Congo — and the World Trembles
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo prompts a U.S. travel restriction: Americans in Congo or who traveled there must spend 21 days in a third country before boarding US-bound flights. The rule, tied to Ebola incubation, also covers travelers from Uganda and South Sudan, with exemptions for humanitarian missions and law enforcement. About 24 Americans who had been in Congo were slated to fly to the U.S. when the measure took effect; the State Department said it would assist during the waiting period. The policy uses a federal transportation authority to block boarding on health grounds, a shift from prior port-of-entry checks. Public health experts criticize the ban as potentially driving concealment and hindering aid, while the CDC says the risk to Americans is low and no U.S. Ebola cases have been confirmed. Congress seeks over $1.4 billion for outbreak response; Europe urges stronger controls and higher contributions.

triage.headline_ja: 史上最速の感染爆発：エボラ出血熱がコンゴで拡大——世界が震撼
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクを受け、米国が渡航制限を導入するなど国際的な対応が進んでおり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国での感染拡大を主題としており、米国・ウガンダ・南スーダンは渡航制限の適用範囲として言及されているのみで、発生国としては明記されていないため対象国リストからDRCのみを採用した。

article.articleHeadline: 登革熱、基孔肯雅熱由境外輸入及跨省傳播引起本地疫情風險上升 - 香港文匯報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever and chikungunya fever: local epidemic risk rising due to overseas importation and inter-provincial transmission - Wen Wei Po (Hong Kong).
article.articleSummary: As of 16 July 2026, China's CDC warns Dengue fever and Chikungunya fever pose rising local epidemic risks in China from overseas importation and inter-provincial transmission, with summer conditions favoring Aedes mosquitoes amid climate change. Global spread of these mosquito-borne diseases has expanded in tropical and subtropical regions, and imported cases, plus domestic spread, heighten the risk of local outbreaks. Key national actions include: 1) 依法防控: since 1 April 2026, Chikungunya is a Category B infectious disease with mandatory reporting, emergency response, and medical treatment. 2) 联防联控: strengthen border/public health cooperation with customs and immigration to monitor imports and quarantine arrivals. 3) 完善防控政策: publish the Dengue and Chikungunya Prevention and Control Plan (2026); pursue integrated surveillance and risk assessment, and timely delineate risk areas for vector control. 4) 常态化开展爱国卫生运动: environmental management, biological and physical vector control, with chemical measures as needed, mobilizing society to cut transmission.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱・チクングニア熱：海外からの輸入例および省をまたぐ伝播により、中国国内での流行リスクが上昇 - 香港文匯報
triage.triage_reason: 中国CDCが季節的なベクター媒介感染症（デング熱・チクングニア熱）のリスク上昇を注意喚起し予防計画を公表したものだが、具体的な症例数や重症度データが示されておらず、実際の国内アウトブレイク発生の確証はないため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 本記事は中国CDCによる予防計画・行政対応の発表が中心で、実際の症例数・重症度データは示されていない。季節性の輸入例増加によるリスク上昇の注意喚起であり、香港文匯報の報道は中国本土の状況を扱っているためChinaとして分類した。

article.articleHeadline: 流感等病毒活跃易中招，科学用药安心护娃
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza and other viruses are active; it's easy to get infected. Rational use of medicines to protect your child with peace of mind.
article.articleSummary: Influenza and other respiratory viruses remain active in summer, elevating pediatric infections. The surge is driven by indoor air conditioning use and crowded venues like indoor playgrounds and shopping malls, coupled with large outdoor–indoor temperature differences that stress children’s airways. Common symptoms include fever, cough, and sore throat. For fever, use child-appropriate ibuprofen or acetaminophen (paracetamol) with dosing by age/weight and avoid polypharmacy; employ physical cooling for low fever and intervene for high fever. For cough with phlegm, ambroxol hydrochloride oral solution (ambroxol) is described as suitable for children to relieve coughing and thin sputum, with dosing per medical guidance. Prevention emphasizes maintaining indoor temperatures at 25–27°C, regular ventilation, avoiding crowded indoor venues, and outdoor play when feasible; emphasize hand hygiene, hydration, light meals, and rest. Seek medical care if fever persists or symptoms worsen, or if there are breathing difficulties or vomiting.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザなどのウイルスが活発化、感染しやすい時期に。科学的な服薬で子どもを安心して守る
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザに関する一般的な健康啓発・家庭ケア記事であり、異常性や重症例の集積、国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 一般向け健康情報記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す内容ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Two months since the Ebola outbreak, response in Congo losing ground
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 1,963 confirmed cases, 719 deaths, and 333 recoveries as of July 14, 2026. Two months after the WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, the case fatality rate has risen to the mid-30s, and roughly 80% of new cases are detected outside known transmission chains, with many deaths occurring at home before care. Originating in Ituri’s remote gold-mining zones, the outbreak has spread to Haut-Uele and Tshopo provinces, including Kisangani, raising cross-border risks with Uganda and other neighbors. Uganda reports 20 cases and 2 deaths; no new Ugandan cases since June 30. France has one imported case who recovered. Africa CDC notes lab capacity expanding from about 30 to over 2,000 tests per day, but the virus remains ahead of the response. Health workers at Rwampara Ebola treatment center have threatened a strike over unpaid salaries, jeopardizing control efforts, while only about 40% of a $115 million appeal is funded.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ発生から2ヶ月、コンゴでの対応は後退している
triage.triage_reason: PHEICが既に宣言されたエボラ流行で、症例数・死亡率が拡大し続け、ウガンダ・フランスへの越境拡大も確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・フランスへの症例拡大も報告されているが、対象国リストにウガンダ・フランスは含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。既にWHOがPHEICを宣言済みの進行中流行であり、資金不足・医療従事者ストライキの懸念など管理面のリスクも高い。

article.articleHeadline: 国家疾控局：全国新冠病毒疫情目前处于低流行水平
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: National Center for Disease Control and Prevention: The nationwide COVID-19 outbreak is currently at a low level of transmission.
article.articleSummary: As of July 16, 2026, the National Center for Disease Control and Prevention reported nationwide COVID-19 activity at a low level, with rhinovirus and parainfluenza viruses showing limited activity. Summer conditions have boosted mosquito breeding and human mobility, increasing the risk of local transmission from imported cases. Southern provinces face potential clustered outbreaks of dengue fever and chikungunya. The country is in the monsoon flood season, with widespread floods that can compromise environmental hygiene and food and drinking-water safety. In flood-affected areas, vector and reservoir animal activity may change, elevating risks of gastrointestinal, respiratory, and vector-borne diseases. The briefing emphasizes surveillance and vigilance for imported cases seeding local transmission and highlights broader health threats during disasters.

triage.headline_ja: 国家疾病予防管理局：全国の新型コロナウイルス感染症の流行状況は現在低流行水準にある
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19は低流行水準であり、デング熱・チクングニア熱についても現時点では注意喚起レベルの一般的な情報提供にとどまり、具体的な異常事態や重大な公衆衛生上の影響は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 中国当局による定例の感染症サーベイランス報告であり、COVID-19は低水準、デング熱・チクングニアは夏季・洪水シーズンにおける一般的なリスク注意喚起にとどまる。具体的な症例数増加や集団発生の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: 中疾控：当前新冠疫情已演变为常见的呼吸道传染病
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China CDC: The current COVID-19 pandemic has evolved into a common respiratory infectious disease.
article.articleSummary: China’s COVID-19 situation has evolved into a common respiratory infectious disease, according to a China CDC briefing. Since October 2025, SARS-CoV-2 activity has remained at a low-level endemic for eight and a half months. A brief rise occurred in May 2026, but by mid-June activity had returned to low levels. Surveillance shows the dominant domestic lineage as NB.1.8.1-series variants; no newly detected strain presents additional public health risk. Authorities say routine fluctuations should not cause alarm. With summer travel and interregional movement increasing, the public should maintain good personal hygiene, including hand hygiene and cough etiquette, and ensure adequate rest. If fever or cough occurs, protect others, monitor health, seek medical care early, and follow medical advice for appropriate medication.

triage.headline_ja: 中国疾病予防管理センター：現在の新型コロナウイルス感染症流行は一般的な呼吸器感染症に移行した
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19は低いレベルの流行状態が続いており、新規変異株によるリスク増大もなく、当局も「警戒不要」と説明しているため、シグナルとしての緊急性はない。
triage.notes: 定例のサーベイランス報告であり、新規の公衆衛生リスクは確認されていない。

article.articleHeadline: US quarantine order for Americans returning from Congo will hurt Ebola response, aid group says
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Bundibugyo strain) has >1,900 confirmed cases and >700 deaths, making it the third-worst outbreak on record per WHO. U.S. policy now requires Americans returning from Congo to spend 21 days in a third country before entering the United States, replacing airport screenings with a do-not-board framework and potentially hindering response staffing. Samaritan’s Purse runs Ebola treatment centers in Bunia and Nyankunde with ~100 beds and has treated >270 patients; about 80 U.S. citizens are deployed there, and the 3-week quarantine adds costs and could reduce recruitment. A Kenya-based quarantine facility is being built, with exceptions on a case-by-case basis for humanitarian or law-enforcement needs. No U.S. cases have been confirmed and risk is described as low; the policy could still hinder on-the-ground care in Congo.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、コンゴ帰還者への隔離命令がエボラ対応に悪影響との支援団体の指摘
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が史上3番目の規模（症例数1,900超、死者700超）に達しており、米国が渡航制限（21日間隔離）を導入するなど国際的対応にも影響が及んでいるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 米国・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCでの流行が記事の主題であり、対応活動（Samaritan's Purseの治療センター等）への影響が焦点。

article.articleHeadline: Malaria and Dengue : मुंबईत मलेरिया, डेंग्यू, लेप्टोचे थैमान, मलेरिया ३,६८१, डेंग्यू ९३८, लप्टोच्या १५७ रुग्णांची नोंद!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria and Dengue: In Mumbai, malaria, dengue, the leptospirosis menace, malaria 3,681, dengue 938, leptospirosis 157 cases recorded!
article.articleSummary: Mumbai reports monsoon-driven outbreaks of malaria, dengue, leptospirosis, and other infections. From January to July 14, 2026: malaria 3,681; dengue 938; leptospirosis 157; gastroenteritis 3,866; H1N1 (Swine Flu) 113; chikungunya 31; COVID-19 71. Aedes and Anopheles larvae were found at 27,382 breeding sites; more than 3,000 construction sites were surveyed; 54,763 workers tested, 37 malaria cases detected. A citywide survey covered 3,681,683 residents, with over 1 million blood samples sent for testing. Although June was dry, July rains intensified transmission. Measures include removing stagnant items and tyres (66,595 removed), vector control, and public guidance: wash hands, maintain proper diet and rest. High-risk individuals—cancer, elderly, diabetes, hypertension, kidney disease—should seek medical advice for fever and avoid self-medication; visit local health centers promptly.

triage.headline_ja: マラリアとデング熱：ムンバイでマラリア、デング熱、レプトスピラ症が猛威、マラリア3,681件、デング熱938件、レプトスピラ症157件を記録！
triage.triage_reason: ムンバイにおける例年のモンスーン季節性感染症（マラリア・デング熱・レプトスピラ症等）の発生報告であり、地元当局による通常の対策（媒介動物駆除、検査拡大）が既に実施されている。異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: モンスーン季節に例年発生する媒介動物由来感染症（マラリア、デング熱、レプトスピラ症等）に関する地元メディアの定期報告。ムンバイ市当局による予防的サーベイランスと対策（幼虫発生源除去、建設現場労働者検査等）が既に進行中であり、通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Hepatitis-A, typhoid outbreak hits Kaithal village; 47 infected
article.articleSummary: As of 16 July 2026, Sajuma village in Kaithal district has an outbreak of Hepatitis A and typhoid with 47 residents infected this month (35 Hepatitis A, 12 typhoid). Affected individuals were identified after testing 109 residents out of about 1,500 households, with reports corroborating contamination of the drinking water supply. Several patients, including children, were hospitalized last week; a 12-year-old girl died during treatment, with final cause pending confirmation from PGIMER, Chandigarh. Health teams have deployed 24-hour medical teams and ambulances; free consultations, diagnostics and treatments, including liver function tests, Hepatitis A and typhoid checks, are being offered at temporary camps. Officials reviewed the village’s canal-based water project and directed a feasibility study to source drinking water from the Bhakra canal, plus repair/operation of the non-functional RO plant.

triage.headline_ja: A型肝炎・腸チフスの集団感染がカイタル村を襲う、47人感染
triage.triage_reason: 汚染された飲料水を原因とする村レベルの集団感染で、死亡例も出ているが地域当局が対応中であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。続報（原因確定・感染拡大の有無）を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 汚染飲料水を原因とする水系感染症の村単位のアウトブレイク。地元保健当局が医療チーム派遣・水道インフラ改善などで対応中。国際的な支援要請や渡航制限の兆候はなく、局地的な公衆衛生対応事案と判断される。
