article.articleHeadline: Congo Ebola outbreak disrupts US-backed minerals talks, threatening critical supply chains for crypto mining hardware
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo declared mid-May 2026 has infected 2,011 people and killed 754. As of July 11, the US Embassy in Kinshasa advised against all travel to the region, with entrants potentially facing 21-day quarantines. The epidemic disrupts US-backed efforts to secure access to DRC mineral wealth, undermining a planned US–DRC Critical Minerals partnership aimed at countering China’s influence. A Washington review of US company interests was postponed from June, with a July follow-up canceled; discussions have shifted to London and Paris, lacking on-the-ground project reviews. The DRC is the world’s top cobalt producer and second-largest copper supplier, and holds significant germanium, lithium, and tantalum deposits. Cobalt powers lithium-ion batteries; copper wires the electrical grid; germanium and tantalum support semiconductors and capacitors. Prices for cobalt and copper may rise if restrictions tighten, reinforcing Chinese-controlled supply chains and delaying mining equipment and crypto mining hardware markets.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行が米国支援の鉱物交渉を混乱させ、暗号資産マイニング用ハードウェアの重要サプライチェーンを脅かす
triage.triage_reason: DRCで2,011人感染・754人死亡という大規模なエボラ流行が発生し、米国大使館が渡航自粛勧告と21日間隔離措置を発出するなど、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的関心・対応を要する事態であるため。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はDRCでのエボラ流行が米国の鉱物資源交渉（コバルト・銅等の重要鉱物）に与える経済的影響であり、疾患自体の詳細（感染経路・国際拡大状況）は限定的。ワシントン・ロンドン・パリは交渉の場であり発生地域ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Svetu preti crni scenario: Zaraženi ebolom umiru po ulicama, novac ne stiže gde treba
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The world faces a grim scenario: Ebola-infected people are dying in the streets, money isn't reaching where it's needed.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak in Ituri Province has reached 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths, described as the fastest-growing epidemic on record. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain has no vaccine; control relies on testing, contact tracing, and isolation. Response is hampered by logistics, poor infrastructure, and armed groups, with about 900,000 people in displacement camps complicating surveillance. In Bunia, PPE is scarce and clinics are often closed for disinfection; remote areas face severe service gaps. WHO reports dozens of health workers infected and 25 deaths. Donors pledged over $1.2 billion, but only about $115 million has been disbursed. The outbreak began in Ituri with May 15 government declaration and May 17 WHO PHEIC; on July 9, authorities admitted the virus has spread to two additional provinces. By late June, a pregnant woman who died in Ituri was transported to Kisangani, indicating wider reach beyond Ituri, including Mongbvalu.

triage.headline_ja: 世界に迫る暗い未来:エボラ感染者が路上で死亡、資金が必要な場所に届いていない
triage.triage_reason: DRCのイトゥリ州で発生したエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）はWHOがPHEICを宣言し、症例数2,011人・死者754人と史上最速の拡大を見せ、複数州への拡大や資金不足による対応の遅れが報告されており、国際的な公衆衛生上の重大な懸念事案である。
triage.notes: WHOが2026年5月17日にPHEICを宣言済み。ワクチンが存在しないブンディブギョ株であること、900,000人規模の避難民キャンプでの監視困難、資金拠出率の低さ（12億ドルの誓約に対し実際は約1.15億ドル）が対応の重大な障害となっている。

article.articleHeadline: UNICEF Democratic Republic of the Congo Humanitarian Situation Report No. 1 - Ebola Outbreak (Bundibugyo Virus), 15 May-30 June 2026
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) persists as of 12 July 2026, with 1,963 laboratory-confirmed cases, 719 deaths and 333 recoveries across 42 health zones in five provinces (Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uélé, Tshopo). Ituri remains the epicenter with 1,772 cases and 608 deaths. First confirmed cases were reported 15 May 2026 in Bunia, Rwampara and Mongbwalu; WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on 17 May. National contact-tracing follow-up is 81.5% (Ituri 79.4%; North Kivu 90.5%). UNICEF-led actions include RCCE and IPC/WASH support: 5,740 frontline workers trained and messages reaching over 1 million people; about 27,000 household visits for active case finding. IPC/WASH measures cover seven Ebola Treatment Centres; IPC/WASH kits for 15 Ituri facilities; handwashing kits for 154 examination centres and 12 schools. MHPSS and child protection support serves 8,535 people; 240 children receive case management; three nurseries opened. Six-month funding needs total US$119.3 million; US$23.5 million mobilized by 30 June (80% gap). The response contends with insecurity, displacement and limited access, with spread to Haut-Uélé and Tshopo linked to Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: ユニセフ・コンゴ民主共和国 人道状況報告書No.1 - エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（ブンディブギョウイルス）2026年5月15日～6月30日
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言した継続中のエボラ（ブンディブギョウ株）アウトブレイクで、5州42保健区に拡大し死亡719例・致死率約37%と深刻。既存事象だが継続モニタリングのためフルRRA相当の注視が必要。
triage.notes: WHOは2026年5月17日にPHEICを宣言。Ituri州が中心（症例の90%以上）で、Haut-UéléおよびTshopoへの拡散が確認されている。Rwanda（Kigali Province）は発生地域リストに含まれるが対象国リスト外のため除外。資金ギャップ80%と治安・アクセス問題が対応の障壁。

article.articleHeadline: 國家疾控局：南方部分省份存在登革熱、基孔肯雅熱疫情風險
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: National CDC: Some southern provinces face the risk of dengue fever and chikungunya fever outbreaks.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever and chikungunya fever outbreaks are considered possible in southern provinces of China, according to the National CDC. With summer arrival and rising mosquito activity, increased population movement raises the risk that imported cases trigger local transmission, potentially forming clusters. Beijing spokesperson Xi Jingjing emphasized that southern areas face this risk of dengue and chikungunya outbreaks. Concurrently, national respiratory infections remain generally at low levels; rhinovirus and parainfluenza viruses show activity, while COVID-19 stays at low prevalence. China is in the peak flood season ('seven-down eight-up'), with frequent floods that can threaten environmental hygiene and food and drinking-water safety. Disaster-affected regions may experience higher risks of gastrointestinal, respiratory, and vector-borne diseases. The report underscores vigilance for imported cases and potential southern outbreaks during the summer monsoon.

triage.headline_ja: 国家疾病予防管理局：南部一部省份で登革熱・チクングニア熱の流行リスクあり
triage.triage_reason: 中国国家疾控局による季節性のリスク注意喚起であり、具体的な症例数や集団発生の確認情報がないため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 本記事は実際の症例発生報告ではなく、夏季・洪水シーズンにおける登革熱・チクングニア熱発生リスクについての国家疾控局の予防的注意喚起。具体的な感染者数や地域名（省名）の明記なし。今後の症例報告動向を注視する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: US to further restrict travel from DR Congo over Ebola
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has infected over 2,000 people with 754 deaths, across five provinces. WHO warns the outbreak could be 2–4 times larger than official figures. There is no approved vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo; a first antiviral drug trial began recently. In response, the United States will screen returning citizens departing the DRC and may issue Do Not Board orders, with a 21-day period outside the country before re-entry. Non-US nationals who have been in DRC were already barred from entry. The move seeks to reduce Ebola importation. The U.S. CDC under Title 42 and DHS under Title 49 coordinate the measures. Restrictions were in effect as of Monday, per authorities.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ出血熱を理由にコンゴ民主共和国からの渡航制限をさらに強化
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が2,000人以上感染・754人死亡と大規模化し、承認済みワクチン・治療薬がない中、米国が入国制限を実施するなど国際的対応が発生しているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 米国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めない。ブンディブギョ株には承認済みワクチン・治療薬がなく、WHOは実際の症例数が公式発表の2〜4倍の可能性があると警告しており、フルRRAでの詳細評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Gigitan Hewan Penular Rabies di NTT Tembus 835
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabies-transmitting animal bite cases in East Nusa Tenggara reach 835.
article.articleSummary: Rabies-transmitting animal bite cases in East Nusa Tenggara (NTT), Indonesia, have reached 835 as of July 4, 2026. Data from the NTT Health Office show the highest caseloads in Nagekeo (114), followed by Timor Tengah Utara (98), Ngada (79), Ende (71), and Timor Tengah Selatan (69). Rabies fatalities are reported in Sikka (8), Kupang (3), Timor Tengah Utara (2), and Malaka, Nagekeo, and Ende (1 each). Health authorities, led by Ruth D. Laiskodat, urge immediate wound cleansing with running water and soap for at least 15 minutes, then prompt medical care including rabies vaccination when indicated. Rabies can be transmitted via bites, scratches, or licking from infected dogs, cats, and monkeys. Citizens should avoid contact with abnormal or unknown animals and report bites to health or animal-health workers to enable treatment and surveillance. Emphasis on pet vaccination and post-bite services to curb suffering and deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 東ヌサトゥンガラ州における狂犬病媒介動物咬傷症例が835件に達す
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア東ヌサトゥンガラ州で狂犬病媒介動物による咬傷が835件、複数の死亡例が報告されているが、狂犬病は同地域の既知のエンデミック疾患であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はインドネシア東ヌサトゥンガラ州において既知のエンデミック疾患であり、地方保健当局が咬傷後の対応とペットワクチン接種を呼びかけている。人-人感染の可能性はなく、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威とは考えにくいが、死亡例の継続的発生には注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 登革热、基孔肯雅热由境外输入及跨省传播引起本地疫情风险上升
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever and chikungunya fever: increased local outbreak risk caused by overseas importation and inter-provincial transmission.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever and chikungunya fever at elevated risk of local outbreak in China due to overseas importation and inter-provincial spread. The China CDC notes that dengue and chikungunya are spreading globally in tropical and subtropical regions, with climate change expanding Aedes habitat. Increased cross-border travel raises imported cases and inter-provincial transmission risks; summer heat and heavy rainfall boost mosquito breeding. To address this, as of 1 April 2026, chikungunya fever is classified as a Class B infectious disease, with mandatory reporting, emergency response, and medical care. A new 2026 Dengue and Chikungunya Control Plan guides joint prevention across border ports and inland regions, ensuring unified monitoring, testing, and control for imported, cross-provincial, and local cases. Policy emphasizes early, targeted, stringent measures and reinforces patriotic health campaigns and vector control combining environmental management with biological/physical methods, and chemical control as needed.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱・チクングニア熱、海外からの輸入例と省をまたぐ伝播により国内アウトブレイクリスク上昇
triage.triage_reason: 具体的な症例数や発生地域の詳細がなく、中国CDCによる季節的リスク評価と予防計画の発表にとどまるため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 本記事は具体的な発生報告ではなく、中国CDCによる夏季のデング熱・チクングニア熱の輸入・伝播リスクに関する予防的政策発表（2026年新制御計画、チクングニア熱の法定伝染病分類変更）である。実際の症例数や発生地域の情報が含まれていないため、フルRRAへの移行は時期尚早と判断。

article.articleHeadline: 米、コンゴ民主共和国からの帰国制限　エボラ流行で21日待機義務化
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. imposes return restrictions on travelers from the Democratic Republic of the Congo; 21-day quarantine mandatory amid Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: On July 15, 2026, the United States imposed entry restrictions amid an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). U.S. citizens and dual nationals who have stayed in the DRC within the previous 21 days are barred from boarding U.S.-bound commercial flights, with the Embassy advising those travelers to remain outside the DRC for 21 days before attempting U.S. entry. The measure follows the widening outbreak across multiple provinces in the DRC. As of the night of July 12, Congolese official data reported 1,926 laboratory-confirmed Ebola infections and 702 deaths nationwide. The action aims to curb cross-border transmission during the ongoing outbreak, highlighting imported-exported risk and the need for precautionary quarantine-like delays for recent travelers.

triage.headline_ja: 米、コンゴ民主共和国からの帰国制限　エボラ流行で21日待機義務化
triage.triage_reason: DRCで多数の死者・感染者を伴うエボラ流行が拡大し、米国が渡航制限措置を実施するなどIHR基準に複数該当するためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 米国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCでの流行拡大と致死率の高さ（702/1926）が懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: 國家疾控局：南方部分省份 存在登革熱等疫情風險|香港經濟日報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: National CDC: Some Southern Provinces Face Dengue Fever and Other Epidemic Risks | Hong Kong Economic Daily
article.articleSummary: China's National CDC warns that after summer, mosquito breeding surges and higher population mobility raise the risk of local transmission of vector-borne diseases. In southern provinces, clustered outbreaks of dengue fever and chikungunya fever are possible. Climate change expands Aedes-suitable habitats, and cross-border travel heightens imported and local spread risk. Authorities will maintain legal prevention and response, ensure reporting, emergency management, and treatment, promptly detect and control outbreaks, and reinforce joint prevention and control mechanisms. They will strengthen port health cooperation, coordinate with customs and immigration, and boost imported-infection surveillance and entry screening to curb importation. Nationally, respiratory infections are generally at low levels; rhinovirus and parainfluenza activity persists, and COVID-19 remains at a low level. Flooding in many regions may raise environmental health risks and threaten food and drinking-water safety, increasing diarrheal, respiratory, and vector-borne disease risk in affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: 国家疾病予防管理局：南方の一部省でデング熱等の疫病リスクが存在
triage.triage_reason: 実際の症例発生ではなく中国疾病予防管理局による季節性のリスク注意喚起であり、具体的な患者数や地域拡大の証拠がないため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 本記事は中国疾病予防管理局による季節性のベクター媒介感染症（デング熱・チクングニア熱）リスクに関する予防的注意喚起であり、実際の集団感染確認情報ではない。具体的な症例数・発生省份・期間などの詳細が不明なため、続報の有無を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا.. الولايات المتحدة تمنع دخول القادمين من الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola.. The United States bars entry of those arriving from Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 July 2026, the United States barred entry for travelers who have been in the Democratic Republic of Congo within the preceding 21 days on commercial flights, aiming to curb Ebola transmission. The DHS and the US Embassy in Kinshasa advise American citizens and nationals who spent time in DRC to plan to stay outside the country for 21 days before entering the United States. In the DRC, Ebola cases exceed 2,000, with 2,011 confirmed and 754 deaths. The outbreak is being monitored in five provinces, with Ituri in the northeast the epicenter; Ituri borders Uganda and South Sudan, and Uganda has reported infections and fatalities. Ebola virus disease spreads via direct contact with patients or their body fluids. The current Bundibugyo strain has no specific vaccine or targeted treatment, though two antiviral therapies are in clinical trials since early July.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱:米国、コンゴからの入国者を禁止
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で2,000人超の感染・754人の死亡が報告され、ウガンダへの越境拡大と米国による渡航制限措置が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナルである。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの感染拡大が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。特異的なワクチン・治療法が未確立であり、国際的な対応の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en Congo rebasa 2.000 casos - Diario La R
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in Congo surpasses 2,000 cases - Diario La R.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 2,000 confirmed cases and 750 deaths as of July 16, 2026. The National Institute of Public Health (INSP) reports 2,011 cases and 754 deaths, with 753 patients in isolation or hospitalized and 366 discharged. Case fatality rate stands at 37.5% and contact tracing completion at 67.4%. Ituri remains the epicenter, accounting for most new infections, while South Kivu has shown no new confirmed cases for 47 days; however, Alto Uele (Haut-Uele) and Tshopo provinces have recently reported cases, signaling potential geographic spread. Doctors Without Borders (MSF) warns the outbreak is spreading at an unprecedented pace and urges intensified medical response in the DRC. Delays in action continue to cost lives, according to MSF's emergency coordinator.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行が2,000症例を突破 - Diario La R紙
triage.triage_reason: DRCで2,000例超・致死率37.5%のエボラ流行が拡大しており、新たな州への地理的拡大とMSFによる警告があるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: MSFが前例のない速度での拡大と対応の遅れによる死亡増加を警告。Haut-UeleおよびTshopo州への拡大が新たな懸念点。

article.articleHeadline: 国家疾控局：全国新冠疫情总体上处于低流行水平
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: National CDC: The nationwide COVID-19 epidemic is generally at a low level of transmission.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 in China remains generally at a low transmission level. Since October 2025, the domestic epidemic has persisted in an eight-and-a-half-month inter-epidemic period, with a May 2026 uptick and a return to low transmission by mid-June. National sentinel hospital SARS-CoV-2 testing positivity has risen recently, indicating a rebound but overall risk remains low. The dominant local strain remains NB.1.8.1 lineage; no new variants detected that would pose additional public health risk. COVID-19 has evolved into a common respiratory illness, so normal fluctuations do not require panic. With summer travel and increased cross-regional mobility, emphasize personal hygiene (hand hygiene, cough etiquette, ventilation). If respiratory symptoms occur, monitor health and seek medical care early and follow medical advice.

triage.headline_ja: 国家疾控局：全国新型コロナウイルス感染症の流行状況は総体的に低流行水準にある
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19は既に通常の呼吸器疾患として扱われており、全国的に低流行水準で新規変異株の検出もなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 定例のサーベイランス報告であり、季節性の変動範囲内。新規懸念すべき変異株や重症化増加の報告なし。

article.articleHeadline: 白喉全球多地反弹，京东互联网医院提醒：接种疫苗是核心、疑似症状早就医
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Diphtheria resurges in many parts of the world; JD Health Internet Hospital reminds: vaccination is the key, and seek medical care promptly for suspected symptoms.
article.articleSummary: Diphtheria resurges; Nigeria and Australia report cases since 2025, with outbreaks and case fatality up to 14.3%. China has had about two decades without locally acquired diphtheria, but importation risk remains. Caused by Corynebacterium diphtheriae, the disease can release toxins damaging the respiratory tract, heart, and nerves. Early symptoms resemble a cold, but red flags include fever, sore throat, and a gray pseudomembrane; membrane fragments can obstruct the airway between days 7–10. About 20% of cases are cutaneous or ocular. Transmission is by close contact; untreated disease has high mortality. Vaccination with diphtheria vaccines is the key preventive measure. China’s program since Jan 1, 2025 uses the DTaP schedule at 2, 4, 6, 18 months and 6 years, with boosters every 10 years; travelers should verify vaccination and may need pre-travel boosters. Seek prompt medical care for suspected symptoms; treatment includes antitoxin and antibiotics. JD Health Internet Hospital offers 24/7 online triage and AI-assisted guidance.

triage.headline_ja: 白喉が世界各地で再流行、京東互聯網医院が注意喚起：ワクチン接種が核心、疑わしい症状は早期受診を
triage.triage_reason: 記事はナイジェリア・オーストラリアでの流行を受けた中国向けの一般的な健康啓発・予防啓発記事であり、中国国内では約20年間ジフテリアの自国内感染例がないと明記されている。対象国での実際の発生・アウトブレイクを報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事で言及される実際の流行地はナイジェリアとオーストラリアであり、いずれも対象国リストに含まれない。中国については輸入リスクへの注意喚起のみで、局所感染例の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Un virus mortel a décimé l'Australie au XVIIIe siècle: il aurait été introduit par les médecins, selon une étude
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A deadly virus decimated Australia in the 18th century: it is believed to have been introduced by physicians, according to a study.
article.articleSummary: Smallpox decimated Aboriginal Australia in the late 18th century, likely arriving with the First Fleet that landed in Sydney in January 1788 to establish a penal colony. A new study tests two introduction routes—British settlers in Sydney or Indonesian fishermen in the north—using population, mortality, and migration data. Researchers propose the virus could have survived on variola crusts used for inoculation before the 1796 vaccine; crust powder from terminal patients rubbed into scratches. While Royal Navy ships did not routinely carry variola material, at least one surgeon may have obtained it en route near Rio de Janeiro or the Cape. There is no written evidence of deliberate dissemination, and Governor Arthur Phillip is unlikely to have orchestrated such an effort. Precolonial Aboriginal population now estimated at 2–3 million, not 200k–800k, with about 2.4 million additional deaths linked to disease and early 19th-century colonization.

triage.headline_ja: 18世紀オーストラリアを壊滅させた致死性ウイルス:研究によれば医師によって持ち込まれた可能性
triage.triage_reason: 18世紀の歴史的出来事に関する研究記事であり、現代の公衆衛生上の脅威ではないため。
triage.notes: 本記事は1788年の第一船団によるオーストラリア天然痘流行の歴史的起源に関する学術研究の紹介であり、現在進行中の感染症イベントではない。対象国リストに該当する現代の発生国はなし。

article.articleHeadline: 國家疾控局：全國新冠疫情總體上處於低流行水平 - 香港商報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: National CDC: The nationwide COVID-19 outbreak is generally at a low level of transmission.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever and chikungunya outbreaks risk clusters in southern provinces as mosquito breeding and population movement rise. Imported cases raise local transmission risk. Nationwide COVID-19 remains at a low level, with rhinovirus and parainfluenza viruses showing ongoing activity. The summer flood season ('seven down eight up') has caused floods in multiple areas, potentially compromising food and drinking-water safety and altering vector and host animal activity. This raises risks of gastrointestinal, respiratory, and vector-borne diseases in disaster-affected regions and among travelers. The authorities emphasize science-based prevention during the summer, strengthened surveillance, and measures to mitigate environmental health hazards and disease transmission from disasters and imported cases.

triage.headline_ja: 国家疾病予防管理局：全国の新型コロナウイルス感染症は総じて低い流行レベルにある
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19は低流行水準で沈静化しているが、南部でのデング熱・チクングニア熱の集団発生リスクや洪水による媒介生物感染症・水系感染症リスクの上昇が指摘されており、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: COVID-19自体は低水準の定例報告であり主要懸念ではない。デング熱・チクングニア熱の輸入症例と国内伝播リスク、洪水による衛生環境悪化が今後の焦点となる可能性があり、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 에볼라 확산세 지속...국경없는의사회, 국제 지원 확대 촉구
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak continues to spread... Doctors Without Borders urges expanded international assistance.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached nearly 2,000 confirmed cases and over 700 deaths as of July 12, two months after official declaration. Most cases (~90%) are in Ituri Province, with spread to North Kivu, South Kivu, and Tshopo. MSF warns that surveillance, diagnosis, and treatment capacities are insufficient and access is limited, especially outside major city centers. Ayokunnu Raji says many patients arrive in severe condition; expanding facilities could curb transmission and fatalities. MSF runs seven Ebola treatment centers and more than 15 isolation wards across four provinces, about 430 beds, and has treated 968 patients (including 357 confirmed) up to July 14. The crisis unfolds amid conflict, displacement, and concurrent cholera and malaria responses; the rainy season is expected to raise malaria burdens. Trish Newport calls for expanded international assistance and freer movement of medical staff.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ拡大続く…国境なき医師団、国際支援の拡大を要請
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョウイルス）がDRCで約2000症例・700人超の死亡に達し、複数州に拡大。コレラ・マラリアも同時発生し公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際支援が必要な状況。
triage.notes: MSFが国際支援拡大を要請しており、紛争・避難民状況下でコレラ・マラリアとの同時流行が医療体制を圧迫している。フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Ebola Cases in DRC May Be Four Times Official Tally, Says Who
article.articleSummary: DRC Congo’s 17th Ebola outbreak, declared 15 May in Ituri, is caused by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus (no approved vaccine or treatment). Official counts show about 1,960 infections and over 700 deaths since detection two months ago, with cases also identified in Uganda. WHO modelling suggests true numbers may be two to four times higher, and the outbreak is spreading faster than ever, ranking as the third-largest. More than 90% of cases are in Ituri across five DRC provinces; Uganda reports cross-border transmission. Transmission occurs via close contact and infected bodily fluids; many deaths occur in communities before reaching care. Response is ramping up: treatment capacity >700 beds, expanded laboratories, and roughly 80% contact-follow-up. Recently, over 80 cases were confirmed in a single day. US travel bans block citizens in the DRC from returning on flights; non-citizens who visited DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan are restricted.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ感染者数は公式集計の4倍に上る可能性があるとWHOが発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、致死率の高いエボラ出血熱がウガンダへ越境拡大し米国が渡航制限を実施するなど、国際的関心・対応の必要性が極めて高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも症例が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。WHOはDRCの実際の感染者数が公式発表の2〜4倍に上る可能性を指摘しており、ワクチン・治療薬未承認のブンディブギョ株による第17次アウトブレイクである。

article.articleHeadline: بسبب تفشي إيبولا.. أمريكا تفرض قيودا مشددة على المسافرين القادمين من الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Due to an Ebola outbreak, the United States imposes strict restrictions on travelers arriving from Congo.
article.articleSummary: United States tightens travel rules amid Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. On 2026-07-16, U.S. authorities may bar citizens who have traveled to the DRC from re-entering the United States until 21 days have elapsed since they left the outbreak epicenter, to curb Ebola transmission. The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) will conduct testing that could trigger additional travel restrictions on some passengers on commercial flights. A 'no-boarding' mechanism has been activated in coordination with the Department of Homeland Security. The measures aim to limit spread from travelers linked to the Congo outbreak, with potential return travel restrictions for exposed individuals.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行を受け、米国がコンゴからの入国者に厳格な渡航制限を課す
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行を受け、米国が入国制限・搭乗拒否措置を発動しており、IHR基準（渡航制限、国際的拡大リスク）に複数該当するためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 記事は米国の渡航制限措置に焦点を当てているが、流行の発生源はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）であり、米国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCでの流行の詳細（症例数、致死率等）は記事に記載がなく不明。

article.articleHeadline: U.S. renews Ebola travel rules for citizens leaving DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) caused by Bundibugyo Ebola virus has reached 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths as of Tuesday. The United States expands Ebola-related travel controls: the CDC and Department of Homeland Security may issue DO NOT BOARD (DNB) orders for American citizens departing the DRC, with allowed return to the United States 21 days after departure. In parallel, the CDC temporarily restricts entry for travelers who have recently been in the DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan; those from Uganda and South Sudan within the past 21 days will be rerouted to designated airports for public health entry screening. The Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak has no approved vaccine or specific treatment. These measures reflect ongoing outbreak management and heightened health screening for imported/exported travel linked to the DRC situation.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、コンゴ民主共和国からの出国者に対するエボラ渡航規制を更新
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのブンディブギョ型エボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが2,011症例・754死亡に達し、致死率が高く、承認ワクチン・治療法がない中、米国が渡航制限を実施しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 米国・ウガンダ・南スーダンは記事に言及されるが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ワクチン・治療法がないブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスによる大規模アウトブレイクであり、致死率約37%と極めて深刻。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: 'In the DRC, Containing Ebola Requires Stronger Collective Action and a Faster Response'
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo remains a spreading outbreak, now affecting five provinces—Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uélé and Tshopo—with 2,111 confirmed cases and 750 deaths as of July 13. UNICEF Regional Director Gilles Fagninou, returning from Ituri, says the epidemic can be contained only with faster, more collective action. The response is hampered by conflict, displacement and limited access, increasing urgency. UNICEF focuses on four priorities: mobilizing communities and countering misinformation, strengthening infection prevention and control, protecting affected children, and expanding community-based surveillance. In Bunia, a three-month-old who recovered and a nine-month-old child who lost both parents illustrate the value of psychosocial support and protection services. Ebola cannot be treated in isolation; the response must align with other emergencies such as malnutrition, cholera, polio, and displacement while maintaining essential services. Only about 25% of required funding is available, highlighting the need for rapid resources and sustained solidarity.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:『DRCにおけるエボラ封じ込めには、より強力な連携行動と迅速な対応が必要』
triage.triage_reason: DRCで5州にまたがるエボラ流行が拡大中で、2,111症例・750死亡と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、紛争・避難民問題により対応が困難で資金も不足しているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: エボラは5州（Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uélé, Tshopo）に拡大しており、コレラ・ポリオ・栄養失調など他の緊急事態とも重複。資金は必要額の約25%のみ確保されている状況。

article.articleHeadline: Bé gái 5 tuổi nhiễm "siêu vi khuẩn", gặp nguy hiểm vì món ăn vặt ngọt mát mùa hè người lớn còn mê
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Five-year-old girl infected with a 'superbug' is at risk due to sweet, cooling summer snacks that adults still love.
article.articleSummary: A five-year-old girl in Hong Kong contracted Shiga-toxin–producing Escherichia coli (E. coli O157:H7) after eating ice cream at a local restaurant during a summer trip to Zhanjiang, Guangdong, China. She presented with vomiting, diarrhea, and severe abdominal pain; laboratory tests confirmed E. coli infection with the Shiga toxin, raising risk of acute kidney injury. The Hong Kong Centre for Health Protection notes a 2–10 day incubation (typically 3–4 days) and that symptoms include diarrhea (often with blood), abdominal cramps, and dehydration. She was admitted to The Chinese University of Hong Kong Hospital; nephrology input and readiness for dialysis or plasma exchange were in place, but her condition improved by evening and she was discharged with home treatment. Officials warn ice-cream–associated E. coli infections can occur, especially in children during summer, underscoring safe handling of dairy products.

triage.headline_ja: 5歳の女児が「スーパー細菌」に感染、大人にも人気の甘くて冷たい夏のおやつが原因で危険な状態に
triage.triage_reason: 香港在住の児童1名の散発的な腸管出血性大腸菌(O157)感染例であり、アイスクリームが原因とみられる個別の食中毒事例。患者は回復・退院しており、アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の広範な脅威を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 単一症例の報道であり、広東省湛江での喫食が発症契機とされるが、感染源の特定や他患者の発生報告はない。香港衛生防護センターの一般的な注意喚起にとどまる。

article.articleHeadline: Karnataka intensifies COVID-19 screening at border as Andhra reports third virus-related death
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 surveillance has been intensified along the Karnataka–Andhra Pradesh border after Andhra Pradesh reported its third COVID-19–related death and three new infections, raising active cases to 11. In Karnataka, authorities at Pavagada in Tumakuru district stepped up screening, stopping entering vehicles, checking for fever, recording travel history, and providing initial care; five additional screening centers were opened besides the Rajavanthi entry point. In Andhra Pradesh, the 66-year-old man with respiratory illness, pneumonia, diabetes, hypertension and kidney disease died after testing positive earlier in the month, with officials saying death was linked mainly to underlying conditions. Two other deaths occurred in YSR Kadapa and Annamayya districts. Three new cases were detected—two at AIIMS Mangalagiri and one at King George Hospital in Visakhapatnam; the Visakhapatnam patient had recently travelled to Hyderabad and is stable. Rapid response teams are deployed; experts cite vaccination and prior infections providing hybrid immunity, limiting large-scale risk.

triage.headline_ja: アーンドラ・プラデーシュ州で3人目のCOVID-19関連死、カルナータカ州は州境での検疫を強化
triage.triage_reason: 既知の疾患であり、症例数・死亡数は限定的で基礎疾患を有する患者が中心。専門家も大規模流行リスクは低いと評価しており、通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内と考えられる。
triage.notes: 死亡例は基礎疾患（糖尿病、高血圧、腎疾患）を有する患者であり、COVID-19単独の重症度評価は困難。活動性症例数は11例と少なく、既存の監視体制内での対応が行われている。

article.articleHeadline: Angry backlash as US bars citizens from entering directly from Congo's Ebola zone
article.articleSummary: New US policy bars Americans returning from Congo's Ebola zone from boarding US-bound flights, requiring 21 days in a third country before entry; humanitarian or law-enforcement exceptions possible. The Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak, tied to the Bundibugyo strain, has surpassed 1,900 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and over 700 deaths, the third-worst outbreak on record per WHO. The policy affects travelers from Congo and also some from Uganda and South Sudan; others remain subject to airport screening. Samaritan's Purse, led by Franklin Graham, operates Ebola treatment centers in Bunia and Nyankunde with about 100 beds, having treated over 270 patients; roughly 80 US citizens are deployed. Graham warns the three-week separation will hinder staff recruitment and raise transfer/quarantine costs. CDC officials say no cases in the US and risk remains low; a Kenyan quarantine center is being built to support isolation.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、コンゴのエボラ発生地域からの入国を禁止し反発招く
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラアウトブレイクは1,900例以上・死者700人超でWHO史上3番目に深刻な流行とされ、米国が渡航制限を実施するなど国際的な影響が拡大しているため。
triage.notes: 米国、ケニア、ウガンダ、南スーダンなど周辺国・域外国への影響も報告されているが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。ケニアは隔離施設建設中だが発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 新冠病例为何又多了起来 多重因素叠加导致
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Why COVID-19 Cases Have Increased Again: The Accumulation of Multiple Factors.
article.articleSummary: June 2026, China reports 79,000 new confirmed COVID-19 cases across 31 provinces and the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps, with 130 severe cases and 1 death attributed to preexisting conditions. The monthly total nearly tripled from May, and daily cases approached 6,000 by month’s end. Syndromic surveillance of influenza-like illness shows SARS-CoV-2 positivity rising from 2.9% to 6.4% during weeks 23–26; fever outpatients increased from 58,000 to 65,000, yet no explosive surge, indicating low-level circulation. Beijing You’an Hospital infectious disease expert Li Tongzeng attributes the rebound to multiple factors, not increased virulence: waning immunity with more susceptible individuals; hot summer conditions with air conditioning and reduced ventilation; temperature fluctuations weakening mucosal defenses; increased summer travel and indoor gatherings; and co-circulation with influenza, rhinovirus, and human metapneumovirus. The findings come from the national COVID-19 epidemic Situation report for June 2026 by China CDC.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナウイルス感染症の症例数がなぜ再び増加しているのか：複数要因の重なりが原因
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19症例数の季節的な増加であり、専門家により免疫低下・気候要因等の複数要因で説明可能な予想範囲内の変動と分析されている。重症化率・死亡率も低く、爆発的増加もないため深刻性・異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 中国CDCによる月次定例サーベイランス報告であり、専門家が季節性要因（免疫低下、エアコン使用、気温変動、夏季の人流増加、他の呼吸器感染症との共循環）による説明可能な低水準の流行と位置づけている。重症例130件、死亡1件（基礎疾患要因）のみで爆発的増加なし。継続的なモニタリング対象ではあるが、フルRRAを要する新規性・深刻性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: मुंबईत मलेरिया, डेंग्यूचे थैमान! डेंग्यूच्या रुग्णांमध्ये २८ तर मलेरियाच्या रुग्णांमध्ये १८ टक्क्यांनी वाढ; आजारांमुळे पालिका प्रशासनाची धावपळ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria and dengue wreak havoc in Mumbai! Dengue cases rise by 28%, malaria cases by 18%; the civic administration is scrambling to cope with the diseases.
article.articleSummary: Malaria, dengue, and leptospirosis are afflicting Mumbai during the monsoon. From January to July 14, 2026, malaria totaled 3,681 cases; dengue 938; leptospirosis 157; gastroenteritis 3,866; jaundice 866; chikungunya 31; and COVID-19 co-infections 71; A(H1N1) influenza rose to 113 cases (from 42). Despite relatively low rainfall this year, vector-borne diseases surged after July rains, with July’s first two weeks doubling counts. A city-wide survey covered 3,681,683 residents; 10,472 blood samples were sent to labs. Mosquito breeding sites included Anopheles 5,341 and Aedes 22,041; 66,595 sites with discarded tires or standing water were cleared. Among 54,763 workers tested from over 3,000 construction sites, 37 malaria cases were detected. Health authorities urge handwashing, proper nutrition and rest, and warn high-risk groups to seek prompt medical care and avoid self-medication, visiting municipal health centers if fever arises.

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイでマラリアとデング熱が猛威！デング熱患者28%増、マラリア患者18%増；市当局は対応に追われる
triage.triage_reason: モンスーン期のムンバイにおける媒介動物媒介疾患（マラリア、デング熱、レプトスピラ症等）の季節的増加であり、既知の毎年発生するパターンだが、患者数増加率が高く動向注視が必要。
triage.notes: モンスーン期にムンバイで例年発生する媒介動物媒介疾患の増加報告。市当局（BMC）は蚊の発生源除去や住民調査など対応中で、外部支援の必要性は示唆されていない。ただし増加率（デング熱28%、マラリア18%）は注視に値する。

article.articleHeadline: Pasay pushes health habits vs Covid-19
article.articleSummary: Pasay City intensifies its EMI Habit public health campaign—wash hands regularly, wear a mask when feeling unwell, and rely on official updates—to guard against Covid-19, even as the city remains classified as low risk. Mayor Emi Calixto Rubiano cited reports of Covid-19 cases in neighboring cities and urged continued adherence to simple health practices as the best defense. The city remains vulnerable due to daily influx of workers, tourists, commuters, and travelers passing through airports, transport terminals, and business centers. The City Epidemiology and Surveillance Unit (CESU) has intensified monitoring of Covid-19 and other communicable diseases to ensure early detection and rapid intervention. Rubiano emphasized readiness to respond quickly to any reported case and urged residents not to be complacent, particularly when unwell, to keep Pasay safe and healthy.

triage.headline_ja: パサイ市、新型コロナウイルス対策として健康習慣を推進
triage.triage_reason: 低リスク地域における通常の公衆衛生啓発活動の報道であり、異常な増加や深刻な影響を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 市当局による予防的な健康キャンペーンの報道であり、具体的な症例数や急増を示すデータは記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: U.S. renews Ebola travel rules for citizens leaving DR Congo
article.articleSummary: U.S. Ebola travel rules for citizens leaving the Democratic Republic of the Congo are renewed, per the 2026-07-16 publication. The body reports a Swakopmund, Namibia event on 15 July 2026—an opening session for the Effective Communicators Conference in Swakopmund—featuring a special APRA Panel Discussion with Irene Lungu, Director of Commercial for Zambia’s Zaffico; Professor Emmanuel Dandaura, Vice President of the Nigerian Institute of Public Relations; and Shoki Kandjimi, PetroFund Head of Communications and Stakeholder Engagement, moderated by Dr Omoniyi Ibietan. No Ebola case counts, symptoms, laboratory confirmation, infection sources, or other outbreak details are provided. The article does not elaborate on policy specifics beyond the headline. The piece juxtaposes a health-travel policy topic with a regional conference agenda, highlighting public communications professionals and cross-border ties in the region.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、コンゴ民主共和国出国者に対するエボラ渡航規則を更新
triage.triage_reason: 米国のDRC向けエボラ渡航規則の更新を報じるのみで、具体的な症例数・発生状況などの新規アウトブレイク情報が一切含まれていないため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCからの出国者に対する米国のエボラ渡航規則更新を報じるのみで、具体的な症例数や発生状況の詳細は記載されていない。ナミビア・ザンビア・ナイジェリアの言及は無関係な会議に関するもので、エボラ発生地域とは無関係。

article.articleHeadline: В России оценили вероятность новой пандемии из-за Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia assessed the likelihood of a new Ebola pandemic.
article.articleSummary: Ebola remains a highly dangerous disease, but Russian academician Gennady Onishchenko says a new global pandemic is unlikely. He points to an existing vaccine and notes that Ebola spreads mainly via direct contact, not through respiratory transmission, so it does not possess pandemic characteristics. The World Health Organization has declared the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, with a high risk of regional spread. The article reports that the death toll in the DRC has surpassed 750. These statements reflect the situation as of 2026-07-16, outlining ongoing concerns and containment considerations for Ebola in the region.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア、エボラによる新たなパンデミックの可能性を評価
triage.triage_reason: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダのエボラ流行をPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）に指定し、死者750人超・地域拡大の高リスクが報告されており、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はロシアの専門家によるパンデミックリスク評価だが、DRC・ウガンダでのエボラ流行がWHOによりPHEICに指定され死者750人超と報告されている点が重要情報。ウガンダとロシアは対象国リスト外のためverified_locationsから除外。続報でDRCの詳細な感染状況・封じ込め対策の進捗を確認する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: TSPCA เตือนโรคอุบัติใหม่จากสัตว์สู่คน พร้อมย้ำให้ดูแลสัตว์อย่างเข้าใจ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: TSPCA warns of emerging zoonotic diseases from animals to humans, and reiterates the need to care for animals with understanding.
article.articleSummary: Thailand’s TSPCA and Mahidol University’s Faculty of Veterinary Medicine warn of emerging zoonotic diseases jumping from animals to humans, a trend reflected in global data: over 60% of new human pathogens originate in animals, and more than 70% come from wildlife. Notable examples include novel influenza, avian influenza, SARS, MERS, COVID-19, and monkeypox. The spillover is driven by human-driven bridges—deforestation, habitat loss, dam and road construction, and expanded wildlife trade (legal and illegal)—which increase contact between people and diverse wildlife and facilitate viral exchange. The response emphasizes One Health: human, animal, and environmental health are interdependent. Public actions include avoiding wildlife contact, practicing hygiene (eat hot foods, use clean utensils, wash hands), maintaining tidy homes to deter pests, and responsible wildlife viewing (distance, no chasing, no feeding). The organizations advocate education on humane animal care to prevent cruelty and disease transmission.

triage.headline_ja: TSPCA、動物から人へ感染する新興人獣共通感染症について警告し、動物への理解あるケアを改めて呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 特定の発生事例ではなく、人獣共通感染症全般に関する一般的な啓発・教育記事であり、具体的な症例報告や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報がない。
triage.notes: 本記事はタイ動物福祉協会(TSPCA)とマヒドン大学獣医学部による一般的な啓発活動であり、具体的な発生事例やアウトブレイクの報告ではない。特定の疾患発生に関する情報が含まれていないため、トリアージ対象外と判断。

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、最後のエボラ患者を退院させ、42日間の無感染宣言に向けたカウントダウンを開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCで2,011例・754人死亡という大規模なエボラ流行が続いており、WHOにより既にPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）が宣言されている重大事案であるため。
