article.articleHeadline: Uganda to discharge last Ebola patient, spokesperson says
article.articleSummary: Uganda is set to discharge its last Ebola patient on July 16, 2026, at Mulago National Referral Hospital, triggering a 42-day countdown after which, if no new cases emerge, the WHO could declare Ebola-free in Uganda. The broader outbreak is in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), where the WHO declared a public health emergency in May. As of Wednesday, the DRC reported 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths. In Uganda, the online health ministry portal shows 17 recoveries, one current isolation admission, and two deaths, with five locally acquired and 15 imported cases. All cases are linked to the rare Bundibugyo strain, described by WHO as the third-worst outbreak on record. Spokesperson Alan Kasujja noted the discharge would start the 42-day clock necessary for the potential outbreak finish declaration under WHO guidelines.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、最後のエボラ患者を退院させる予定と広報担当者が発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCでWHOが公衆衛生緊急事態を宣言した大規模エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（確定症例2,011件、死亡754人）が継続中であり、稀なブンディブギョ株による史上3番目に深刻な流行とされ、国際的拡大（ウガンダへの越境）も確認されているため。
triage.notes: ウガンダは記事の主題の一部だが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。主流行地であるDRCのみを記載。DRCの状況は依然深刻で、WHOのPHEIC宣言下にあるため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Megkezdődött a feszült visszaszámlálás: végleg legyőzheti a halálos vírust az afrikai ország
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The tense countdown has begun: the African country could finally defeat the deadly virus.
article.articleSummary: Uganda began a 42-day countdown toward an official Ebola-free status after releasing the last patient from Mulago National Hospital’s isolation ward in Kampala on July 16, 2026. WHO-guided protocol requires 42 consecutive days without a new case to declare elimination. Uganda’s health ministry reports 17 recoveries, one person still in isolation, and two deaths. Of the infections, five were locally acquired and fifteen were imported from abroad; all cases are linked to the Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain, one of the rarer and more severe variants. The country’s outbreak is part of a broader crisis in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, where, according to government data, 2,011 confirmed infections and 754 deaths have occurred during the ongoing outbreak; the WHO had declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern in May last year. If no new cases emerge, Uganda could be declared outbreak-free after the countdown.

triage.headline_ja: 緊張の中で始まったカウントダウン：アフリカの国がついに死のウイルスを克服できるか
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の複数該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常事象、国際的拡大）に加え、WHOがPHEICを宣言した進行中のDRCエボラ流行の一部であり、社会的関心も高いためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダの流行終息（42日間カウントダウン開始）を主題としているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ただし記事はこの流行がDRCで進行中の大規模エボラ流行（2,011症例、754死亡、WHO PHEIC宣言）の一部であると明記しており、DRCを主題国として含めた。ウガンダ側の感染者数（17回復、1隔離中、2死亡、輸入例15/自国内5）は限定的で管理下にあるが、DRC側の流行は依然深刻。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda to Discharge Last Ebola Patient, Spokesperson Says
article.articleSummary: Uganda is set to discharge its last Ebola patient on July 16, 2026, starting a 42‑day countdown required before the WHO can declare the country Ebola‑free. The broader outbreak linked to the Bundibugyo virus strain has caused 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) as of Wednesday. In Uganda, recoveries total 17, with one current admission in Mulago National Referral Hospital’s isolation unit and two deaths. Of Ugandan cases, five were locally acquired and 15 imported. The WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern for the DRC outbreak in May, and authorities describe Bundibugyo infections as the third‑worst outbreak on record. If no new cases arise in 42 days, Uganda would be declared Ebola‑free.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、最後のエボラ患者を退院させる予定と広報担当者が発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクはWHOがPHEICを宣言済みで、2,011例・754死亡と深刻。ウガンダへの越境感染も発生しており国際的拡大のリスクが現実化しているため。
triage.notes: ウガンダ(Uganda)は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。記事はDRCで発生中のアウトブレイクがウガンダへ越境した状況を報じており、DRCが主たる発生地域である。

article.articleHeadline: エボラ出血熱の症例2000件超、死者754人に 流行は前例ないペースで拡大
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over 2,000 cases of Ebola hemorrhagic fever, with 754 deaths; the outbreak is expanding at an unprecedented pace.
article.articleSummary: As of July 15, 2026, Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 2,000 cases with 754 deaths. The World Health Organization cautions official counts may be two to four times higher. Congo health authorities report spread across five provinces. Médecins Sans Frontières warns the outbreak is expanding into new regions at an unprecedented pace and calls for a rapid scale-up of medical response. The current outbreak’s case load already exceeds half of the total cases from the 2018–2020 epidemic in the country. The Bundibugyo virus strain responsible has no approved vaccine or treatment; WHO notes that the first antiviral clinical trial began on July 14. No details on imported or exported cases are provided.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の症例2000件超、死者754人に 流行は前例ないペースで拡大
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が5州に拡大し、致死率も高く前例のないペースで拡大しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 承認済みワクチン・治療薬がないブンディブギョ株による流行で、WHOは実際の症例数が公式発表の2〜4倍に上る可能性を指摘。国境なき医師団は医療対応の急速な拡大を要請しており、国際的な支援ニーズが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Zákaz návratu domů kvůli ebole. USA udělaly bezprecedentní krok, který šokoval i experty
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ban on returning home due to Ebola. The United States took an unprecedented step that shocked even the experts.
article.articleSummary: As of July 16, 2026, the United States barred American citizens and dual nationals who have spent the previous 21 days in the Democratic Republic of Congo from boarding commercial flights to the United States. The Ebola outbreak there, declared in mid-May, has spread to five Congolese provinces, with 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths. The policy, described by Reuters as unprecedented, risks shifting public-health responsibility to third countries and could prompt travelers to conceal travel plans or hinder recruitment of U.S. outbreak responders. Public health critic Daniel Jernigan voiced concerns. Separately, Germany has admitted another American infected with Ebola; one previously infected American was admitted in May, and another American with suspected infection was hospitalized in the Czech Republic around the same period.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱を理由に帰国禁止。米国が専門家も驚く前例のない措置を実施
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が5州に拡大し2,011症例・754死亡と深刻化、米国が前例のない渡航制限を導入し、ドイツ・チェコでも感染者が確認されるなど国際的拡大が確認されているためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 米国・ドイツ・チェコでの感染者確認は渡航関連の二次的発生であり、発生地域（アウトブレイクの原点）はDRCのみ。対象国リストに米国・ドイツ・チェコは含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Monsoon Fever: How To Tell The Difference Between Dengue, Malaria, Chikungunya And Viral Fever
article.articleSummary: Monsoon fever can be caused by dengue, malaria, chikungunya, or viral fever, all of which often begin with similar symptoms. Dr. Vandana Garg, Associate Director of Internal Medicine at Max Super Speciality Hospital, Vaishali, Ghaziabad, notes that distinguishing these illnesses is difficult based on symptoms alone and requires clinical evaluation and appropriate laboratory tests. A diagnosis can be confirmed only by a doctor, underscoring the importance of seeking medical care during the monsoon season. The article emphasizes recognizing the common signs of each illness to prompt timely treatment and laboratory confirmation, and it highlights the need for medical guidance to differentiate dengue, malaria, chikungunya, and viral fever, preventing delays in care and ensuring appropriate management.

triage.headline_ja: モンスーン熱：デング熱、マラリア、チクングニア熱、ウイルス性発熱の見分け方
triage.triage_reason: 特定のアウトブレイクや症例数増加を報じるものではなく、一般的な健康啓発・症状鑑別に関する記事であるため、シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は医療監修者による季節性発熱症状の鑑別診断ガイドであり、具体的な発生報告や症例数データを含まない一般啓発記事。地域名（Bihar, UP等）は病院所在地の紹介であり、アウトブレイクの発生地ではないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Mau News: संचारी रोग के प्रति लोगों को जागरूक कर रहीं कार्यकत्रियां
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mau News: Women workers raising awareness about communicable diseases
article.articleSummary: In Mau, Douhari Ghat block, ASHA and Anganwadi workers are intensifying door-to-door vector-borne disease outreach, focusing on dengue, malaria, and brain fever prevention. The campaign employs E-Kavach to generate Abha cards on mobile devices. Activities span villages including Farsara Khurd, Tarnpur, Siyarhi, Farsara Burzug, Nai Bazar, Lami, Kadipur, Panail, and Dhanouli, among others, with educators informing residents about protective measures. BCPM Surendra Nath Yadav stated that ASHAs have been equipped with stickers, banners, and posters to aid awareness drives. As of 16 July 2026, the initiative highlights local health outreach efforts without reporting case or death counts. Key diseases: dengue, malaria, brain fever; locations: Mau district (Douhari Ghat block) and listed villages. Keywords: outbreak prevention, vaccination not mentioned, public health education.

triage.headline_ja: Mau News: 感染症について住民に啓発活動を行う女性職員たち
triage.triage_reason: 実際の症例・死亡報告はなく、通常の予防啓発活動に関する記事であり、シグナルとしての緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は症例数や死亡数の報告を伴わない、地域における予防啓発キャンペーンの紹介に留まる。

article.articleHeadline: 中国疾控中心：全国新冠病毒疫情总体上仍处于低流行水平
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China CDC: The nationwide COVID-19 epidemic remains at a low level of transmission overall.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 in China remains at a nationwide low level of transmission as of July 16, 2026. Since October 2025, SARS-CoV-2 activity has been in an eight-and-a-half-month inter-epidemic phase, with overall low viral activity; a late May 2026 uptick occurred but by mid-June the situation returned to low prevalence. Sentinel hospital testing positivity has risen recently, indicating a mild upward trend, yet no substantial increase in cases. The dominant circulating lineage is the NB.1.8.1-series variants, and monitoring has found no new variant with additional public health risk. The virus has largely become a common respiratory disease; normal fluctuations are not cause for alarm. With summer travel and increased inter-regional movement, emphasize hygiene (handwashing, ventilation, cough etiquette). Seek medical care promptly for fever or respiratory symptoms and follow medical guidance and prescriptions.

triage.headline_ja: 中国疾控中心：全国新型コロナウイルス感染症の流行は総体的に依然として低い流行レベルにある
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19は全国的に低い流行レベルにあり、新たな公衆衛生リスクを持つ変異株も確認されておらず、通常の呼吸器疾患として扱われている状況で、シグナルとしての基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 定例のサーベイランス報告であり、既知のNB.1.8.1系統が優勢で新規リスク変異株は検出されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Vector-borne disease risk on the rise, NDCPA says
article.articleSummary: Vector-borne disease risk is rising across China, with dengue fever and chikungunya fever of particular concern. Xi Jingjing, spokeswoman for the National Disease Control and Prevention Administration, said mosquito breeding and higher population mobility in summer increase the chance of imported vector-borne diseases triggering local transmission, with southern provinces facing the greatest risk of local clusters. By contrast, respiratory pathogens show only mild activity: rhinovirus and parainfluenza infections are low, while novel coronavirus transmission remains at a low level. China’s COVID-19 level has been low since October 2025, with a brief uptick in late May 2026 but overall circulation low; the dominant circulating NB.1.8.1 lineage has not produced troubling new variants. Flood-affected areas face higher risks of intestinal, respiratory, and vector-borne diseases. Public concern for routine fluctuations should be measured.

triage.headline_ja: 媒介動物由来感染症のリスクが上昇、国家疾病予防管理局が発表
triage.triage_reason: 中国当局が夏季の蚊媒介感染症（デング熱・チクングニア熱）リスク上昇に言及した一般的な注意喚起記事であり、具体的な集団発生の報告はないため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性の媒介動物由来感染症リスクに関する当局の一般的注意喚起であり、具体的な症例数や集団発生の報告は含まれていない。COVID-19については低水準で推移し懸念すべき新変異株もないとされている。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda på väg att skriva ut sista ebolapatienten
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda set to discharge the last Ebola patient.
article.articleSummary: As of July 16, 2026, Uganda is set to discharge the last Ebola patient from hospital, potentially declaring the country Ebola-free after 42 days if no new cases emerge. Uganda's tally: 20 Ebola virus disease cases in the current outbreak, with 2 deaths. In neighboring Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), the outbreak remains severe with over 2,000 confirmed cases and 754 deaths. All cases are linked to the Bundibugyo virus variant, which has no licensed vaccine. The report underscores the 42-day window to confirm elimination, subject to no new infections. No details on laboratory confirmation methods or imported/exported cases are provided in the article.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、最後のエボラ患者を退院させる見込み
triage.triage_reason: 隣国DRCで2,000例超・754人死亡という大規模なエボラ流行が継続しており、有効なワクチンがないブンディブギョ株による深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威が続いているため。
triage.notes: ウガンダは今回の流行でまもなく終息宣言の可能性があるが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCでの流行は依然深刻であり、ワクチン未承認のブンディブギョ株による感染拡大が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola se expande rápidamente en República Democrática del Congo, alerta MSF
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is spreading rapidly in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, MSF warns.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), centered in Ituri province in the northeast, declared May 15. MSF warns the outbreak is advancing at an unprecedented pace, with confirmed cases tripling and deaths quintupled in under five weeks, urging a faster, coordinated medical response. Official counts: 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths. WHO notes the true number of infections could be 2–4 times higher than reported. Some cases have been detected in neighboring Uganda. Transmission occurs through direct contact with bodily fluids of infected humans or animals, and the disease carries a high mortality rate. This is the third-largest Ebola outbreak in DRC and among the fastest-growing, underscoring the need for rapid international coordination and outbreak control measures.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国で急速に拡大、MSFが警鐘
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の急速な拡大、高い致死率、周辺国ウガンダへの越境例が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの症例確認が言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCのイトゥリ州が主要発生地域。

article.articleHeadline: 中新健康｜专家：当前新冠疫情总体上处于低水平流行
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China News Service Health | Experts: The current COVID-19 epidemic is generally at a low level of transmission.
article.articleSummary: China’s national data show 79,000 new COVID-19 cases in June 2026, with 130 severe cases and 1 death (underlying conditions). SARS-CoV-2 positivity among influenza-like illness patients rose from 2.9% in early June to 6.4% in late June; Omicron NB.1.8.1 and sublineages remain dominant. As of July 16, the CDC says COVID-19 has persisted at a low-level endemic transmission since Oct 2025, with a May uptick but June returning to low levels; the public should treat COVID-19 as a common respiratory disease and avoid panic. Symptoms are mainly fever, sore throat, cough; severe disease and pneumonia remain uncommon. Risk groups include older adults and those with cardiovascular, respiratory, or renal disease. From July 6–13, online pharmacy data show self-test kits and COVID meds surging; Paxlovid and other antivirals rose 47–62%, Meituan orders up 32% week-on-week.

triage.headline_ja: 中新健康｜専門家：現在の新型コロナウイルス感染症流行は全体として低水準で推移
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19は中国で低水準の流行状態が継続しており、重症例・死亡例も少なく、公衆衛生当局も「通常の呼吸器疾患として扱うべき」としているため、特段の異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 自己検査キットや抗ウイルス薬の販売増加は見られるが、当局は低水準の流行が継続していると評価しており、パニックを避けるよう呼びかけている。既存の流行状況の継続報告であり新規シグナルとは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: 科兴Vero细胞与昆明所人二倍体细胞手足口病疫苗安全性与保护效力全解析
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Comprehensive analysis of the safety and protective efficacy of Sinovac's Vero cell-based hand, foot and mouth disease vaccine and Kunming Institute's human diploid cell-based vaccine
article.articleSummary: HFMD ranks second in nationwide infectious-disease incidence in June 2026 in China, with 257,993 cases, and July marks a summer peak. The core at-risk group is children ≤5 years, especially under 3, with EV71-driven HFMD capable of rapid progression to brainstem encephalitis or meningitis. EV71 vaccination for 6–71 months is an effective prevention strategy. The article notes that Vero cell–based and human diploid cell–based vaccines are different production substrates, not a quality hierarchy; WHO endorses parallel use of both. In Zhejiang’s Yiwu real-world study (n=6,854), no serious adverse events occurred; fever 3.0% (Vero) vs 3.5% (diploid); in 24–35 months, 2.5% vs 5.3% (P<0.001). Phase 3 head-to-head shows higher seroconversion with Sinovac Vero vaccine (95.5% vs 86.0%). Sinovac Erlai Fu’s ultra-low impurity profile yields rapid onset (10 days, 89.2% seroconversion) and durable protection to 64 months (~94%). Conclusion: both vaccines are effective; for faster, longer protection with lower reactogenicity, Sinovac Erlai Fu is preferred; begin at 6 months and follow local guidance.

triage.headline_ja: 科興Vero細胞ワクチンと昆明研究所ヒト二倍体細胞ワクチンの手足口病予防における安全性と有効性の徹底解析
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はHFMDワクチンの製品比較・広告的解説記事であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではないため、シグナルとして取り上げる必要性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は中国国内のHFMD流行状況（季節性ピーク、既知の疫学）を背景としつつ、主眼はワクチン製品（Sinovac Vero株 vs 昆明研究所ヒト二倍体細胞株）の安全性・有効性比較であり、新規発生や異常なアウトブレイクの報告ではない。既知の季節性HFMD流行についての言及のみで、EV71関連脳幹脳炎等の重症化リスクは既知情報として説明されているに留まる。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-arts test nieuw medicijn in Congo: 'We zijn het virus achterna aan het hollen'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola doctor tests a new drug in Congo: 'We're chasing the virus'.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Ituri province remains severe: over 2,000 confirmed infections and 725 deaths, with the WHO warning the outbreak is in an expansion phase and possibly two to four times larger than two weeks earlier (377 deaths). The Bundibugyo variant currently has no vaccine or approved treatment. An international team, including Dutch doctor Laurens Liesenborghs, is testing two therapeutics to reduce mortality: remdesivir (10 days IV) and MBP134, neutralizing antibodies; no vaccine. The study began in Bunia and will expand to other centers, aiming for 700–1,000 participants. The outbreak is not under control and is shifting westward to new areas such as Nizi. Conditions are dire: late patient presentation, high mortality, limited resources, and occasional healthcare worker strikes over pay. Strong emphasis on contact tracing (21-day follow-up) to halt transmission.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ治療医、コンゴで新薬を試験：「我々はウイルスを追いかけて走っている」
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州で確認感染者2,000人超、死者725人に達するエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)アウトブレイクが拡大局面にあり、ワクチンも承認された治療薬も存在しないため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: WHOが拡大局面と警告、致死率の高いブンディブギョ株にはワクチンがなく、国際的な治療薬治験(レムデシビル、MBP134)が実施中。ヘルスケアワーカーのストライキなど対応能力にも懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: Toinen salmonellaan kuolleista oli saattohoidossa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The other person who died of salmonella was in palliative care.
article.articleSummary: Finland's spring Salmonella outbreak led to two deaths within a month of infection, with ten people hospitalized. One deceased individual was in palliative care, and THL stated that deaths could be related to other illnesses. The Finnish Institute for Health and Welfare later declared the outbreak over. Investigations traced the source to contaminated blue lupin seed sprouts imported from India into Europe. The report notes that Salmonella is not typically life-threatening for people with underlying conditions, though coexisting illnesses can influence outcomes. The article does not provide a broader case total beyond the two fatalities and ten hospitalizations. This event highlights import-linked transmission from India-origin lupin seeds into European markets, including Finland. Published date: 2026-07-16.

triage.headline_ja: サルモネラ感染で死亡したもう一人は緩和ケア中だった
triage.triage_reason: フィンランドで発生したサルモネラ集団感染はすでに終息宣言されており、対象国（インド）は汚染ルピナス種子の輸出元にすぎず、実際の発症・死亡はフィンランド国内で起きたため対象国での公衆衛生イベントには該当しない。
triage.notes: 汚染源としてインド産ルピナス種子が挙げられているが、発症・死亡事例はフィンランドで発生しており、対象国での実際の感染イベントではないため verified_locations は空とした。アウトブレイクはすでに終息宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda to discharge last Ebola patient | News.az
article.articleSummary: Uganda to discharge its last Ebola patient from Mulago National Referral Hospital in Kampala on Thursday, initiating WHO's 42-day countdown to declaring the outbreak in Uganda Ebola-free if no new cases occur. The outbreak linked to the Bundibugyo Ebola strain, while the WHO had earlier declared a public health emergency of international concern for the broader outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) in May. In the DRC, the government reports 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths as of Wednesday. Uganda's health portal shows five locally acquired and 15 imported cases, with 17 recoveries, one current admission in isolation, and two deaths. The patient discharge on Thursday coincides with the countdown; if 42 days pass without a new case, Uganda would be declared Ebola-free per WHO guidelines.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、最後のエボラ患者を退院へ
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準に該当する重大感染症であり、DRCでは2,011例・754死亡という大規模流行が継続中でWHOがPHEICを宣言済みのため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダにおけるエボラ流行終息（最後の患者退院）だが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。一方、DRCの大規模流行（2,011例、754死亡）についても具体的数値が報告されており、DRCを主題の一部として含めた。WHOは既にDRCの流行についてPHEICを宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: ಕಾಂಗೋ ಗಣರಾಜ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಎಬೋಲಾ ಪ್ರಕರಣ; 700ಕ್ಕೂ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಮೃತ್ಯು: ವರದಿ | ebola-congo-deaths
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in the Republic of the Congo; more than 700 deaths: report | ebola-congo-deaths
article.articleSummary: As of 16 July 2026, Ebola virus disease in the Congo has caused 702 deaths from about 1,926 confirmed infections across three provinces, with Ituri’s Bunia region accounting for the majority. Health officials say roughly 80% of newly reported cases are from unlinked, unknown sources, signaling rapid community transmission. There is no approved treatment or vaccine. Bunia’s treatment capacity has been expanded to about 800 beds, and laboratory capacity has increased from 1 to 14 facilities. Challenges include funding shortfalls, attacks on health facilities, ongoing eastern Congo conflict, and community mistrust. Strikes by Ebola treatment center workers over pay temporarily halted services, though government pledged payments within 72 hours. The outbreak was officially declared in May, with clinical trials starting the previous week. On July 11, a U.S. citizen working for a humanitarian organization was laboratory-confirmed with Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ共和国でエボラ出血熱の症例；700人以上死亡：報告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（1926感染、702死亡）で市中感染が疑われ、国際的な医療従事者への感染も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナルである。
triage.notes: 米国籍の人道支援従事者が感染確認されたことで国際的拡大リスクが顕在化。医療従事者のストライキや資金不足、紛争地域での対応困難など管理可能性にも懸念あり。米国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: В Уганда от болница ще бъде изписан последният пациент, заразен с ебола, съобщиха властите
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Uganda, the last Ebola-infected patient will be discharged from the hospital, authorities said.
article.articleSummary: Uganda is discharging the last Ebola patient today from Mulago National Referral Hospital in Kampala, initiating a 42-day observation period after which the country could be declared Ebola-free under WHO guidelines. The discharge marks the start of Uganda’s post-outbreak countdown. The broader outbreak linked to the Bundibugyo strain has prompted WHO to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern in May in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). DRC data show 2011 confirmed Ebola cases and 754 deaths as of yesterday. In Uganda, the health ministry portal lists 17 recoveries (one still in isolation) and two deaths. Five locally acquired cases and 15 imported cases have been reported in Uganda. All infections are tied to Bundibugyo; WHO characterizes this as the third-deadliest Ebola epidemic. Spokesperson Alan Kasujja said the discharge initiates the countdown toward potential elimination.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダで、エボラウイルスに感染していた最後の患者が退院すると当局が発表
triage.triage_reason: WHOがDRCでPHEICを宣言した大規模エボラ流行（DRCで2011症例・754死亡）に関連する国際的なイベントであり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダにおける最後のエボラ患者退院だが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。より広範な流行の中心であるDRC（WHOがPHEICを宣言）のみを対象国として記載した。

article.articleHeadline: കൊച്ചി അല്‍ റീമില്‍ നിന്ന് ഭക്ഷണം കഴിച്ചവര്‍ക്ക് ഷിഗെല്ല: ഹോട്ടല്‍ ഉടമകള്‍ക്കെതിരെ കേസ്
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Shigellosis among those who ate food from Al Reem in Kochi: case filed against hotel owners.
article.articleSummary: Shigellosis linked to Al Reem Hotel in Kathrikadavu, Kochi, after consuming Kuzhimanthi and Alfaham led to illness in around 50 people. Laboratory confirmation showed Shigella in three patients; health department plans to test all samples. The outbreak prompted suspension of the hotel’s license and closure of the establishment; Kochi North Police filed a case against the owners. Symptoms included nausea, vomiting, high fever, and abdominal pain; some patients also had diarrhoea. At the time of reporting, 27 people were still receiving treatment in Kochi hospitals. Food and water samples collected for detailed laboratory testing. Initial assessment points to mayonnaise distributed with mint as a potential transmission vehicle, though some chicken dishes alone caused symptoms. Ongoing investigation aims to determine infection source and extent, with further samples and testing planned.

triage.headline_ja: コーチのアル・リームホテルで食事をした人々にシゲラ症：ホテル経営者に対して訴訟
triage.triage_reason: 単一レストランを感染源とする食中毒事例で約50人が発症、27人が入院治療中。地元当局が既に対応（営業停止・捜査）しているが、感染源特定や検査結果は継続中であり続報を要する。
triage.notes: 単一ホテル（Al Reem, Kochi）を感染源とする局地的な食中毒（シゲラ症）事例。既にホテルの営業許可停止・警察による捜査が行われており、地域外への拡大や国際的懸念は現時点で確認されない。感染源（マヨネーズ等）の特定調査は継続中。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Oxford Ebola Vaccine Reaches Human Trial in Just Eight Weeks
article.articleSummary: ChAdOx1 BDBV, a Bundibugyo Ebola virus vaccine, entered Phase 1 trials (BD‑Ebov) in the UK—50 healthy adults aged 18–55—to assess safety and immunogenicity, with vaccinations to begin after regulatory review. The rapid initiation—57 days after the WHO declared the DRC/Uganda Ebola outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern—makes it one of the fastest Ebola vaccines to reach human testing. If approved, studies may expand in Africa in collaboration with MRC/Uganda Virus Research Institute and the London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine Uganda Research Unit. The vaccine uses the same ChAdOx1 chimpanzee adenovirus vector platform as the Oxford‑AstraZeneca COVID‑19 vaccine, delivering a Bundibugyo Ebola gene fragment; the vector cannot cause Ebola. CEPI funds US$8.6 million; Serum Institute of India manufacturing ~620,000 doses, with ~4,000 investigational doses for Phase 1. Ebola spreads by direct contact with blood or body fluids and is not airborne; ERVEBO protects only Zaire ebolavirus.

triage.headline_ja: オックスフォード大学のエボラワクチン、わずか8週間でヒト臨床試験に到達
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は英国で実施されているワクチン第1相試験に関する科学ニュースであり、新たな感染症発生や公衆衛生上の異常事態を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はオックスフォード大学によるエボラワクチン（ChAdOx1 BDBV）の英国における第1相臨床試験であり、DRC/ウガンダのエボラ流行は背景情報として言及されているのみ。インドはワクチン製造（Serum Institute of India）に関する記述であり、疾患発生地ではない。実際の発生国（DRC/ウガンダ）は本記事の直接の報告対象ではないため、verified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: हरियाणा में AI का कमाल: 104 दिनों में मिले 25 हजार से अधिक नए टीबी मरीज...घर-घर चल रही जांच
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: AI's Marvel in Haryana: More than 25,000 new TB patients detected in 104 days... door-to-door screening underway.
article.articleSummary: AI-assisted screening by Haryana's health department, under the 100-day TB-Free India Campaign (Phase-2), identified 25,666 new tuberculosis patients in the first 104 days (Mar 24–Jul 5). Across the state, 473,197 people were screened through 3,914 health camps, with 2,854 high-risk areas targeted. The camps yielded 225,321 chest X-rays and about 125,000 NAAT tests, enabling rapid case detection. The program aims to start treatment promptly to curb transmission, conducting home-to-home screening in villages and towns with a focus on high-risk zones. AI tools include handheld AI-enabled X-ray devices for remote areas, and the ‘Cough Against TB’ mobile app that analyzes cough sounds to flag potential cases. A total of 2,111 rural and urban localities were designated high-risk, and 23,962 nutrition kits were distributed to TB patients.

triage.headline_ja: ハリヤーナ州でAIの快挙:104日間で2万5千人以上の新規結核患者を検出…戸別検診を実施中
triage.triage_reason: 既存の結核対策プログラムによるスクリーニング成果報告であり、異常な流行や新規の公衆衛生上の脅威を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 結核撲滅キャンペーンの一環としてのスクリーニング活動報告であり、通常の公衆衛生プログラムの成果として位置づけられる。

article.articleHeadline: Les Etats-Unis renouvellent des règles de voyage liées à Ebola pour leurs ressortissants revenant de la RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States renews Ebola-related travel rules for its nationals returning from the DRC.
article.articleSummary: As of July 16, 2026, the United States tightens Ebola-related travel controls for American nationals returning from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). U.S. CDC and DHS are implementing a DO NOT BOARD (DNB) procedure for citizens leaving the DRC, with Americans allowed to return to the United States 21 days after departure. The move follows a CDC update on temporary entry restrictions for travelers who recently stayed in the DRC, and for some travelers who recently stayed in Uganda or South Sudan; air travelers who stayed in Uganda or South Sudan within 21 days will be directed to a designated airport for onboard public health screening. Since May, the DRC has faced an Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with no approved vaccine or specific treatment. Confirmed cases total 2,011, with 754 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、コンゴ民主共和国から帰国する自国民に対するエボラ関連渡航規則を更新
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で致死率の高いエボラ（ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス）が拡大中（2,011症例・754死亡）であり、米国が渡航制限措置を実施するなど国際的な対応が発生しているためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ流行に対する米国の渡航規制強化に関するもの。ウガンダ・南スーダンも言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。米国も対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Restricții pentru americanii din Congo din cauza riscului de Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Restrictions on Americans in Congo due to Ebola risk.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) totals 2,011 cases and 754 deaths, with the surge concentrated across five provinces and the epicenter in Ituri province in the northeast, bordering Uganda and South Sudan. Uganda has also reported Ebola cases, including two fatalities. Transmission is via direct contact with infected individuals or their bodily fluids. The outbreak involves the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no vaccine or tailored treatment, complicating containment. Since early July, two antiviral therapies are undergoing clinical trials. In response to cross-border risk, the United States Department of Homeland Security restricts repatriation by commercial flights for Americans and residents who have been in the DRC within the previous 21 days; such travelers must wait 21 days in another country before returning to the United States.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染リスクによりコンゴ在住アメリカ人に渡航制限
triage.triage_reason: DRCで2,011症例・754死亡という大規模エボラ流行が発生し、ウガンダへの越境拡大とワクチン未整備の希少株（ブンディブギョ株）により、米国が渡航制限を課すなど国際的関心が高い深刻な事案。IHR基準4つ全てに該当。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・南スーダンへの越境拡大リスクが指摘されているが、対象国リストにウガンダ・スーダンは含まれないため除外。米国もリスト外のため除外。ワクチンや治療法が確立されていないブンディブギョ株であり、致死率が高く、封じ込めが困難な点に留意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: ABD, Ebola salgını nedeniyle Kongo Demokratik Cumhuriyeti'ndeki vatandaşlarının ülkeye dönüşünü kısıtladı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States restricted the return of its citizens in the Democratic Republic of the Congo due to the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: United States imposes a temporary ban on returning American citizens from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) amid an Ebola outbreak. As of May 15, the outbreak reports 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths. All U.S. citizens and dual nationals in the DRC must remain outside the country for 21 days before entering the United States; those not meeting the requirement will be denied on U.S.-bound flights. The restriction accompanies ongoing transmission across multiple regions of the DRC. The World Health Organization notes this is the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak to date, with roughly 80% of new infections among people not on contact lists, indicating undetected transmission chains and a true case count potentially 2–4 times the official figure. The outbreak is due to Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no approved treatment or vaccine. Ebola emerged in 1976 in Nzara, Sudan and Yambuku, DRC near the Ebola River; the 2014–2017 West Africa outbreak infected about 30,000 people and killed over 11,000.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ流行によりコンゴ民主共和国にいる自国民の帰国を制限
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確認例2,011人・死亡754人、WHOが「史上最速の拡大」と指摘し米国が渡航制限を発動するなど、IHR4基準すべてに該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにはSudan/Burundi/Angola/United States/Yambukuなど含まれるが、これらはエボラの歴史的発生起源地や渡航制限対象国としての言及であり、現行の流行地はDRCのみ。WHOは接触者リスト外での感染が約80%を占め、未検出の伝播が多い可能性を指摘しており、実際の症例数は公式発表の2〜4倍の可能性がある点に留意。原因ウイルスはBundibugyoエボラウイルスで承認された治療薬・ワクチンなし。

article.articleHeadline: قيود أميركية جديدة على القادمين من الكونغو الديمقراطية بسبب إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New U.S. restrictions on arrivals from the Democratic Republic of the Congo due to Ebola.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-07-16, the United States imposed travel restrictions tied to the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, barring American citizens and dual nationals who were in the DRC within the 21 days prior to travel from boarding commercial flights to the United States. The U.S. Embassy in Kinshasa states that such travelers will not be allowed to depart on U.S.-bound commercial flights and should plan to remain outside the DRC for 21 days before entering the United States. The measures come as Ebola has spread to multiple provinces in the DRC, prompting tightened travel safeguards. CDC official Dr. Daniel Jernigan, who led the West Africa response in 2014–2015, described the no-boarding policy as unprecedented, even though the risk to travelers is perceived as limited. Reuters had previously reported on the restriction.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国からの入国者に対する米国の新たな制限措置(エボラ出血熱の影響)
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC複数州に拡大し、米国が異例の渡航制限（搭乗拒否）を課すなど、IHR基準の大半に該当する重大な国際的懸念事案。
triage.notes: 米国CDC元西アフリカ対応責任者が『前例のない』搭乗拒否政策と評価。DRC国内で複数州への拡大が報告されており、フルリスク評価（RRA）が必要。米国・アンゴラは対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: L'épidémie d'Ebola continue de progresser en République démocratique du Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak continues to progress in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to progress, concentrated in Ituri province in the North-East. According to the World Health Organization (WHO), the outbreak could be two to four times larger than the official counts over the past two months, which stand at about 2,000 cases and 700 deaths. The new Ebola virus variant is highly contagious and spreads via saliva; currently there is no approved treatment or vaccine. Ongoing conflict and displacement drive people into overcrowded camps, challenging case contact tracing; ~80% of new infections are not on contact lists, and hospital systems are under-resourced with health workers reporting non-payment and threats of strike. Hope remains with two therapeutic candidates being tested on site, including an antiviral aimed at protecting contacts of patients; if effective, this would be a major advance. The outbreak is affecting neighboring countries as well.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の流行が拡大を続ける
triage.triage_reason: WHOによれば公式集計の2〜4倍規模の可能性があり、高感染性の新変異株かつワクチン・治療薬未承認、周辺国への拡大も報告されておりIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事は周辺国への影響拡大に言及しているが具体国名は不明。イツリ州はDRC国内のADM1地域のため国としてはDRCのみを列挙。

article.articleHeadline: Travel restrictions hold as race for Bundibugyo treatments accelerates
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) persists as the United States maintains Do Not Board travel restrictions for departures from the DRC to curb importation. CDC and DHS note U.S. citizens may be barred and could return 21 days after leaving the DRC, aligning with the virus’s incubation period. An American physician infected in the DRC is treated in Germany in a high-containment unit, with authorities pledging safety. Three major trials are under way: PARTNERS, evaluating MBP134 monoclonal antibody plus remdesivir to improve survival; EBO-PEP, testing post-exposure prophylaxis; and a WHO-led vaccine trial for Bundibugyo Ebola, since no vaccine exists specifically for this strain. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus calls research essential; WHO Europe’s Hans Kluge urges calm and notes that robust surveillance, rapid diagnosis, and infection control reduce broader risk. Cross-border spread to Uganda is limited, with one imported case previously in France.

triage.headline_ja: ブンディブギョ型エボラ治療薬開発競争が加速する中、渡航制限は継続
triage.triage_reason: IHR4基準すべてに該当し、DRCでのブンディブギョ型エボラ流行が継続、国際的な渡航制限・越境事例・国際機関の関与があるため、フルRRAが必要と判断される。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株はワクチンが存在しないため治療・予防法開発が急務。米国、ドイツ、フランスへの越境・輸入例があるが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ウガンダへの越境拡大も限定的と記載されているが対象国リストに存在しないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Amploarea epidemiei de Ebola ar putea depăşi "de două până la patru ori" estimările
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The scale of the Ebola epidemic could exceed estimates by two to four times.
article.articleSummary: WHO says the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo could be two to four times higher than officially recorded. Chikwe Ihekweazu, head of WHO’s emergency program, notes the outbreak, declared two months ago, has over 700 deaths among about 2,000 confirmed cases. Despite progress, the response is being outpaced, with many new infections occurring in people who died in their communities before reaching medical centers. To curb transmission, authorities must detect cases earlier, strengthen contact tracing, and ensure health facilities are accessible, safe, and trusted by communities. Positive indicators include contact-tracing nearly 80% complete, about 700 beds for treatment, and laboratories expanding from 1 to 14. Additionally, two treatments are currently being tested on-site.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行の規模は推計の2〜4倍に達する可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が公式集計の2〜4倍に達する可能性があり、致死率も高く、対応が追いついていないことから深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威かつ国際的関心事項である。
triage.notes: WHO高官が公式発表しており、既存のエボラ流行に関する状況悪化・過小報告の可能性を示す重要な続報。フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda to discharge last Ebola patient, spokesperson says
article.articleSummary: Uganda is due to discharge its last Ebola patient on Thursday, triggering a 42-day countdown that could see the country declared Ebola-free. A government spokesperson said the development marks the end of Uganda’s current Ebola response. The broader Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo remains of international concern, with the World Health Organization declaring a public health emergency in May. As of Wednesday, the DRC has reported 2,011 confirmed Ebola cases and 754 deaths, according to government data. The report ties Uganda’s imminent discharge to the ongoing DRC outbreak and the global surveillance surrounding Ebola transmission. This reflects ongoing regional monitoring and response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、最後のエボラ患者を退院させる予定と広報担当者が発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行はWHOによりPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）として宣言されており、致死率も高く、周辺国への波及（ウガンダ）も見られるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダでの流行終息（最後の患者退院）だが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。一方、DRCの継続的流行（2,011症例、754死亡、WHO PHEIC宣言）が国際的懸念の主軸であり、DRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。

article.articleHeadline: USA mają problem. Rozmowy w Afryce odwołane. Wszystko przez epidemię
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States has a problem. Talks in Africa have been canceled. All due to the epidemic.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) declared May 15 has reached 2011 confirmed cases with 754 deaths; WHO estimates the true scale could be two to four times higher than official counts due to underreporting. Transmission typically occurs 2–21 days after exposure; initial symptoms include fever, fatigue, loss of appetite, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal and muscle pain, with many subsequently experiencing internal and external bleeding and multi‑organ failure. About 80% of new cases arise outside known contact lists, and roughly 70% of deaths occur among patients not treated in medical facilities. U.S. CDC requires Americans who traveled to DRC to spend 21 days in a third country before entering the United States. The outbreak has disrupted U.S.-DRC mineral resource discussions (copper, cobalt), with some talks moved to Paris/Brussels. A previous Ebola outbreak in the DRC ended in late 2025; the current event remains active.

triage.headline_ja: 米国に問題発生。アフリカでの協議が中止に。すべてはエボラ流行が原因。
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確定2011例・死亡754例のエボラ流行が継続中で、WHOは過小報告を指摘。米CDCの渡航制限措置や米DRC間の資源交渉中断など国際的影響が既に生じており、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 発生地域にBelgium/France/United Statesが含まれるが、これらは資源交渉の開催地・渡航制限の対象国であり、感染症の発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola: Trump burla a la OMS e impone una cuarentena de 21 días a los viajeros a EEUU que procedan del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: Trump flouts the WHO and imposes a 21-day quarantine on travelers to the U.S. arriving from Congo
article.articleSummary: United States imposes a 21-day Do Not Board protocol on travelers who have departed the Democratic Republic of the Congo to curb Ebola virus disease importation. CDC, in coordination with DHS, restricts entry to U.S. citizens/national and certain government/military personnel who have been in RDC, Uganda, or South Sudan in the prior 21 days, with exemptions considered case-by-case. Four designated airports—Washington Dulles, Atlanta, Houston, and New York JFK—will screen entrants via epidemiological questionnaires, no-contact temperature checks, and CDC staff assessment, followed by 21-day text-message surveillance. Asymptomatic travelers may proceed after evaluation but must monitor health daily; those developing fever or symptoms are subjected to clinical evaluation and possible hospital isolation. The WHO opposes travel bans and, on May 17, 2026, declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Bundibugyo ebolavirus has been detected in Ituri (DRC) with cases also in Kinshasa and Uganda; eight lab-confirmed, 246 suspected, and 80 suspected deaths reported, including two Ugandan ICU patients infected after RDC travel.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の発生：トランプ氏、WHOを軽視しコンゴからの米国渡航者に21日間の検疫を課す
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言したエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）がDRCで発生し、ウガンダへの国際的拡大や米国による渡航制限措置も生じているため、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（イトゥリ州、キンシャサ）でのブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス発生とWHOのPHEIC宣言、米国の渡航制限措置を中心に報じている。ウガンダ・南スーダン・米国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。感染確認8例、疑い246例、疑い死亡80例と報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: יוצאת משליטה: 80% מהנדבקים ממקורות לא ידועים - אמס MS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Spiraling out of control: 80% of those infected originate from unknown sources - AMS MS.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola virus disease in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo worsens, with Bundibugyo strain lacking approved vaccine or therapy. Began in May, it has infected at least 1,926 people and killed 702 across three provinces; cases also identified in Uganda. WHO warns that 80% of new infections originate from transmission chains not known to health authorities. Chikwe Ihekweazu, WHO Emergencies head, visited Bunia in Ituri and noted many deaths occur at home, delaying isolation and contact tracing; 80% of new cases are outside contact lists. Congo has expanded the response to about 800 hospital beds and 14 labs, but transmission outpaces control. Health-care worker strikes over pay, attacks on facilities, and long-running conflict in the east, plus community mistrust, hinder efforts. Last week a clinical trial for a new treatment began; on July 11, a U.S. NGO worker in Congo contracted Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: 制御不能に陥りつつある：感染者の80%が感染経路不明 - AMS MS
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部でエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）の感染拡大が制御不能となりつつあり、感染者1,926人・死者702人、ウガンダへの越境例も確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準双方で複数該当しフルRRAへの移行が必要と判断。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの感染例も報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。承認済みワクチン・治療薬がないブンディブギョ株であること、伝播経路不明の症例が80%に上ること、医療従事者ストライキや紛争、コミュニティの不信感が対応を阻害している点は重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: ABD, Ebola salgını nedeniyle Kongo Demokratik Cumhuriyeti'ndeki vatandaşlarının ülkeye dönüşünü kısıtladı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States restricted the return of its citizens in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to the United States due to the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: United States restricts the return of its citizens in the Democratic Republic of the Congo due to an Ebola outbreak. All U.S. citizens and dual nationals in the DRC must spend 21 days outside the country before entering the United States; those failing to comply will be denied boarding on U.S.-bound flights. The measure accompanies ongoing transmission in multiple regions of the DRC. By May 15, the outbreak logged 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths. The World Health Organization warns this is the fastest-spreading current outbreak, with about 80% of new cases from people not on contact lists, implying untraceable transmission chains and true case counts possibly 2–4 times higher than official figures. There is no approved treatment or vaccine for the Bundibugyo Ebola variant. Ebola, first identified in 1976 near the Ebola River, has a history including West Africa’s 2013–2017 outbreak (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone) with ~30,000 infections and >11,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ流行を理由にコンゴ民主共和国からの自国民帰国を制限
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)の急速な感染拡大が続き、致死率が高く、米国が渡航制限措置を講じるなど国際的な対応が見られるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 米国、シエラレオネ、リベリア、ギニアは過去の2013-2017年西アフリカ流行に関する背景情報であり、現行のイベント発生地域はDRCのみ。承認された治療法・ワクチンが存在しないブンディブギョ株での流行であり、感染者の8割が接触者リスト外からの発生という点で追跡困難な拡大が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Jagannath Rath Yatra 2026: Odisha intensifies COVID-19 surveillance; doctor tells what devotees must do
article.articleSummary: Odisha intensifies COVID-19 surveillance ahead of Jagannath Rath Yatra 2026 in Puri to detect respiratory infections during one of India's largest religious gatherings, with thousands of visitors expected, without restricting participation. Officials say there is no panic, but crowds and travel from diverse regions raise transmission risk. Dr. Yogesh Kumar Chhabra advises that elderly, pregnant, immunocompromised, or those with diabetes, cardiovascular or lung disease should wear a good quality mask in crowds. Precautions include hand hygiene, not touching the face, proper coughing etiquette, carrying a mask, avoiding eye/nose/mouth touching, keeping towels and water bottles separate, staying hydrated, and choosing fresh, hygienic food. If fever, cough or flu-like symptoms occur, avoid attending and seek medical advice rather than self-medicating beyond 48 hours. Follow official advisories; medical camps are in place for timely care.

triage.headline_ja: ジャガンナート・ラート・ヤトラ2026:オリッサ州がCOVID-19サーベイランスを強化、医師が参拝者への注意点を説明
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染拡大や異常事態の報告はなく、大規模宗教行事を前に例年通りの予防的サーベイランス強化を伝える内容であるため。
triage.notes: 記事は具体的な感染者数や異常な感染拡大を報告しておらず、大規模集会前の通常の予防措置・啓発情報にとどまる。制限は課されていないと明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Ituri : les prestataires de la riposte à Ebola annoncent la reprise des activités | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Ituri: the Ebola response providers announce the resumption of activities | mediacongo.net.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease response teams in Bunia and Rwampara health zones, Ituri, DR Congo, have resumed operations after assurances from the military provincial governor. Dr. Isaac Mungenyi, head of the Ebola Treatment Center in Rwampara, said teams were reassured that all response pillars — including patient care, communication, laboratory, and psychosocial support — would be paid, addressing gaps where some pillars had gone unpaid. About 148 care staff are involved in patient care, with nearly 90% of responders across Bunia and Rwampara affected by the delays, blamed on irregular beneficiary lists and duplications. The governor asked a five-day window, together with the provincial health division, to regularize payments. Following the meeting, providers suspended the strike and resumed patient management, urging calm while the situation is resolved and highlighting government commitment to a solution.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ州：エボラ対応活動の提供者らが活動再開を発表
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州で継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクの対応活動が、支払い問題によるストライキ後に再開されたことを報じており、エボラという重篤な疾患の対応継続性に関わる懸念があるため。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ対応チームの給与未払いによるストライキと再開についての内容であり、新規症例数や感染拡大の詳細は言及されていない。ルワンダは発生地域に含まれるが記事本文では言及されておらず除外した。

article.articleHeadline: ചെറുതാണെന്ന് കരുതി അവഗണിക്കാൻ വരട്ടെ; മനുഷ്യന്റെ ജീവന് വരെ ഈ ജീവികൾ ഭീഷണിയാണ്
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Don't underestimate them by thinking they're small; these creatures threaten human life.
article.articleSummary: Asian giant hornet (murder hornet), native to East Asia, can reach about two inches and stings with venom that can be fatal; several deaths are reported annually. Bullet ant, found in Central and South American rainforests, grows up to 1.2 inches; nests may have up to 3,000 individuals; its sting delivers extreme pain lasting 12–24 hours due to poneratoxin, though deaths are rare. Mosquitoes (Anopheles) transmit deadly diseases including malaria, dengue, and Zika virus. Kissing bug (Triatominae) vectors Chagas disease (Trypanosoma cruzi) via bite and defecation; infection can cause serious heart and digestive problems and may be life-threatening if untreated. Tsetse fly, common in southern Africa, transmits African sleeping sickness (Trypanosoma brucei), affecting the brain and nervous system. This roundup highlights small creatures with outsized risks to human health across Asia, the Americas, and Africa.

triage.headline_ja: 小さいからと侮ることなかれ；人間の命を脅かすこれらの生物たち
triage.triage_reason: 特定の発生イベントではなく、危険な生物・媒介動物と疾患を紹介する一般的な解説記事であり、具体的な流行や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す情報がない。
triage.notes: 記事は特定の発生地域における感染症アウトブレイクを報じるものではなく、マラリア・デング・シャーガス病・アフリカ睡眠病などを媒介する危険な昆虫を紹介する一般教養記事。地理的にも特定の対象国での発生を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: बारिश के साथ बढ़ा मलेरिया का खतरा: बस्तर में पांच महीने में मिले 617 मरीज, पीएफ संक्रमण ने बढ़ाई चिंता, स्वास्थ्य विभाग ने लोगों से की ये अपील
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria risk has increased with the rains: 617 patients found in Bastar in five months, Pf infection has raised concerns, the health department has appealed to the public.
article.articleSummary: Malaria risk in Bastar district, Chhattisgarh, has intensified with the monsoon. January–May 2026 saw 617 malaria-positive cases: 506 P. falciparum and 111 P. vivax (Pf ~82%). Lohandiguda (156), Badkilepal (155), and Darbha (105) were the most affected blocks. The district’s population is about 952,223. Last year saw 2,888 malaria cases; in six months of 2026, about 651 cases have emerged, signaling ongoing transmission with monsoon ahead. About 40% of infections are asymptomatic. When a case is found, health teams screen around 50 nearby households (roughly 250 people). During 15 June–15 July MMC survey, 299 new cases were detected. No malaria deaths have been reported in 2026. Authorities urge bed-net use, eliminating standing water, and prompt malaria testing for fever.

triage.headline_ja: 雨季とともにマラリアリスク増加：バスタル地区で5か月間に617人の患者、Pf感染が懸念を高める、保健当局が住民に呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: インド・チャッティースガル州バスタル地区における季節性（モンスーン期）のマラリア症例増加であり、死亡例なし、既知の風土病の通常範囲の変動と考えられるため、緊急のRRAは不要。
triage.notes: 地域保健当局が住民に蚊帳使用や早期検査を呼びかける通常の公衆衛生対応であり、死亡例報告なし。前年と比較しても症例数は同程度〜減少傾向であり、異常な増加ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 中疾控：警惕登革熱、基孔肯雅熱境外輸入風險 | 電訊
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China CDC: Beware the risk of imported dengue fever and chikungunya fever
article.articleSummary: China faces rising risk of imported dengue fever and chikungunya fever as summer heat and heavy rainfall boost Aedes aegypti density. At a China CDC briefing, Li Jiandong warns that cross-border and interregional travel this summer will heighten imported infection risks and potential local transmission. Pillars of response: (1) law-based prevention and control; chikungunya fever reclassified as Category B since April 1, with surveillance reporting, emergency response, and medical treatment; (2) joint defense: strengthen port health cooperation and border/immigration control, with enhanced inbound monitoring and quarantine; (3) policy updates: the 2026 Dengue and Chikungunya Prevention and Control Plan promotes synchronized monitoring, testing, and prevention for both diseases; (4) patriotic health campaigns emphasize environmental management, vector biological/physical control, and chemical measures when needed, mobilizing society to cut transmission. Climate change and global spread widen Aedes habitats; cross-border travel increases imported risk to China.

triage.headline_ja: 中国疾病予防控制中心：デング熱・チクングニア熱の海外からの輸入リスクに警戒
triage.triage_reason: 具体的な症例数やアウトブレイクの報告はなく、夏季の輸入リスクに関する予防的注意喚起にとどまるため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事は中国CDCによる夏季の蚊媒介感染症（デング熱・チクングニア熱）の輸入リスクに関する予防的広報であり、実際の発生事例や症例数の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Од болница во Кампала денеска излегува последниот пациент заразен од ебола во Уганда
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: From a hospital in Kampala today, the last patient infected with Ebola in Uganda leaves the hospital.
article.articleSummary: Uganda's last patient infected with Ebola is being discharged from Mulago National Referral Hospital in Kampala, initiating a 42-day post-discharge surveillance period under World Health Organization guidelines. If no new cases are reported during these 42 days, Uganda will be declared Ebola-free. The patient will remain in the hospital’s quarantine area during the countdown. In the wider region, the Democratic Republic of Congo remains the most affected, with 2,011 confirmed Ebola cases and 754 deaths to date. The outbreak is attributed to the Bundibugyo virus strain, which the WHO notes as the third-deadliest Ebola epidemic on record. The situation underscores ongoing regional transmission despite Uganda’s near-term status, as health authorities monitor for any new infections during the mandated 42-day period.

triage.headline_ja: カンパラの病院から、ウガンダで最後のエボラ感染患者が本日退院
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダでの終息傾向が報じられる一方、DRCでは2,011例・754人死亡と深刻な流行が継続しており、IHR基準複数該当及び国際的関心が高いためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダでの終息（42日間監視期間開始）だが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCについては具体的な症例数・死亡者数（2,011例、754人死亡、Bundibugyo株による史上3番目に致死率の高い流行）の実質的言及があるため verified_locations に含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : le Centre de traitement d'Ebola de Nyankunde pris pour cible après des échanges de tirs - LePotentiel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: Nyankunde Ebola Treatment Center targeted after exchanges of gunfire - LePotentiel
article.articleSummary: An Ebola Virus Disease outbreak response in Ituri, DRC, was disrupted on the evening of July 15, 2026, in Nyankunde (Irumu territory) as gunfire and vandalism targeted the Ebola Treatment Center (ETC). Alleged FPIC fighters were involved; a supposed combatant was shot and taken to Nyankunde Evangelical Medical Center, then assailants reportedly pelted the ETC, causing panic among staff and patients. Some sources say the ETC staff were evacuated with no injuries; others cite clashes between armed men and security forces, with the sequence unclear. No official statements have been issued. The incident comes amid the ongoing Ebola response in Ituri; reports speak of deaths and injuries among assailants, but no casualty count is confirmed in the article.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ州:銃撃戦の末、ニャンクンデのエボラ治療センターが標的に - LePotentiel
triage.triage_reason: 進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク対応地域で治療センターが武装勢力の攻撃を受け、対応体制が阻害されたため、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と異常事態に該当する。
triage.notes: エボラ治療センターへの攻撃により、感染対応(隔離・治療・接触者追跡)が妨げられ、感染拡大リスクが高まる可能性がある。死傷者数など詳細は未確認であり、公式声明も出ていないため続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 中国疾控中心：全国冠病疫情总体上仍处于低流行水平
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China CDC: Nationwide COVID-19 epidemic remains at a low level overall.
article.articleSummary: China CDC reported on July 16, 2026, that nationwide COVID-19 transmission remains at a low level. Since October last year, China has spent about eight and a half months in an endemic phase with low viral activity; May saw a brief rise, with June returning to low transmission, though sentinel hospital positivity rose. The dominant circulating strains are NB1.8.1-series variants; no new variant posing additional public-health risk has been detected. COVID-19 is now considered a common respiratory infectious disease, with officials advising calm over normal fluctuations. In June, 79,000 new confirmed cases were reported across 31 provinces plus the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps, including 130 severe cases and 1 death (in a patient with underlying conditions). Public interest in testing and antivirals increased: self-test kits/reagents doubled (Jul 6–13); antiviral sales rose; flu/COVID-related orders surged over 110% (JD.com); Meituan showed a 32% weekly rise in COVID-related drug demand.

triage.headline_ja: 中国疾病予防管理センター：全国の新型コロナウイルス感染症流行は総じて依然低流行水準
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19は低流行水準で推移し、公式には通常の呼吸器感染症として扱われている。重症化率・死亡数も低く、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 国内での検査キット・抗ウイルス薬需要の増加は見られるが、これは季節的変動の範囲内であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態とは認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda set to discharge final Ebola patient
article.articleSummary: Uganda discharged its last Ebola patient on July 16, triggering a 42-day countdown under WHO guidelines to declare the country Ebola-free, provided no new cases emerge. Since the outbreak was announced in May, Uganda has 20 confirmed cases, 2 deaths and 1 probable case who also died; no new cases have been reported since June 21. All Ugandan cases were linked to transmission originating in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), with evidence of imported infections and secondary transmission among contacts and healthcare workers. The DRC outbreak remains active and expanding, with as of July 11 more than 2,000 confirmed cases and over 700 deaths—the fastest growth in a single month of any Ebola outbreak. WHO’s Dr Chikwe Ihekweazu cautioned that transmission remains rapid, likening the outbreak to a spreading fire.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、最後のエボラ患者を退院させる見込み
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ流行は2000例・700人超の死亡と急速に拡大しており、既に国境を越えてウガンダへ伝播した実績があるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準共に複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダの流行はDRCからの越境感染に起因し、ウガンダ国内では終息に近いが、DRC本体の流行は依然として拡大中で史上最速の増加率とされる。ウガンダはGeoNames対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda Hampir Akhiri Wabah Mematikan, Pasien Ebola Terakhir Dipulangkan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda Almost Ends the Deadly Outbreak, Last Ebola Patient Discharged.
article.articleSummary: On July 16, 2026, Uganda is nearing Ebola outbreak containment. The Health Ministry reports 17 patients have recovered, 2 deaths, and 1 person remains in isolation. Of the total cases, 5 were locally transmitted and 15 imported. The last patient is slated for discharge from Mulago National Referral Hospital in Kampala, after which Uganda will begin a 42-day countdown; if no new cases emerge, the country would be declared Ebola-free under WHO guidelines. Meanwhile, Ebola activity in Central Africa persists. The World Health Organization has since May declared the Congo Basin outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, as of this week, 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths have been recorded, all linked to the Bundibugyo strain—the largest Bundibugyo outbreak in history. International health authorities continue surveillance, contact tracing, and rapid response to prevent cross-border spread.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、致命的な流行をほぼ終息、最後のエボラ患者退院へ
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクは史上最大規模で、WHOが5月にPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言済みであり、IHR基準を複数満たす重大事案。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダのエボラ流行終息状況だが、DRC（コンゴ盆地）における史上最大のブンディブギョ株アウトブレイク（2,011例、754死亡）にも言及があり、WHOがPHEICを宣言済み。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCの状況はIHR/WPRO基準を強く満たすためPICKUPと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Sai lầm phổ biến khi chăm sóc người mắc bệnh truyền nhiễm tại nhà
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Common Mistakes When Caring for People with Infectious Diseases at Home.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever, hand-foot-mouth disease, chickenpox, influenza, and measles are discussed in home care. Common mistakes include self-medicating with antibiotics for viral infections; antibiotics ineffective and drive resistance. Fever management pitfalls: avoid aspirin or ibuprofen in dengue or measles and avoid overdosing or combining oral and rectal dosing. Avoid extreme hygiene restrictions; bathe with warm water in a closed room to help cooling. Dangerous traditional remedies include cupping and applying leaves; risk of skin damage and infection. Home IV hydration is unsafe, especially for dengue; seek medical facility care. Practical advice: boost oral rehydration, light meals, monitor warning signs (persistent fever, lethargy, vomiting, breathing difficulties, bleeding) and seek hospital care when indicated. Context: home care guidance in Vietnam.

triage.headline_ja: 自宅で感染症患者をケアする際のよくある間違い
triage.triage_reason: 特定の異常な発生事象の報告ではなく、家庭内での感染症ケアに関する一般的な健康啓発記事であるため、シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱、手足口病、水痘、インフルエンザ、麻疹などの家庭内看護における一般的な誤りを扱った啓発記事であり、特定のアウトブレイクや異常な公衆衛生事象を報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Nyakunde : inquiétudes autour d'une présumée fuite de patients du CTE - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Nyakunde: concerns over a presumed escape of patients from the CTE - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is reported at the Nyakunde Ebola Treatment Center in Ituri, northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo, where an armed attack on Wednesday night raised alarms of a possible escape of several Ebola patients. The incident follows the death of a pregnant woman admitted for delivery and violence against the health facility, prompting civil-society NSCICO to condemn attacks on healthcare workers and call for independent investigations and stronger protection of medical structures. Unconfirmed reports mention the possible death of FPIC militia chief 'Hérode' and two bodyguards amid gunfire. Some sources link the episode to an anemia case involving a member of an armed group and local blood-transfusion restrictions. This event marks the fourth attack on a CTE in Ituri, after Rwampara, Mongbwalu, and Bunia’s CME.

triage.headline_ja: ニアクンデでのエボラ出血熱：CTE（エボラ治療センター）からの患者逃走疑惑をめぐる懸念
triage.triage_reason: エボラ治療センターへの武装襲撃により患者の逃走が疑われ、感染拡大・治療体制崩壊のリスクが高く、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高いためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は主にDRC・イトゥリ州ニアクンデでの出来事を報じており、ルワンダ（キガリ州）は発生地域リストに含まれるが記事本文では言及されていないため除外した。武装勢力による攻撃と患者逃走疑惑は、既存のエボラ対応体制における感染拡大リスクを著しく高める可能性がある。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Anh thử nghiệm vaccine ngừa Ebola mới
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UK tests a new Ebola vaccine.
article.articleSummary: UK launches first-in-human trials of an Oxford-developed Ebola Bundibugyo vaccine amid the Congo outbreak. The candidate, developed in eight weeks, will be tested in healthy UK volunteers (about 50 participants, ages 18–55) with potential expansion to Uganda; volunteers will be followed for one year to assess immune responses and adverse effects. Immunogenicity data and safety signals are expected early. The vaccine uses the Oxford/AstraZeneca platform: a chimpanzee adenovirus vector modified to carry Ebola Bundibugyo genes, delivering a viral protein to elicit immunity while not causing Ebola. Preclinical testing in mice and rhesus macaques supported approval; Serum Institute of India has produced a stockpile of roughly 620,000 doses. The platform carries a rare thrombotic risk (up to about 1 in 100,000), considered lower than the Ebola risk. Other candidates include Moderna's mRNA vaccine and two vaccines from IAVI and Public Health Vaccines, though slower to produce.

triage.headline_ja: 英国、新たなエボラワクチンの試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は英国におけるエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）ワクチンの臨床試験開始を報じるもので、新規の感染症発生や症例急増を示す内容ではなく、既知のコンゴ（DRC）流行への言及にとどまるため、新たなシグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は英国でのワクチン臨床試験であり、コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）の既存のエボラ流行はワクチン開発の背景として言及されているのみ。ウガンダ・インドは製造・拡張候補地として言及されているが、実際の症例発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。
