article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China CDC: The nationwide COVID-19 outbreak remains at a low level of transmission.
article.articleSummary: As of July 16, 2026, China CDC reports the nationwide COVID-19 situation remains at a low transmission level. June saw a modest uptick, but overall activity remains categorized as low, with no detected new variants likely to pose additional public health risk. In a Beijing press briefing, infectious disease researcher Chang Zhaorui of the Chinese CDC said COVID-19 has been in an inter-epidemic phase for eight and a half months since October last year, with low viral activity. She noted a recent rise in sentinel hospital positivity rates, though the outbreak has not shifted to high transmission. The dominant circulating lineage remains the NB1.8.1-series variants. The report does not provide specific case counts or details on imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: 中疾控：全国冠病疫情仍处于低流行水平
triage.triage_reason: 中国CDCが全国的に低流行水準にあると公式発表しており、新規変異株や重症化リスクの増加も報告されていないため、シグナルとして扱う必要性は低い。
triage.notes: 既知のCOVID-19の定期モニタリング報告であり、新規変異株や重症例急増などの異常事象は確認されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Šíri sa bezprecedentným tempom. Počet prípadov eboly v Kongu sa za päť týždňov strojnásobil, WHO bije na poplach
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Spreading at an unprecedented pace. The number of Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has tripled in five weeks, WHO is sounding the alarm.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola cases exceed 2,000 with 754 deaths, and the outbreak has spread to five provinces. The causative virus is Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there are no approved vaccines or treatments. The World Health Organization warns the true scale could be two to four times the official count. As of July 15, the outbreak is expanding into new areas, and MSF (Doctors Without Borders) has called for an immediate scale-up of medical aid amid unprecedented transmission. A clinical trial named EBO-PEP began on July 14 to evaluate obeldesivir, an antiviral developed by Gilead Sciences, in individuals who have been in contact with Bundibugyo-infected patients. The experimental drug showed potential in preclinical filovirus studies, and the trial seeks to assess efficacy in the absence of approved therapies.

triage.headline_ja: 前例のない速さで拡大。コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ症例数が5週間で3倍に、WHOが警鐘
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）がDRCで5州に拡大し、症例2000超・死亡754人と急増、承認ワクチン・治療薬がないためIHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 承認されたワクチン・治療法がなく、WHOは実際の感染規模が公式発表の2〜4倍の可能性を指摘。MSFが緊急支援拡大を要請し、Gilead社の実験的抗ウイルス薬obeldesivirの臨床試験（EBO-PEP）が開始された。

article.articleHeadline: US restricts travellers from Uganda, DRC over Ebola outbreak concerns
article.articleSummary: As of July 16, 2026, the United States restricts entry for travellers in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), Uganda, and South Sudan amid an Ebola outbreak in East and Central Africa. The CDC, with DHS, implements a Do Not Board protocol for travellers departing the DRC; American citizens leaving the DRC may only return after 21 days outside the country. Travellers from Uganda and South Sudan entering the US will be routed to airports for health screening, including a travel-history questionnaire, temperature checks, and CDC observation; some travellers may receive additional assessments. Those without symptoms should monitor for 21 days; symptomatic individuals are isolated and evaluated. The State Department has issued Level 4 Do Not Travel advisories for Uganda, DRC, and South Sudan as of July 15. The DRC outbreak is linked to Bundibugyo, with over 1,900 confirmed cases and more than 700 deaths; full scale remains unclear.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ出血熱の流行を受けウガンダ・コンゴ民主共和国からの渡航者を制限
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で1900人超の感染・700人超の死亡が確認され、米国が渡航制限・入国審査強化を実施するなど国際的な対応が既に発生しており、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC・ウガンダ・南スーダンでのエボラ流行と米国の渡航制限措置に言及しているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ウガンダ・南スーダンは対象国リスト外のためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: 國內首例感染茲卡病毒 黃偉哲籲市民務必做好防蚊
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First domestic Zika virus infection case; Huang Wei-che urges citizens to take mosquito precautions.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports its first domestically confirmed case of travel-related Zika virus infection. A man in his 30s from the northern region returned from Thailand in mid-June and soon developed fever, dizziness, headache, and a rash; laboratory testing confirmed Zika infection. Health authorities conducted environmental cleanup to remove mosquito breeding sites, traced contacts, and provided health education; contacts and cohabitants are asymptomatic. Zika can be transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes, sexually, and vertically, so men returning from outbreak regions should practice safe sex for three months and women for two months, using condoms or abstaining if the partner is pregnant. Pregnant women are advised to avoid Zika-affected areas. After returning, continue personal mosquito precautions for at least three weeks and defer blood donation for one month. Seek care if fever, rash, or joint pain develops within two weeks and inform clinicians of travel history.

triage.headline_ja: 台湾で国内初のジカウイルス感染例、黄偉哲市長が防蚊対策の徹底を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: タイ渡航歴のある1名の輸入例であり、接触者は無症状、行政による環境対策・追跡調査が実施済みで、重篤化や国際的拡大の兆候は見られない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾における輸入症例の管理・防蚊対策であり、感染源地としてタイが言及されているためタイを対象国として計上。台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Kisangani : le lavage systématique des mains recommandé aux ménages pour prévenir Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kisangani: Systematic handwashing recommended for households to prevent Ebola - ACP
article.articleSummary: Systematic handwashing with clean water and soap is recommended for households in Kisangani, the capital of Tshopo Province in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, as a key measure to prevent Ebola virus disease. Dr. Gabriel Oketa, chief of staff at Makiso-Kisangani General Referral Hospital, said regular handwashing is among the most effective actions to reduce transmission and urged households to make it a daily habit alongside other hygiene practices. Authorities also advised avoiding contact with people showing symptoms or with the biological fluids of the ill, and to promptly report any suspected case to health facilities while avoiding self-medication to enable early management and reduce community transmission. The message underscores adherence to health guidelines and improved hygiene in homes, schools, markets, and other public places, amid heightened vigilance as of 16 July 2026 for possible Ebola resurgence in Kisangani.

triage.headline_ja: キサンガニ：エボラ熱予防のため各家庭に手洗いの徹底を推奨 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国キサンガニでエボラ再流行の可能性に備えた予防的な公衆衛生対応が取られており、感染力・重篤性の高い疾患であることからIHR基準の複数該当が疑われる。
triage.notes: 記事は確定症例数を報告しておらず、予防的な啓発活動が中心。ただし『再流行の可能性への警戒』という文言があり、実際の症例発生状況について続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: مسؤول أوغندي: آخر مريض مصاب بفيروس إيبولا في أوغندا سيغادر المستشفى
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ugandan official: the last Ebola patient in Uganda will leave the hospital.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 July 2026, Uganda’s government says the last Ebola patient in the country will leave Mulago National Referral Hospital in Kampala, triggering a 42-day monitoring period under WHO guidelines that could declare Uganda Ebola-free if no new cases arise. Uganda reports five locally acquired infections and 15 infections among travelers who were infected abroad, all linked to Bundibugyo ebolavirus; there are 17 recoveries, two deaths, and one patient still in isolation. Meanwhile, the Democratic Republic of Congo continues a broader Ebola outbreak designated a Public Health Emergency of International Concern by WHO in May, with 2,073 confirmed cases and 796 confirmed deaths reported in DRC to date. The Bundibugyo outbreak is described by WHO as the third worst on record.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ政府当局者:ウガンダ国内最後のエボラ患者が退院へ
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ流行はWHOによりPHEICに指定され、2,073例確定・796死亡と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダの流行終息（隔離期間終了）とDRCで継続中のPHEIC指定エボラ流行の両方に言及。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外し、DRCのみを記載。DRCの状況が本イベントのリスク評価上重要。

article.articleHeadline: Abd, Kongo Demokratik Cumhuriyeti'nden Dönen Vatandaşlarına Yönelik Ebola Kısıtlamalarını Genişletti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The U.S. expanded Ebola restrictions for citizens returning from the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola travel restrictions expanded by the United States for citizens returning from the Democratic Republic of the Congo amid a Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak. U.S. Homeland Security, with the CDC, announced a non-boarding process and a 21-day waiting period after leaving the DRC before U.S. entry. The CDC had previously restricted entry for travelers who recently visited the DRC and for those who had been in Uganda or South Sudan. On Tuesday, travelers who had been in Uganda or South Sudan and were cleared for U.S. entry will be redirected to designated airports for health screening. Since May, the DRC has been grappling with Bundibugyo ebolavirus; there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment. As of July 14, 2026, confirmed cases reached 2,011 with 754 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、コンゴ民主共和国からの帰国者に対するエボラ渡航制限を拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス流行(2,011症例、754死亡)を受け米国が渡航制限を拡大しており、国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限・公衆衛生への深刻な影響が確認されるためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事の発生地域にはUganda, South Sudan, United Statesも含まれるが、主題は米国側の渡航制限措置であり、実際の感染発生国はDRCのみ。致死率は約37.5%と高く、承認されたワクチンや特異的治療法がない点も重大。

article.articleHeadline: Российских дачников предупредили о риске заразиться туляремией
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russian dacha owners were warned about the risk of contracting tularemia.
article.articleSummary: Russia’s Rospotrebnadzor warns of tularemia risk in natural areas and advises vaccination for high‑risk groups: private rural homeowners, hunters, fishers, geologists, construction workers, and agricultural workers. Immunity develops about 20–30 days after vaccination and lasts five years. Tularemia is a natural foci zoonosis transmitted by insect bites, contact with infected animals, and contaminated water or food. Symptoms include fever, headache, weakness, lymph node swelling, and sometimes buboes. Dacha owners should ventilate rooms, perform wet cleaning, and work on plots wearing a four-layer gauze mask and rubber gloves; protect homes, dachas, and cellars from rodents. Outdoor precautions include repellents, insecticides, light clothing and head coverings, and tick checks every 1.5–2 hours with careful removal. In late June, a Russian tourist returning from Thailand was diagnosed with melioidosis, prompting travel guidance for Southeast Asia, Africa, and South America: wear closed footwear, avoid freshwater bathing, avoid flood zones, and avoid contact with animals.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアの別荘所有者に野兎病感染リスクについて注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: ロシア国内での季節性野兎病に関する定例的な予防啓発情報であり、東南アジア渡航者の類鼻疽単発輸入例も含め、いずれも公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大リスクを示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 主題はロシア国内での野兎病に関する季節性の予防啓発。タイは、帰国後に類鼻疽と診断された単発の輸入症例の感染推定地として言及されているのみで、タイ国内での発生・流行を示す記述はないため対象国として計上せず。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو تعلن ارتفاع عدد إصابات إيبولا إلى 2073
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo announces that Ebola cases have risen to 2,073.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports Ebola virus disease in the eastern outbreak with 2,073 confirmed cases and 796 deaths as of July 14, according to government figures. Separate WHO data indicate about 1,926 cases and at least 702 deaths. The World Health Organization says it has received only about 40% of the $115 million it requested to fight the outbreak in Bundibugyo, urging donors not to abandon the country during this critical phase. The disease lacks a proven treatment or vaccine. The declaration underscores ongoing transmission in eastern DR Congo and highlights funding gaps hampering response efforts as authorities and partners mobilize surveillance, tracing, and clinical care.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴがエボラ感染者数2,073人に増加と発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱でDRC東部において2,000人超の確定症例・約800人の死亡が報告され、資金不足により対応が逼迫しており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクを伴うシグナルと判断される。
triage.notes: 記事内でBundibugyoが言及されているが、これはDRC国内の地名（またはウガンダ国境地域）として扱われ、記事全体の主題はDRC東部のエボラ流行。Ugandaは発生地域リストに含まれるが、記事本文はDRCの症例数・死亡者数・資金不足に焦点を当てており、ウガンダでの発生は明記されていないため除外。政府発表とWHO発表で症例数に差異があり、データの正確性に注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Sud-Kivu : 14 cas de choléra enregistrés en 2 semaines à Kamituga
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: South Kivu: 14 cholera cases recorded in two weeks in Kamituga
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreak in South Kivu: 14 cholera cases recorded in the Kele health area of Kamituga, Mwenga territory, over a two-week period ending July 15, 2026, with at least one official death; local civil society cites two deaths. Dr. Léandre Mitimbwa, chief medical officer of Kamituga health zone, warns of a critical situation and shortages of medical supplies needed for effective patient care. In a July 15, 2026 press briefing, he called on partners to support the response to prevent further fatalities amid dwindling care capacity. Civil society criticizes the absence of medical partners and proposes opening a humanitarian corridor to expedite aid delivery to the area. The report notes that the South Kivu health system has deteriorated due to ongoing armed conflict in the region.

triage.headline_ja: 南キブ：カミツガで2週間に14件のコレラ症例が記録
triage.triage_reason: コレラのアウトブレイクで死亡例が発生しており、医療体制が武力紛争により脆弱化・医療物資不足で外部支援が必要とされているため、フルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 武力紛争により医療インフラが脆弱化しており、コレラの拡大リスクが高い。死亡者数について当局発表（1名）と市民社会報告（2名）に差異あり。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع عدد المصابين بإيبولا في الكونغو والضحايا يقتربون من 800
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of people infected with Ebola in the Congo rises as the death toll nears 800.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreaks persist in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda as of July 14, 2026. In the DRC, confirmed cases have reached 2,073 with 796 deaths, spanning multiple regions, while the U.S. has imposed travel restrictions on travelers who were in the DRC within 21 days of a flight, requiring a 21‑day period outside the United States before entry. In Uganda, the last patient is expected to be discharged today from Mulago National Referral Hospital in Kampala, initiating a 42‑day waiting period to determine Ebola‑free status under WHO guidance. Uganda reports 17 recoveries, 2 deaths, and 1 active case in isolation; five infections occurred domestically, 15 were acquired abroad, all linked to the Bundibugyo strain. WHO labels this outbreak wave the third‑worst on record.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ感染者が増加、死者数は800人に迫る
triage.triage_reason: DRCで2,073症例・796死亡と大規模な感染拡大が継続し、米国が渡航制限を課すなど国際的影響が既に発生しているためIHR基準複数該当。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの流行も記事に含まれるが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。米国は渡航制限措置の主体であり発生国ではないため除外。WHOは本流行を記録上3番目に深刻な流行と位置付けている。

article.articleHeadline: 关于新冠，国家疾控发声！还有这类传染病疫情风险升高
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Regarding COVID-19, the National CDC speaks out — and the epidemic risk for this type of infectious disease is rising.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 remains a common respiratory disease in China, with 79,000 new confirmed cases in June 2026, nearly triple May’s figure; sentinel hospital testing shows rising positivity, but overall activity remains low. Since October 2025, the pandemic has persisted in an endemic/inter-epidemic phase for about eight and a half months; no evidence of a new variant with additional public health risk, and the dominant lineage is NB.1.8.1. Mosquito-borne diseases are rising in concern as climate warming expands Aedes aegypti habitats and cross-border travel increases. Guangdong reported June cases of Dengue fever 50 and Chikungunya fever 36. From April 1, 2026, Chikungunya is managed as a Category B infectious disease; a 2026 Dengue and Chikungunya prevention plan emphasizes joint monitoring, early containment, risk zoning, and vector surveillance to curb importation and local spread. Dengue causes high fever; Chikungunya causes severe joint pain, especially in wrists and ankles.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナウイルスについて、国家疾病対策センターが発表——この種の感染症の流行リスクが上昇
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19は低活動ながら症例数が前月比で約3倍に増加しており、さらに気候変動によるネッタイシマカ生息域拡大でデング熱・チクングニア熱のリスク上昇が指摘されている。国家疾病対策センターが公式発表しており社会的・行政的関心が高い。
triage.notes: COVID-19は流行間期が続いており新規変異株の追加リスクは確認されていない。デング熱・チクングニア熱は広東省で増加傾向にあり、媒介動物対策と越境流入監視の強化が図られている。国家レベルでの管理体制は既に整っており、外部支援の必要性は低いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو الديمقراطية تعلن ارتفاع إصابات إيبولا إلى 2073 حالة بينهم 796 وفاة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo announces that Ebola infections have risen to 2,073 cases, including 796 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 2,073 laboratory-confirmed cases and 796 deaths as of 14 July, tied to the Bundibugyo strain. Authorities report only about 67% of exposed individuals are being contact-traced, leaving transmission chains largely unidentified. The World Health Organization says the true infection burden could be at least double the official tally. The outbreak, ongoing since 15 May, has advanced for about two months with the virus spreading faster than surveillance can keep up. WHO notes that at least 80% of new infections originate from unknown transmission chains. Amid the crisis, doctors and healthcare workers have threatened strikes over unpaid salaries, complicating response efforts in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ感染者数が2,073人（うち死亡796人）に増加したと発表
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱が急速に拡大し、感染連鎖の大半が追跡不能で、医療従事者のストライキ懸念も加わり公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクが高いため。
triage.notes: WHOは実際の感染者数が公式発表の倍以上に達する可能性を指摘。追跡不能な感染連鎖が80%以上、医療従事者の未払い給与によるストライキ懸念も対応を困難にしている。

article.articleHeadline: Waspada DBD: Begini Gejala Umum Demam Berdarah Dengue yang Sering Diabaikan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beware of Dengue Fever: Here Are the Common Symptoms of Dengue Fever That Are Often Overlooked.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever (DVB) outbreak in South Sumatra, Indonesia, with 2,149 cases reported through July 14, 2026 across 17 regencies/cities, led by Palembang with 619 cases. Transmission is via Aedes aegypti mosquitoes, which breed in clean standing water, bathtubs, flower pots, and discarded tires. Common, often overlooked symptoms include fever with myalgia/arthralgia and leukopenia, plus rash, lymphadenopathy, thrombocytopenia, and a hemorrhagic tendency. The Ministry of Health guidance frames diagnosis within the Dengue spectrum and emphasizes characteristic laboratory cues. Dengue is categorized into four grades; Grade I features fever with typical clinical signs and a positive Tourniquet test, along with thrombocytopenia and hemoconcentration. This situation underscores the need for heightened awareness of symptoms and intensified vector-control measures to curb ongoing transmission in Sumatra Selatan.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱に注意：見過ごされがちな一般的症状とは
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア南スマトラにおける季節性・地域流行性のデング熱に関する一般啓発記事であり、異常性や国際的拡大の兆候はなく、症状啓発が主目的である。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱の症状啓発が主題であり、南スマトラの症例数（2,149例）は地域流行の範囲内と考えられる。SFTSウイルスへの言及は本文中になく、疾患タグの誤付与の可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: AS perbarui aturan Ebola bagi warganya yang tinggalkan RD Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. updates Ebola rules for its citizens who have left DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: U.S. travelers are subject to expanded Ebola travel controls as the United States tightens rules for citizens returning from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). The CDC and Department of Homeland Security are coordinating DO NOT BOARD (DNB) procedures for U.S. citizens who depart the DRC, with a requirement that they may be barred from boarding and can return to the United States 21 days after leaving the DRC. The update follows a CDC announcement introducing temporary entry restrictions on travelers who recently visited the DRC, and on certain travelers who recently visited Uganda or South Sudan. Affected passengers who recently passed through Uganda or South Sudan within 21 days and are allowed entry will be redirected to designated airports for health screening on arrival. Since May, the Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in the DRC has 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths, with no approved vaccine or specific treatment.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、コンゴ民主共和国を出国した自国民に対するエボラ規則を更新
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクが2,011症例・754死亡と大規模化し、米国が渡航制限（DNB措置・入国制限）を導入するなど国際的な対応が本格化しているため。
triage.notes: 承認されたワクチン・特異的治療法がないブンディブギョ株エボラのアウトブレイクであり、致死率が高い（約37%）。ウガンダ・南スーダンへの渡航歴者にも入国後の健康スクリーニングが課されているが、これらの国及び米国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: स्कूल में छात्र की अजीब हरकत से मचा हड़कंप, एक दर्जन से अधिक सहपाठियों को काटा, मौके पर पहुंची स्वास्थ्य विभाग की टीम
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Panic at school over a student's strange behavior as more than a dozen classmates were bitten; health department team reached the scene.
article.articleSummary: Rabies-related precautionary measures after an incident at Government Higher Secondary School Silouti, Dhamtari district, Chhattisgarh, on 16 July 2026. A student with a prior rabies exposure from a dog bite three years earlier suddenly altered behavior and began biting more than 12 classmates, injuring them. All exposed students are receiving rabies post-exposure prophylaxis vaccines as a precaution. The biting student was taken to district hospital for further medical assessment and treatment. Health department teams reached the scene to coordinate medical and preventive actions. It is not yet confirmed whether the current episode is linked to the earlier rabies infection; medical tests and official confirmation are awaited. Authorities urge parents to avoid rumors and follow health department guidelines. This case highlights potential rabies exposure concerns and the need for prompt vaccination of contacts.

triage.headline_ja: 学校で生徒の奇妙な行動によりパニックが発生、十数人以上の同級生を噛む、保健局チームが現場に到着
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病既往のある生徒が突然多数の同級生を噛むという異常事例だが、現時点で狂犬病発症の確定診断はされておらず、被害範囲も一校内に限定されているため続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 狂犬病発症の確定はまだであり、噛んだ生徒が実際に狂犬病を発症しているか医学的検査結果待ちの状態。ヒト-ヒト感染は狂犬病では極めて稀であり、今回の事例は特異なケースとして地域保健当局が対応中。

article.articleHeadline: 金門海漂豬驗出非洲豬瘟　農業部：暫停輸出1周
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kinmen drifting pig tests positive for African swine fever; Ministry of Agriculture suspends exports for one week.
article.articleSummary: One sea-drift pig carcass found at Xintou Beach in Jinhu Township, Kinmen County, Taiwan on July 14 tested positive for African swine fever (ASF) by nucleic acid analysis, marking Kinmen’s first ASF case of 2026. The carcass was incinerated, and surroundings sanitized; officials disinfected personnel, vehicles, and equipment. The Ministry of Agriculture subsequently expanded the ban, suspending Kinmen pork and pork-product exports to Taiwan’s main island and other offshore islands for at least one week, pending a no-new-cases period. The event is linked to weather patterns, with Typhoon Bavi’s outer circulation and sea currents likely carrying the carcass to Kinmen near Fujian Province, Xiamen, and the Jiulong River area. Health visits to 25 pig farms within a 10-km radius were completed; all pigs were healthy. Since 2018, 21 drift-ASF detections nationally; 2025 had 2 cases; this is 2026’s first.

triage.headline_ja: 金門で漂着豚から非洲豚熱（ASF）検出　農業部が1週間の輸出停止を発表
triage.triage_reason: 台湾・金門島で発見された漂着豚死体からASFが検出された事例で、動物疾病であり人への健康影響はなく、過去にも同様の漂着例が複数あることから異常性・公衆衛生上の深刻さは低い。
triage.notes: 検出は台湾・金門島であり、対象国リストに台湾は含まれない。福建省由来の漂着が疑われるが中国本土での発生事例ではないため、Chinaは含めない。動物のみの感染事例で人への感染報告なし。

article.articleHeadline: 今年首例！金門海漂豬屍「非洲豬瘟陽性」 豬肉加工品暫停輸本島
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This year's first case! Kinmen sea-drift pig carcass tests positive for African swine fever; exports of pork products to the main island suspended.
article.articleSummary: Kinmen County (Jinhu Township), Xintou Beach, reported a sea-drift pig carcass that tested positive for African swine fever (ASF) virus by qPCR, with sequencing analysis ongoing. The carcass was incinerated and buried on-site, and the surrounding environment was disinfected. The incident is believed to be linked to climate conditions, including Typhoon Bavi’s outer circulation and ocean currents bringing the carcass to Kinmen near Fujian Province and the Jiulong River outlets. This year’s first sea-drift ASF positive case; nationwide since 2018 there have been 21 sea-drift ASF positives, with 2 last year. A 10-km radius around the find encompasses 25 pig farms placed under health-visit surveillance, with all pigs reported healthy. To strengthen risk control, authorities expanded the suspension of Kinmen pork and pork products exports to Taiwan’s main island and other islands, requiring at least one week without outbreaks before lifting. Cross-ministry efforts will bolster border quarantine and domestic monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: 今年初のケース！金門島の海岸に漂着した豚の死骸が「アフリカ豚熱陽性」、豚肉加工品の本島への輸出を一時停止
triage.triage_reason: 台湾金門島でのアフリカ豚熱（ASF）陽性の海漂豚死骸事例であり、対象国リストに該当する地域（台湾は非対象）での発生でなく、人への健康影響もないため、監視対象としての優先度は低い。
triage.notes: 本事案は台湾金門県（中華民国福建省管轄）での動物疾病（ASF）事例であり、対象国リストの中国本土（1814991）とは異なる行政区域のため、verified_locationsには含めない。人への感染性はなく、豚肉貿易への影響が主な懸念点。

article.articleHeadline: MSF: Ebola outbreak in DRC spreading at alarming rate
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, caused by Bundibugyo virus, is spreading at an unprecedented rate with Ituri province accounting for about 90% of confirmed cases. Two months after declaration, the outbreak has recorded over 2,000 confirmed cases and more than 750 deaths. Case counts have tripled from 650 to above 2,000 in under five weeks, and deaths have risen from about 130 to over 700. MSF warns that containment is harder without stronger international support, as movement restrictions and limits on humanitarian access hinder response. MSF runs seven Ebola Treatment Centres and more than 15 isolation units across Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu and Tshopo, with capacity exceeding 430 beds. In Bunia, the 90-bed Elikiya centre is near full; 968 patients have been admitted, including 357 confirmed Ebola, with 116 survivors. Healthcare access is strained amid conflict, displacement, cholera and malaria, with the rainy season looming.

triage.headline_ja: MSF:コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の流行が驚異的な速度で拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョウイルス）の症例・死亡数が急増しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性があり、IHR基準の複数該当が認められる。
triage.notes: MSFが国際支援の必要性を明言しており、コレラ・マラリア・紛争・避難民問題との複合的な公衆衛生危機が進行中。症例数・死亡者数が短期間で急増している点で極めて深刻。

article.articleHeadline: Bunia : la MONUSCO appuie des audiences foraines pour désengorger la prison et limiter les risques liés à Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bunia: MONUSCO supports mobile court sessions to decongest the prison and limit Ebola-related risks.
article.articleSummary: From 22 June to 14 July 2026, Bunia's Military Garrison Tribunal organized 16 days of exceptional mobile hearings to reduce pretrial detention and curb Ebola-related risk at Bunia Central Prison. Of 240 cases, 115 involved detainees still held in Bunia, with others released or jailed in Aru, Mahagi or Mambasa. The prison, designed for 520 inmates, housed about 2,231 at the outset, with roughly 80% pretrial detainees, some detained since 2018. Three chambers sat daily; MONUSCO's Justice Support Section funded judges, FARDC assessors, the National Police, defense lawyers, and prison staff, relocating hearings from the prison to the tribunal to minimize Ebola transmission. One detainee was acquitted after 3.5 years due to insufficient evidence. The operation reinforces MONUSCO’s support for faster, rights-respecting justice and public health protection in the Democratic Republic of Congo.

triage.headline_ja: ブニア：MONUSCOが刑務所の過密緩和とエボラ関連リスク軽減のため移動法廷審理を支援
triage.triage_reason: 記事はエボラ流行そのものの新規発生・拡大に関する疫学情報ではなく、ブニア中央刑務所の過密解消を目的とした司法対応（移動法廷）に関する内容であり、公衆衛生上の新たなシグナルとは言えない。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC・ブニアにおける過密刑務所でのエボラ感染リスク低減を目的とした司法制度上の対応（MONUSCO支援の移動法廷）を報じたものであり、エボラ症例数や死亡者数など疫学的な新規情報は含まれていない。既存のDRCエボラ流行の文脈における間接的な報道と判断し、DISMISSとした。

article.articleHeadline: El ébola avanza sin control en la República Democrática del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spreads uncontrollably in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease caused by the Bundibugyo strain is spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) two months after the WHO alert, with over 2,000 confirmed cases and more than 750 deaths. The epicenter is Ituri, hosting about 90% of infections, with geographic spread toward North Kivu and cross-border cases near Uganda; infections have also been reported near borders with South Sudan and the Central African Republic. There is currently no vaccine for this strain. MSF and Oxfam warn that the outbreak is accelerating in a war-torn country with destroyed hospitals and sharply reduced aid. About 20,000 people rely on a single water source at Ebola treatment centers, and facilities are operating at 130% capacity. Contact tracing stands at 80%, below the 2018 outbreak’s ~90%, and health workers face PPE shortages and rising infections.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が制御不能な状態で拡大
triage.triage_reason: Bundibugyo株によるエボラ流行で2000人超の感染・750人超の死亡が確認され、ワクチンがなく国境を越えた拡大の可能性があるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（イトゥリ州が震源）での流行拡大が主題。ウガンダ、南スーダン、中央アフリカ共和国は国境付近での感染報告があるとされるが、対象国リストにウガンダ・南スーダン・中央アフリカは含まれないため除外。ワクチン不在、医療体制崩壊、接触者追跡率低下など重大な公衆衛生上の懸念が複数確認される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Kongo Makin Mengerikan, Rantai Penularan Misterius dan Sulit Dilacak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Kongo Is Getting More Terrifying, with a Mysterious and Hard-to-Trace Transmission Chain.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is accelerating, with Ituri province remaining the core area and spread to Haut-Uele and Tshopo. By July 11, nearly 2,000 confirmed cases and over 700 deaths have been reported across five provinces, making it the largest third outbreak on record. A striking feature is transmission through unknown chains: 80% of new infections are not linked to known contacts, and daily confirmed cases have surpassed 80. Many deaths occur in communities, with patients not reaching health facilities. Models suggest the true scale may be two to four times higher than reported. The outbreak was officially declared about two months ago. WHO recommends a dual approach: intensify outbreak response at the epicenter and map travel routes to high-risk areas. Some therapeutics are in trials; no approved treatment for Bundibugyo ebolavirus; early supportive care improves survival.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ、さらに恐ろしく…謎めいた追跡困難な感染連鎖
triage.triage_reason: IHR4基準すべて該当する大規模エボラ流行（約2000症例、700人以上死亡）で、感染経路の80%が追跡不能という異常な状況が続いており、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 史上最大級の第3次エボラ流行とされ、5州に拡大。新規感染の80%が既知の接触者と無関係という追跡困難な感染連鎖が特徴。モデル推計では実際の規模が報告の2〜4倍の可能性。WHOは震源地での対応強化と高リスク地域への移動経路マッピングを推奨。承認された治療薬はまだない。

article.articleHeadline: Com 4 casos suspeitos de sarampo, São Bernardo do Campo (SP) deve vacinar bebês
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With four suspected measles cases, São Bernardo do Campo (SP) should vaccinate babies.
article.articleSummary: Four suspected measles cases in São Bernardo do Campo (ABC region, São Paulo) prompted a dose zero vaccination recommendation for babies aged 6 to 11 months in São Bernardo, São Paulo city, and Guarulhos. The São Paulo state Health Secretariat reported the preliminary cases; two of the suspects, if confirmed, would be classified as imported. No measles cases have been recorded in São Bernardo since 2020. On July 9, frontline teams conducted a near-residence sweep: 520 visits, 800 interviews, and 89 immunizations given to those lacking complete vaccination. As of now, the state has seven confirmed measles cases, all imported. Dose zero does not replace routine vaccination; routine schedule remains: first MMR dose at 12 months, second at 15 months with tetraviral. People aged 1–29 should have two MMR doses; 30–59 at least one; health workers two doses.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹疑い4例発生、サンパウロ州サンベルナルド・ド・カンポで乳児へのワクチン接種を推奨
triage.triage_reason: 2020年以来報告のなかった地域での麻疹疑い例発生および輸入例の確認があり、地域保健当局が緊急対応（ドーズゼロ接種、訪問調査）を実施しているため、スクリーニング基準複数該当かつ行政関心が高い。
triage.notes: 疑い4例のうち2例は輸入例の可能性、州全体では確認済み7例（すべて輸入例）。地域保健当局が積極的なワクチン接種・調査を実施中で、現時点では地域内での大規模拡大の兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: 今年首例！金門海漂豬屍「非洲豬瘟陽性」
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This year's first case! Kinmen drifted pig carcass tests positive for African swine fever.
article.articleSummary: African swine fever (ASF) in Kinmen, Taiwan was detected after a sea-drift pig carcass found at Xintou Beach, Jinhu Township, Kinmen County on July 14, 2026 tested ASF virus nucleic acid positive by qPCR. The carcass was burned and buried on site and surrounding areas disinfected. The Animal Health Research Institute, Council of Agriculture, is performing genome sequencing. Drift likely due to Typhoon Bavi's outer circulation and currents near Fujian (Xiamen, Jiulong River area). Within 10 km, 25 pig farms were placed under health surveillance; all pigs were healthy. Kinmen extended a ban on pork and pork products to Taiwan's main island and other offshore islands; lifting requires at least one week without new cases. Since 2018 there have been 21 sea-drift ASF-positive cases in Taiwan; this year is the first, after two cases last year. Farmers are urged to maintain biosafety and travelers to avoid bringing pork products.

triage.headline_ja: 今年初事例！金門沖で漂着した豚死骸がアフリカ豚熱陽性
triage.triage_reason: 動物(豚)のアフリカ豚熱事例であり、ヒトの健康への直接影響はない。海漂豚死骸による事例は2018年以降21件目で異常性は低く、既に的確な防疫対応（焼却・消毒・移動禁止）がなされている。
triage.notes: 本事例は台湾金門島における海漂豚死骸のアフリカ豚熱(ASF)陽性事例であり、ヒト感染症ではなく動物衛生上の問題。福建省(中国)由来の可能性が台風の海流により示唆されているが、中国本土での発生確認ではなく推測にとどまるため、対象国リストにおける中国は主題として扱わない。また台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda da el alta al último paciente de ébola y empieza el camino hacia el fin del brote
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda discharges the last Ebola patient and begins the path toward the end of the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Uganda discharged the last Ebola patient, a Congolese national treated at Mulago National Referral Hospital in Kampala, on 16 July 2026, initiating a 42‑day period with no new infections to declare the outbreak over. The patient was certified Ebola-free and cleared to reunite with family; health authorities urged ongoing vigilance for fever, vomiting, diarrhea, or unexplained bleeding. Uganda has had 20 confirmed Ebola cases since the outbreak spread from neighboring Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), including 15 imported cases from the DRC and two deaths. The outbreak involves the Bundibugyo ebolavirus lineage, which has a 30–50% case fatality rate and currently has no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. In eastern DRC, where the outbreak was officially declared on May 15, 2026, there are 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダがエボラの最後の患者を退院させ、流行終息への道を歩み始める
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダの流行終息の兆しがある一方、発生源であるDRCでは2,011例・754人の死亡という大規模なエボラ流行が継続しており、国際的拡大と深刻な公衆衛生影響が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事の見出しはウガンダの終息を報じているが、感染源であるDRC東部では依然大規模な流行が継続中（2,011例・754人死亡）であり、対象国リストにはDRCのみが該当。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Deux mois après l'annonce d'une 17e épidémie d'Ebola, un virus qui progresse plus vite que la riposte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo-Kinshasa: Two months after the announcement of the 17th Ebola outbreak, a virus that is spreading faster than the response.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the DRC's Ituri province is expanding rapidly in its 17th outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. Declared May 15, 2026, it has 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths (through July 13), a 37.5% case fatality rate. MSF calls it the fastest-growing and third-largest Ebola outbreak in the DRC. It began with suspected cases in Mongbwalu at the end of April; laboratory confirmation came May 12–13 at INRB Kinshasa, with sequencing May 15 confirming Bundibugyo. Ituri accounts for about 90% of cases and deaths, concentrated in Bunia, Rwampara, Mongbwalu, Nizi and Nyankunde, while Nord-Kivu has 182 cases. Haut-Uélé has 14 cases (7 reclassified as imported from Nia-Nia) and Tshopo four cases. Delays in response and incomplete contact tracing hinder control, with only 67.4% of contacts seen nationwide by July 13 and several zones not reporting follow-up. Centers are overwhelmed and patients arrive late.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:第17回エボラ流行発表から2カ月、対応を上回る速さで進行するウイルス
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが2,011症例・754死亡（致死率37.5%)に達し、対応を上回る速度で拡大しており、深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威かつ国際的拡大リスクがある。
triage.notes: MSFはDRC史上3番目に大きく最速拡大のエボラ流行と指摘。接触者追跡の遅れ（全国67.4%のみ）や医療施設の逼迫が制御を困難にしている。ルワンダ・キガリ州も地域リストに含まれるが記事本文はDRC国内のみに言及しており対象国外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Viruses do not respect borders. An expert explains how the world should prepare for their outbreaks
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease, hantaviruses, and Nipah virus underscore rising zoonotic threats at the human–animal–environment interface, with Ebola outbreaks in central Africa worsened by conflict, displacement, unsafe burials, distrust, and weak surveillance; hantavirus linked to the MV Hondius cruise ship shows how travel and enclosed spaces can internationalize a local niche virus; Nipah poses regional threats in India and Bangladesh with high case-fatality ranges. All three can transmit human-to-human under certain conditions: Ebola via body fluids, Nipah through close contact, Andes hantavirus through limited person-to-person spread. No licensed human vaccines exist for Bundibugyo Ebola, Nipah, or hantavirus infections; only a vaccine against one major Ebola species is available. Outbreaks cross borders within days; preparedness must precede deaths. Preclinical and translational steps include basic research, industrial-scale development, AI-assisted target discovery, and platform technologies (mRNA, viral vectors, recombinant proteins). Emergency trial designs, ring vaccination, adaptive protocols, regional networks, and regulatory strategy are emphasized. As of 2026-07-16, preparedness remains essential.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルスは国境を選ばない――専門家が説く、世界がアウトブレイクにどう備えるべきか
triage.triage_reason: 特定の新規アウトブレイクを報告するものではなく、エボラ・ハンタウイルス・ニパウイルスを例に人獣共通感染症への備えを論じる専門家解説記事であるため、トリアージ対象のシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は具体的な新規発生事例の報告ではなく、既知の事例（中央アフリカのエボラ、インド・バングラデシュのニパ、クルーズ船関連ハンタウイルス）を引用しながらパンデミック備えの重要性を論じる総説的な解説記事であり、特定国での現在進行中の発生を報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: САД увеле обавезан карантин за повратнике из Конга
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States have imposed a mandatory quarantine on returnees from Congo.
article.articleSummary: The United States imposes a 21-day quarantine in a third country for U.S. travelers returning from the Democratic Republic of Congo to curb Ebola importation. CDC policy requires Congo-bound individuals to complete this abroad before boarding U.S.-bound flights. Ebola in Congo has surpassed 1,900 confirmed cases and 700+ deaths, making this outbreak the third-largest in history, per WHO. Samaritan’s Purse operates Ebola treatment centers in Bunia and Nyankunde with ~100 beds total and has treated over 270 patients; about 80 American staff are on the ground, with the extended stay abroad raising costs and complicating recruitment. The CDC says the risk to the United States remains low and no cases linked to the current Congo outbreak have been detected domestically.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、コンゴからの帰国者に対し強制隔離を導入
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行が史上3番目の規模（1900例超、死亡700例超）に達し、米国が渡航制限（隔離措置）を導入するなど国際的な対応が取られているため、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 米国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。記事の主題はDRCでのエボラ流行とそれに対する米国の渡航対策。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو الديمقراطية تعلن ارتفاع عدد الإصابات بفيروس إيبولا مجددًا إلى 2073 حالة - أردو بوینت
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo announces that Ebola virus infections have risen again to 2,073 cases.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 2,073 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 796 deaths as of July 14, 2026, according to the DRC Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. The outbreak, ongoing since May 15, is driven by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain and continues to challenge contact tracing, which covers about 76% of exposed individuals. The World Health Organization estimates the true number of infections in the DRC is at least double the official figure. The report highlights sustained, countrywide response efforts, with no details provided on infection sources or imported/exported cases within the article. Filed from Kinshasa on July 16, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラウイルス感染者数が再び2,073人に増加したと発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）に該当し、WPRO基準も全て該当するため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 致死率約38%（796死亡/2073症例）と極めて高く、WHOは実際の感染者数が公式発表の倍以上と推定。接触者追跡は72%に留まり、感染拡大リスクが継続している。ブンディブギョ株による大規模流行で、5月15日から継続中。

article.articleHeadline: 今年首例！金門海漂豬驗出「非洲豬瘟」病毒　即日起「這類肉品」禁輸台
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This year's first case! Kinmen sea-drift pig tests positive for African swine fever virus; effective immediately, imports of this type of meat are banned from entering Taiwan.
article.articleSummary: Kinmen County, Jinhu Township, Xintou Beach, recorded the year’s first African swine fever (ASF) virus–positive sea-drift pig on July 14. ASF virus nucleic acid was detected by qPCR; sequencing is underway. The carcass was burned/buried on site and surrounding areas disinfected. A 10-km radius health survey covered 25 pig farms; all pigs inspected were healthy. The Agriculture Ministry has expanded restrictions to suspend Kinmen pork and pork products exports to Taiwan’s main island and other offshore islands until at least one week with no new detections. Since 2018, 21 sea-drift ASF-positive pigs have been found; 2025 saw two cases, making this the first in 2026. Officials attribute drift to Typhoon Bavi’s outer circulation and sea currents, with possible sources from Fujian Province, Xiamen, and Jiulong River outlets. Citizens should avoid bringing pork products home; farms should maintain strict biosecurity and disinfection protocols.

triage.headline_ja: 今年初事例！金門の海漂豚からアフリカ豚熱（ASF）ウイルスを検出　直ちにこの種の食肉輸入を禁止
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾病（ASF）であり人への健康影響はなく、金門島での海漂豚検出は2018年以降毎年発生している既知のパターンで、封じ込め対応も迅速に行われているため見送りと判断。
triage.notes: 事象は台湾金門島で発生した海漂豚のASF陽性事例。中国福建省・厦門は漂着起源として推測されているのみで、実際の発生地ではないため対象国リストには含めない。台湾自体も対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空。

article.articleHeadline: 金門金湖鎮岸際發現海漂豬隻屍體 檢驗確認非洲豬瘟病毒核酸陽性
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Drifted pig carcass found along the coast of Jinhu Township, Kinmen; African swine fever virus nucleic acid positive.
article.articleSummary: Drifted pig carcass found at Xintou Beach, Jinhu Township, Kinmen County, is positive for African swine fever (ASF) virus nucleic acid by real-time PCR, with viral gene sequencing ongoing. On 14 July 2026, authorities cremated/buried the carcass on-site and disinfected the surrounding area; 25 pig farms within a 10-km radius were placed under health surveillance, with all pigs confirmed healthy. The incident is linked to weather patterns—Typhoon Bavi’s outer circulation and local currents—potentially carrying ASF material from mainland China’s Fujian Province, Xiamen, and nearby Jiulong River outlets to Kinmen. Since 2018, drifted-pig ASF nucleic acid-positive cases total 21 domestically; 2025 saw 2 cases; this is the first case in 2026. Kinmen has banned live pigs exported to Taiwan Island and other offshore islands, and has extended bans on Kinmen pork and pork products for at least one week unless no outbreaks occur, with ongoing border and domestic surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: 金門金湖鎮の海岸で漂着した豚の死骸を発見、アフリカ豚熱ウイルス核酸検査で陽性
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱（動物疾病）で人への健康影響はなく、過去にも同様事例が複数回発生している既知の事象だが、貿易制限（豚肉輸出停止）が発生しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本事象は金門島（台湾）沿岸での漂着豚死骸によるASF陽性検出であり、対象国リストに台湾は含まれない。福建省（中国本土）は感染源として言及されているが、実際の発生地ではなく推測に留まるため verified_locations には含めない。人への健康影響はなく、動物疾病としての管理事案。

article.articleHeadline: 今年首例非洲豬瘟！海漂豬疑隨巴威漂抵金門 豬肉暫禁輸本島
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This year's first case of African swine fever! A sea-drift pig suspected to have arrived in Kinmen with the Bawei drift; pork imports to the main island are temporarily suspended.
article.articleSummary: Kinmen County reports the year's first African swine fever (ASF) case after a sea-drift pig carcass was found at Xintou Beach, Jinhu Township, and confirmed ASF virus nucleic acid positive. The carcass is thought to have drifted to Kinmen via Typhoon Bawei’s external circulation and sea currents. To strengthen risk control, Kinmen pork and pork products exported to Taiwan’s main island and other offshore islands are suspended from today, at least one week with no new infections required before lifting. The Bureau of Animal and Plant Health Inspection and Quarantine is sequencing the virus; 25 pig farms within a 10-km radius were surveyed, with all pigs healthy. Kinmen lies near Fujian Province, Xiamen, and the Jiulong River estuaries, supporting wind-driven drift. Under the Animal Epidemic Prevention and Control Act, Kinmen live pigs were already banned from export to the mainland; the new measure expands to pork products. Since 2018, 21 sea-drift ASF cases have been detected nationwide; 2025 had 2 cases; this is the first in 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 今年初のアフリカ豚熱！台風バウィに伴い漂着した死骸から検出、金門の豚肉製品を本島向け輸出停止
triage.triage_reason: ヒトへの感染リスクがない動物由来疾患（ASF）であり、金門で海漂豚死骸から検出された局地的事例。既に同種事例が2018年以降21件発生しており異常性は低く、周辺農場調査でも健康な豚のみ確認され封じ込め可能な状況。
triage.notes: 本件はヒト感染症ではなく動物疾患（アフリカ豚熱）であり、公衆衛生上のリスク評価対象としての優先度は低い。発生地は台湾金門島であり、対象国リストのChina（本土）やTaiwanは該当対象国に含まれないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: China economy weakens amid property crisis & COVID surge
article.articleSummary: China's economy grew 4.3% year-on-year in Q2 2026 (April–June), slowing from 5.0% in Q1 and missing economists' 4.5% forecast, marking the weakest quarterly expansion since late 2022. A fresh wave of COVID-19 infections in China weighs on the outlook amid a protracted property downturn and rising unemployment. Real estate investment dropped 18% YoY, fixed-asset investment slid 5.7% in H1 2026, while retail sales rose 1% in June and industrial production advanced 5.3% YoY. Exports remained a bright spot, up 27% YoY in June. The economy remains skewed toward high-tech manufacturing and exports, with consumption and investment weakness persisting; analysts expect potential stimulus at a Politburo meeting later this month. EU pressures on trade imbalances persist as external headwinds.

triage.headline_ja: 中国経済、不動産危機と需要低迷、COVID再流行の圧力で3年ぶりの低成長に
triage.triage_reason: 記事は中国の経済動向に関する報道であり、COVID-19再流行は経済減速要因として言及されているのみで、症例数・重症度・公衆衛生対応等の疫学的情報が一切含まれていないため。
triage.notes: 記事は経済報道が主題であり、COVID-19に関する具体的な疫学データ（症例数、重症度、対応措置等）が記載されていないため、公衆衛生シグナルとしての評価は困難。

article.articleHeadline: Bhopal's NIHSAD Institute Develops First Indigenous Vaccine To Prevent African Swine Fever Virus
article.articleSummary: India's National Institute of High-Security Animal Diseases (NIHSAD) in Bhopal has developed the country's first indigenous African Swine Fever (ASF) vaccine, produced using the MA-104 cell line. Union Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan dedicated the vaccine to the nation in New Delhi. ASF is described as highly resistant, with a capacity to survive on surfaces; the greatest risk of spread is through pork-based products. NIHSAD notes ongoing research into prevention, and after numerous tests the results have been positive. The development marks a milestone in India's efforts to curb ASF in pigs, though the article provides no details on distribution timelines, regulatory approvals, or field deployment. The report emphasizes the Indian origin of the vaccine and the use of the MA-104 cell line in its manufacture.

triage.headline_ja: ボパールのNIHSAD研究所、アフリカ豚熱ウイルス予防のための初の国産ワクチンを開発
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はワクチン開発の成果報告であり、新規の疾病発生や流行状況を報じるものではないため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事はASF自体の発生状況ではなく、インドで開発された国産ワクチンに関する報道。人間の健康リスクではなく動物衛生(養豚業)に関する話題であり、ヒトへの公衆衛生上の影響は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: 中國新冠疫情仍處於低流行水平 | 電訊
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China's COVID-19 epidemic remains at a low level of transmission | Telecom
article.articleSummary: On July 16, 2026, China CDC infectious-disease researcher Chang Zhaorui said the mainland COVID-19 epidemic remains at a low transmission level. Since October 2025, China has endured about eight and a half months in an inter-epidemic phase, with a late May 2026 uptick followed by a return to low transmission by mid-June. Recently, sentinel hospital SARS-CoV-2 positivity rates have risen, indicating a mild upward trend but overall low activity. The dominant circulating lineage is NB.1.8.1; surveillance has found no new variants posing additional public health risk. COVID-19 has evolved into a common respiratory infection in China. With summer travel and increased inter-regional movement, authorities urge good personal hygiene, handwashing, proper coughing etiquette, ventilation, early medical care for fever or cough, and adherence to medical guidance.

triage.headline_ja: 中国の新型コロナウイルス感染症の流行は依然として低い流行レベルにある | 電訊
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19は中国で低い流行レベルにあり、新規変異株のリスクもないため、通常の公衆衛生モニタリングの範囲内と判断される。
triage.notes: COVID-19は既に中国において一般的な呼吸器感染症として位置づけられており、新規懸念変異株も確認されていないため、通常のサーベイランス報告と判断する。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: ¿Subirá el precio del pollo? Esta es la "capacidad" de Perú para responder a la influenza aviar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Will chicken prices rise? This is Peru's 'capacity' to respond to avian influenza.
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza A(H5N1) outbreak prompted Peru to declare a 90-day national health emergency after detection at a poultry farm in San Vicente de Cañete, Lima. Senasa reports no active outbreaks in commercial meat or egg-laying flocks and cites strong biosecurity, including a mandatory 28-day restock period after culling. Peru relies on breeder farms and incubation plants producing day-old chicks (BB) to meet national demand and follows genetic import protocols from the United States and Brazil. Midagri is evaluating potential price effects, tracking affected farms, culled birds, supply reductions, and possible export restrictions. Industry experts suggest prices may fall initially due to public concern, but could rise if supply is constrained, with wholesale adjustments appearing within days and retail changes over weeks. Chicken remains Peru’s dominant protein, with high per-capita consumption.

triage.headline_ja: 鶏肉価格は上昇するのか？ペルーの鳥インフルエンザ対応「能力」について
triage.triage_reason: 本事象はペルーの養鶏場における家禽H5N1発生とその経済的影響に関する記事であり、対象国（ザンビア、フィリピン等）には該当せず、人への感染例も報告されていない。
triage.notes: 記事はペルー（対象国外）における家禽H5N1発生と鶏肉価格への経済的影響を扱ったものであり、米国・ブラジルは種鶏（ひな）輸入元として言及されているのみで、発生国ではない。人への感染事例の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda Discharges Last Ebola Patient, Starts 42-Day Countdown
article.articleSummary: Uganda has discharged the last Ebola patient from Mulago National Referral Isolation Centre, starting a 42-day countdown before the outbreak can be officially declared over. The discharged patient was a Congolese national who sought treatment in Uganda after developing Ebola-like symptoms in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). Uganda reported 20 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases during the outbreak, with 15 imported from the DRC and 5 among contacts under institutional quarantine; two patients, both Congolese nationals, died after presenting late. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, with a 10% case fatality rate, among the lowest for Bundibugyo outbreaks. No specific antiviral exists; patients received comprehensive supportive care with medicines under compassionate use protocols. Incubation can be up to 21 days; if no new cases in 21 days, another 21-day period begins. Surveillance remains heightened at borders and high-risk districts, and travel/trade restrictions are being discussed.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、最後のエボラ患者を退院させ42日間のカウントダウンを開始
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常事態、国際的拡大、渡航・貿易制限の議論）しており、DRCとウガンダにまたがるエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクとしてフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダはGeoNames対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCはアウトブレイクの発生源であり、症例の輸入元として記事の主題に含まれるため verified_locations に含めた。ウガンダでの終息宣言に向けた動きだが、国境を越えた感染拡大が実際に発生しているため引き続き注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à la Tshopo: l'épidémie se propage à un rythme alarmant ( Médecins Sans Frontières) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Tshopo: the outbreak is spreading at an alarming rate (Doctors Without Borders) - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo is spreading at an alarming rate, with transmission across Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Tshopo, including Kisangani in Tshopo. As of July 14, MSF reports seven Ebola Treatment Centers and more than 15 isolation units, totaling 430 beds. Since the epidemic began, MSF teams have admitted 968 patients, including 357 confirmed Ebola cases. Access to care remains limited, surveillance overwhelmed, and treatment centers strained, leaving urban communities without adequate support. MSF supports the provincial health ministry with surveillance, testing, community mobilization, training, and safe access to other essential health services. The organization calls for intensified, better-coordinated international action and increased resources to curb the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: ツショパ州でのエボラ:国境なき医師団によれば流行は驚異的な速さで拡大している - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ流行が複数州(イトゥリ、北キブ、南キブ、ツショパ)に拡大しており、確定例357名、入院968名と規模が大きく、国際的拡大・公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: MSFが国際的な支援強化とより良い調整を要請しており、既に複数州への拡大が確認されている点が重要。都市部(キサンガニ)への拡大は監視体制の逼迫を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Lubero : des déplacés sans moyens de protection contre Ebola, la société civile redoute un risque de propagation du virus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lubero: Displaced people with no protection against Ebola, civil society fears the risk of the virus spreading.
article.articleSummary: Over 6,000 displaced people living in reception sites in Lubero-Centre, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, lack hygiene kits and protective equipment, raising civil society concerns about heightened exposure to contagious diseases, notably Ebola virus disease (EVD). Community actors report cramped, unsanitary conditions with scarce soap, handwashing facilities, disinfectants, and other essentials, hindering adherence to preventive measures promoted by health authorities. The civil society calls on authorities, humanitarian organizations, and health partners to act urgently: distribute hygiene kits, install handwashing points, strengthen site sanitation, and sustain awareness campaigns for the displaced. The Lubero territory continues to host families fleeing violence by armed groups; humanitarian needs remain substantial and exceed current response capacity. An immediate intervention is essential to protect the displaced and prevent a health crisis from worsening the already challenging humanitarian situation.

triage.headline_ja: ルベロ：エボラに対する防護手段のない避難民、市民社会がウイルス拡散のリスクを懸念
triage.triage_reason: 北キブ州ルベロの避難民6,000人以上が衛生用品・防護具を欠き、エボラウイルス感染症への曝露リスクが高まっていると市民社会が警鐘を鳴らしている。過密・不衛生な環境と人道支援の不足により流行拡大の懸念があり、外部支援の必要性も指摘されているため、フルリスク評価に進めるべきと判断した。
triage.notes: 記事は具体的な感染確定例数を報告しておらず、避難民の衛生状況悪化によるエボラ拡散リスクへの懸念を伝える内容。北キブ州は過去に複数回のエボラ流行歴があり、現地の脆弱な人道状況を踏まえ、続報や実際の症例発生状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola propaga-se na RDC a ritmo sem precedentes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spreads in the DRC at an unprecedented pace.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is spreading at an unprecedented pace, driven by the Bundibugyo variant. By mid-July, authorities report 2,011 cases and 754 deaths across five provinces, with more than 90% of cases in Ituri and spillover into Uganda. The outbreak was declared May 15 in Ituri, and the pace has intensified about two months later. The World Health Organization cautions that official counts may underestimate reality by two to four times. MSF notes cases tripling and deaths quintupling in five weeks. Transmission occurs via close contact and bodily fluids, and roughly 80% of new cases are outside established contact lists, indicating unknown chains of transmission. No vaccine exists for Bundibugyo; the first antiviral efficacy trial began this week. Conflict and distrust impede the response, complicating control efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が前例のない速さで拡大
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）が前例のない速度で拡大し、ウガンダへの越境拡散も報告されており、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高いためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの流出（spillover）が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めない。WHOは公式報告数が実際の2〜4倍過小評価の可能性を指摘しており、状況は深刻化している。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda discharges last Ebola patient: minister
article.articleSummary: Uganda discharged its last Ebola patient, marking a notable containment of the cross-border outbreak from the Democratic Republic of Congo. Uganda must now pass 42 days without a new case to be declared Ebola-free per WHO guidelines, covering two full incubation periods. Across the border, DR Congo has logged over 2,000 confirmed Ebola cases and 754 deaths since the outbreak began in mid-May; WHO cautions actual numbers may be 2–4 times higher. Uganda reported 20 cases and two deaths, mostly Congolese citizens who crossed the porous border, with the remainder recovering. Health Minister Chris Baryomunsi confirmed the figures. The development underscores the importance of cross-border surveillance while awaiting the 42-day Ebola-free window before formal declaration.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、最後のエボラ患者を退院させる:保健相
triage.triage_reason: DRCで2,000例超・754人死亡の大規模エボラ流行が発生し、既に国境を越えてウガンダへ拡大した実績があるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、記事の主題国であるDRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。WHOは実際の症例数が報告の2〜4倍の可能性があると指摘しており、依然として警戒が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 金門海漂豬屍驗出非洲豬瘟病毒　豬肉7天禁運台灣本島
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kinmen sea-drift pig carcass tests positive for African swine fever virus; pork shipments to Taiwan's main island banned for seven days.
article.articleSummary: A sea-drift pig carcass (≈70 kg) found at Xintou Harbor, Kinmen, tested positive for African swine fever (ASF) nucleic acid by PCR, confirmed by the Agricultural Veterinary Research Institute. To prevent spread, the Council of Agriculture suspended Kinmen pork and pork-products shipments to Taiwan’s main island and offshore islands from July 16–22, 2026, contingent on a week with no new cases. The incident is linked to Typhoon Bavi circulation and shifting currents, with the carcass likely arising from mainland China ports near Fujian/Xiamen. Kinmen disease prevention office conducted health checks within a 10-km radius (25 pig farms, 5033 pigs); all healthy. Decontamination of contacts, vehicles, and equipment completed; border patrols intensified. Under the Animal Infectious Disease Prevention Act, live Kinmen pigs remain restricted, but 51 hooved-animal processed-product categories may still ship to the main island and offshore islands, including dried and frozen meat products. Farmers urged strict biosecurity and to avoid bringing pork or animal products from abroad.

triage.headline_ja: 金門で海上漂着した豚の死骸から アフリカ豚熱ウイルスを検出、台湾本島への豚肉輸送を7日間禁止
triage.triage_reason: 動物由来のASF検体単発検出で、人への健康影響はなく封じ込め措置済みだが、越境拡散の可能性があるため継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 金門（台湾）で発見された豚の死骸がASF陽性となったが、対象国リストに台湾は含まれず、中国（福建・厦門）は死骸の漂着元として推測されているのみで実際の発生地ではないため、verified_locationsは空とした。動物衛生上の措置であり人の公衆衛生への直接影響は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: СЗО: Епидемията от ебола в ДРК се разраства най-бързо, като повечето нови случаи са от неизвестни вериги на предаване -- Novinata.bg
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: The Ebola epidemic in the DRC is spreading fastest, with most new cases from unknown transmission chains.
article.articleSummary: WHO warns the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is the fastest-growing on record, with most new infections from unknown transmission chains. As of 11 July, about 2,000 confirmed cases and over 700 deaths have been reported across five provinces, making it the third-largest Ebola outbreak to date and the quickest month-to-month growth since it began. The outbreak was declared two months earlier. A troubling finding is that many recently reported deaths occurred in communities without healthcare access, and 80% of new cases are outside official contact lists, signaling undetected transmission. The virus originated in Ituri and has recently spread to Haut-Uele and Tshopo. WHO recommends a double strategy: intensify epicenter response while mapping travel routes and identifying high-risk areas for potential new cases. There is no approved treatment for Bundibugyo virus; several therapeutics are in trials, and early supportive care improves survival. Emphasize early case finding and prompt hospitalization.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：DRCのエボラ流行は過去最速で拡大、新規症例の多くは不明な感染経路から
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上3番目の規模のエボラ流行が過去最速ペースで拡大しており、新規症例の80%が感染経路不明という異常事態でIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: WHOが公式に警告を発しており、承認された治療法がないブンディブギョウイルス（エボラ亜種）による流行。5州にまたがり拡大中で、フルRRAへの移行が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : le cap des 2 000 cas franchi, MSF alerte sur un " rythme sans précédent "
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: 2,000-case milestone reached, MSF warns of an 'unprecedented pace'.
article.articleSummary: As of mid-July 2026, Ebola in the DRC's Ituri region has surpassed 2,000 confirmed cases with about 754 deaths. Official counts show 1,873 cases and 672 deaths by July 11; MSF cites nearly 2,000 cases and over 700 deaths by July 15, with more than 300 recoveries. The outbreak centers on Bunia, Rwampara, Mongbwalu and Nizi but has reached Tshopo (Kisangani) and Haut-Uélé, with Uganda reporting 20 cases. Most new infections occur outside known contact lists, signaling hidden transmission chains. Bundibugyo strain has no vaccine or approved treatment; Zaïre-based tools exist for other outbreaks. Trials underway in Bunia; a Bundibugyo vaccine trial began in the UK. Leadership boosted: President Tshisekedi named Steve Ahuka on July 13; U.S. aid exceeds $600 million. Bunia’s Elikiya center runs at capacity; isolation center in Rwampara was burned in May; security constraints hinder response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：2,000症例の節目に到達、MSFは『前例のないペース』を警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC・イツリ地域で2000症例超・死者754人に達し、ウガンダへの越境例、隠れた感染連鎖、承認済みワクチン/治療薬の欠如など複数のIHR/WPRO基準に該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも20症例報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。Bundibugyo株には承認済みワクチン・治療薬がなく、隠れた感染連鎖が示唆される点で懸念が大きい。

article.articleHeadline: 今年首例！金門海漂豬驗出「非洲豬瘟」病毒　即日起「這類肉品」禁輸台
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This year's first case! African swine fever virus detected in a drifting pig in Kinmen; from today, imports of this type of meat are banned into Taiwan.
article.articleSummary: Kinmen County, Jinhu Township, Xintou Beach, found a drifting pig carcass on the 14th; African swine fever virus detected by qPCR, this year’s first case. The central disaster response center says this is the 21st ASFV-positive drifting pig in Taiwan since 2018, with 2 cases in 2025 and the 2026 case the first this year; sequencing is underway. The likely origin is from nearby mainland China ports in Fujian Province, Xiamen, and Jiulong River, carried by winds and currents after Mawar’s outer circulation. Kinmen’s veterinary authority has placed 25 farms within 10 km under health surveillance; all pigs healthy and surrounding areas disinfected after on-site incineration/burial. The Agriculture Ministry has expanded the prohibition on Kinmen pork and pork products exported to Taiwan’s main island and other offshore islands, lifting only after at least one week without new cases. Citizens urged not to bring pork products home; farms to maintain biosecurity.

triage.headline_ja: 今年初のケース！金門の海岸に漂着した豚から「アフリカ豚熱（ASF）」ウイルスを検出　本日より当該肉製品の輸入禁止
triage.triage_reason: 動物由来のアフリカ豚熱で、2018年以降21例目・今年初のルーティン的な事例であり人への直接影響はないが、対岸中国由来と推定され貿易制限（輸入禁止）が発動されたため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 事象は台湾・金門で発見された漂着豚死骸からのASF検出であり、台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため直接のverified_locationsには計上できない。ウイルスの由来が中国福建省沿岸と推定されているため、中国を関連国として参考的に記載したが、実際の発生（検出）地は台湾側である点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Vanredno zaprašivanje komaraca u Gradcu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Emergency mosquito spraying in Gradac.
article.articleSummary: Emergency adult-m mosquito spraying is planned in Gradac tonight from 19:00 to 23:30 local time due to the appearance of African swine fever virus, targeting Gradac with additional operations in Johovac, Glavicicama, Batru, and Ruhotina. Beekeepers are urged to adapt treatment times and protect hives with measures including covering colonies, closing bees at night, keeping ventilation, supplying water to feeders, sealing flight entrances, shading hives in extreme heat, and washing landing boards after treatment. If weather conditions are unfavorable, citizens will be informed of a rescheduled date. The spraying will continue tomorrow, July 17, from 19:00 to 23:30 in Bjeloševac, Banjica, and Kačevac. Public information channels and social media will provide updates; residents should follow for any postponements.

triage.headline_ja: グラダツで緊急の蚊駆除作業
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱（ASF）に関連したボスニア・ヘルツェゴビナの一地域における蚊の緊急防除作業についての記事であり、対象国（India等）への言及はなく、人への健康影響も認められない。
triage.notes: Bluedotの発生地域にIndia（Jharkhand州）が含まれているが、記事本文はボスニア・ヘルツェゴビナのGradac等の村における蚊防除作業についてであり、インドへの言及は一切ない。動物疾病（ASF）であり人への公衆衛生上の直接的懸念も記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Waspada! Dugaan Penipuan Berkedok Sumbangan Tangani Wabah DB Berkeliaran di Sleman
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beware! Alleged donation scam to tackle a dengue fever outbreak circulating in Sleman.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever (DBD) and chikungunya scam in Sleman Regency, Indonesia, centers on alleged outbreak fundraising. Two women in brown uniforms and masks approached shop owners on Jalan Godean, Bantulan, soliciting Rp30,000 via a form labeled as environmental social service, claiming to be mosquito-control (PSN) staff with a Koperasi Indonesia logo. The operation is described as a donation drive to combat a supposed DBD outbreak; no confirmed outbreak data or laboratory confirmation are provided in the report. Sleman Health Office (Dinas Kesehatan Kabupaten Sleman) clarified that no circular soliciting donations for outbreak response had been issued and warned the public to beware of new scam models impersonating official health authorities. The incident was shared on X by @merapi_uncover. Authorities urged victims to report extortion to police; the suspects were seen moving westward along Jalan Godean.

triage.headline_ja: 注意！スレマンでデング熱・チクングニア熱の流行対策と称した募金詐欺が横行
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題はデング熱流行を装った募金詐欺事件であり、保健当局も実際の流行発生を確認していないため、公衆衛生上のシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は詐欺事件に関する報道であり、デング熱・チクングニア熱の実際の流行状況についての確認情報は含まれていない。保健当局は募金活動の事実自体を否定している。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : des équipes de la riposte quittent temporairement Nyankunde après l'attaque du CTE - LePotentiel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: Response teams temporarily withdraw from Nyankunde after the attack on the Ebola Treatment Center - LePotentiel
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease response teams in Ituri, Democratic Republic of the Congo, temporarily withdrew from Nyankunde in Irumu territory after an armed attack on an Ebola Treatment Center on July 15. World Health Organization Congo, Africa CDC, and Samaritan's Purse personnel left the area on July 16 citing security concerns. The withdrawals followed gunfire reported in Nyankunde and the subsequent targeting of the treatment center, fueling fear among healthcare workers and patients. While precise circumstances of the attack are under investigation, local sources link the violence to regional tensions amid clashes in Nyankunde and reports of the alleged death of a FPIC faction leader, though this remains unconfirmed. The pause jeopardizes surveillance, case management, and prevention efforts across several health zones in Ituri. Health and administrative authorities are urged to restore a secure environment to resume humanitarian interventions; no official duration or continuity plans have been released.

triage.headline_ja: イツリのエボラ：CTE（エボラ治療センター）襲撃後、対応チームがニャンクンデから一時撤退 - LePotentiel
triage.triage_reason: エボラ治療センターへの武装襲撃により対応チームが撤退し、サーベイランス・症例管理・予防活動が中断される深刻な事態であり、感染拡大リスクが懸念される。
triage.notes: エボラ治療センターへの攻撃は地域紛争（FPICとの衝突）に関連する可能性があるが未確認。対応活動の中断期間や継続計画は公表されていない点に注意。

article.articleHeadline: توصية بتشديد الرقابة على نقل الحيوانات للحد من انتشار الحمى القلاعية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Recommendation to tighten controls on the movement of animals to limit the spread of foot-and-mouth disease.
article.articleSummary: Libya's National Center for Animal Health urged tighter controls on inter-city animal movement to curb foot-and-mouth disease (FMD). In a wide meeting with the Agricultural Police, authorities emphasized coordinated field action and integrated preventive measures under national plans to protect livestock and food security. The session was chaired by Mohamed Al-Bashir Al-Turki, acting undersecretary of the Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock in the Government of National Unity, with deputies of the Agricultural Police and the head of Inspection and Monitoring in attendance. On July 1, local livestock markets were closed in Al-Khums and Qasr al-Akhiyar, followed by closures in Bani Walid as precautionary steps. By July 8, the Jabal al-Akhdar branch reported suspected FMD infections among sheep in Qandoula and Marawa, urging herders to report symptoms and to refrain from moving or marketing infected or exposed animals until test results are released.

triage.headline_ja: 家畜移動の管理強化を勧告 口蹄疫の拡大抑制のため
triage.triage_reason: リビア国内の家畜(口蹄疫)に関する行政対応の記事であり、対象国リストに該当する国での発生ではないため見送り。
triage.notes: 発生地域にPhilippinesが含まれているが、記事本文はリビア国内の口蹄疫対応に関するものであり、フィリピンでの発生を示す記述はない。また動物疾患であり人への公衆衛生影響は限定的。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ouganda : les autorités annoncent la guérison du dernier patient
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Uganda: Authorities announce the recovery of the last patient.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-07-16, Uganda is poised to discharge the last Ebola patient, marking a milestone as the country enters a 42-day surveillance period required by the World Health Organization before being officially declared Ebola-free. The Ugandan Health Ministry records 20 cases, including five local transmissions and fifteen imported, with 2 deaths and 17 recoveries; all infections are linked to the rare Bundibugyo strain. Concurrently, the Democratic Republic of Congo faces a far larger outbreak, with over 2,000 confirmed cases and more than 750 deaths. Authorities in Uganda hope no new infections will be recorded to cement the end of the outbreak in the country.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ・イン・ウガンダ：当局が最後の患者の回復を発表
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダの終息は前向きなニュースだが、記事はコンゴ民主共和国で2000例以上・750人以上の死亡という大規模かつ継続中のエボラ流行にも言及しており、重大な公衆衛生上の懸念がある。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダにおけるアウトブレイク終息（ブンディブギョ株、20例・2死亡・17回復）だが、同時にコンゴ民主共和国で継続中のより大規模なエボラ流行（2000例超・750人超死亡）が言及されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外し、DRCのみを計上した。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda begins countdown to end of Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Uganda enters a 42-day countdown to ending its Ebola outbreak after the last confirmed case tested negative for the virus a second time and was discharged. As of 16 July 2026, the country reports 20 confirmed cases and 2 deaths, with 15 imported from the Democratic Republic of the Congo and 5 locally acquired. The countdown, equivalent to two maximum incubation periods for Bundibuygo virus disease, begins while transmission continues across the border; no new confirmed cases have been reported since 21 June 2026. The response has emphasized rapid case detection, laboratory testing, contact tracing, infection prevention and control, case management, risk communication, and cross-border collaboration with DRC. All 836 contacts have been followed up; surveillance operates in 36 high-risk districts and at 38 points of entry. WHO mobilized roughly 70 experts, bolstering labs, surveillance, and frontline protection. A six-month Ugandan plan aims to sustain vigilance and prevent resurgence.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、エボラ出血熱流行終息へのカウントダウン開始
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の複数（深刻性、異常性、国際的拡大）に該当し、DRCとの国境を越えた感染連鎖が継続しているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダの流行終息カウントダウンだが、症例の大半がDRCからの輸入例であり、国境を越えた感染拡大が継続しているためDRCを対象国として記載。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) Activates Emergency Delivery plan to break Bundibugyo Ebola transmission
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in the DRC. As of 13 July 2026, 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths, with 366 recoveries; 54 new cases and 28 deaths in the latest 24 hours. The outbreak spans 45 health zones across five provinces, with Ituri the epicentre (~90% of cases). Transmission remains active, with expansion in Haut-Uele and ongoing cases in North Kivu and Tshopo; South Kivu reports 48 consecutive days without a new case. Capacity expanded to 11 laboratories (>2,000 tests/day) with sequencing in Bunia; 22 treatment centres and 7 transit centres (>700 beds). 12,430 contacts registered (67.4% seen). 114 health workers infected, 36 died; occupancy 87.4% overall, saturated in North Kivu. Uganda reports 20 cases (17 recovered, 2 deaths, 1 in care); cross-border support and rapid funding emphasized. Roadmap prioritizes contact follow-up, bed capacity, infection prevention, health worker protection, essential services, and funding liquidity for rapid deployment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国(DRC)、バンディブギョ・エボラの感染連鎖を断つための緊急デリバリー計画を発動
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（確定2,011例、死亡754例）が継続中で、複数州に拡大し医療従事者感染・ウガンダへの越境伝播も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも症例発生（20例、うち死亡2例）が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。既に大規模な継続的流行であり、フルRRA（リスク評価）が必要。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو تعلن ارتفاع عدد الإصابات بفيروس إيبولا مجددًا إلى 2073 حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo announces that the number of Ebola infections has risen again to 2,073 cases.
article.articleSummary: As of July 16, 2026, the Congo reports that Ebola infections have risen again, reaching 2,073 confirmed cases. The update signals an ongoing outbreak, but the brief provides no breakdown of deaths, recovered cases, or current transmission hotspots. There are no disclosed details on laboratory confirmation, exact infection sources, symptom profiles, or links to imported or exported cases. The article emphasizes the elevated case count without supplying granular epidemiological data or information on vaccination campaigns or regional spillover. The Congo’s persistent Ebola situation highlights the necessity for sustained surveillance, robust contact tracing, and rapid public health responses to interrupt transmission and protect affected communities. No additional country-specific or cross-border details are provided in the report.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラウイルス感染者数が再び2,073例に増加したと発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の感染者数が2,073例に達し継続的な拡大を示しており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが懸念されるためフルRRAへ進むべきである。
triage.notes: 死亡数、致死率、感染源、ワクチン接種状況などの詳細情報が不足しており、フルRRAでの追加情報収集が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-arts test nieuw medicijn in Congo. 'We zijn het virus achterna aan het hollen'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola doctor tests a new drug in Congo. 'We're chasing the virus.'
article.articleSummary: East Congo's Ebola outbreak in Ituri province is escalating, with the death toll rising rapidly. An international research team began testing a new drug last week as part of the response. Flemish physician Laurens Liesenborghs, stationed for nearly two months at the epicenter, reports stark conditions: patients arrive too late and too ill for health centers, and many die on the ground; frontline workers operate with severely limited resources. The interview underscores the ongoing struggle to contain transmission while promising treatments are explored, offering a glimmer of hope but no clear end in sight. The situation reflects the broader challenges of outbreak response in Ituri, where access, timing of care, and resource constraints contribute to high mortality despite medical advances.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ治療医、コンゴで新薬を試験『我々はウイルスを追いかけている』
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州でエボラ出血熱の死亡者数が急増しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 国際研究チームが新薬治験を実施中であり、患者が重症化してから来院する状況が死亡率上昇に寄与している。続報でのアウトブレイク規模・致死率・WHO対応状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kangra leads Himachal in TB prevention - The Tribune
article.articleSummary: Kangra district, Himachal Pradesh, achieved 91% TB Preventive Treatment (TPT) coverage among eligible household contacts in 2026 under the TB-Mukt Bharat Abhiyan, the highest in the state. Of 1,708 household contacts enrolled, 1,530 were started on TPT, while 34 diagnosed with active tuberculosis were immediately placed on anti-TB therapy. 144 eligible contacts remain to be covered, with plans to reach 95% coverage by enrolling them in the three-month weekly TB Preventive Treatment (3HP) regimen. Kangra’s approach includes systematic household contact investigations, timely chest X-rays and diagnostic evaluations, intensive counseling, real-time monitoring via the Nikshay portal, and close follow-up by frontline health workers. Officials credit coordinated efforts across the TB Centre, medical officers, TB Health Visitors, ASHA workers, pharmacists, and laboratory staff. The achievement reinforces the campaign’s Prevent, Find, Treat and End TB motto and underscores prevention alongside treatment to break transmission in the region.

triage.headline_ja: カングラ地区、ヒマーチャル州でTB予防対策をリード
triage.triage_reason: 既存のTB対策プログラムの進捗報告であり、異常な発生や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: TB-Mukt Bharat Abhiyanの一環としての予防的治療（TPT）カバレッジ達成に関する定例報告記事。

article.articleHeadline: Parasite causing 'explosive diarrhoea': Why cyclospora is worrying doctors
article.articleSummary: In the United States, Cyclospora outbreaks are among the largest on record, with case numbers already exceeding the 2019 peak. A patient reported about 30 explosive, watery stools daily. Cyclospora cayetanensis is a protozoan parasite; illness features prolonged diarrhoea, loss of appetite, weight loss, abdominal cramps, bloating and fatigue, with dehydration sometimes requiring hospitalization. Vomiting is not predominant. Illness lasts weeks to a month or longer and may relapse; incubation averages about a week (two days to two weeks). Standard stool tests for ova and parasites often miss Cyclospora; specific staining or ultraviolet fluorescence testing is required. Empirical antibiotics such as metronidazole, azithromycin, or fluoroquinolones are ineffective; co-trimoxazole typically yields a dramatic response. The eggs survive weeks in soil and water, enabling environmental contamination upstream; outbreaks arise from contaminated produce rather than direct person-to-person spread. A 2025 Kolkata study found Cyclospora in about 2% of diarrhoeal patients in eastern India, rising to 7% in July–August, with children aged 5–12 most affected (18%).

triage.headline_ja: 『爆発的下痢』を引き起こす寄生虫：シクロスポラが医師を悩ませる理由
triage.triage_reason: 記事は主に米国におけるサイクロスポラ症流行の解説記事であり、対象国であるインドについては2025年の過去の研究データ（有病率）に言及するのみで、現在進行中のアウトブレイクを報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼は米国でのサイクロスポラ流行の解説であり、インド（コルカタ）については2025年の疫学研究結果への言及にとどまり、現行のアウトブレイク事例ではないため対象国イベントとして扱わない。

article.articleHeadline: भागीरथपुरा जल त्रासदी जैसा बैक्टीरिया अब शिशुकुंज स्कूल के पानी में मिलाः तेल, नमकीन और आइसक्रीम भी फेल, जांच के घेरे में स्कूल प्रबंधन
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bacteria Similar to Bhagirathpura Water Tragedy Found in Shishukunj School's Water: Oil, Salt and Ice Cream Also Fail, School Management Under Investigation.
