article.articleSummary: In Indore, Shishukunj School saw about 150 students fall ill on June 22 with vomiting, diarrhea, and abdominal pain. Lab tests confirmed Escherichia coli and coliform bacteria in the school's RO drinking water, signaling sewage or contaminated water, echoing the Bhagirathpura water contamination case. Food samples also failed quality checks: soybean oil, salt, toor dal, and strawberry ice cream showed issues, with the ice cream sample revealing Listeria-like bacteria. The district administration ordered the kitchen sealed and formed a multi-agency team for a detailed inquiry. Collector Shivam Verma vowed strict action against those responsible and ongoing health protections for students. The incident highlights water and food safety lapses in an urban school setting in Indore.

triage.headline_ja: バギーラトプラ水害と類似の細菌がシシュクンジ学校の水からも検出:食用油、塩、アイスクリームも不合格、学校運営側が調査対象に
triage.triage_reason: 学校での集団食中毒（約150人発症）で大腸菌・リステリア様菌が検出されたが、単一施設内の局地的事例であり国際的拡大の懸念は低い。ただし同様の水質汚染事例(Bhagirathpura)との関連性や地域の水道インフラ問題が背景にある可能性があり、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 150名の生徒が発症したが死者は報告されていない。学校の給水・食品(食用油、塩、アイスクリーム)からE.coliおよびリステリア様菌が検出され、当局が調査・是正措置を実施中。地域内の局地的な食品・水質安全問題であり、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Smrtonosni virus sličan eboli se širi: Stručnjaci upozoravaju da svet nije spreman za ovakvu epidemiju
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A deadly virus similar to Ebola is spreading: Experts warn that the world is not prepared for such an epidemic.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo (Bundibugyo) virus, a filovirus related to Ebola, has triggered the largest outbreak to date in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. By June 11, 2026, 695 cases and 138 deaths have been reported. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids, placing healthcare workers and family members at high risk. Early, non-specific symptoms (fever, malaise) mimic malaria/typhoid, making clinical diagnosis unreliable without laboratory confirmation, which is challenged by the need to ship samples to distant reference labs, delaying diagnosis, isolation, and contact tracing. There is no approved vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo virus. The NEJM study by Dr. Nensi Saliven notes that preparedness must address rare pathogens, as health systems struggle to recognize and contain such infections, underscoring global gaps in outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラに似た致死性ウイルスが拡大：専門家は世界がこのような流行に備えていないと警告
triage.triage_reason: DRC・ウガンダでバンディブギョウイルス（フィロウイルス）の過去最大規模の流行が発生し、695症例・138死亡、ワクチン・治療法がなく、ヒト-ヒト感染リスクが高いためIHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生地域とされているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。NEJM掲載の研究に基づく報道であり、国際的な関心・専門家の警鐘が強い。承認されたワクチン・治療法がない点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: 高雄添2例境外移入登革熱　衛生局籲返台主動採檢
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kaohsiung reports two imported dengue fever cases; Health Bureau urges people returning to Taiwan to proactively undergo testing.
article.articleSummary: Two imported dengue fever cases were reported in Kaohsiung, both in Daliao District: a 27-year-old Vietnamese immigrant and a 21-year-old Cambodian student. This year Kaohsiung has recorded 11 imported dengue cases, including 3 foreign students. The Vietnamese case returned to Taiwan in late June and developed fever on July 11; NS1 rapid test and PCR confirmed the diagnosis. The Cambodian student returned to Taiwan on July 10 after a late-June stay in Cambodia and developed fever, joint pain, and poor appetite on July 14; confirmation followed. At the Cambodian student’s school, four containers tested dengue-positive; cleaning and chemical control were performed. Daliao District’s mosquito-positive rate rose to 10% with recent rainfall, increasing community risk; residents were advised to eliminate standing water in gutters, balconies, plant pots, tires, and basements. The Summer Overseas Rewards Program offers a 500 NT voucher after dengue screening post-Southeast Asia travel, and provides mosquito repellent pre-travel.

triage.headline_ja: 高雄で境外移入デング熱2例確認、衛生局が台湾帰国者に自主検査を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 台湾（高雄）における輸入デング熱症例の日常的な報告であり、対象国リストに該当する発生国はなく、地域拡大や重大な公衆衛生上の懸念も認められない。
triage.notes: 症例は台湾で発生した輸入例（ベトナム・カンボジア由来）。台湾・フィリピン・ベトナム・カンボジアが発生地域として付与されているが、記事の主題は台湾国内での輸入症例管理であり、対象国リスト（フィリピン・ベトナム含む）における実際の発生ではないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: اقترب إعلان خلوّ أوغندا من "إيبولا".. والكونغو تصارع التفشي الأعنف
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda Nears Ebola-Free Declaration as Congo Battles the Deadliest Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Uganda is nearing an Ebola-free status as the last patient is set to leave isolation at Mulago National Referral Hospital in Kampala, triggering a 42-day WHO-mandated countdown before declaring the outbreak over. Health authorities report 17 recoveries, with one patient remaining in isolation and two deaths; five local infections and 15 imported cases, all linked to the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, described by WHO as the third-largest outbreak of this strain. If no new cases occur in the next approximately six weeks, Uganda would be declared free of Ebola. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, the situation remains more severe, with WHO declaring a Public Health Emergency of International Concern in May. Government data cite 2,011 confirmed infections and 754 deaths, making it one of the deadliest recent outbreaks, with ongoing cross-border containment efforts monitored by the international community.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダはエボラ終息宣言に近づく一方、コンゴは最も深刻な流行と戦う
triage.triage_reason: DRCではWHOがPHEICを宣言し754人が死亡する深刻なエボラ流行が継続しており、国境を越えた感染拡大リスクも認められるためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダも記事の主題だが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCはWHOがPHEICを宣言した深刻な流行が継続中。

article.articleHeadline: Lubero : des déplacés sans moyens de protection contre Ebola, la société civile redoute un risque de propagation du virus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lubero: Displaced people lacking protective measures against Ebola, civil society fears a risk of the virus spreading.
article.articleSummary: More than 6,000 displaced people in Lubero-centre, North Kivu, are living in reception sites without hygiene kits or protective equipment, including soap, handwashing facilities, and disinfectants. Civil society warns this precarious hygienic situation raises exposure to contagious diseases, notably Ebola virus disease, as prevention measures are hard to maintain. Community actors urge authorities, humanitarian organizations, and health partners to act promptly: distribute hygiene kits, install handwashing points, strengthen site sanitation, and sustain awareness campaigns among the displaced. The Lubero territory continues to host families fleeing violence by armed groups; humanitarian needs remain substantial and exceed current response capacities. Rapid intervention is deemed essential to protect displaced populations and prevent a health crisis from adding to the region’s already concerning humanitarian situation.

triage.headline_ja: ルベロ:避難民がエボラ対策の防護手段を欠き、市民社会がウイルス拡散リスクを懸念
triage.triage_reason: 北キブ州ルベロの避難民キャンプにおける衛生環境の欠如がエボラ拡散リスクを高めていると市民社会が警告しているが、実際の感染確定例や発生の報告はなく、確認情報が不足しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は実際のエボラ感染例の報告ではなく、避難民の衛生状態悪化によるリスクへの警鐘であり、続報（実際の症例発生有無）の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Health Alert - U.S. Embassy Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo (July 15, 2026)
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) prompts new U.S. travel restrictions under Title 49: U.S. citizens and nationals who have been in the DRC within 21 days may not enter the United States via commercial aviation. Travelers in the 21-day window cannot board flights bound for U.S. destinations and should plan to remain outside the DRC for 21 days before entering the United States. The U.S. Embassy Kinshasa health alert, issued July 15, 2026 (published July 16, 2026), also directs travellers to review CDC information on travel restrictions, enroll in the Smart Traveler Enrollment Program (STEP), and monitor official updates. For assistance, contact the Kinshasa Embassy or State Department Consular Affairs; ensure travel documents are current; alert your healthcare provider if experiencing symptoms consistent with Ebola; and prepare medical directives and evacuation plans as needed.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：健康警報 - 在キンシャサ米国大使館（2026年7月15日付）
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行によりDRCに対する米国の渡航制限が発動されており、IHR基準の複数項目（渡航制限、国際的拡大リスク、深刻な公衆衛生影響）に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事は米国大使館による渡航警告に焦点を当てており、DRC国内のエボラ流行状況（症例数・地域詳細）については具体的記載がない。続報でアウトブレイクの規模・拡大状況を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: منظمات إغاثة تحذر: قيود واشنطن قد تعرقل مكافحة إيبولا في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Aid organizations warn: Washington's restrictions could hinder the fight against Ebola in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: United States imposes a new rule requiring citizens departing the Democratic Republic of Congo to spend 21 days in a third country before entering the United States, blocking direct Congo-to-U.S. commercial flights and extending screening previously conducted at certain airports. The measure risks hampering Ebola response in Congo by making it harder to recruit medical volunteers; Samaritan's Purse warns the three-week delay and higher travel costs could reduce its Congo operations. The organization runs two Ebola treatment centers—Bunia and Nyankunde—with about 100 beds and has treated over 270 patients since June, employing about 80 American staff. Official data cite more than 1,900 confirmed Ebola cases and 700 deaths, all linked to Bundibugyo virus; WHO calls it the third-largest outbreak. CDC says risk to U.S. public remains low; humanitarian or security waivers may be granted case-by-case. The rule sparks a debate over preventing spread versus sustaining the international response and Congo’s capacity.

triage.headline_ja: 援助団体が警告：ワシントンの渡航制限がコンゴのエボラ対策を妨げる可能性
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で1,900例超・死亡700人規模（WHOが第3位の大流行と認定）のエボラ流行が継続中であり、米国の渡航制限が国際的な対応能力を損なう恐れがあるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 米国はコンゴ渡航者に対する新規入国制限を課しており、これが人道支援団体（Samaritan's Purse等）の医療従事者派遣を困難にし、エボラ対応能力に影響を与える懸念が指摘されている。米国自体は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Oxfam Intermón advierte que miles de personas se ven obligadas a utilizar una única fuente de agua en centros de tratamiento del ébola de la República Democrática del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Oxfam Intermón warns that thousands of people are forced to use a single water source at Ebola treatment centers in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo is facing a Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak with over 2,000 cases and more than 750 deaths across 42 health zones. In Bunia, up to 20,000 people are forced to fetch potable water from a single source inside an Ebola treatment center, highlighting a critical lack of water and sanitation in facilities. Centers are operating beyond capacity (some >130%), underfunded and short of PPE, increasing infection risk among health workers in Ituri. Contact tracing is about 80%, below the 90% achieved in 2018, leaving transmission gaps as the outbreak spreads to Tshopo, Haut-Uélé, and Kisangani. The situation raises cross-border concerns with South Sudan and the Central African Republic, as daily new cases run around 70. Community engagement covers only about 10%. Oxfam Intermón calls for urgent investment to restore water access and bolster treatment centers and community outreach.

triage.headline_ja: オックスファム・インテルモン、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ治療センターで数千人が単一の水源利用を強いられていると警告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で2000人以上の症例・750人以上の死亡者を伴う大規模エボラ流行が継続し、複数州への拡大と国境を越えた懸念（南スーダン、中央アフリカ共和国）があるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 南スーダン・中央アフリカ共和国は『越境の懸念』として言及されているのみで、実際の症例確認情報はないため verified_locations には含めていない。接触者追跡率80%（2018年の90%を下回る）、コミュニティエンゲージメント約10%、治療センターの過剰収容（130%超）、PPE不足など、対応能力の逼迫が顕著。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو الديمقراطية تعلن ارتفاع عدد الإصابات بفيروس إيبولا مجددًا إلى 2073 حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo announces that the number of Ebola virus infections has risen again to 2,073 cases.
article.articleSummary: 2,073 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 796 deaths reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as of July 14, 2026, per the DRC's Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. The ongoing outbreak remains challenging to contain, with contact tracing covering only 76% of those exposed to infection. The World Health Organization has indicated the true number of Ebola infections in the DRC is likely at least double the official count, signaling substantial under-ascertainment. These figures highlight surveillance and tracing gaps that complicate containment, as authorities strive to strengthen tracing, reporting, and laboratory confirmation of cases to better quantify and control transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラウイルス感染者数が再び2,073人に上昇したと発表
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱の大規模流行が継続中で、症例2,073件・死者796人と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、接触者追跡が76%に留まり過小把握の可能性も指摘されるなど、国際的拡大リスクと管理困難性が認められるためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: WHOによれば実際の感染者数は公式発表の2倍以上の可能性があり、サーベイランス・追跡体制の不備が継続的な感染拡大リスクを高めている。継続的なモニタリングが必要。

article.articleHeadline: विशाखापत्तनम में भी COVID की दस्तक... हैदराबाद से लौटे युवक की रिपोर्ट पॉजिटिव
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID knocks in Visakhapatnam too... Hyderabad-returned youth tests positive
article.articleSummary: First COVID-19 case in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh, as of 16 July 2026: a 33-year-old man who recently returned from Hyderabad tested positive for COVID-19 in a private lab and King George Hospital, and is currently in home isolation under medical supervision. He developed cold, cough, fever and body ache after returning. He resides in a government colony near the Collectorate. Health authorities have begun contact tracing and advised home isolation for exposed individuals. This follows two COVID-19 deaths earlier in Kadapa district, prompting heightened vigilance across the state. Officials urged calm, testing for fever, cough, sore throat, or breathing difficulties, and continued hygiene measures such as handwashing and masking when needed.

triage.headline_ja: ヴィシャーカパトナムでもCOVID到来…ハイデラバードから帰郷した若者の検査結果が陽性
triage.triage_reason: 単発の軽症例で公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は現時点で認められないが、州内での死亡例報告もあり動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: COVID-19は既知の疾患であり通常のサーベイランス対象。カダパ県での死亡例言及があるが詳細不明のため続報を注視。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RD Congo : 2.073 cas recensés
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in DR Congo: 2,073 cases recorded.
article.articleSummary: As of July 16, 2026, authorities in the Democratic Republic of the Congo report 2,073 confirmed Ebola cases and 796 deaths. The update, from Kinshasa and cited by SANA, reflects the latest laboratory-confirmed figures across the country. Transmission is described as direct contact with blood, secretions, organs and other infected bodily fluids, as well as with surfaces and materials contaminated by these fluids. The notice provides no regional breakdown, treatment updates, or details on public health measures within this brief. No information is provided on vaccination status, exported or imported cases, or new transmission chains in the article. These numbers mark the current Ebola situation in DR Congo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：2,073例を確認
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（2,073症例、796死亡）であり、公衆衛生上深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクを有するためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 致死率は約38%と高く、感染拡大の詳細（地域別内訳、ワクチン接種状況、輸出症例の有無）は記事内で不明。継続的なモニタリングと詳細情報の収集が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 乌干达最后一名埃博拉患者出院
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The last Ebola patient in Uganda has been discharged.
article.articleSummary: Uganda reports the last Ebola patient discharged in Kampala, marking another milestone in containing the border spillover from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). Since mid-May, DRC has recorded over 2,000 Ebola cases and about 754 deaths, with WHO warning actual totals may be 2–4 times higher. Uganda has reported 20 cases and 2 deaths, largely among Congolese cross-border arrivals. Hundreds of close contacts were quarantined for 21 days and have been released, as authorities vow to tighten border controls to minimize cross-border spread. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which no vaccine or specific therapy exists yet; however, a first antiviral drug clinical trial has begun. Under WHO guidelines, Uganda must withstand 42 consecutive days without new cases to be declared Ebola-free.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダで最後のエボラ患者が退院
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はDRCで2000例超・754人死亡と深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、ウガンダへの越境伝播も発生しているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダでの最終患者退院という朗報だが、根本にあるDRCでのエボラ大規模流行（2000例超、754人死亡、WHOは実数がさらに高い可能性を警告）が主要な懸念事項。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。42日間新規症例なしでの終息宣言まで継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Gefährliches Virus: Symptome von Ebola-Patient in Frankfurt bessern sich
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dangerous virus: Symptoms of an Ebola patient in Frankfurt are improving.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola patient treated at Frankfurt University Medical Center remains stable and shows symptom improvement, benefiting from supportive therapies. The patient is the second US citizen infected with the virus to be treated in Germany, flown in about two months after the first Ebola-stricken American arrived in the country, and arrived at Frankfurt Airport on Monday night. The patient contracted Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a variant of Ebola virus, in the Democratic Republic of Congo and presented with high fever among its symptoms. Frankfurt has previously treated hemorrhagic fever cases, including one Ebola patient and two others with Lassa fever (Lassa virus). This reflects ongoing management of imported Ebola cases in Germany, with continued stabilization under supportive care.

triage.headline_ja: 危険なウイルス：フランクフルトのエボラ患者の症状が改善
triage.triage_reason: ドイツで治療中の輸入エボラ症例（感染源はコンゴ民主共和国）で、患者は安定・回復傾向にあり二次感染の報告もないため緊急性は低いが、DRCでの発生状況の続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はドイツ・フランクフルトでの輸入エボラ症例(米国人患者)の治療経過であり、患者は安定・回復傾向。感染源であるコンゴ民主共和国(Bundibugyoエボラウイルス)における流行状況自体の詳細は記載されていないため、DRCでの発生動向は続報で確認する必要がある。ドイツ国内での二次感染や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: 暑期境外移入登革熱風險拉警報　高雄單日新增2確診個案
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning issued over the risk of overseas-imported dengue fever this summer; Kaohsiung reports 2 new confirmed cases in a single day.
article.articleSummary: Two new overseas-imported dengue fever cases were confirmed in Kaohsiung City, both in Daliao District, bringing the year's imported total to 11. The 10th case is a 27-year-old Vietnamese new immigrant; the 11th is a 21-year-old Cambodian student. Both returned from abroad—Vietnam (May 31–June 30) and Cambodia (June 21–July 10)—and developed fever, myalgia, retro-orbital pain, and nausea after returning to Taiwan. NS1 rapid tests were positive and PCR confirmed dengue infection. A 500 NT voucher reward is offered for proactive rapid testing upon return from Southeast Asia. Breeding-site checks around the Cambodian student’s school found four positive containers (water wells, iron drums, flower pots, basins); authorities intensified environmental cleaning and vector-control around residences. Daliao District’s mosquitos showed a 10% positive rate in week 27; with rainfall, community transmission risk remains. Citizens should monitor for 14 days post-travel and seek prompt medical care with TOCC information.

triage.headline_ja: 夏季の海外由来デング熱リスクに警戒警報　高雄で1日に2件の新規確定例
triage.triage_reason: 台湾（高雄）における海外渡航歴のある輸入例2件の報告であり、対象国における発生事例ではなく、公衆衛生上の重大性や異常性も認められない通常の季節的サーベイランス報告である。
triage.notes: 感染発生地は台湾（対象国リスト外）。ベトナム・カンボジアは患者の渡航元として言及されているのみで、当該国での発生事例ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ouganda : les autorités annoncent la guérison du dernier patient
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Uganda: authorities announce the recovery of the last patient.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 July 2026, Uganda is poised to discharge the last Ebola patient, signaling near-term declaration of outbreak end after a 42-day WHO surveillance period. The Ugandan Health Ministry reports 20 cases, including five locally transmitted and fifteen imported, with two deaths and 17 recoveries; all cases are linked to the Bundibugyo strain. The country aims to complete the surveillance without new infections to be officially declared Ebola-free. By contrast, the Democratic Republic of Congo continues to face a larger situation with over 2,000 confirmed cases and more than 750 deaths. Continued vigilance is expected during post-outbreak monitoring until formal WHO status updates.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱:ウガンダ当局、最後の患者の回復を発表
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダでの症例終息が近い一方、DRCでは2,000例以上・750人超の死亡を伴う大規模なエボラ流行が継続しており、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と複数国への拡大が確認される。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダの症例終息を主題とするが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。一方、DRCの大規模流行（2,000例以上、750人超の死亡）が明記されており、DRCを実発生国として計上した。

article.articleHeadline: 海漂豬檢出非洲豬瘟　金門縣府：鄰近豬場豬隻健康
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Drifting pigs test positive for African swine fever; Kinmen County Government: Pigs at nearby farms are healthy.
article.articleSummary: A drifting 70-kg pig carcass found at Jinhu/Xintou coast, Kinmen, tested positive for African swine fever (ASF) virus nucleic acid by PCR, confirmed by the Ministry of Agriculture's Veterinary Research Institute. The carcass was incinerated on site and the surrounding area disinfected. Health visits to 25 pig farms within a 10-km radius (5,033 pigs) found all animals clinically healthy. The incident is potentially linked to weather; authorities cite Typhoon Bavi’s outer circulation and sea currents that could have carried the carcass from nearby mainland China (Fujian/Xiamen area). In response, Kinmen County extended restrictions on Kinmen pork and pork products exported to Taiwan’s main island and other offshore islands until July 22, requiring at least one week without new outbreaks. Exports of certain ruminant processed products meeting national risk assessments may still proceed.

triage.headline_ja: 海上を漂流していた豚がアフリカ豚熱陽性反応、金門県政府：近隣養豚場の豚は健康
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱は動物疾病であり人への健康影響はないが、対岸の中国本土からの越境汚染が疑われ、貿易制限措置も取られているため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 発見場所は台湾・金門島であり対象国リストに含まれない。中国本土（福建・厦門）からの漂流が疑われるが、中国本土での発生確認情報はサマリー中に無いため verified_locations には含めない。人への感染はなく、家畜疾病としての経済・貿易影響が中心。

article.articleHeadline: 金門14日出現海漂豬屍體 應變中心確認非洲豬瘟
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kinmen reports sea-drifted pig carcasses on the 14th; Emergency Response Center confirms African swine fever.
article.articleSummary: Sea-drift pig carcass found on Kinmen Island’s Xintou Beach on July 14; tests by the Council of Agriculture's Animal Health Research Institute confirmed African swine fever virus nucleic acid positive, with genome sequencing underway. Kinmen County Epidemic Prevention Office collected samples and, on-site, burned and buried the carcass and disinfected surrounding areas. The Emergency Response Center attributes drift to Typhoon Bavi's outer circulation. Kinmen is near Fujian Province, Xiamen, and Jiulongjiang coast. Within 10 km, 25 pig farms underwent health visits; all pigs were healthy. Under the Animal Infectious Disease Control Act, the Ministry expanded the ban on Kinmen pork and pork products to Taiwan’s main island and other offshore islands until at least one week with no new outbreaks. Border controls and domestic surveillance will continue; travelers are advised not to bring pork or related products. This is the first sea-drift ASF case in 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 金門島で14日に海に漂着した豚の死骸が発見され、対策センターがアフリカ豚熱（ASF）を確認
triage.triage_reason: 本事案は動物のみに影響する感染症（アフリカ豚熱）であり、ヒトへの健康被害はない。また発生地は台湾（金門島）であり、対象国リストに該当する国での発生は確認されていないため、監視対象としての優先度は低い。
triage.notes: 発生地は台湾・金門島（対象国リスト外）。福建省・厦門は地理的近接として言及されているのみで、実際の感染確認地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。ASFはヒトに感染しないため公衆衛生上の直接的リスクは低いが、豚肉貿易・畜産業への経済的影響は継続監視の価値あり。

article.articleHeadline: ಮಕ್ಕಳಲ್ಲಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚುತ್ತಿರುವ ಕೈ, ಕಾಲು, ಬಾಯಿ ಸೋಂಕಿನ ಲಕ್ಷಣಗಳು ಹೇಗಿರುತ್ತವೆ, ಇದನ್ನು ತಡೆಗಟ್ಟಲು ಏನು ಮಾಡಬೇಕು ತಿಳಿದುಕೊಳ್ಳಿ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What are the symptoms of the increasing hand, foot, and mouth disease in children, and what should be done to prevent it?
article.articleSummary: Hand, Foot and Mouth Disease (HFMD), caused by Coxsackie and other enteroviruses, is spreading among children in Karnataka, notably Bengaluru. Transmission occurs via infected saliva, nasal discharge, blister fluid, stool, and contaminated objects—rapid in schools, anganwadis, day-care centers, and playgrounds. Symptoms include fever, sore throat, reduced appetite, malaise, and painful ulcers inside the mouth (tongue, gums, inner cheeks), with red or fluid-filled blisters on hands and feet, sometimes on ankles, knees, or back. Younger children may be irritable and refuse foods or drinks; vomiting can occur. There is no specific antiviral; most recover in 7–10 days with supportive care and doctor-guided fever/pain relief. Prevention emphasizes regular handwashing, cleaning toys and surfaces, isolating the infected child until fully recovered, hygiene before meals and after toileting, and not sharing clothes or towels. Seek urgent care for high fever, excessive drowsiness, severe dehydration, or breathing trouble.

triage.headline_ja: 子供に増加中の手足口病の症状とは、予防のために何をすべきか
triage.triage_reason: 手足口病は小児に一般的な疾患で、記事は一般的な症状・予防啓発情報であり、異常な流行や重症化、公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 手足口病(HFMD)は小児によくみられるエンテロウイルス感染症で、記事は健康啓発記事の性質が強く、突発的な集団発生や異常な重症例の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak is fastest-growing in history as cases hit 2,000 with 750 dead
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Eastern Congo is the fastest-growing in history, with more than 2,000 confirmed cases and over 750 deaths. The epicenter is Ituri province (Bunia) with suspected cases emerging in Kisangani and a second province, heightening spread concerns. WHO notes 80% of new cases link to unknown transmission chains, complicating containment. The Bundibugyo strain, for which no approved vaccines or treatments exist, drives the surge; researchers have begun enrolling patients in two experimental therapies, remdesivir and MBP134 antibodies. A randomized trial will compare standard care, remdesivir, MBP134, both, or neither, but results may take months and involve up to 1,000 participants. Unpaid health workers struck at an Ituri treatment center and at Bunia General Hospital, threatening containment through labor disruption. Transmission occurs from wildlife to humans and person-to-person via bodily fluids; funeral restrictions aim to cut spread amid community tensions. Trial access remains limited to a single center in Ituri with plans to expand.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の発生が史上最速のペースで拡大、感染者2,000人・死者750人に到達
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ東部で史上最速の拡大を示し、感染者2,000人・死者750人超、未知の感染経路が80%を占め、医療従事者ストによる対応能力低下も発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大なシグナルである。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株による流行で承認済みワクチン・治療薬がなく、実験的治療（remdesivir、MBP134）の治験が開始されているが、規模は限定的。医療従事者のストライキが封じ込め対応を脅かしている点も重要な懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak: Uganda starts 42-day countdown to being declared free of the virus
article.articleSummary: Uganda has discharged the last Ebola patient from the Bundibugyo outbreak, starting a 42-day countdown to an official Ebola-free status if no new infections arise. The first case was confirmed in May in a man who travelled from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DR Congo), the outbreak’s epicentre. Uganda reported 20 confirmed cases, mostly among visitors from DR Congo, and two deaths. DR Congo records over 2,000 confirmed infections and 796 deaths in the outbreak there. Uganda’s health ministry urges vigilance and early care for fever, vomiting, diarrhoea, or unexplained bleeding, noting isolation and contact tracing. DR Congo remains hard hit; WHO suggests true infections could be four times higher due to possible undetected community transmission. The US now requires 21 days in a third country for travellers from DR Congo, potentially affecting medics’ recruitment. Ebola virus targets the immune system and organs and spreads via bodily fluids, with spillovers often linked to handling infected animals.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行:ウガンダ、ウイルス終息宣言に向け42日間のカウントダウンを開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCで2000人超の感染・796人の死亡という大規模流行が継続中であり、越境例や渡航制限措置も生じているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダの終息宣言に向けた動きだが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。感染源であり流行が継続しているDRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。米国の渡航制限（DRCからの渡航者に第三国での21日間滞在を要求）は国際的な対応措置として言及されている。

article.articleHeadline: Gericht: Kasse muss Kosten wegen möglicher Lepraerkrankung in Brasilien nicht tragen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Court: Health insurance fund does not have to cover costs for possible leprosy in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: Telemedicine assessment costs for a suspected leprosy case diagnosed in Brazil were not preliminarily covered by a German statutory health insurance fund. In Germany, medical treatment is generally limited to the statutory benefits catalog, with foreign services allowed only in exceptional cases (Az.: L 16 KR 221/26 BER). The applicant, a 45-year-old woman diagnosed with leprosy in autumn 2023 in Brazil, sought coverage for medications and telemedicine treatment plus travel costs. The insurer refused, citing lack of a bilateral social security agreement and that entitlement abroad is suspended during stays. An initial injunction was denied; in April the Social Court ordered provisional payment. The Landessozialgericht Niedersachsen-Bremen reversed, upholding the insurer. It ruled telemedicine abroad can be claimed only in exceptional cases outside the EU/EEA, not met here, since leprosy was not sufficiently confirmed by tropical institutes or a Bundeswehr hospital. Tropical diseases are treatable at German tropical medicine institutes.

triage.headline_ja: 裁判所:健康保険はブラジルでの疑いのあるハンセン病治療費用を負担する必要はない
triage.triage_reason: 個人の医療保険費用負担を巡る法的紛争であり、公衆衛生上の脅威や感染症アウトブレイクに関する情報ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はドイツの社会裁判所における医療保険給付を巡る個別の法的判断に関する内容であり、感染症の発生・拡大を報告するものではない。ブラジルでの単一症例（2023年秋診断）に関する言及のみで、公衆衛生上のシグナルとは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: DRC Ebola Deaths Mount while Health Workers Strike
article.articleSummary: Outbreak overview: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak with >2,000 confirmed cases and at least 750 deaths; official toll 754, with WHO estimating true deaths potentially 2–4 times higher. Ituri province is hardest hit, especially Bunia General Hospital, where frontline staff have struck over months of unpaid wages and promised bonuses. The outbreak was declared on 15 May, and vaccine trials are underway, though there are no specific treatments or vaccines for Bundibugyo at present. Ebola spreads via direct contact with body fluids. The health crisis is set against a backdrop of other urgent health threats in DRC, including cholera, HIV, malaria, measles, mpox, pneumonia, and tuberculosis, as well as malnutrition and insecurity. The escalation underscores governance and resource gaps and the need for sustained international support to protect workers and contain the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: DRCでエボラ死者数が増加、医療従事者はストライキ中
triage.triage_reason: エボラ（ブンディブギョ株）の大規模アウトブレイクで2,000例超・死者750名超、医療従事者のストライキにより対応体制が脆弱化しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し国際支援の必要性も明確。
triage.notes: 医療従事者のストライキによる対応能力低下がアウトブレイク拡大の一因となっており、ガバナンス・資源不足の問題も指摘されている。WHOは実際の死者数が公式発表の2〜4倍に上る可能性を推定。

article.articleHeadline: Upper Assam logs 55 JE & 244 AES cases since Jan 1; 11 deaths reported
article.articleSummary: Between Jan 1 and July 15, 2026, Upper Assam's six districts reported 55 Japanese encephalitis (JE) cases and 244 Acute Encephalitis Syndrome (AES) cases, with nine JE deaths and two AES deaths. Sivasagar: 6 JE, 33 AES, no deaths; worst areas Geleki Khelua, Demow, Morabazar, Kalugaon, Gaurisagar. Tinsukia and Golaghat each reported 12 JE cases, with two JE deaths in each. Dibrugarh: 11 JE and 56 AES, one death; worst-hit Khowang, Naharkatia. Jorhat: 9 JE (3 deaths) and 31 AES (2 deaths); hotspots Baghchung, Titabar, Solmara. Charaideo: 5 JE (1 death) and 31 AES. JE is viral, transmitted by Culex mosquitoes; pigs and wading birds are amplifying hosts; humans are dead-end hosts. Cases rise during monsoon (June–October). Measures include mosquito nets, vaccination drives for children, pig-management, and door-to-door fever surveys, IPC, fogging, and nets distribution.

triage.headline_ja: アッサム州上部地域、1月1日以降に日本脳炎55例、急性脳炎症候群244例を報告、死亡11例
triage.triage_reason: インドAssam州は日本脳炎の流行地域であり、季節性（雨季）の毎年発生するパターンに合致するため異常性は低いが、死亡例が継続的に報告されており動向の注視が必要。
triage.notes: Assam州は日本脳炎の風土病地域であり、毎年雨季（6-10月）に症例が増加する既知のパターン。ワクチン接種、豚の管理、防蚊対策など既存の対応策が実施されている。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、死亡例の継続的発生から経過観察が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: 高雄市今日新增兩例登革熱確診個案 衛生局暑期決戰境外獎勵專案　民眾返國主動採檢快篩贈500元禮券 - OwlNews
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two new dengue fever cases confirmed in Kaohsiung City today; Health Bureau's Summer Overseas Battle Rewards Program; Citizens returning to Taiwan voluntarily undergo rapid testing and receive NT$500 gift vouchers - OwlNews
article.articleSummary: Two new imported dengue cases were confirmed in Kaohsiung City on 16 July 2026, both in Daliao District. The patients are a 27-year-old Vietnamese new immigrant and a 21-year-old Cambodian student who had returned to Southeast Asia for family visits before illness; NS1 rapid tests were positive and PCR confirmed dengue. This brings Kaohsiung’s imported dengue total for the year to 11, with foreign students making up three cases. In response, the Health Bureau urged schools with foreign students to bolster summer vector-control efforts and participate in the Summer Overseas Battle Rewards Program, offering NT$500 vouchers to returnees who proactively test after Southeast Asia travel. Investigations and emergency control followed; four breeding-positive containers were found at the Cambodian student’s school. Daliao District’s Week 27 vector surveillance showed a 10% positivity rate, reinforced by rainfall. Returnees with fever within 14 days should seek care and report TOCC to physicians.

triage.headline_ja: 高雄市今日新增兩例登革熱確診個案 衛生局暑期決戰境外獎勵專案　民眾返國主動採檢快篩贈500元禮券
triage.triage_reason: 台湾・高雄市における輸入性デング熱の散発事例であり、地元当局が通常の対策を実施している段階で、国際的拡大や重大な公衆衛生上の脅威を示す要素はない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾（対象国リスト外）における輸入デング熱事例。フィリピン人・カンボジア人・ベトナム人の言及はあるが、感染発生国はいずれも台湾であり、対象国リスト該当は東南アジア渡航歴のうちフィリピンが地域情報に含まれるが、実際の患者渡航先はベトナム・カンボジアであり、フィリピンは主題として直接言及されていないため、厳密には該当なしの可能性が高い。念のため空配列とすべきか要確認。

article.articleHeadline: Health: Uganda starts 42-day Ebola-Free countdown as last pa
article.articleSummary: On 16 July 2026, Uganda discharged its last confirmed Ebola patient, a Congolese national at Mulago National Isolation Centre in Kampala, triggering a 42-day countdown before the WHO can declare the country Ebola-free. The outbreak, which began in the Democratic Republic of Congo and killed two people in Uganda, is imported; if no new cases are recorded during the 42-day window (two 21-day incubation periods), Uganda could be declared Ebola-free. The countdown proceeds as border districts with the DRC remain at risk; surveillance, screening, and community sensitisation will continue. Uganda’s response is attributed to prior epidemic preparedness, with a case fatality rate under 10%. About 160 suspected patients passed through the isolation unit; many had malaria or typhoid. No health worker infections were reported. The National Task Force will cautiously review restrictions on markets and public gatherings in border areas.

triage.headline_ja: 保健:ウガンダ、最後の患者退院を受けエボラ出血熱終息へ向けた42日間のカウントダウンを開始
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準に複数該当（重篤性・異常性・国際的拡大・活動制限検討）しており、DRCからの越境輸入例という国際的公衆衛生上の懸念があるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 本アウトブレイクはDRCで発生しウガンダへ越境輸入された事例。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。国境地域では引き続きリスクがあり、DRC側での状況（新規症例の有無等）について続報を要確認。ウガンダの対応自体は事前準備により良好（院内感染ゼロ、致死率10%未満）。

article.articleHeadline: Camanducaia vacina funcionários do Fórum contra a Influenza
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Camanducaia vaccinates courthouse staff against influenza.
article.articleSummary: Influenza vaccination was administered on July 7 at the Camanducaia courthouse by the Municipal Health Department, targeting staff who interact daily with the public. The outdoor immunization drive brought the flu vaccine directly to the workplace to protect both employees and visitors and to reduce exposure in the forum environment. This action is part of the Health Secretariat's broader effort to expand prevention and reach different segments of the Camanducaia community. The influenza vaccine provides protection against the flu. Residents are encouraged to visit their nearest health unit to check and update their vaccination records per the individual immunization schedule. Source: Prefeitura de Camanducaia.

triage.headline_ja: カマンドゥカイア、裁判所職員にインフルエンザワクチンを接種
triage.triage_reason: 通常のインフルエンザ予防接種活動に関する記事であり、異常な公衆衛生事象や国際的懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・カマンドゥカイア市の日常的なワクチン接種キャンペーンに関する内容であり、感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: COVID-19 case at AIIMS Mangalagiri; Guntur health authorities step up precautions
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 case detected with symptoms at AIIMS Mangalagiri in Guntur district, Amaravati, Andhra Pradesh, prompting heightened precautionary and containment measures from the district administration on 16 July 2026. DMHO K. Vijayalakshmi said authorities are intensifying surveillance, monitoring, and public health protocols after a symptomatic positive case was identified at AIIMS Mangalagiri. Samples are being sent to the National Institute of Virology in Pune for genome sequencing to identify the circulating variant and to support epidemiological assessment. The statement follows reports of another COVID-19 death in Andhra Pradesh and three additional positive tests, underscoring rising vigilance. District Collector C.M. Sai Kanth Varma instructed strict adherence to health protocols. Visakhapatnam DMHO added that precautionary measures are in place and there is no need to panic.

triage.headline_ja: AIIMSマンガラギリでCOVID-19症例確認、グントゥール保健当局が予防措置を強化
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19は既にエンデミック化した既知の疾患であり、インド国内での単発の症状陽性例と地域的な死亡例報告に対する通常の監視強化対応であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当性が低い。
triage.notes: 地元当局は『パニックの必要はない』と明言しており、通常の感染症サーベイランス対応の範囲内。ゲノム解析中だが新変異株の危険性を示す情報はなし。

article.articleHeadline: L'Assemblée nationale auditionne le ministre de la Santé sur Ebola et adopte un rapport sur la pêche et l'aquaculture
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The National Assembly holds a hearing on Ebola with the Minister of Health and adopts a report on fishing and aquaculture.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the Ebola outbreak has reached 2,011 total cases across affected zones, with Ituri province as the main epicenter; no confirmed Ebola cases in Kinshasa to date. On July 15, 2026, the National Assembly heard Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba, who cited mobility challenges for response teams and knowledge gaps about the disease in some communities. MPs questioned resources, response strategy, and preventive measures. The session also considered a government bill to extend the state of siege in parts of North Kivu and Ituri, and the plenary adopted a report from the joint Assembly-Senate on fishing and aquaculture principles, paving the way for a harmonized law.

triage.headline_ja: 国民議会、エボラ出血熱についてカンバ保健相を招致し聴取、漁業・養殖に関する報告書を採択
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが累計2,011例に達し、国会が保健大臣を招致するなど政府レベルでの高い関心が示されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ流行の疫学的詳細よりも国会での政治的対応（大臣聴取、北キブ・イツリの戒厳令延長、漁業法案採択）に焦点を当てているが、既存の大規模エボラアウトブレイク（累計2,011例）の継続を示す重要な続報であるためPICKUPと判断。キンシャサでは症例確認なし、主要発生地はイツリ州。

article.articleHeadline: 香港過去四周錄7宗新冠死亡個案 | 電訊
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hong Kong records 7 COVID-19 deaths in the past four weeks.
article.articleSummary: As of July 16, 2026, Hong Kong’s Centre for Health Protection reports rising COVID-19 and seasonal influenza activity, with COVID-19 at a one-year high. Local SARS-CoV-2 positivity in respiratory samples rose from under 1% at end-May to 9.79% last week; wastewater SARS-CoV-2 RNA around 500,000 copies per liter, higher than late May. In the past four weeks, 45 adult severe COVID-19 cases and seven deaths were recorded; about 80% were 65 or older, most with chronic illnesses, and all had not received a COVID-19 booster in the past six months. Two severe pediatric cases in June, both unvaccinated. The director notes cycle recurring roughly every six to nine months, with expectations that the current high level will continue for weeks. Seasonal influenza entered its season in late June; last week influenza positivity was 8.75%, public-hospital influenza admissions 0.55 per 10,000. Predominant strains: A(H3) 53%, A(H1) 33%, B 14%.

triage.headline_ja: 香港、過去4週間で新型コロナウイルス関連死亡7件を記録
triage.triage_reason: 香港衛生当局による定例のCOVID-19・季節性インフルエンザ サーベイランス報告であり、当局自身が6～9か月周期の想定内の再流行と説明している。異常性や国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限の兆候はなく、現地の通常対応で管理可能と判断される。
triage.notes: 香港衛生防護中心（CHP）による定例の呼吸器感染症サーベイランス報告。COVID-19陽性率上昇・重症例・死亡例が報告されているが、当局は既知の周期的再流行パターンと位置づけており、外部支援の必要性や国際的懸念の高まりを示す記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: تشديد الرقابة على نقل الحيوانات بين المدن والمناطق لمواجهة انتشار الحمى القلاعية - أخبار ليبيا 24
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tightening surveillance on the movement of animals between cities and regions to combat the spread of foot-and-mouth disease - Libya News 24
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) prompts tighter Libya-wide animal movement controls as the National Center for Veterinary Health urges stricter surveillance of livestock transfers between cities and regions. Indications of FMD spread have appeared in several areas, leading to enhanced preventive and regulatory measures and coordinated field operations between the Center and the Agricultural Police. In July, authorities closed livestock markets in the municipalities of Khoms and Qasr al-Akhiyar to curb transmission. On July 8, the Agricultural Police branch in Jabal al-Akhdar reported suspected FMD infections among sheep flocks in Qandula and Marawa in Bayda, calling breeders to report signs and prohibiting movement or marketing of sick or exposed animals until laboratory confirmation and veterinary actions are completed. No confirmed case counts are provided; officials stress rapid response, lab testing, and ongoing national plans to protect livestock and food security.

triage.headline_ja: 口蹄疫の蔓延に対処するため、都市・地域間の動物移動に対する監視を強化 - リビアニュース24
triage.triage_reason: リビアにおける家畜の口蹄疫事例であり、対象国リストに該当する国での発生ではないため見送り。
triage.notes: 発生地域にPhilippinesが含まれるが、記事本文はリビア国内の口蹄疫対応に関するものであり、フィリピンでの発生は言及されていないため除外。また本疾患は動物のみに影響し人間の公衆衛生への直接的リスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: Dans l'Est de la RDC: une épidémie, deux administrations sanitaires de part et d'autre du front
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In eastern DRC: an epidemic, two health authorities on both sides of the front.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo centers in Ituri under government control but spills into AFC/M23 rebel zones around Goma and Bukavu. A parallel health response has formed: Kinshasa coordinates from the national government, while the AFC/M23 established a Task Force led by epidemiologist Freddy Kaniki, with a treatment center in Munigi (Goma) and quarantine measures, including suspension of buses and contact isolation. By late June, rebels claimed the first wave was over after 21 days without new cases; cross-frontier transmission persists amid displaced persons and trade. Kinshasa rejects direct coordination with the rebels; data sharing and sample analysis occur via mediation channels, with samples sent to Kinshasa’s reference lab. Rwanda has deployed six specialists to Goma and provided tens of thousands of dollars in PPE and equipment through its biomedical center and Gisenyi hospital. Logistical bottlenecks and payroll shortages hinder responses on both sides.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国東部：一つの流行に対し、前線を挟んで二つの保健当局
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国東部の紛争地域で発生し、国境を越えた感染拡大リスクと二重の保健行政による対応の混乱があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国東部（イトゥリ、北キブ、南キブ）でのエボラ流行が主題。ルワンダは支援国として言及されているが対象国リストに含まれず、フィリピンは記事サマリー中に言及なく除外。紛争により政府とM23/AFC反政府勢力が別々の保健対応を行っている点が特異的で、データ共有や検体分析にも支障が出ている。

article.articleHeadline: Warga AS di Kongo Dilarang Pulang ke Negaranya Imbas Wabah Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Americans in the Congo barred from returning home due to Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 July 2026, the United States imposes travel restrictions on its citizens and permanent residents who were in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) within 21 days prior to departure, barring them from boarding commercial flights to the United States. The U.S. Embassy in the DRC urges those affected to postpone return and remain outside the DRC for the 21-day observation period before entering the United States. The measure responds to a spreading Ebola virus disease outbreak across multiple provinces in the DRC, with Doctors Without Borders warning that transmission is accelerating. MSF reports more than 2,000 confirmed cases and spread to 41 health zones within two months of the outbreak's declaration. The DRC Ministry of Health tallies 2,011 confirmed Ebola cases since May 15, with 754 deaths, a case fatality rate of 37.5%.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ在住の米国人、エボラ流行の影響で帰国禁止に
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ確診2,011例・死亡754例（致死率37.5%）と41保健区域に拡大し、米国が渡航制限を課すなど国際的影響が顕著なためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 米国はDRCからの渡航者に対する制限措置を課しているのみで発生国ではないため、verified_locationsから除外。MSFおよびDRC保健省のデータにより流行の深刻度・拡大が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda discharges last Ebola patient, begins 42-day countdown to end outbreak
article.articleSummary: Uganda on July 16, 2026, discharged its last Ebola patient after a negative test, launching a 42-day countdown to declare the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak over if no new cases emerge. The discharge ceremony at Mulago National Referral Hospital in Kampala was led by Health Minister Chris Baryomunsi, who noted the patient no longer transmits the virus and can resume normal life with social reintegration encouraged. WHO Uganda representative Kasonde Mwinga attributed the containment to preparedness and sustained alertness, saying the outbreak’s case fatality rate remained below 10%. Uganda first declared the outbreak on May 15 after a patient traveling from eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo tested positive for Bundibugyo ebolavirus. Since then, 20 confirmed cases (15 Congolese nationals, 5 Ugandans) and 2 deaths have been recorded.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、最後のエボラ患者を退院させ、流行終息までの42日間カウントダウンを開始
triage.triage_reason: 既知のウガンダ・ブンディブギョ株エボラ流行の終息に向けた進捗報告であり、新規の公衆衛生上の脅威や国際的拡大リスクを示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダにおけるエボラ流行の終息プロセスであり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれない。DRCは患者の渡航元として言及されているのみで、DRC国内での発生事例ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 又見「非洲豬瘟」海漂豬 金門豬肉、加工品即起暫停輸出1週
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Another case of African swine fever: drift pigs; exports of Kinmen pork and processed products suspended for one week.
article.articleSummary: African swine fever (ASF) detected in a drifting pig carcass found at Xintou Port, Jinhu Township, Kinmen County, Taiwan. The ~70 kg pig tested ASF virus nucleic acid positive by PCR on July 16 after samples were sent to the Veterinary Research Institute, confirming infection risk. Kinmen pork and pork product exports to Taiwan proper and other offshore islands are suspended for one week (July 16–22) to strengthen biosecurity; this extends an earlier prohibition on live pigs from Kinmen. Health checks were conducted on 25 pig farms within a 10-km radius (5,033 pigs) with all animals reported healthy. Officials link the drifting carcass to recent weather and typhoon-related currents near Fujian/Xiamen, and emphasize enhanced shoreline surveillance. Measures include disinfection of personnel, vehicles, and equipment; strict farm access controls; change of boots and clothing or disposable protective gear; regular boot disinfection; avoidance of non-farm entry, other ruminant farms, meat markets, and slaughterhouses; and avoidance of swill feeding.

triage.headline_ja: またも「アフリカ豚熱」漂着豚：金門の豚肉・加工品、輸出を1週間停止
triage.triage_reason: 動物衛生事案（ASF、漂着豚死骸）であり人への健康影響はなく、既存の防疫措置内で対応されているため、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念は低い。
triage.notes: 本事案は台湾金門県での漂着豚死骸からのASF検出であり、対象国リストに台湾は含まれない。福建・厦門は漂着経路の推測地として言及されているのみで、実際の発生地ではないため中国も含めない。動物衛生（家畜疾病）であり人への感染症ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Der Tag: Gute Nachrichten für Ebola-Patienten in Frankfurter Klinik
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Day: Good news for Ebola patients in a Frankfurt clinic.
article.articleSummary: Two Ebola patients have been treated at Frankfurt's University Medical Center. The patient currently shows clinical improvement, with symptoms abating and ongoing benefit from supportive therapy, and remains in stable condition. Nearly two months after the first Ebola-infected U.S. citizen arrived in Germany, a second Ebola-infected U.S. citizen was flown to Germany for treatment. The arriving patient landed at Frankfurt Airport on Monday night. The hospital said the person contracted Bundibugyo virus, an Ebolavirus variant, in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and presented with symptoms, notably high fever. Details such as age, sex, and additional clinical information are not provided.

triage.headline_ja: 本日の話題：フランクフルトの病院でエボラ患者に朗報
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）でエボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス）に感染した米国人患者が2例、治療のためドイツに空輸されており、国際的な患者移送を伴う深刻な感染症事例であるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はドイツでの治療経過を報じる続報だが、感染源はDRCであり、米国人患者2名がDRCでエボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス変異株）に感染しドイツへ搬送された事実が確認されている。DRCにおける流行状況・詳細な疫学情報は不明のため、フルRRAでの詳細確認が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19 Cases On Rise In India: Doctor Suggests Ways To Identify Early Symptoms, Tips To Take Care & When To See The Doctor
article.articleSummary: Covid-19 cases are rising in India, with health experts noting a gradual, milder surge driven by new variants/subvariants. Vaccination and prior infections appear to blunt severity, but vulnerable groups (older adults, pregnant women, people with chronic conditions) remain at higher risk of complicated illness. Early symptoms often mimic flu, fever, or cold, including sore throat, runny nose, dry cough, fever/chills, headache, fatigue, and less commonly loss of taste or smell; some people may experience shortness of breath or GI symptoms. Most patients recover at home with supportive care, though advised to test if symptoms persist or if advised by a clinician. Home care tips include staying hydrated, resting, eating a balanced diet, and monitoring temperature and oxygen saturation. Seek emergency care for difficulty breathing, chest pain, confusion, or a sudden drop in oxygen levels.

triage.headline_ja: インドで新型コロナ感染者が増加：医師が早期症状の見分け方と対処法、受診タイミングを助言
triage.triage_reason: 軽症の緩やかな増加であり、医療情報提供的な内容で公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は一般向けの健康アドバイス記事であり、既知の変異株による軽度な流行を報じているのみでシグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Anvisa manda recolher água por bactéria já encontrada em produtos da Ypê; saiba qual a marca
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anvisa orders water recall due to a bacterium already found in Ypê products; find out which brand.
article.articleSummary: Anvisa (Brazil) ordered a recall of two lots of still mineral water (Mamba Water) after Pseudomonas aeruginosa was detected during manufacturer QA testing by HNK BR Indústria de Bebidas Ltda. Voluntary recall suspends sale, distribution, and use of 350 ml canned batches 13 and 14, produced on 3–4 April 2026, with expiry in April 2027. No consumer cases reported. This is the third 2026 Brazilian incident of P. aeruginosa in consumer products, following more than 100 lots of Ypê cleaning products in April and a Crystal mineral water recall in June. Brazilian law prohibits P. aeruginosa in drinking water; recalls occur to prevent public health risks. The bacterium is an opportunistic pathogen, capable of causing infections in immunocompromised individuals such as the elderly, children, cancer patients, transplant recipients, and those with uncontrolled HIV."

triage.headline_ja: アンヴィザ(ブラジル衛生当局)、Ypê製品で既に検出された細菌を理由に水の回収を命令；ブランド名は
triage.triage_reason: 消費者への症例報告はなく、製造時の品質検査で検出された予防的な自主回収であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: HIVは免疫不全者の一例として言及されているのみで、疾患名として付与されたHIVは記事の主題ではない。実際の主題は飲料水中のPseudomonas aeruginosa汚染による製品回収。

article.articleHeadline: 中国国家疾控局：登革热、基孔肯雅热由境外输入及跨省传播引起本地疫情风险上升
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China CDC: Dengue fever and chikungunya fever—local outbreak risk rising due to imported cases from abroad and interprovincial transmission.
article.articleSummary: China faces rising local outbreak risk for Dengue fever and Chikungunya fever due to imported cases from abroad and interprovincial transmission. China CDC Virus Diseases Institute researcher Li Jiandong said at a July 16 briefing that global spread and climate change expand Aedes habitats, increasing importation risk as cross-border travel grows. To strengthen control this year, four measures are emphasized: (1) legal framework, with Dengue and Chikungunya managed as Category B infectious diseases since April 1; (2) enhanced port health collaboration with customs and immigration, intensifying entry surveillance and quarantine to prevent importation; (3) implementation of the 2026 Dengue and Chikungunya Prevention and Control Plan, improving multi-source data analysis, risk assessment, and rapid detection/delineation of risk areas for local outbreaks; (4) an environment-first vector-control strategy—environmental management, supported by biological and physical controls and chemical measures when needed—mobilizing society for mosquito control.

triage.headline_ja: 中国国家疾病管理局：デング熱・チクングニア熱、海外からの輸入例や省をまたぐ伝播により国内流行リスクが上昇
triage.triage_reason: 中国当局がデング熱・チクングニア熱の輸入例増加と国内伝播リスク上昇を公式に注意喚起しているが、具体的な症例数や重症度・地域限定的な発生状況は不明のため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事は予防対策強化の公式発表であり、具体的な発生地域・症例数のデータは含まれていない。季節性のベクター媒介感染症対策として毎年繰り返される内容の可能性もある。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Assemblée Nationale - L'Honorable Jean-Paul Ngabu Tsunde appelle à renforcer la lutte contre Ebola et à protéger les provinces non encore touchées
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: National Assembly — The Honorable Jean-Paul Ngabu Tsunde calls to strengthen the fight against Ebola and to protect the provinces not yet affected.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak in Bundibugyo ebolavirus is expanding from a single province to five in two months. Ituri Province, Djugu territory resident Jean-Paul Ngabu Tsunde urged urgent strengthening of the response and protection for provinces not yet affected, citing 54 new confirmed cases in one day on July 14. The deputy underscored that health zones are the critical operational link to interrupt transmission, calling for deployment of qualified personnel, nurse training, and deployment of community relays (RECO) to rapidly identify suspects and contacts for management in transit and treatment centers. He also pushed for preventive strategies in untouched provinces—enhanced surveillance, barrier measures, and proactive preparation—to prevent further spread, emphasizing national mobilization and a coordinated, collective effort to safeguard the entire country.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：国民議会 — ジャン=ポール・ンガブ・ツンデ議員、エボラ対策強化と未感染州の保護を訴える
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC国内で2か月で1州から5州へ急拡大し、1日で54例の新規確定例が報告されるなど深刻化しており、国際的拡大リスクと社会的・政治的関心（国会での議論）も高いためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（イトゥリ州、ジュグ準州、ブンディブギョ）における国内感染拡大を主題としており、ウガンダは発生地域として言及されていない（Bundibugyoはコンゴ国内の地名として使用）。国際的拡大やヒト-ヒト感染継続の可能性から緊急のリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 우간다 마지막 에볼라 환자 퇴원...민주콩고는 확산 지속
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda's last Ebola patient discharged... Democratic Republic of the Congo outbreak continues.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 July 2026, Uganda reports the last Ebola virus disease patient has been discharged, two months after declaring an outbreak with the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) on May 15. The final patient, a DRC national, has recovered and will reunite with family. Uganda’s cumulative confirmed cases total 20: 15 imported from DRC across the border and 5 among local healthcare workers and contacts. Two deaths have occurred; 18 patients have recovered. Hundreds of contacts were quarantined for 21 days. Under WHO guidelines, Uganda could declare the outbreak over after 42 days without new cases. In contrast, DRC’s outbreak persists, with over 2,000 confirmed cases and more than 700 deaths in two months, indicating continued transmission and cross-border risk. Common symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and unexplained bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダの最後のエボラ患者退院…民主コンゴでは感染拡大が続く
triage.triage_reason: DRCで2,000例超・700人超の死亡が続くエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクであり、国境を越えてウガンダにも感染が広がった実績があるため、IHR基準を複数満たしフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ(Uganda)は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCでは依然として感染拡大が継続しており、国境を越えた伝播リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: 金門海漂豬驗出非洲豬瘟 25養豬場5033頭豬檢查結果出爐
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: African swine fever detected in Kinmen drift pigs; results for 5,033 pigs from 25 farms released.
article.articleSummary: African swine fever (ASF) virus nucleic acid detected in a drifting pig carcass found at Kinmen’s Xintou shoreline on 14 July 2026; PCR confirmed ASF on 16 July. The Kinmen County authorities conducted clinical visits to 25 pig farms within a 10-km radius, totaling 5,033 pigs, all clinically healthy. Officials attribute the drift pig’s arrival to weather and sea currents associated with the Bawei Typhoon outer circulation, noting Kinmen’s proximity to Fujian, Xiamen, and the Jiulong River outlets. In response, Kinmen pork and pork products are suspended from entering Taiwan’s main island and other offshore islands through 22 July, pending a minimum one-week period without new cases to lift the restriction. Some processed meat products remain allowed under existing risk assessments, with a listed roster of compliant manufacturers. Authorities urge strict farm biosecurity and border surveillance, and advise travelers not to bring pork or animal products into Taiwan.

triage.headline_ja: 金門の漂着豚からアフリカ豚熱を検出、25養豚場5,033頭の検査結果が判明
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱は動物感染症であり人への健康被害はなく、発生地は台湾・金門島で対象国リストに該当しないため見送りとする。
triage.notes: 発生地は台湾金門県（金門島）であり、対象国リストに台湾は含まれない。漂着豚が福建・厦門方面からの海流由来と推定されているが、実際の検出・対応は台湾側で行われており中国本土での発生事例ではない。動物衛生・貿易上の問題であり人的公衆衛生上のシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: 暑期境外移入登革熱風險拉警報 高雄再增2例確診
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Summer imported dengue fever risk triggers warning; Kaohsiung reports two more confirmed cases.
article.articleSummary: On 16 July 2026, Kaohsiung City Health Bureau reported two additional imported dengue fever cases in Daliao District, raising the year's total to 11. Patients: a 27-year-old Vietnamese new immigrant and a 21-year-old Cambodian student, both having returned from overseas before illness onset, with fever, myalgia, retro-orbital pain, and nausea; NS1 rapid tests were positive and PCR confirmed dengue infection. The Cambodian student’s school yielded four positive containers at breeding sites, prompting intensified vector-control activities, breeding-source clearance, and epidemiological investigations around residences and schools. Mosquito surveillance in Daliao District showed a 10% average positive rate in week 27, with current rainfall heightening community transmission risk. Officials urge schools hosting foreign students to perform summer breeding-source inspections and participate in a summer program offering NT$500 vouchers for pre-travel rapid testing to deter exports/imports of dengue.

triage.headline_ja: 夏季の海外由来デング熱リスク警報、高雄で新たに2例確診
triage.triage_reason: 台湾（高雄）における輸入デング熱症例の増加を報じる地域保健当局の定例発表であり、対象国リストに該当する国での発生ではないため見送りとする。
triage.notes: 患者はベトナム国籍・カンボジア国籍であるが、発症・診断は台湾（高雄）で確認された輸入症例であり、ベトナムやフィリピンでの発生ではないため対象国に含めない。台湾は対象国リストに含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: 6月新冠阳性率连续4周上升！电商平台新冠药搜索量环比翻倍，专家：5天未好转需就医
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: June COVID-19 positivity rate rises for four consecutive weeks; e-commerce platforms' COVID-19 drug search volume doubles month-over-month; experts say: seek medical attention if no improvement after five days.
article.articleSummary: June 2026 COVID-19 activity rose in China. From June 1–30, nationwide confirmed cases reached about 79,000, with 130 severe cases and 1 death (with underlying conditions). Fever clinic visits rose from 58,000 to 65,000. Sentinel surveillance shows influenza-like illness at ED visits around 4.3–4.6%, while COVID-19 positivity among ILI samples rose from 2.9% to 6.4% over weeks 23–26. Sequencing of 3,741 local cases identified Omicron lineages NB.1.8.1 and sublineages as dominant (about 95–99%). Most infections are mild; severe disease remains uncommon due to prior infection and vaccination. Online demand for COVID-19 drugs surged in July, with Paxlovid and several domestically produced oral antivirals showing sharp sales growth. Health authorities advise home care for healthy individuals, but early antiviral treatment for older adults and those with comorbidities, and medical care if fever persists beyond five days or symptoms worsen.

triage.headline_ja: 6月の新型コロナ陽性率が4週連続で上昇！ECサイトでの新型コロナ治療薬検索数が前月比倍増、専門家「5日経っても改善しなければ受診を」
triage.triage_reason: 既知のオミクロン系統（NB.1.8.1）による季節性の感染増加であり、重症例・死亡は少数にとどまる。異常性・国際的拡大リスクは低く、ルーチンサーベイランス情報の範囲内と判断。
triage.notes: 既知のオミクロン系統による季節性増加で、重症化率・致死率は低い（79,000例中重症130例、死亡1例）。中国当局は既に対応方針（家庭療養・高齢者早期治療）を示しており、国内で管理可能と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: 本港新冠病毒活躍程度創一年新高 衞生防護中心料未來數周維持高水平 - 香港商報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hong Kong's COVID-19 activity level hits a one-year high; Centre for Health Protection expects to maintain a high level in the coming weeks - Hong Kong Commercial Daily
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong's Centre for Health Protection reports rising COVID-19 and seasonal influenza activity, with COVID-19 entering a new cycle. Mainland China, Macao, Japan, Korea and Singapore show similar trends. COVID-19 respiratory positivity is 9.79% (week of July 5–11) and wastewater around 500,000 copies per liter. In the past four weeks, 45 severe adult COVID-19 cases including 7 deaths were recorded; about 80% were 65+, most with chronic disease, and none had a booster in six months. Two severe pediatric cases in June were unvaccinated. Dominant variants NB.1.8.1 and PQ.16.1.1; vaccines reduce severe outcomes. Boosters after six months for high-risk. Adult vaccines through Sept; new vaccines being procured; 12+ doses to Sept 5; 6 months–11 years doses resume in Q4. Flu season began end-June; 8.75% positivity; 0.55/10k hospitalizations; strains A(H3) 53%, A(H1) 33%, B 14%. Public urged masking and good hygiene in public/crowded settings.

triage.headline_ja: 香港の新型コロナウイルス活動レベルが1年ぶりの高水準に達し、衛生防護中心は今後数週間高水準が続くと予測 - 香港商報
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のCOVID-19・インフルエンザ活動の増加は例年見られるパターンであり、IHR基準には該当しないが、重症例・死亡例の発生と流行継続の可能性があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性のCOVID-19・インフルエンザ流行に関する定例的な公衆衛生報告であり、香港・マカオ（中国として集約）のみが対象国に該当。日本・韓国・シンガポールは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。高齢者・慢性疾患患者における重症化・死亡例が報告されているが、ワクチン接種状況などで管理可能な範囲内と見られる。

article.articleHeadline: Anvisa determina retirada de água vendida no Brasil após detectar bactéria; consumidores devem interromper uso
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anvisa orders withdrawal of water sold in Brazil after detecting bacteria; consumers should stop using it.
article.articleSummary: Brazil's health regulator Anvisa has ordered the voluntary recall and suspension of sale, distribution, and use of 350 ml canned water from Mamba Water after detecting Pseudomonas aeruginosa in quality controls. Affected lots are 13 and 14, manufactured on April 3 and 4 of this year, with the recall voluntarily reported by the producer, HNK BR Indústria de Bebidas Ltda. The total quantity of affected cans has not been disclosed. This marks the third recent instance of Pseudomonas aeruginosa in consumer products since May, following recalls of Ypê cleaning-products and a Crystal mineral water lot. Pseudomonas aeruginosa is an opportunistic bacterium that can cause infections in the lungs, urinary tract, skin, and bloodstream, particularly in immunocompromised individuals such as the elderly, children, cancer patients, transplant recipients, and those with uncontrolled HIV or on immunosuppressants. Brazilian regulations prohibit its presence in drinking water.

triage.headline_ja: アンビザ、細菌検出によりブラジルで販売されていた水の回収を命令；消費者は使用中止を
triage.triage_reason: 感染症の集団発生ではなく、飲料水製品からの緑膿菌検出による自主回収措置であり、感染症例の報告や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報がない。
triage.notes: 疾患名として『HIV』がタグ付けされているが、これは免疫不全者（HIV患者含む）が緑膿菌感染のリスク群として言及されているためであり、HIVの流行事案ではない。製品回収に関する消費者安全情報であり、感染症サーベイランスのシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Anvisa manda recolher água mineral; bactéria encontrada é a mesma de produtos da Ypê
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anvisa orders a recall of mineral water; the bacteria found are the same as those in Ypê products.
article.articleSummary: Two lots of Mamba Water mineral water in 350 ml cans were recalled after Anvisa detected Pseudomonas aeruginosa in quality tests. Lot 13, manufactured April 3, 2026, with expiry April 3, 2027, and Lot 14, manufactured April 4, 2026, with expiry April 4, 2027, are affected. The recall is voluntary by HNK BR Indústria de Bebidas Ltda., with suspension of sale, distribution, and use of the involved packaging. No consumer illnesses are reported. This follows recent Brazilian alerts of Pseudomonas aeruginosa in Ypê products (April 2026) and Crystal mineral water (June 2026). P. aeruginosa is an opportunistic bacterium posing higher risk to older adults, children, cancer patients, transplant recipients, and people with uncontrolled HIV or on immunosuppressants; infections can affect lungs, urinary tract, skin, or bloodstream. Consumers should check batch numbers and avoid these lots until further guidance.

triage.headline_ja: アンヴィザ(ANVISA)がミネラルウォーターの回収を命令、検出された細菌はイペ製品と同じもの
triage.triage_reason: 製品の予防的自主回収であり、消費者の健康被害報告はなく、感染症としての公衆衛生上の異常事象には該当しない。
triage.notes: 本件はHIVの疾患イベントではなく、ミネラルウォーターの細菌汚染による製品回収の記事。HIV感染者等の免疫不全者がリスク群として言及されているのみで、感染症の発生・流行を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: More health workers strike as Ebola cases in Congo exceed 2,000, including 754 deaths
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Congo's Ituri province caused by Bundibugyo virus has reached 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths, the fastest-growing outbreak on record since it began in May. Ituri is hardest hit amid rapid spread across the country. Health care workers at Bunia General Hospital and an Ebola treatment center in Rwampara staged strikes over unpaid salaries; WHO reports over 100 health workers have contracted the virus since onset. About 80% of new cases arise from unknown transmission chains, with patient zero unidentified. Armed conflict and mining-related population movements hinder contact tracing, though 67% of exposed contacts have been traced. Bundibugyo virus lacks approved vaccines or treatments, unlike the Zaire strain; two potential therapies are enrolling in the region. Ongoing challenges include funding gaps, attacks on health centers, and community distrust. As of 2026-07-16, 753 patients remain hospitalized or isolated, with 366 recovered.

triage.headline_ja: 医療従事者のストライキが再燃、コンゴのエボラ感染者数が2,000人を超え、死者754人に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でブンディブギョ株によるエボラ感染が2,000例超・死者754人に達し、史上最速の拡大ペースであることに加え、ワクチン・治療薬未承認、医療従事者のストライキや資金不足など管理上の重大な課題がありフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にルワンダ(Kigali Province)が含まれているが、記事サマリーではコンゴ・イトゥリ州（ブニア、ルワンパラ地区含む）での発生のみが具体的に述べられており、ルワンダでの感染発生は確認できないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع إصابات فيروس إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية إلى 2073 حالة و796 وفاة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in Ebola virus infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to 2,073 cases and 796 deaths.
article.articleSummary: As of July 14, 2026, health authorities in the Democratic Republic of the Congo report 2,073 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 796 deaths. Contact tracing remains a major challenge, with only about 67% of exposed individuals tracked. The World Health Organization cautions that the true number of infections may be double the official tally. The outbreak—driven by the rare Bundibugyo strain—has persisted since May 15 and continues to spread faster than surveillance can keep pace. An estimated 80% of new infections arise from unknown transmission chains. Health workers have threatened strikes over delayed salary payments, adding strain to the response and containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルス感染者数が2,073人、死者796人に増加
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（稀なブンディブギョ株）の大規模アウトブレイクで、致死率が高く、感染経路不明の症例が80%に上り、接触者追跡率も67%に留まるなど制御不能な拡大を示している。
triage.notes: WHOは公式集計より実際の感染者数が2倍に上る可能性を指摘。医療従事者の給与未払いによるストライキの脅威が対応能力をさらに悪化させている。

article.articleHeadline: شبح كورونا يطل من جديد في الهند وخبراء يطلبون عودة الكمامات
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The specter of the coronavirus reappears in India, and experts are calling for the return of masks.
article.articleSummary: As of July 16, 2026, Andhra Pradesh, India reports new COVID-19 cases and two deaths, prompting renewed public-health vigilance. Officials say the rise reflects scattered transmission rather than a statewide surge. Dr. Mala Kaneria, infectious-disease consultant at Jaslok Hospital, notes waning population immunity allows periodic increases. Early testing is advised for anyone with fever, cough, sore throat, fatigue, or shortness of breath to ensure timely care and curb spread. Health authorities emphasize surveillance and rapid reporting to identify hotspots before clusters form. High-risk groups include the elderly, and patients with diabetes, cardiovascular or chronic lung disease, kidney disease, cancer, or immunocompromise. Vaccination remains crucial; boosters are advised, especially before international travel or after exposure. Preventive measures—hand hygiene, masking in crowded indoor spaces, avoiding close contact with the sick, covering coughs, staying home when symptomatic, and good ventilation—remain effective. The virus persists with periodic increases as immunity wanes, and the goal is to minimize severe disease and protect the most vulnerable.

triage.headline_ja: インドで新型コロナウイルスの脅威が再燃、専門家がマスク着用の再開を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の散発的な増加と2名の死亡が報告されているが、当局は州全体の急増ではないとしており、情報も限定的なため継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: 既知の疾患であるCOVID-19の季節的・散発的増加であり、当局も統計的急増ではないとしている。死亡者数や重症度の詳細は不明。

article.articleHeadline: شبح كورونا يطل من جديد في الهند وخبراء يطلبون عودة الكمامات - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The specter of coronavirus reappears in India, and experts call for the return of masks - Youm7
article.articleSummary: Two COVID-19 deaths and new infections were reported in Andhra Pradesh, India, prompting renewed health alerts. Experts say the situation reflects sporadic, localized transmission rather than a statewide surge. Dr. Mala Kanaria, infectious-disease specialist at Jaslok Hospital and Research Centre, notes that periodic rises are expected as population immunity wanes. Early testing for fever, cough, sore throat, fatigue, or shortness of breath is crucial for appropriate care and reducing transmission, with surveillance and prompt reporting needed to identify emerging clusters. Vaccination remains vital; boosters are particularly important before international travel or during rising community transmission. Basic protective measures persist: regular hand hygiene, masking in crowded indoor spaces, avoiding close contact with the ill, covering the mouth and nose when coughing or sneezing, staying home when symptomatic, and ensuring good indoor ventilation. High-risk groups include older adults, people with diabetes, heart or lung disease, immunocompromised individuals, kidney disease, and cancer.

triage.headline_ja: インドで再びコロナウイルスの影が忍び寄る、専門家がマスク着用の再開を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の散発的な死亡例・感染例であり、専門家も州全体の急増ではなく局地的な散発的感染と評価している。既知の病原体であり新規性・異常性は低い。
triage.notes: 既知の病原体（COVID-19）による季節的・散発的な感染報告であり、専門家コメントも予防啓発が主眼。新たな脅威を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: وسط تحذير أممي من تمدد إيبولا في وسط أفريقيا.. ليبيا تؤكد خلوها من الإصابات وترفع التأهب - أخبار ليبيا 24
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Amid UN warning of Ebola's spread in Central Africa, Libya confirms no cases and steps up readiness - Libya News 24
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) resurges as UN and WHO warn of accelerated spread in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) due to the Bundibugyo strain, with the fastest transmission in years and many new infections linked to unknown transmission chains, complicating contact tracing. The outbreak crosses borders, and Uganda has tightened border and health facility surveillance as authorities mobilize rapid response teams and strengthen laboratory capacity to prevent wider spread. In Libya, the National Center for Disease Control reports no Ebola cases or suspected cases, maintains ongoing monitoring of the DRC and Uganda outbreaks, and has raised readiness levels. The Libyan embassy in Kampala has warned Libyans abroad to avoid exposure and follow local health authorities’ instructions. Ebola is a severe viral hemorrhagic fever transmitted by contact with infected animals or body fluids; early symptoms include fever, headache, muscle pains, fatigue, with possible bleeding; early detection and isolation are critical.

triage.headline_ja: 中央アフリカでエボラ拡大の国連警告の中、リビアは感染ゼロを確認し警戒態勢を強化
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ（Bundibugyo株）の急速な拡大が国連・WHOにより警告されており、感染経路不明の症例が多く国境を越えた拡大リスクがあるため、IHR基準複数該当でフルRRAに進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 記事はリビア国内の予防的対応が主だが、根本事象はDRCでのエボラ急拡大。ウガンダ・リビアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。続報でDRC国内の感染者数・致死率等の詳細確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ouganda: le compte à rebours vers la fin de l'épidémie d'Ebola est lancé, mais le risque demeure en raison de la situation en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda: the countdown to the end of the Ebola outbreak has begun, but the risk remains due to the situation in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Uganda began a 42-day countdown on July 16, 2026 to declare the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak over after the last confirmed patient recovered and was discharged. The outbreak, first declared May 15, 2026, has reached 20 laboratory-confirmed cases and 2 deaths as of July 16. Fifteen cases were imported from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with five due to local transmission along the border; no new confirmed cases have been reported since June 21. A cross-border risk remains as transmission continues in DRC, and a new imported case from DRC would reset the countdown. Authorities identified 836 contacts and have followed them, with enhanced surveillance in 36 districts at risk and at 38 entry points. The WHO deployed about 70 experts to support surveillance, laboratory work, logistics, and health worker protection. Uganda also launched a six-month plan to sustain surveillance and reduce recurrence.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ:エボラ流行終息へのカウントダウンが開始、しかしDRCの状況によりリスクは残る
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱のウガンダ・DRC間の越境流行であり、公衆衛生上重篤かつ国際的拡大が既に発生しているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 主な発生地はウガンダ(Bundibugyo)だが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは越境感染源として継続的な伝播リスクがあるため含める。

article.articleHeadline: Медики в охваченной Эболой ДР Конго начали забастовку из-за невыплаты зарплат
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Medics in Ebola-hit DR Congo began a strike over unpaid salaries.
article.articleSummary: Medics and burial personnel in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of Congo, began a strike over unpaid salaries and allowances since the Ebola outbreak were declared on May 15. Protests occurred at Bunia’s main hospital and Ruampare hospital, hampering outbreak response described as the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in history. Although Health Minister Roger Kamba pledged payments “in the shortest possible time” after a July 8 visit, staff continued the strike and demanded better working conditions and PPE, giving the government a 72-hour deadline. The Ebola Treatment Center in Bunia, the provincial administrative center and outbreak epicenter, saw barricades and burning tires. As of May 15, confirmed cases reached 2,011 with 754 deaths. Context: Ebola disease, first identified in 1976 near Nzara (Sudan) and Yambuku (DR Congo), named after the Ebola River; the 2014–2017 West Africa outbreak caused ~30,000 cases and >11,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行下のコンゴ民主共和国で医療従事者が未払い給与を理由にストライキを開始
triage.triage_reason: 史上最速拡大とされるエボラ出血熱の大規模流行（症例2,011件、死者754人）が継続中であり、対応要員のストライキにより対応体制が阻害されているため、深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスクの観点からフルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにはYambuku・Nzara（1976年最初の発見地）やBurundi、Sudan、Angolaなど歴史的・文脈的言及が含まれるが、現在進行中の流行はDRCイトゥリ州（ブニア）に限定されているため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: United States Supports Tanzania's Rapid Ebola Preparedness
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-07-16, the United States is providing more than $1 million in new and reprogrammed funding to help Tanzania strengthen preparedness for Ebola caused by the Bundibugyo virus. Tanzania has not recorded any confirmed Ebola cases, but the government is intensifying preparedness in Mainland Tanzania and Zanzibar amid outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, with cross-border movement increasing vigilance. Following the regional outbreak announcement, Tanzania's Ministry of Health convened technical directors, U.S. agencies, and international partners to align response activities. U.S. support is delivered through three lines of effort: CDC technical assistance to bolster surveillance, laboratory capacity, and infection prevention and control; the State Department's support for coordination and entry-point preparedness; and WRAIR's collaboration with the Tanzania People's Defence Force to reinforce border-region readiness. The goal is rapid detection, safe management of suspected cases, sustained entry surveillance, and robust future-response capacity.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、タンザニアのエボラ出血熱迅速対応準備を支援
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダで進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが越境拡大リスクを伴い、IHR基準を複数満たすため。
triage.notes: 本記事はタンザニアにおけるエボラ準備強化（米国支援）を主題としているが、実際の感染確定例はタンザニアにはない。記事内で言及されているコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）とウガンダでの既存アウトブレイクが越境リスクの根拠となっているため、対象国リストに含まれるDRCのみをverified_locationsに計上した。ウガンダ・タンザニア・米国は対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: UNICEF launches "Generation Zero Polio
article.articleSummary: UNICEF launches 'Generation Zero Polio', a network of five young French-speaking advocates from Cameroon, Central African Republic, Chad, Democratic Republic of the Congo, and Niger, to bolster vaccination advocacy and polio eradication in West and Central Africa. The initiative seeks to involve youth in public health policy, bridging local realities and decisions at national/regional levels; members will lead awareness campaigns, participate in vaccination drives, and shape communication strategies to build vaccine confidence. In West and Central Africa, about 6 million children are under-vaccinated, including 4 million with no vaccine dose; third-dose DTP coverage stands at 71%, well below the 90% target of Immunisation Agenda 2030. WHO/UNICEF estimates show 90% of infants globally received at least one DTP dose in 2025, with 85% receiving three doses. Poliovirus variants continue circulating; since start of the year, 56 polio cases reported across Cameroon, CAR, Chad, DRC, Niger, and Nigeria, amid fragile health systems.

triage.headline_ja: UNICEF、「ポリオ根絶世代ゼロ」を発足
triage.triage_reason: 西・中央アフリカにおけるポリオワクチン接種推進の広報イニシアチブに関する記事であり、DRCを含む複数国での既知のポリオ流行状況の継続を示すが、新規かつ具体的なアラート情報は乏しいため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はUNICEFの啓発活動発足に関するもので、DRCを含む6カ国全体で年初来56例のポリオ症例が報告されているとの記載があるが、DRC固有の症例数や詳細な状況は不明。既知の流行継続情報であり新規シグナルとしての緊急性は低いが、地域的拡大とワクチン接種率の低さから継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak the fastest-growing ever with 2,000 cases and 750 dead
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is the fastest-spreading in history, with more than 2,000 confirmed cases and over 750 deaths. Suspected cases have emerged near Kisangani, outside Eastern Congo. WHO warns that about 80% of new infections are linked to unknown transmission chains, complicating isolation. The Bundibugyo strain, for which there are no approved vaccines or treatments, is driving transmission.
