Health workers face limited resources, with unpaid staff at a treatment center in Ituri province and at Bunia General Hospital going on strike, hampering containment. Researchers have begun a clinical trial testing two potential treatments: remdesivir (Gilead) and MBP134 (Mapp Biopharmaceutical), alone or in combination with standard care. Enrolment targets up to 1,000 patients at a single Ituri site, with plans to expand as conditions permit.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行は史上最速のペースで拡大、感染者2,000人・死者750人超
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱がDRCで史上最速ペースで拡大し、感染経路不明の症例が8割を占め医療体制も逼迫しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 承認されたワクチン・治療薬のないブンディブギョ株が原因で、医療従事者のストライキも発生し封じ込めが困難な状況。臨床試験も開始されている。

article.articleHeadline: 烏干達最後一名伊波拉患者出院　啟動42天無病毒倒數 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda's last Ebola patient discharged; 42-day virus-free countdown begins.
article.articleSummary: Uganda discharged its last Ebola patient, a Congolese national, from Mulago National Referral Hospital in Kampala, triggering a 42-day countdown to be declared Ebola-free if no new cases arise, per WHO guidelines. Uganda has logged 20 Bundibugyo-virus Ebola cases since mid-May, with 15 infections acquired in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and later traveling to Uganda. Since June 22, no new Ugandan cases have been reported. By contrast, the DRC reported 62 new Ebola cases on Thursday, bringing its total to 2,073, though the WHO says actual infections may be at least double that figure. The Bundibugyo strain drives Uganda’s outbreak; no symptoms or laboratory confirmation details are provided. Ongoing cross-border transmission risk persists as Uganda nears the 42-day milestone.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ最後のエボラ患者退院、42日間のウイルスフリー・カウントダウン開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ感染者が2,073人（新規62人）に達し、越境感染も継続しており、国際的拡大リスクと重篤性からIHR基準2つ以上に該当するためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダのエボラ終息だが、DRCでの継続的な感染拡大（62例新規、累計2,073例）が重要な情報として含まれるため、DRCを対象地域として抽出。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Kisangani : l'hôpital du Cinquantenaire enregistre de moins en moins des patients à cause de la présence du centre de traitement d'Ebola, déplore le médecin directeur
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kisangani: The Cinquantenaire Hospital is seeing fewer and fewer patients because of the presence of the Ebola Treatment Center, the medical director laments.
article.articleSummary: On 16 July 2026, Kisangani's Cinquantenaire Hospital notes a drop in patient attendance since the provisional Ebola Treatment Center was installed on its grounds. Medical Director Dr. Falay Sadiki reports fewer admissions overall, especially in internal medicine and pediatrics, with only two to three cases versus normal volumes. The facility remains operational but slower; some patients avoid the hospital due to fear of Ebola. The Ebola Treatment Center is provisional; a definitive center is planned for Kisangani within three weeks. The staff at Cinquantenaire are not involved in the Ebola response, and precautions are in place. The reduced attendance risks economic strain, as most healthcare workers are not government-paid and rely on a local attendance-based bonus. The Democratic Republic of Congo faces its 17th Ebola outbreak, declared May 17 in Ituri, epicenter, with 754 deaths; Kisangani has four cases, two deaths.

triage.headline_ja: キサンガニ:サンカンテナール病院、エボラ治療センターの設置により患者数が減少していると医療部長が嘆く
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中の第17次エボラ流行（イトゥリ州震源、754人死亡）がキサンガニにも拡大しており（4症例、2死亡）、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクのある事象であるため。
triage.notes: 記事自体はキサンガニの病院運営への副次的影響を報じるものだが、背景に進行中の大規模エボラ流行があり、震源地イトゥリから都市部キサンガニへの拡大が確認されているため、フルリスク評価対象とすべき。

article.articleHeadline: 高雄登革熱新增兩例境外移入均住大寮 該區病媒蚊指數上升
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two new imported dengue fever cases in Kaohsiung, both residents of Daliao District; the district's vector mosquito index is rising.
article.articleSummary: Two new imported dengue fever cases in Kaohsiung’s Daliao District: a 27-year-old Vietnamese new immigrant and a 21-year-old Cambodian student, both ill after returning from Southeast Asia for family visits. NS1 rapid tests were positive and PCR confirmed dengue. Citywide, 7 locally acquired and 11 imported cases, 18 total for the year. Investigations at the Cambodian student’s school found four breeding-positive containers in water wells, iron buckets, flower vases, and basins. Daliao District’s week-27 vector surveillance shows a 10% positive rate, up from week-26, with rainfall increasing community transmission risk. This year’s imported cases total 11, including 3 foreign students; authorities urge schools with foreign students to inspect breeding sites. The Summer Incentive Program to combat imported cases offers free mosquito repellent at health centers or schools and a 500 NT voucher for Southeast Asia returnees who take rapid tests.

triage.headline_ja: 高雄市登革熱、新たに2例の輸入症例—いずれも大寮区在住、同地区の媒介蚊指数が上昇
triage.triage_reason: 台湾高雄市における輸入性デング熱の地域サーベイランス報告であり、対象国リストに該当する国での発生ではなく、重症度や国際的拡大の懸念も認められない。
triage.notes: 感染事例はいずれも台湾（対象国リスト外）で発生。ベトナム人・カンボジア人はそれぞれ帰省先での感染が疑われるが、台湾国内での媒介蚊サーベイランスと輸入症例管理の通常業務報告であり、地域流行状況もルーチンレベル。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda discharges last Ebola patient: minister
article.articleSummary: Uganda discharged its last Ebola patient on Thursday, marking containment of the outbreak that spread from neighbouring Democratic Republic of Congo. Under WHO guidelines, Uganda must go 42 days without a new case to be declared Ebola-free, representing two incubation periods. The DR Congo outbreak has produced more than 2,000 confirmed cases and 754 deaths since mid‑May; WHO cautions the true toll could be two to four times higher. Uganda reported only 20 cases and two deaths, mostly Congolese citizens who crossed the border. Hundreds of contacts were isolated for 21 days and have since been released. Health authorities will strengthen border interventions to minimize cross-border transmission. There is no approved vaccine or treatment for the Bundibugyo strain, though the WHO noted a first clinical trial of an antiviral drug began on Tuesday.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、最後のエボラ患者を退院させる：保健相
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で2,000例以上・754人死亡の大規模エボラ流行が継続しており、国境を越えた感染拡大が既に発生しているため、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダでの流行終息（最後の患者退院）を報じているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。震源地であるDRCでの流行は依然として大規模かつ継続中であり、Bundibugyo株にはワクチン・治療薬が未承認である点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : le point de l'Africa CDC après deux mois
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: Africa CDC update after two months.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo marks two months since its July 15 declaration, with official counts near 2,000 cases and over 700 deaths. The initial Ituri cluster near the South Sudan and Uganda border has expanded to North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, Haut-Uélé, and Kisangani. WHO estimates the true caseload could be two to four times higher than reported, reflecting under-detection amid insecurity and population movement. Africa CDC notes ongoing challenges and an expanded response: strengthened community surveillance, near-patient diagnostics, additional treatment centers, and intensified active case finding and contact tracing. Transmission remains largely community-driven; the peak will come with improved control of contacts and rapid isolation. Therapeutic and vaccine trials are under way, with funding from the Congolese government, Africa CDC, and partners totaling about $18 million; the first patient has been enrolled and results are expected in 2–3 months.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：発生から2か月後のアフリカCDC最新報告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）の大規模流行が継続しており、約2000症例・700人以上の死亡、複数州への拡大、ヒト-ヒト感染（コミュニティ内伝播）が確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAが必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダ・南スーダン国境近くの初期クラスターに言及しているが、感染事例が確認されているのはDRC国内（イトゥリ、北キブ、南キブ、ツショピ、オー・ウエレ、キサンガニ）のみであり、ウガンダ・スーダンでの症例発生は記載されていないため対象国から除外した。WHOは実際の症例数が報告の2〜4倍に上る可能性を指摘しており、治安不安・人口移動による過小検出が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: University of Hyderabad Researchers Unveil the Therapeutic Potential of Lactobacillus johnsonii Against Enteric Pathogens
article.articleSummary: University of Hyderabad researchers led by Dr. Vijay Morampudi report that Lactobacillus johnsonii exerts multifunctional antimicrobial effects against attaching-and-effacing pathogens Enteropathogenic Escherichia coli (EPEC) and Citrobacter rodentium. Published in Frontiers in Immunology (2026), the study demonstrates that L. johnsonii inhibits pathogen growth and biofilm formation through antimicrobial bioactive compounds, competes for nutrients and intestinal attachment sites, and promotes favorable colonization of the gut mucosa. Located in Hyderabad, the work underscores translational potential of L. johnsonii as a probiotic-based therapy to manage enteric infections and reduce antibiotic reliance, particularly in vulnerable populations. The article marks the first publication from Morampudi's lab, authored by Vasamsetti, Khaderbad, Sarmah, Atham, Pondugala, Chintalapati, and Morampudi, supported by IoE, SERB, and UGC. Reference: Vasamsetti et al., Frontiers in Immunology, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ハイデラバード大学の研究者、腸管病原体に対するLactobacillus johnsoniiの治療可能性を解明
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、プロバイオティクスによる病原体抑制効果に関する基礎研究論文の紹介記事であるため。
triage.notes: 実際の症例やアウトブレイクの報告ではなく、研究成果の発表記事であるため、公衆衛生上のシグナルとしては該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Africa's Greater Horn region is facing a looming polycrisis fueled by conflict, prices, climate and disease
article.articleSummary: Greater Horn of Africa faces a looming polycrisis in 2026–2027 as El Niño-driven droughts and floods intersect with protracted conflict, rising prices, and disease. Eastern Somalia, eastern Kenya, and eastern Ethiopia endured below-average short rains in 2025, with March–May 2026 long rains also poor, threatening crops, grazing, and water; the northern Horn (Ethiopia’s highlands, South Sudan, Sudan) is forecast below average. A super El Niño could trigger drought and floods, driving displacement and livelihoods losses. An unpredictable Ebola variant is circulating in Congo and Uganda; spread to South Sudan would heighten epidemic risk and complicate responses to other shocks. Fertilizer shortages linked to the Iran war and a global bottleneck will raise costs and depress harvests later this year. Widespread aid cuts and reduced humanitarian capacity shift primary responsibility to governments and local communities.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ大アフリカの角地域は紛争、物価高騰、気候変動、疾病が重なる複合危機に直面
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ・ウガンダで「予測不可能なエボラ変異株」が流行中との記載があるが、具体的な症例数・死亡者数・拡大状況等の詳細情報がなく、記事全体も地域複合危機の分析が主題でエボラ単独の新規事案報告ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はGreater Horn of Africaの複合危機（旱魃・紛争・物価・疾病）を分析するもので、エボラは複合要因の一つとして言及されている。「予測不可能な変異株」との表現は懸念材料だが、既存流行状況への言及か新規事案かは記事から判別不可。South Sudanへの拡大懸念があるが同国は対象国リスト外。Ugandaも対象国リスト外のため除外。続報で具体的な症例情報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: इबोला के नए वैक्सीन का इंसानों पर पहला परीक्षण शुरू, सीरम इंस्टीट्यूट ने तैयार किए 6.2 लाख डोज
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First human trial of the new Ebola vaccine begins; Serum Institute has manufactured 6.2 lakh doses.
article.articleSummary: First human trial of a new Ebola vaccine, ChAdOx1 BDBV, has begun in Oxford, UK, targeting the Bundibugyo strain. Developed by Oxford University and Serum Institute of India (SII), the program has produced over 620,000 doses, with 4,000 investigational doses for a Phase 1 study involving 50 healthy adults aged 18–55. The trial, to assess safety and the strength of immune response, is conducted with CEPI, Oxford, and SII partners, and recruitment has started with vaccination expected in coming weeks after regulatory approval. The vaccine uses the ChAdOx1 chimpanzee adenovirus vector platform, the same technology behind the Oxford–AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine. If safe and effective, it could help control Bundibugyo Ebola outbreaks in Africa. Uganda plans additional trials; the ongoing outbreak underscores urgent need, and WHO noted rapid progress within 57 days of declaration. Ebola spreads via blood and bodily fluids, causing fever, weakness, vomiting, diarrhea, and bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ新ワクチンの初のヒト臨床試験開始、セラム・インスティテュートが62万回分を製造
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はウガンダで発生中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）に対する新ワクチンの第I相臨床試験開始を報じるものであり、対象国リストに含まれる国での新規感染症発生情報ではない。
triage.notes: 実際のエボラ流行はウガンダ（対象国リスト外）で発生。インドはワクチン製造拠点（Serum Institute of India）としての言及であり、感染症発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Zambia declares end to cholera outbreak
article.articleSummary: Zambia declared the end of its cholera outbreak on July 16, 2026, after four consecutive weeks with no confirmed cases. The outbreak, which began in August 2025, recorded 1,627 confirmed cases and 26 deaths across 25 districts. Permanent Secretary Kennedy Lishimpi announced the decision at a Lusaka briefing, attributing containment to an aggressive package of interventions implemented by the government, health workers, cooperating partners, and community members who embraced measures to stop transmission. The measures reportedly halted transmission and interrupted the outbreak, marking a successful containment achieved through sustained surveillance and public health response across the affected districts. The declaration confirms the end of the nationwide outbreak affecting 25 districts, with no new confirmed infections for four weeks.

triage.headline_ja: ザンビア、コレラ流行の終息を宣言
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はアウトブレイクの終息宣言であり、新規の公衆衛生上の脅威を示すものではないため、フルRRAの必要性は低い。
triage.notes: 既に終息した過去のアウトブレイク（2025年8月〜2026年7月、25地区、1,627症例、26死亡）の終了報告であり、新規シグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: "هنلبس الكمامات تاني".. كورونا يضرب من جديد ومخاوف عالمية (تفاصيل)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "We'll wear masks again"... COVID-19 strikes again and global fears (Details).
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 infections resurged with two deaths in Andhra Pradesh, India, triggering a health alert though experts caution against a statewide surge. Physicians say the rise reflects sporadic transmission as immunity from prior infection and vaccination wanes over time. Early testing is advised for fever, cough, or shortness of breath to ensure appropriate care and reduce transmission. High-risk groups remain the elderly, people with diabetes, chronic heart or lung disease, kidney disease, cancer, and those with weakened immune systems. Vaccination remains protective, with boosters especially important before international travel or during outbreaks. Preventive measures—masking in enclosed crowded spaces, regular hand hygiene, good ventilation, and avoiding close contact with patients—are recommended. Public health goals focus on reducing severe disease and protecting vulnerable populations, with guidance to stay informed and seek medical advice at symptom onset.

triage.headline_ja: 「またマスクを着けることになる」…新型コロナウイルスが再流行、世界的な懸念（詳細）
triage.triage_reason: インドのアンドラプラデシュ州でCOVID-19の散発的な再流行と2件の死亡が報告されているが、専門家は州全体での急増ではないとしており、情報が限定的なため継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: COVID-19は既知の疾患であり、既存の対策・ワクチンで対応可能。地域限定的な散発例であり専門家も州全体での急増を否定しているため、フルRRAへの移行は現時点で不要と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda discharges last Ebola patient, starts countdown to be virus-free
article.articleSummary: On 16 July 2026, Uganda discharged its last Ebola patient, a Congolese national, from Mulago National Referral Hospital in Kampala, triggering a 42-day countdown to be declared Ebola-free under WHO guidelines. Uganda has confirmed 20 Bundibugyo Ebola cases since mid-May, with 15 infections acquired in neighbouring Democratic Republic of Congo and then entering Uganda. Uganda has not reported a new case since 22 June. In Congo, 62 new cases were reported on Thursday, bringing total confirmed infections to 2,073, though WHO says the true tally could be at least double. The discharged patient is now with his family. If no new cases occur in 42 days, WHO guidelines stipulate that Uganda will be declared Ebola-free.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、最後のエボラ患者を退院させ、ウイルス撲滅宣言へのカウントダウン開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国では2,073例の確認例（実際は2倍以上の可能性）を伴うエボラ流行が継続しており、国境を越えた感染拡大（ウガンダへの伝播）も既に発生しているため、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダでの流行終息（対象国リスト外のため除外）だが、コンゴ民主共和国では2,073例確認・新規62例発生と流行が継続中であり、こちらを主要な懸念国として抽出した。ウガンダはBundibugyo株で20例確認、うち15例はDRCで感染後にウガンダへ流入した越境伝播事例。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak is the fastest-growing on record with 750 dead and 2,000 cases
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Eastern Congo is the fastest-growing on record, with over 2,000 confirmed cases and more than 750 deaths. Potential cases have surfaced near Kisangani, expanding concerns about geographic reach; Ituri province is the outbreak's focal point, with Bunia General Hospital affected and a treatment facility shut down briefly due to unpaid wages by staff. Approximately 80% of new infections stem from unidentified transmission chains, complicating containment. The Bundibugyo strain underlies this outbreak, for which no authorised vaccines or treatments exist. Two therapies—remdesivir and MBP134—are under clinical trial; in a randomized design at Ituri, patients receive standard care, remdesivir, MBP134, or both, with up to 1,000 participants planned. WHO cautions results may take months. Symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhoea, muscle pain, and sometimes bleeding. Funeral restrictions limit transmission post-mortem.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行、記録上最速のペースで拡大、死者750人・感染者2,000人
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当し、WPRO基準も複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 記録上最速の増加率、未特定感染経路が80%を占める点、ワクチン・治療薬未承認（臨床試験段階）である点が特に懸念材料。Kisangani近郊への拡大は地理的拡散のリスクを示唆。

article.articleHeadline: UNICEF subraya la necesidad de "una acción colectiva más enérgica y una respuesta más rápida" ante el ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UNICEF emphasizes the need for "a more vigorous collective action and a faster response" in the face of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo demands 'a more vigorous collective action and a faster response' as UNICEF reports over 2,000 confirmed cases and more than 750 deaths. Ituri province in the northeast is the epicenter, with five provinces affected: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo, amid conflict, insecurity, displacement and limited access that hinder control. UNICEF Regional Director Gilles Fagninou calls for accelerated, coordinated action focusing on four priorities: mobilizing communities and countering misinformation; strengthening prevention and infection control; protecting children affected; and enhancing community surveillance. The response must be integrated with other emergencies such as malnutrition, cholera, polio, and displacement, while maintaining essential health services and preparing for the next school year. A funding gap exists: only 25% of required funding is secured despite urgent mobilization. DR Congo, the most experienced Ebola country since 1976 (Yambuku, Ebola River), ended the Kasai outbreak in December 2025.

triage.headline_ja: UNICEF、エボラ出血熱に対し「より強力な集団行動と迅速な対応」の必要性を強調
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で確認症例2,000人超、死者750人超、5州にまたがる大規模エボラ流行が継続中であり、紛争・避難民問題も絡み国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が極めて高い。
triage.notes: エボラ流行はイツリ州を中心に北キブ、南キブ、ハウトウエレ、チョポの5州に拡大。紛争・避難民・アクセス制限が対応を妨げており、資金不足（必要額の25%のみ確保）も深刻。コレラ・ポリオ等他の緊急事態との統合対応が求められている。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda begins 42-day countdown to Ebola-free status after discharging last patient
article.articleSummary: Uganda recorded 20 confirmed Ebola cases in the current outbreak—5 locally acquired and 15 imported—along with 17 recoveries and 2 deaths. The final patient was discharged from Mulago National Referral Hospital in Kampala, triggering a 42-day WHO countdown to declare the outbreak over, provided no new confirmed cases emerge after the last recovery or death. As of 16 July 2026, Uganda awaits 42 consecutive days without a new case to be declared Ebola-free. The Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) continues to report Ebola activity, with 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths, driven by the Bundibugyo strain. There is no widely licensed vaccine specifically approved for Bundibugyo, making surveillance, early detection, contact tracing, and infection prevention essential for containment. The Bundibugyo strain was first identified in Uganda in 2007.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、最後の患者退院後にエボラフリー宣言に向けた42日間のカウントダウンを開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCで2,011例・754名死亡という大規模なエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が継続中であり、有効なワクチンがなく、ウガンダへの越境感染（輸入症例15例）も確認されているため、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はウガンダの流行終息（対象国リスト外のため除外）だが、DRCにおけるブンディブギョ株の大規模流行（2,011例・754死亡）が継続しており、ワクチン未承認・越境感染の実績があるため、DRCについてはPICKUP相当と判断した。

article.articleHeadline: 金門海漂豬驗出非洲豬瘟　卓榮泰：當地豬肉、加工品禁輸1週
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kinmen sea-drift pigs test positive for African swine fever; Zhuo Rong-tai says local pork and processed products are banned from imports for one week.
article.articleSummary: African swine fever (ASF) was confirmed in a drifted pig found at Xintou Beach, Jinhu Township, Kinmen County, Taiwan. Sampling after Coast Guard notification showed ASF virus nucleic acid positive, with sequencing underway at the Veterinary Research Institute. This is 2026’s first domestic ASF case; since 2018 Taiwan has recorded 21 sea-drift ASF positives, with 2 in 2025. The pig likely drifted from mainland ports near Fujian, Xiamen, and Jiulong River, aided by Typhoon Bavi’s outer circulation and currents. Kinmen authorities conducted health visits to 25 pig farms within 10 km of the site; all pigs were healthy. Premier Zhu Rong-tai announced cross-ministry measures, including strengthened border surveillance and ongoing sequencing; a one-week ban on Kinmen pork and processed pork products imports to the main island and other offshore islands was imposed to prevent spread. Residents are urged not to bring pork products back to Taiwan.

triage.headline_ja: 金門海岸に漂着した豚からアフリカ豚熱（ASF）陽性反応、卓栄泰行政院長が現地豚肉・加工品の輸出入を1週間禁止と発表
triage.triage_reason: 台湾金門島で海上漂着豚からASF陽性が確認され、本土由来の可能性が高いが、これは動物疾病であり人への健康影響はなく、既に2018年以降繰り返し発生している既知の事象であるため、フルRRAには進めず継続監視とする。
triage.notes: 本事象は動物（豚）のアフリカ豚熱であり、ヒトへの感染性・公衆衛生影響はない。中国本土由来の可能性が示唆されているが、確認された発生地は台湾金門島であり、対象国リストに台湾は含まれず、中国本土での発生確認情報もないため verified_locations は空とした。台湾当局は既に境界監視強化・輸入禁止等の対応を実施しており、外部支援の必要性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Araçatuba compartilha experiência exitosa no combate à dengue em congresso nacional de saúde
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Araçatuba shares successful experience in fighting dengue at the National Health Congress.
article.articleSummary: Dengue control in Araçatuba, São Paulo, was showcased at the 21st Mostra Brasil, Aqui Tem SUS, during the 39th CONASEMS in Porto Alegre. Epidemiological Surveillance Director Priscila Cestaro presented "Portas Fechadas, Olhos Abertos: Araçatuba and Creci-SP inspect abandoned properties to combat dengue," coauthored with Guilherme Santos of the UVZ. The initiative, conducted during the 2025 dengue epidemic, involved CRECI-SP inspectors installing drain-cover devices in abandoned properties and contributed to disease control. The work earned a Honorable Mention at the 15th David Capistrano Prize at COSEMS in Santos. Health Secretary Lucila Bistaffa stressed the opportunity to share an innovative, integrated approach that helped save lives and could be reapplied elsewhere. The 39th CONASEMS, held July 12–15, drew about 13,000 participants; Araçatuba was represented by Francisco Júnior Rodrigues da Silva. Discussions focused on regionalization and health financing responsibilities.

triage.headline_ja: アラサトゥーバ、全国保健会議でデング熱対策の成功事例を共有
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は過去(2025年)のデング熱対策成功事例を学会発表として紹介する内容であり、新規の公衆衛生上の脅威や異常事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱の新規発生を報じるものではなく、2025年の流行時に実施された対策の成功事例を保健学会で共有したという内容。トリアージ対象としての緊急性はない。

article.articleHeadline: Warga Cilincing ikuti pemeriksaan kesehatan telusuri kontak erat TBC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cilincing residents participate in health screening to trace the close contacts of TB.
article.articleSummary: TB remains a public health priority in North Jakarta as Cilincing residents in Kalibaru (RW 014) undergo health screenings for household and close contacts of tuberculosis patients to locate active cases. The Cilincing District Health Center has performed screenings at 120 locations this year, targeting roughly 100 people per site, in collaboration with the Health Ministry and supported by private partners to broaden access. Officials stress early case finding and screening of household contacts to halt transmission; TB is curable with disciplined, complete treatment. If X-ray findings indicate TB, residents can promptly seek treatment at Kalibaru Auxiliary Community Health Center. After about two weeks of treatment, transmission risk declines significantly. Initiatives include TB Alert Village programs, cadre training, and community education on early detection and treatment adherence. Jakarta North Health Office praises public-private collaboration to expand free health services and reduce stigma.

triage.headline_ja: チリンチン住民、結核の濃厚接触者追跡のため健康診断を受診
triage.triage_reason: 通常の結核対策プログラムの一環としての濃厚接触者スクリーニング活動であり、異常性・重篤性・国際的拡大リスクは見られない。
triage.notes: 既知の風土病である結核に対する地域保健当局の日常的な公衆衛生活動（症例探知・接触者追跡）を報じた記事であり、新規性・緊急性はない。

article.articleHeadline: Yadgiri | ಸೆಪ್ಟಿಕ್ ಟ್ಯಾಂಕ್ ನೀರು ರಸ್ತೆಗೆ; ಸಾಂಕ್ರಾಮಿಕ ರೋಗದ ಭೀತಿ | Yadgiri | Septic tank water flows onto the road; fear of infectious diseases
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Yadgiri | Septic tank water flows onto the road; fear of infectious diseases.
article.articleSummary: Septic tank behind Abdul Kalam Students’ Hostel for Minorities in Matamanaikeshwari Colony, Yadgiri, Karnataka, overflows with contaminated water onto road and vacant space, emitting a strong foul odor and raising fears of dengue and malaria among students and residents. No confirmed cases are stated, but public health risk is highlighted due to exposure to contaminated water and potential transmission. Allegations of official neglect prompted a visit by Bharat Gowda, city president of Akhanda Rashtra Yuva Seva Sangha, who condemned inaction and urged immediate removal of polluted water and a permanent fix to the septic tank. Call for accountability and urgent remediation by authorities, with emphasis on public health safeguards. Youth leaders Tejas Hiremath, Vinaykatti, Ashokareddi Vaddadgi, Kirankumar, Preetam, Ankit, Sainath Nayak, Rajesh B.L., Devaraj, Manoj Hubballi, and Ganesh Motkar attended the scrutiny.

triage.headline_ja: ヤドギリ | 浄化槽の汚水が道路に流出、感染症の恐怖
triage.triage_reason: 確定症例の報告はなく、単なる衛生環境悪化への懸念を伝える地方ニュースであり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Fiocruz conclui produção nacional de remédio contra o HIV; Maranhão já registra 355 casos de AIDS em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fiocruz completes domestic production of HIV medication; Maranhão already records 355 AIDS cases in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Dolutegravir, a key HIV antiretroviral, will be produced domestically in Brazil after Fiocruz completed technology transfer to Farmanguinhos from ViiV Healthcare (GSK). Anvisa authorization is pending before distribution through SUS can begin. Three lots have been produced and validated; quality-control analyses of the active pharmaceutical ingredient are underway to consolidate the national production chain. Since 2022 Farmanguinhos has supplied the SUS with over 739 million dolutegravir capsules produced at partner GSK facilities, and in 2025 began independent laboratory QC analyses. The new phase will also produce a fixed-dose combination of dolutegravir with lamivudine next year. In Maranhão, AIDS cases reached 967 in 2025, with 355 in the first half of 2026; São Luís (113), São José de Ribamar (51), and Imperatriz (34) are the leading 2026 municipalities. The WHO has recommended dolutegravir as first/second-line treatment since 2019.

triage.headline_ja: フィオクルズがHIV治療薬の国内生産を完了；マラニョン州では2026年に既にAIDS症例355件を記録
triage.triage_reason: HIV/AIDSの既知の流行状況報告であり、国内医薬品生産体制の話題が中心。新規性・異常性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: HIVは既知の風土病であり、本記事は医薬品生産・供給体制に関する行政報告的内容。対象国リストにBrazilは含まれるが、シグナルとしての緊急性はないためDISMISS。

article.articleHeadline: Shravasti News| Latest Hindi News | UP Breaking News in Hindi Newstrack | Shravasti News: नालियों में पटा कूड़ा, गंदगी की भरमार, नहीं खुली नींद, संक्रामक रोग की आशंका
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Shravasti News | Latest Hindi News | UP Breaking News in Hindi Newstrack | Shravasti News: Trash piled up in drains, filth in abundance, sleepless nights, risk of an infectious disease.
article.articleSummary: Post-monsoon in Shravasti, rampant garbage clogging drains has caused dirty water to overflow onto streets, elevating smells and mosquito proliferation in Gilola Bazaar, surrounding colonies, and along the Gilola Development Block routes to CHC Gilola. Stagnant water near Nehru Memorial Inter College gate and near Gauatri Temple area has intensified the risk of vector- and water-borne diseases. Doctors warn rising fever and stomach illnesses as dengue, malaria, and diarrhea loom if sanitation is not promptly addressed. Residents say cleaning staff are absent and administration is slow; they demand an urgent, targeted cleanliness drive, drain-clearing machinery, and fogging, with accountability for responsible officials. The alert underscores that small filth could spark a major outbreak. Meanwhile, after high humidity, heavy rains have brought relief from heat and farmers resumed fieldwork.

triage.headline_ja: Shravasti News：排水溝にゴミが詰まり不衛生な状態が続き、感染症のリスクが懸念される
triage.triage_reason: 現時点では実際の症例発生や流行の報告ではなく、衛生状態悪化によるデング・マラリア等のリスク警告に留まるため、シグナルとしての基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 記事は特定地域(Shravasti)の衛生環境悪化による感染症リスクへの懸念を伝える予防的報道であり、実際の症例数や発生確認情報は含まれていない。今後の症例報告があれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: أمريكا تمنع دخول القادمين من الكونغو مؤقتاً بسبب "إيبولا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. temporarily bans entry for travelers arriving from Congo due to Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak continues in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) prompting the United States to impose new travel restrictions. American citizens and dual nationals who have been in the DRC within the 21 days preceding travel are barred from boarding commercial flights to the United States; U.S. authorities urge staying outside the DRC for 21 days before attempting entry. The move comes as the outbreak persists and has spread to several provinces. Former Ebola response leader Dr. Daniel Gernigan called the policy 'unprecedented' despite the apparently low risk to Americans. The DRC Ministry of Health reports 1,963 confirmed Ebola cases and 719 deaths as of July 12, underscoring the outbreak's severity. Health authorities, with international and local partners, continue efforts to curb transmission and provide care, aiming to prevent further spread and protect populations.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ出血熱を理由にコンゴからの入国者を一時的に禁止
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が複数州に拡大し致死率も高く、米国が異例の渡航制限措置を取るなどIHR基準に複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 米国はDRC対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCでの流行状況（1,963例、719死亡、複数州拡大）が主題であり、フルRRAへの移行が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda discharges last Ebola patient: minister
article.articleSummary: Uganda discharged its last Ebola patient on Thursday, signaling containment of the Bundibugyo-strain outbreak that spilled from neighboring Democratic Republic of Congo. Uganda has reported 20 cases and 2 deaths, mainly Congolese nationals who crossed the porous border; hundreds of contacts were isolated for 21 days and subsequently released. To be declared Ebola-free under WHO guidelines, Uganda must record 42 consecutive days with no new cases (two incubation periods). In DR Congo, the outbreak has exceeded 2,000 confirmed cases and 754 deaths since mid-May, with authorities warning the true toll may be two to four times higher. There is currently no approved vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo; a first antiviral drug trial began on Tuesday. Uganda's measures, rapid contact tracing and cross-border interventions, have been praised by health officials.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、最後のエボラ患者退院と保健大臣発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確認例2,000人超・死者754人に達する大規模Bundibugyo株エボラ流行が継続しており、ウガンダへの越境拡大も発生。ワクチン・治療薬未承認でIHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCでは5月中旬以降流行が継続中で、実際の感染者数は報告の2〜4倍との当局見解あり。ワクチン・治療薬は未承認で初の抗ウイルス薬治験が開始されたばかり。

article.articleHeadline: 夫妻身上痒到痛不欲生确诊疥疮 热水烫洗反助长病情
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Couple plagued by itching so severe they can't bear to live; diagnosed with scabies; hot-water baths actually worsen the condition.
article.articleSummary: In Fuzhou, a man at the First General Hospital’s dermatology clinic presented with widespread papules and excoriations and was misdiagnosed with eczema. He reported relief from hot-water soaking, a common misconception. After staying several nights at a friend's home, he developed itching on the abdomen and thighs, and his wife later developed the same symptoms. On examination, fine papules between the fingers and other classic signs pointed to scabies. The diagnosis of contagious scabies (Sarcoptes scabiei) was confirmed, and after thorough household disinfection and standard anti-scabies therapy, the family improved markedly. The clinician notes misdiagnosis is common: scabies causes intense nocturnal itching and involves thin-skinned areas such as finger webs, wrists, armpits, navel area, and groin; genital nodules may appear in men. Transmission occurs via close contact and shared bedding or clothing, leading to outbreaks in families or dormitories. Scabies is year-round, thriving in crowded, humid, unhygienic environments, including boarding schools.

triage.headline_ja: 夫婦が耐えられないほどの痒みで疥癬と診断、熱いお湯での洗浄が症状を悪化させる

triage.notes: 個人の医療事例報告であり、集団感染や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Roger Kamba face aux députés - " Plus de 14 laboratoires déployés et des résultats de tests d'Ebola obtenus en 24 heures "
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: Roger Kamba before Parliament - "More than 14 laboratories deployed and Ebola test results obtained within 24 hours."
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) as of 16 July 2026 spans five provinces, with Ituri as the epicenter. The tally stands at 2,011 confirmed Ebola Virus Disease cases and 744 deaths (case fatality rate 37.5%), across 42 health zones in Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uélé, and Tshopo. Ituri accounts for about 90% of cases; access is constrained by insecurity and logistics. The government, with WHO and partners, reports a robust two-month response featuring more than 14 laboratories and over 700 beds deployed within six weeks. All suspected cases are tested; INRB typically returns a diagnosis within 24 hours. Kinshasa reports no positive cases to date. Ongoing challenges include mobility constraints and gaps in population awareness about Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：ロジェ・カンバ大臣が国会で報告 ― 「14以上の検査室を配備し、エボラ検査結果を24時間以内に取得」
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC5州にわたり2,011症例・744死亡（致死率37.5%）と深刻な公衆衛生インパクトがあり、国際的拡大リスクや治安・物流の制約も存在するためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナル。
triage.notes: 既存の大規模アウトブレイクの継続報告。政府・WHO・パートナーによる対応体制（検査室・病床拡充）が進行中だが、治安と住民の認識不足が課題として残る。

article.articleHeadline: В Уганде начинается 42-дневный период наблюдения перед признанием страны "свободной от Эболы"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Uganda, a 42-day observation period begins before the country is declared Ebola-free.
article.articleSummary: Uganda begins a 42-day post-discharge observation to confirm Ebola-free status; if no new cases are detected, the World Health Organization will officially declare the country Ebola-free. The 42-day window aligns with WHO criteria for ending an outbreak. In the latest outbreak announced in May, Uganda recorded 20 confirmed Ebola cases, with 2 deaths and one probable case also resulting in death; the last confirmed case was identified on June 21. Ebola virus disease causes severe hemorrhagic fever and was first identified in 1976 in outbreaks in Sudan and the Democratic Republic of Congo, with the name derived from the Ebola River near one outbreak site. The largest outbreak occurred in West Africa (2013–2017), infecting about 30,000 people and killing over 11,000 across Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダで、エボラ出血熱終息宣言に向けた42日間の観察期間が開始
triage.triage_reason: 本件はウガンダにおけるエボラ流行終息（WHOによる終息宣言に向けた観察期間開始）を報じるものであり、新規感染拡大や異常事態ではなく、対象国リストにも該当国が含まれないため見送りとする。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダの流行終息プロセスを報じるものであり、DRC・スーダン・ギニア等は1976年及び2013-2017年の過去の流行事例として言及されているのみで、現在進行中の発生地ではない。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: تفشي الحمى القلاعية يدفع السلطات الليبية لإغلاق أسواق الماشية بالشرق والغرب والجنوب - اخبار ليبيا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Foot-and-mouth disease outbreak prompts Libyan authorities to close livestock markets in the East, West, and South - Libya News
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) outbreak prompts Libya-wide livestock-market closures across East, West, and South. By 16 July 2026, official data report over 3,765 infected animals, 233 sheep dead, 44 cattle dead, and about 62,341 exposed livestock. Western Libya closed Tarhuna’s Sidi Sayed market and Msallata; Qasr al-Akhiyar market closed; Sirte restricted animal movement. Eastern Libya shuttered markets in Sloug and Qaminis, plus Tobruk and Shahat; Derna urged halt of movement after suspected cases in Qandola and Marawa (Jabal al-Akhdar). In the South, Ogla municipality closed its market; Ubari suspended transfers in Toosh for 10–20 days. Lab confirmation of cases underlines economic fallout: reduced milk production, abortions, weight loss, and rising meat/dairy prices. Eastern authorities led by Osama Hammad acted swiftly, contrasting with Western delays under Abdul Hamid Dbeiba.

triage.headline_ja: 口蹄疫の流行によりリビア当局が東部・西部・南部の家畜市場を閉鎖
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫はリビア国内の家畜感染事例であり、対象国リストに該当する国での発生ではなく、ヒトへの直接的な公衆衛生影響も報告されていないため見送りとする。
triage.notes: 本事案はリビアにおける家畜(牛・羊)の口蹄疫流行であり、ヒト感染症ではない。発生地域フィールドにフィリピンやインド等が含まれるが、記事本文はリビア国内の事例のみを扱っており、対象国リストに該当する国は主題として含まれないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola patients, responders flee attack on Congo hospital
article.articleSummary: At Nyakunde Hospital in Ituri province, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, Ebola patients and responders fled after an angry crowd attacked the facility on July 16. The attack followed the death of a woman who died around 3 p.m. after giving birth and developing severe anaemia; relatives offered to donate blood, but transfusions are prohibited during an Ebola outbreak. Up to 10 Ebola patients were being treated at the hospital, several escaping as attackers damaged the perimeter and cut power. The medical team evacuated, and the Ebola treatment center staff from Samaritan's Purse also pulled back. By Thursday morning, three Ebola patients remained at the hospital. Congo's army opened an investigation into the unrest. The outbreak, the 17th in Congo, has produced 2,073 confirmed cases and 796 deaths, complicating security and ongoing negotiations over a U.S.-backed minerals partnership.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者と対応者、コンゴの病院への襲撃から避難
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中の第17次エボラ流行（確定2,073例、死亡796例）に加え、病院への襲撃により患者が逃走し感染拡大・対応体制の崩壊リスクが生じているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 病院襲撃によりエボラ患者最大10名のうち複数名が逃走し、地域内での感染拡大及び対応活動の妨害が懸念される。米国支援の鉱物パートナーシップ交渉にも影響する可能性があり、政治的関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: 最後一名伊波拉患者出院　烏干達擺脫疫情正式倒數
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The last Ebola patient discharged as Uganda officially enters the countdown to ending the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Uganda has discharged its last Ebola patient and begun a 42-day observation period, after which it could declare the outbreak over per WHO guidelines if no new cases emerge. Since mid-May, Uganda has confirmed 20 Bundibugyo Ebola virus cases, 15 of which were infections acquired in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) before entering Uganda. Uganda has not reported a new case since June 22. Meanwhile, the DRC today added 62 new confirmed cases, bringing its total to 2,073; WHO cautions the true total may be at least twice that figure. The final Ugandan patient was a Congolese national who recovered and was discharged from Mulago National Referral Hospital’s isolation ward, and is ready to reunite with his family. Government spokesman Alan Kasujja announced that Uganda has officially started the countdown.

triage.headline_ja: 最後のエボラ患者が退院、ウガンダは疫病終息へ正式カウントダウン開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCで2,073例（実数はさらに多い可能性）に達するエボラ出血熱の継続的流行があり、国境を越えたウガンダへの感染も確認されているため、国際的拡大リスクと重篤性からフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダの終息プロセスとDRCでの拡大継続の両方に言及しているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためDRCのみをverified_locationsとした。DRCでの症例数増加（62例追加、累計2,073例、WHOは実数がその2倍以上の可能性を指摘）は継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: RD Congo, l'epidemia di Ebola sempre più fuori controllo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo, the Ebola epidemic increasingly out of control.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak in Ituri and North Kivu provinces deteriorates, with over 2,000 infections and 796 deaths reported, though WHO warns actual figures could be 2–4 times higher. In Bunia, Ituri’s capital, on the first day of June volunteers carried a coffin for an Ebola victim, but attackers from local communities opposed WHO burial protocols that forbid washing or direct contact with the dead, highlighting deadly tensions over safe funerary rites. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus is spreading rapidly where no vaccine or proven therapy exists. Attacks and threats against health workers and even Red Cross staff impede case finding, contact tracing, and patient care, especially in war-torn areas around Goma-linked districts. The conflict complicates transit and information flows, fueling misinformation; community dialogue is essential. By early July a fragile, uncertain lull has appeared, but containment remains precarious.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱の流行がますます制御不能に
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱(ブンディブギョ株)がイトゥリ・北キブ州で拡大し、2000人超の感染・796人の死亡が報告され、ワクチン・治療法が存在しない上に紛争と医療従事者への攻撃が対応を阻害しており、国際的拡大リスクと深刻な公衆衛生影響が認められるため。
triage.notes: ワクチン・承認された治療法が存在しないブンディブギョ株による流行で、紛争地域における医療アクセス制限と埋葬儀礼を巡る地域社会との衝突が対応を著しく困難にしている。WHO推定では実際の症例数は報告の2〜4倍の可能性。

article.articleHeadline: آمار واقعات تایید شدۀ ایبولا در کانگو از ۲۰۰۰ گذشت
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of confirmed Ebola cases in Congo has surpassed 2,000 since 2000.
article.articleSummary: As of July 16, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ebola outbreak has surpassed 2,000 confirmed cases since 2000. Since the outbreak began in May, 754 deaths, 366 recoveries, and 753 people in isolation have been reported. WHO warns that sustained transmission could heighten regional spillover risk. MSF calls for an immediate scale-up in testing, patient care, survivor support, and safe burial practices. The United States has imposed travel restrictions on U.S. citizens who have visited the country in the past 21 days. MSF Emergency Programs Director Trish Newport cautions that delays cost lives and that responses should outpace the outbreak. WHO reports about 750 beds for isolation and treatment across 25 facilities in Congo, with 100 more beds slated this week. International efforts include CDC-led collaboration for case tracking, sampling, awareness, and community engagement.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ確定症例数、2000年以降2000例を突破
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で2000例超・754人死亡の大規模エボラアウトブレイクが継続し、WHOが地域波及リスクを警告、米国が渡航制限を課すなど国際的な対応が必要とされている。
triage.notes: 米国は渡航制限を実施している側であり発生国ではないため、verified_locationsには含めていない。CDC・MSF・WHOが国際支援を展開中。

article.articleHeadline: 乌干达现存埃博拉病例清零
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda's remaining Ebola cases have been cleared to zero.
article.articleSummary: Uganda's Ebola outbreak is declared over as the last patient recovered and was discharged on July 16, 2026 at Mulago National Referral Hospital in Kampala, triggering a 42‑day transmission-cessation countdown. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak began May 15, 2026 when a traveler from eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo tested positive. Uganda reported 20 laboratory-confirmed cases: 15 imported from DRC and 5 local transmissions, with 2 fatalities (approximately 10% case fatality rate). WHO Uganda representative Kasonde Mwanga attributed containment to thorough preparedness and sustained vigilance, noting the relatively low mortality. If no new confirmed cases occur during the 42‑day period after the last known case, Uganda will formally declare the outbreak ended.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダで残存エボラ症例がゼロに
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はWPRO基準の異常性・重症度・流行しやすさで該当し、社会的関心も高いため、42日間の終息確認期間中の継続監視も含めフルRRAでの確認が望ましい。
triage.notes: 本アウトブレイクはウガンダ（対象国リスト外）で発生し、コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）から入国した渡航者が感染源。ウガンダは20例確認（DRC由来15例、現地感染5例）、死亡2例（致死率約10%）で、2026年7月16日に最終患者が退院し42日間の終息確認期間に入った。DRC自体での新規発生についての記述はないが、感染源国として言及されているため参考情報として記録。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola - L'Ouganda annonce ne plus compter aucun malade d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola – Uganda says it no longer has any Ebola patients.
article.articleSummary: Uganda says it no longer has any Ebola patients, with the last patient discharged healthy from Mulago Hospital’s Ebola treatment unit on Thursday. Health minister Dr. Chris Baryomunsi, alongside the WHO Uganda representative Dr. Kasonde Mwinga, announced the milestone on July 16, 2026. Uganda recorded 20 confirmed Ebola cases and 2 deaths in the ongoing outbreak linked to the Ebola epidemic officially declared on May 15 in the Democratic Republic of Congo, in Ituri province in the northeast, which borders South Sudan and Uganda. All remaining patients have recovered. Uganda must now undergo a 42-day case-free period to be officially declared Ebola-free. The notification highlights Uganda’s progress amid cross-border transmission risks from the Congo outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱 – ウガンダ、エボラ患者がもういないと発表
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州で宣言されたエボラ流行がウガンダへ越境伝播した事例であり、国際的拡大と異常性の観点からIHR基準に複数該当するためフルRRAへ進める必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダでの症例ゼロ達成を報じているが、対象国リストにウガンダは含まれないため、感染源であるDRC（イトゥリ州）のみをverified_locationsに計上した。DRCでの流行継続状況については本記事からは不明。

article.articleHeadline: 乌干达最后一名埃博拉患者出院
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda's last Ebola patient discharged
article.articleSummary: Uganda discharged its last Ebola patient on July 16, 2026, signaling control of the outbreak imported from neighboring Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). Per WHO guidelines, Uganda will be Ebola-free after 42 consecutive days without new cases, the equivalent of two incubation periods. Since the mid‑May outbreak, DRC has reported more than 2,000 confirmed cases and 754 deaths, though WHO cautions the true toll could be 2–4 times higher. Uganda reported 20 cases and 2 deaths, with most infections among Congolese nationals crossing the border. Hundreds of close contacts were quarantined for 21 days and have since been released. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain currently has no approved vaccine or treatment, though a first antiviral drug trial began recently. Officials praised contact tracing and treatment follow-up and pledged stricter border controls to prevent cross-border spread.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダの最後のエボラ患者退院
triage.triage_reason: DRCでの大規模エボラ流行（確定2000例以上、死亡754例）が隣国ウガンダへ越境伝播しており、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダでの終息を報じているが、流行の主体はDRCであり、DRCでは死亡754例・確定2000例超と深刻。Bundibugyo株にはワクチン・治療薬が未承認であり、抗ウイルス薬治験が開始されたばかり。ウガンダ(Uganda)は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: Uganda dá alta a último paciente infetado com o vírus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Uganda discharges the last patient infected with the virus.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 July 2026, Uganda has no active Ebola infections, with the last patient discharged from Mulago Hospital’s Ebola treatment unit after recovery. A 42‑day observation window is required before the country is declared virus‑free, per WHO guidelines, doubling the maximum incubation period. Hundreds of contacts were quarantined for 21 days and released. Border measures will be reinforced to minimize cross‑border transmission. The outbreak originated in the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri province (northeast, near South Sudan and Uganda). Uganda reports 20 confirmed cases and 2 deaths; the remaining patients have recovered. DRCongo has about 2,000 cases and over 700 deaths, with WHO warning the true size may be 2–4 times higher as transmission accelerates. There is no vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo ebolavirus yet, though the WHO has launched an early antiviral treatment trial.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ウガンダ、ウイルス感染最後の患者を退院させる
triage.triage_reason: DRC（イツリ州）を起源とするエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行がウガンダに越境拡大し、DRCでは約2000症例・700人超の死亡が報告されワクチン・治療法も未確立であるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ただし越境伝播の事実は国際拡大リスク評価に反映した。DRCでは症例数がWHO推計で実際は2〜4倍高い可能性があり、感染拡大が加速中との警告がある点は重要。

article.articleHeadline: أوغندا تقترب من إعلان انتهاء تفشي إيبولا مع خروج آخر مريض من المستشفى - أخبار ليبيا 24
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda nears the announcement of the end of the Ebola outbreak as the last patient is discharged from the hospital - Libya News 24
article.articleSummary: Uganda is poised to declare the end of its Ebola outbreak as the last patient is discharged from Mulago National Referral Hospital in Kampala. After the hospital release, Uganda enters a 42-day monitoring period mandated by the World Health Organization, during which no new infections must be recorded to officially terminate the outbreak. Current Uganda data show 17 recovered, one patient still receiving treatment, and two fatalities. Five infections were acquired domestically, while 15 people contracted the virus abroad before crossing into Uganda, underscoring cross-border transmission risks tied to the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, described by WHO as the third-worst outbreak for this strain. The regional threat persists as neighboring Democratic Republic of Congo reports ongoing transmission, with 2,073 confirmed cases and 796 deaths, and WHO had declared a national emergency in May. Vigilant cross-border surveillance remains essential.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、最後の患者が退院しエボラ流行終息宣言に近づく - Libya News 24
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）はIHR基準を複数満たし、隣国DRCで2,073症例・796死亡の継続的流行とWHOの国家緊急事態宣言があるため、越境伝播リスクを含めフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダの流行終息だが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは継続的な感染拡大と国家緊急事態宣言が本文で具体的に言及されており、verified_locationsに含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : population d'une zone de santé d'Aru appelée à se mobiliser contre Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: Population of an Aru health zone urged to mobilize against Ebola - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) outbreak in Aru territory, Ituri province, northeast Democratic Republic of the Congo, triggers mobilization of Laybo health zone residents to prevent introduction and spread. Since the official outbreak declaration on May 17, Ebola has spread to more than 25 of 36 health zones in Ituri, heightening risk for remaining zones. Transmission occurs by direct contact with an infected person or contaminated objects (clothing, door handles, chairs, cups, shoes, pens). Early EVD symptoms resemble malaria or flu: fever, headache, muscle pains, diarrhea or vomiting; laboratory confirmation is required to confirm a case, and many patients succumb before hemorrhagic signs emerge. Authorities call for strict infection prevention measures: regular handwashing, replacing handshakes with verbal greetings, and close collaboration with response teams to interrupt transmission chains.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ州:アル保健地域の住民、エボラ出血熱への警戒を呼びかけられる - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCイツリ州でのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが36保健地域中25以上に拡大しており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクを有するためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: 2026年5月17日に公式宣言されたエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが、イツリ州アル準州で36保健地域中25以上に拡大。初期症状がマラリアやインフルエンザに類似し診断が困難な点、直接接触・汚染物質を介した伝播が続いている点に留意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: ZAMBIA DECLARES END TO CHOLERA OUTBREAK AFTER NEARLY A YEAR - Zambia 24
article.articleSummary: Zambia declares end to its cholera outbreak as of 16 July 2026, dating from August 2025, after four consecutive weeks with no confirmed cases. The outbreak affected 25 districts, with 1,627 confirmed cases and 26 deaths. Closure follows the Global Task Force on Cholera Control recommendation, signaling interruption of transmission after months of response. Control measures included strengthened disease surveillance, laboratory testing, rapid case management, targeted oral cholera vaccination in high-risk districts, water, sanitation and hygiene interventions, risk communication, environmental health measures, and prepositioning of essential medicines. Despite the end, the threat remains; the public is urged to drink treated water, wash hands with soap, maintain food hygiene, keep spaces clean, and seek medical care for acute watery diarrhoea or vomiting. Authorities will sustain surveillance, preparedness, and a multisectoral cholera control plan to reduce future risk.

triage.headline_ja: ザンビア、約1年に及んだコレラ流行の終息を宣言
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は既に終息した過去のコレラアウトブレイクの終了宣言であり、新規の公衆衛生リスクや進行中の脅威を示すものではないため、フルRRAの対象とはしない。
triage.notes: 2025年8月から続いたコレラ流行（25地区、確定症例1627件、死亡26件）について、4週間新規症例がないことを受けGlobal Task Force on Choleraの勧告に基づき終息を宣言。今後も監視体制と予防策は継続予定。

article.articleHeadline: Global studies redefine the treatment of heart failure caused by Chagas disease
article.articleSummary: Chagas disease-related cardiomyopathy was studied in Parachute-HF (JAMA): 922 patients at 83 centers across Brazil, Argentina, Colombia, and Mexico were randomized to sacubitril/valsartan versus enalapril on top of guideline-directed therapy. Safety was comparable; no significant difference in cardiovascular death or first heart-failure hospitalization between treatments. However, sacubitril/valsartan achieved a markedly greater reduction in NT-proBNP at 12 weeks: median -30.6% versus -5.5% with enalapril, addressed by lead investigator Renato D. Lopes of Tribe MD. The Parachute-HF study, coordinated by the Brazilian Clinical Research Institute, is part of two landmark trials published in JAMA and JACC to provide disease-specific evidence for Chagas cardiomyopathy, enhancing guidance for the 30-40% of infected individuals who develop cardiac manifestations.

triage.headline_ja: 国際的研究がシャーガス病による心不全治療を再定義
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はシャーガス病心筋症の治療薬に関する臨床研究報告であり、公衆衛生上の緊急事態や異常な感染拡大を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は臨床試験（Parachute-HF）の結果報告であり、アウトブレイクや感染拡大を報じるものではない。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるため参考として記載したが、アルゼンチン・コロンビア・メキシコは対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 'Moment of Joy' as Uganda Discharges Last Ebola Patient
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-07-16, Uganda has discharged its last Ebola patient, leaving zero active confirmed cases and triggering a 42-day countdown to an official Ebola-free status. The outbreak involved the Bundibugyo species; Uganda’s first case was in May, a man who travelled from DR Congo, the epicentre. Uganda recorded 20 confirmed cases, mostly among visitors from DR Congo, and two deaths. DR Congo has reported more than 2,000 confirmed infections and 796 deaths; WHO has warned the true number could be four times higher. The US has extended travel rules requiring citizens who were in DR Congo to spend 21 days in a third country before entering the United States, affecting medics and recruitment. Uganda maintains protocols of isolation, contact tracing and targeted public health messaging. Symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhoea, or unexplained bleeding; infection spreads via bodily fluids, and infection may start after handling infected animals.

triage.headline_ja: 『歓喜の瞬間』ウガンダが最後のエボラ患者を退院させる
triage.triage_reason: DRCで2,000例超・796人死亡の大規模エボラ流行が継続中で、ウガンダへの越境伝播や米国の渡航制限措置も生じており、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダでのエボラ終息報告だが、根本的な流行源はDRCであり、DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため列挙。ウガンダ・米国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。WHOはDRCの実際の感染者数が報告の4倍に達する可能性を警告している。

article.articleHeadline: 乌干达现存埃博拉病例清零
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda's remaining Ebola cases cleared to zero.
article.articleSummary: Uganda ends its Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak as the last patient is discharged in Kampala on July 16, 2026, initiating a 42-day countdown to declare the outbreak over if no new cases arise. The final patient recovered at Mulago National Referral Hospital, with Health Minister Chris Baryomunsi presenting the discharge certificate. WHO Uganda representative Kasonde Mwenga attributed the successful containment to strong preparedness and alert Ebola control teams, noting a relatively low case fatality rate in this outbreak. Beginning May 15, the outbreak recorded 20 confirmed cases, including 15 imported from the Democratic Republic of Congo and 5 locally transmitted, with 2 deaths. If no new infections occur within the 42 days after the last case is non-transmissible, Uganda will formally announce the outbreak’s end.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、残存エボラ症例がゼロに
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR上重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、コンゴ民主共和国からウガンダへの越境感染（輸入症例15例）が確認されているため、国際的拡大リスクの観点からフルRRAでの確認が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事の主題はウガンダでのアウトブレイク終息（隔離解除・42日カウントダウン開始）だが、20症例中15例がDRCからの輸入症例であり、DRC側で継続的なエボラ感染源が存在することを示唆する。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外し、感染源国であるDRCのみをverified_locationsに計上した。DRC側の感染状況について続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Sista Ebola-patienten i Uganda utskriven
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The last Ebola patient in Uganda has been discharged.
article.articleSummary: Uganda has discharged its last Ebola virus disease (EVD) patient, a Congolese national who recovered and will reunite with family, but the outbreak worsens in the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Kongo-Kinshasa region. As of Thursday, 2,073 Ebola cases have been reported with 796 deaths. Attacks against patients and relief workers continue amid unrest linked to the death of a pregnant woman who reportedly died because a blood transfusion could not be performed during the outbreak. Contact tracing shows 15 of 20 Ugandan illnesses originated in Congo-Kinshasa; Uganda has not reported new cases since June 22. Although the hospitalized patient has left, formal virological clearance cannot be declared until 42 days after exposure, per international guidelines.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダの最後のエボラ患者が退院
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で2073症例・796死亡と拡大が続く大規模エボラ流行であり、既にウガンダへの越境伝播も確認されているため、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、DRCのみをverified_locationsに記載。コンゴ・キンシャサ地域での流行悪化、医療従事者・患者への攻撃、社会不安の発生など懸念要素多数。

article.articleHeadline: Bidar | ರೋಗವಾಹಕ ಆಶ್ರಿತ ರೋಗಗಳ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಿಸಲು ಕಾರ್ಯನಿರ್ವಹಿಸಿ : ಡಿಸಿ ಶಿಲ್ಪಾ ಶರ್ಮಾ ಸೂಚನೆ | Bidar | Work to control vector-borne diseases: DC Shilpa Sharma's directive
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bidar | Work to control vector-borne diseases: DC Shilpa Sharma's directive
article.articleSummary: Bidar district, Karnataka, aims to eliminate malaria, dengue, chikungunya, lymphatic filariasis (elephantiasis), encephalitis and Zika virus by 2027. District Collector Shilpa Sharma directed all departments to coordinate to curb vector-borne diseases through aggressive containment. At a progress review of the National Vector-Borne Disease Control Programme and interdepartmental committee, she ordered weekly larvicidal spraying in urban and rural areas and sanitation to prevent standing water in public spaces. In villages, close pits and drains to prevent stagnation; keep wells and public hand-pumps protected; ensure drainage systems. Drinking-water tanks must be sealed and chlorinated before supply. Anganwadi workers to go house-to-house for awareness; Education Dept to run school programs; Transport Dept to prevent standing water in bus depots and tyres. Fourteen ICU centers; HIV testing at all PHCs. Infected patients to seek care at BRIMS Hospital's Integrated Consultation Center.

triage.headline_ja: ビダール地区 | ベクター媒介疾患の抑制に向けた取り組み：シルパ・シャルマ地区長官の指示
triage.triage_reason: 特定の異常な集団発生を報告する内容ではなく、通常の行政的な予防・対策プログラムに関する記事であるため。
triage.notes: 地方行政による定期的なベクター媒介疾患対策プログラムの実施報告であり、具体的な症例数や異常な発生状況の記載はない。2027年までの排除目標に向けたルーチンの予防活動。

article.articleHeadline: 广西筹措多笔资金支持疾控建设 健全传染病防控体系
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Guangxi mobilizes multiple funds to support the construction of disease prevention and control, strengthening the infectious disease prevention and control system.
article.articleSummary: Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region (China) mobilized funds to strengthen its infectious disease prevention and control system. Since 2026, the Finance Department has mobilized central funds totaling 906 million yuan to expand the National Immunization Program, HIV/AIDS, tuberculosis (TB) control, schistosomiasis control, and monitoring of major infectious diseases and health hazards. Investments for HIV/AIDS, TB, and immunization exceed 80%. AIDS infection remains at a low endemic level; schistosomiasis elimination is maintained; immunization coverage among eligible children is above 96%. Guangxi also piloted liver fluke control with an initial 5 pilot zones in 2025; an additional 6 counties/districts were added to broaden impact. Central infrastructure funding of 65.5 million yuan supports standardization of the Chongzuo and Hezhou Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. Since 2026, 112 million yuan has been allocated to strengthen early warning and response, including deploying pre-loaded software to grassroots clinics. The region has 286 infectious disease emergency teams and 100% reporting; training exceeds 600 professionals, including Vietnamese trainees, to boost cross-border capacity.

triage.headline_ja: 広西チワン族自治区、複数の資金を調達し疾病予防管理体制の構築を支援、感染症予防管理システムを強化
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は広西における疾病予防管理体制強化のための資金調達に関する行政報告であり、新規の異常な感染症発生や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はエイズ・結核・住血吸虫症などの既存の感染症対策プログラムへの予算配分と体制強化に関する行政ニュースであり、新規のアウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではない。エイズは低流行水準を維持、住血吸虫症は排除状態維持と記載されている。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع إصابات إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية إلى أكثر من ألفي حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo rise to more than 2,000 cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have reached 2,073 confirmed cases and 796 deaths as of July 14, according to the DRC health authorities. The outbreak, centered in central Africa, is driven by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare strain, ongoing since mid-May. Containment remains challenging, with contact tracing covering only about 76% of those exposed. The World Health Organization cautions that the true number of infections may be at least double the official tally. The report highlights continued efforts to curb transmission amid operational hurdles, underscoring the persistent risk and the need for sustained surveillance and response in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ感染者数が2000人超に増加
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（2,073例、796人死亡）で致死率が高く、接触者追跡が不完全なため国際的拡大リスクがあり、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: WHOは実際の感染者数が公式発表の2倍以上の可能性があると警告しており、接触者追跡率も76%と不十分。バンディブギョ株という稀な株が原因で、5月中旬から継続中のアウトブレイク。

article.articleHeadline: Telangana drone trial speeds up TB testing
article.articleSummary: TB in Telangana, India: ICMR’s i-DRONE drone-assisted transport of sputum samples in Yadadri Bhuvanagiri district enrolled 840 participants. Median TB diagnostic turnaround time fell from 15 days to 5 days after drone integration, enabling earlier confirmation and faster clinical decision-making. Sputum samples were collected at nearby PHCs and sub-centres and flown to designated TB diagnostic laboratories via a hub-and-spoke network of 11 PHCs, 60 sub-centres and four TB Units. Out-of-pocket expenditure dropped from about Rs 9,451 to Rs 91, with median OOPE during drone operation at zero, reflecting reduced travel costs and wage loss. Drone transport reduced delays and improved operational efficiency, and was well accepted by communities. Operational considerations include weather, payload limits, and training needs, underscoring planning requirements for wider rollout to bridge geographical barriers in TB elimination efforts.

triage.headline_ja: テランガナ州でのドローン試験がTB検査を迅速化
triage.triage_reason: 既存の結核対策プログラムにおける診断搬送の効率化に関する技術導入報告であり、新規の異常な公衆衛生事象ではないため。
triage.notes: 既存の結核（TB）対策プログラムの一環としてのドローン活用による検体輸送効率化に関する報告で、感染症アウトブレイクや異常事象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza coloca BH em alerta de saúde
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza puts Belo Horizonte on a health alert.
article.articleSummary: Belo Horizonte, Brazil, faces a health alert as July brings a surge in respiratory visits, driven largely by influenza. About 29,000 adult consultations occurred through July 13, with 2026 Jan–Jul totals around 356,000 respiratory visits at BH health centers and UPAs (vs 446,000 in the same period in 2025). Capacity remains adequate; no new beds opened. Experts note influenza tends to be more severe than colds; RSV can mimic milder illness early on. Vaccination remains the main defense: BH’s flu vaccination coverage is 59%, below the WHO target of 90%, though nearly 700,000 doses have been administered since April and vaccination expanded to all ages in May. BH highlights strong performance among Southeast capitals. Actions include home visits, school interventions, and care for long-term care facilities; vaccines available at 154 health centers and Sasv. Minas Gerais records 947 SRAG deaths by July 15, 2026 (~53.9% of 2025 total); BH reports 243 SRAG deaths in 2026, 195 among those over 60. RSV vaccines for pregnant women and a monoclonal antibody for high‑risk under‑2s are being used to prevent bronchiolitis.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザによりベロオリゾンテが健康警戒態勢に
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ・RSVによる呼吸器疾患の増加は例年見られる季節性流行であり、医療キャパシティも十分と報告されているため、異常性・国際的拡大リスクは低いと判断。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ・RSVの流行に関するローカルニュース。死亡者数の報告はあるが、前年同期比では呼吸器受診数はむしろ減少（446,000→356,000）しており、医療体制も逼迫していない。ワクチン接種率が目標に届いていない点は課題として言及されているが、地域レベルの通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de Ébola de crescimento mais rápido da história está cada vez mais difícil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in history is becoming increasingly difficult.
article.articleSummary: More than 2,000 Ebola cases and over 750 deaths are confirmed in eastern Congo, marking the fastest-growing outbreak in history. The Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain is responsible, with no approved vaccines. Suspected cases are reported in two provinces, including Kisangani, and about 80% of new infections stem from unknown transmission chains. The epicenter is Ituri, where attacks on health centers and unpaid-work strikes hinder response; parts of the outbreak are reaching Goma, a major humanitarian hub. Transmission occurs via contact with bodily fluids and contaminated surfaces; symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, muscle pain, and sometimes hemorrhage. A clinical trial at an Ituri Ebola treatment center compares remdesivir and MBP134 (an experimental antibody therapy) against standard care, randomized across four arms, potentially enrolling up to 1,000 participants; expansion to additional sites depends on safety and logistics.

triage.headline_ja: 史上最速で拡大するエボラ出血熱の流行、対応がますます困難に
triage.triage_reason: 2,000人超の症例、750人超の死亡が確認され、承認ワクチンのないブンディブギョ株による史上最速の流行拡大、伝播経路不明の感染が8割を占めるなど深刻かつ異常な事態であり、国際的関心・支援の必要性も高い。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株によるコンゴ東部（イトゥリ、キサンガニ含む2州）の流行。承認ワクチンなし、伝播経路不明の症例が多数、医療施設への攻撃・ストライキが対応を阻害。人道拠点ゴマへの拡大も懸念される。
