article.articleHeadline: ഡി.ആർ. കോംഗോയിലെ എബോള വ്യാപനം, രോഗികളുടെ നിരക്ക് 20,11 ആയി, ആരോഗ്യപ്രവർത്തകർ സമരത്തിൽ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo, case rate at 20.11, health workers on strike
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo has risen to 20,11 cases with 754 deaths as of July 16, 2026. The World Health Organization says over 100 health workers have been infected since the outbreak began, and 67% of contacts have been traced. In Bunia General Hospital, health workers began a salary strike; in the Ruwa mpare area of Ituri, hundreds protested unpaid salaries and bonuses, resuming after the government promised payment within 72 hours. Transmission is rapid, with challenges from funding shortages, attacks on health centers, and ongoing eastern Congo conflict. A vaccine trial targeting the Bundibugyo Ebola strain has started in humans, led by Oxford University and the Serum Institute of India. Context: 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak infected over 28,600; Congo last reported Ebola in August last year with 34 deaths; 2018–2020 outbreak killed about 2,300. Transmission via blood/bodily fluids; animal reservoirs exist; prevention emphasizes safe handling, isolation, and rapid supportive care.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴでエボラ拡大、症例数2,011人に、医療従事者がストライキ
triage.triage_reason: DRコンゴでのエボラ流行が2,011症例・754死亡に達し、医療従事者感染や紛争地域での対応困難など複数のIHR基準に該当するため。
triage.notes: 英国・インド・アンゴラは発生地域として付与されているが、記事本文ではインドはワクチン開発機関（Serum Institute of India）としての言及のみで、実際の発生国はDRコンゴのみ。医療従事者のストライキ・資金不足・武装勢力による医療施設攻撃など管理上の重大な課題が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Aumentan casos de dengue en varios destinos turísticos del país por vacaciones de mitad de año
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue cases rise in several of the country’s tourist destinations due to mid-year holidays.
article.articleSummary: July 16, 2026 update from Colombia reports 52,518 dengue cases in 2026 as of June 20, with 31,733 cases without warning signs, 20,241 with warning signs, and 544 classified as severe dengue. In the latest week, 2,778 new cases and 30 deaths were reported; 43 deaths are under investigation. Dengue transmission remains elevated in heavily visited tourist regions, with 61.1% of 2026 cases in Meta, Cesar, Bolívar, Santander, Norte de Santander, Magdalena, La Guajira, and Cartagena. Amazonas, Arauca, Atlántico, Barranquilla, Casanare, Guaviare, Magdalena, Meta, and Santa Marta also above transmission limits. Health experts warn that travel increases exposure to Aedes aegypti. Preventive measures after return include using repellent, long sleeves, eliminating standing water, nets, and seeking medical care for fever, headache, muscle pain, nausea, vomiting, or malaise.

triage.headline_ja: 年央休暇によりコロンビアの観光地でデング熱症例が増加
triage.triage_reason: コロンビア国内のデング熱流行に関する記事であり、対象国リストに該当する国（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）は主題となっていないため見送り。
triage.notes: 記事はコロンビア国内(Meta, Cesar, Bolívar, Cartagena等)の季節性デング熱流行を報告しているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Americans in DRC will no longer be able to fly directly to US amid Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) remains ongoing with more than 2,000 cases and 750 deaths, the third-largest outbreak on record. CDC and DHS implement a Do Not Board process for Americans in the DRC: departing individuals will return to the United States only after 21 days, and a Do Not Board list blocks boarding passes for any flight into, out of, or within the United States. Previously, only non-citizens were barred and American travelers were screened at select airports. A second American infected with Ebola in the DRC has been transferred to Germany for care, with an unnamed humanitarian aid worker among the cases. The first American patient, Dr. Peter Stafford, was discharged in June and his family has returned to the United States.

triage.headline_ja: DRCのアメリカ人、エボラ出血熱流行の中で米国への直行便搭乗ができなくなる
triage.triage_reason: DRCで2,000例以上・死亡750人超という史上第3位規模のエボラ流行が継続し、米国がDo Not Boardによる渡航制限を導入、感染者がドイツへ搬送されるなど国際的拡大が確認されているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 米国およびドイツは感染者の搬送・帰国先であり、発生地域としては対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。感染症の発生源はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: الكونجو الديمقراطية تعلن ارتفاع عدد الإصابات بفيروس إيبولا إلى 2073
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo announces that Ebola virus infections have risen to 2,073.
article.articleSummary: As of July 14, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo's Centers for Disease Control and Prevention reported 2,073 confirmed Ebola cases and 796 deaths. The outbreak has persisted since May 15 and is linked to the Bundibugyo strain. Contact tracing remains a major challenge, with 76% of exposed individuals being tracked. The World Health Organization estimates the true infection count is likely at least double the official figure, underscoring underdetection. The report notes ongoing surveillance and response efforts in central Africa, reflecting the persistent public health burden of Ebola in the DRC through mid-July 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラウイルス感染者数が2,073人に増加したと発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイクで死者796人、致死率が高く、IHR基準の複数該当およびWPRO基準の該当が確認されるためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: WHOは公式報告数の少なくとも2倍の実際の感染者数を推定しており、過小報告が懸念される。コンタクトトレーシングも76%にとどまり、感染拡大継続のリスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Oeganda ontslaat laatst bekende ebolapatiënt uit ziekenhuis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda discharges the last known Ebola patient from hospital.
article.articleSummary: Uganda has discharged the last known Ebola patient from hospital; the Congolese national has fully recovered and is set to return to his family. Ebola, which can be fatal, remains under close watch in East Africa. Uganda has not reported any new infections since June 22. Since mid-May, the country has confirmed 20 infections with the rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant, with most cases linked to the Democratic Republic of the Congo, which is facing a large outbreak with nearly 2,300 confirmed infections. The Ugandan Ministry of Health announced the discharge today. The episode underscores cross-border transmission dynamics between Uganda and the DRC, while signaling progress in Uganda's outbreak response as of July 16, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、最後の既知エボラ患者を退院させる
triage.triage_reason: DRCで約2,300例確認の大規模エボラ流行が継続しており、稀な変異株(Bundibugyo)による国境を越えたウガンダへの伝播が確認されているため、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダでの回復症例の退院を報じているが、DRCでの大規模流行(約2,300例)が背景にあり、国境を越えた伝播が続いている点が重要。ウガンダ・モザンビークは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: В ДР Конго от лихорадки Эбола умерли 796 человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, 796 people died of Ebola fever.
article.articleSummary: Ebola fever in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has resulted in 796 deaths among 2,073 confirmed cases as of July 16, 2026, per the World Health Organization. The outbreak is spreading more rapidly than the 2018–2019 surge, when about 2,000 cases accumulated in ten months. On May 17, WHO declared the Congo–Uganda Ebola outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, with regional risk assessed as high. WHO notes ongoing transmission and elevated cross-border risk to Uganda. The report underscores international concern amid cross-border dynamics and faster spread. Russian health official Onishchenko stated that Ebola will never become the cause of a new pandemic.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ熱により796人死亡
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言済みで、致死率が高く、国境を越えた感染拡大（ウガンダへ）が確認されているためフルRRAに進むべき事案。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生地域として挙げられているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ロシアは当局者のコメントのみで発生地域ではないため除外。2018-2019年の流行より速いペースで拡大している点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: " Elle se propage plus rapidement que toutes les épidémies précédentes " : la mise en garde de l'OMS sur la flambée d'Ebola en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: It is spreading faster than all previous epidemics: WHO warns about the Ebola outbreak in the DRC
article.articleSummary: Mid-May Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading faster than all previous Ebola epidemics, making it the third-largest on record. As of 2026-07-16, the outbreak has claimed 796 lives and surpassed 2,000 laboratory-confirmed cases in the DRC. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that transmission is accelerating more rapidly than in any prior outbreak, underscoring the ongoing crisis within the country. The rapid pace of spread over recent months indicates a major public health challenge with sustained transmission across multiple regions of the DRC. This marks one of the most severe Ebola events in recorded history.

triage.headline_ja: 「これまでのどの流行よりも速く拡大している」：WHOがコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行に警鐘
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱が史上3番目の規模に拡大し、致死者796人・確定症例2000人超と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、WHOも異例の速さでの拡大に警鐘を鳴らしているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長が過去最速の拡大速度と発言しており、国際的な支援・関心が既に高まっている状況。フルRRAへの移行が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Εξιτήριο για το τελευταίο επιβεβαιωμένο κρούσμα στην Ουγκάντα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: The last confirmed case in Uganda has been discharged.
article.articleSummary: Uganda recorded 20 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases, mainly among visitors from the Democratic Republic of Congo, and two deaths. The last patient hospitalized with Ebola has been discharged, leaving Uganda without any active confirmed cases. The outbreak, linked to Bundibugyo ebolavirus, was first confirmed in May when a man traveling from the DRC—the outbreak’s epicenter—sought medical care. Authorities emphasize early detection, isolation of suspected cases, and contact tracing to contain transmission, and the US has issued a travel advisory for nationals who visited the country. A 42-day countdown has begun toward an official declaration of Ebola-free status, contingent on no new cases. Congo has reported over 2,000 Ebola cases and 796 deaths; WHO notes the true case count could be much higher. Ebola is a virus attacking the immune system and organs, typically involving bats as reservoirs and spreading via bodily fluids such as blood.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ウガンダで最後の確定症例が退院
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国を震源とするエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクで2000人超の症例・796人の死者が報告されており、ウガンダへの越境拡大と米国の渡航勧告発出も確認されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダでの症例終息（エボラフリー宣言に向けた42日間のカウントダウン開始）を主に報じているが、震源地であるコンゴ民主共和国では2000人超の症例・796人の死亡が継続報告されており、対象国リストに含まれるDRCを主要発生国として扱った。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: El ébola avanza rápido en la República Democrática del Congo y ya es el tercer mayor brote registrado en la historia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is spreading rapidly in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and is already the third-largest outbreak in recorded history.
article.articleSummary: Ebola is spreading rapidly in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), now the third-largest outbreak on record. Officially, 2,073 cases and 796 deaths have been reported, two months after the government declared the epidemic. The epicenter is Ituri province, where transmission is intense and more than 80% of new infections occur outside known contact lists, signaling extensive community spread. About two-thirds of deaths are occurring within communities lacking access to care. Response capacity has expanded to over 800 treatment beds, 16 diagnostic laboratories (up from 1), and contact tracing near 80% effectiveness, with more than 21,000 community health workers trained. Trials include MBP134 monoclonal antibody and remdesivir; the ChAdOx1 vaccine began a safety trial, and obeldesivir is being tested for post-exposure prophylaxis. In Uganda, the last patient recovered, initiating a 42-day countdown to declaring the outbreak over there (20 cases, 2 deaths).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が急速に拡大、史上3番目に大きな流行に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上3番目規模のエボラ流行が進行中で、症例2,073件・死者796人、地域社会内感染が80%超と拡大が続いており、国際的関与（ワクチン・治療薬治験）も進んでいるためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの感染拡大が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。感染は主にDRCイトゥリ州が中心。

article.articleHeadline: PMCH sets up 20-bed dengue ward as govt intensifies prevention campaign
article.articleSummary: Patna Medical College and Hospital (PMCH) in Patna, Bihar, has opened a dedicated 20-bed dengue ward in the Rajendra Surgical Block to preempt a seasonal rise in cases. The isolation ward includes insecticide-treated nets and a round‑the‑clock care team, with strengthened diagnostics at the radiology building for faster screening. The Bihar health department has intensified dengue and chikungunya prevention via expanded surveillance, testing, and vector-control, deploying 318 fogging machines districtwide. Stocks of diagnostic kits have been supplied to district hospitals and government medical colleges, and entomological surveillance in vulnerable areas has been stepped up to identify breeding sites. July is observed as Anti-Dengue Month with a statewide awareness drive. Health minister Nishant Kumar chaired a review directing district administrations and medical colleges to stay prepared for outbreaks, ensure medicines and testing kits, and maintain strict monsoon surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: PMCH、政府の予防対策強化に伴い20床のデング熱病棟を新設
triage.triage_reason: 季節性デング熱・チクングニアに対する予防的な準備態勢強化の報道であり、現時点で異常な流行や重症患者急増の報告はないが、モンスーン期の流行しやすさから経過観察対象とする。
triage.notes: この記事は季節性の予防的準備態勢に関する報道であり、実際の症例数急増や異常な流行は報告されていない。ビハール州政府が事前対応として病棟開設、フォギング、サーベイランス強化を実施している段階。

article.articleHeadline: Pesquisa de biomédica angolana desenvolve biomarcadores que podem identificar a malária precocemente
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An Angolan biomedical researcher develops biomarkers that can identify malaria early.
article.articleSummary: Malaria biomarkers identified in Angola may enable early identification of patients at higher risk of complications. Angolan biomedical researcher Teresa Luzembo, who recently completed a master’s study at the Faculdade de Medicina de Ribeirão Preto (FMRP) of the University of São Paulo, investigated serum nanoparticle profiles and their relation to ABO blood groups, sex, and gestational status. Analyzing serum from malaria patients and healthy controls, the study measured the quantity, size, and physicochemical characteristics of serum nanoparticles—tiny structures that act as biological messengers. Results show nanoparticle profiles differ among groups and may correlate with ABO type, suggesting ABO blood type may confer protection against severe malaria forms. The findings promise a valuable tool for the Angolan health system in managing malaria.

triage.headline_ja: アンゴラの生物医学研究者、マラリアを早期に特定できるバイオマーカーを開発
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は研究成果（バイオマーカー開発）の報告であり、実際の感染症発生や公衆衛生上の異常事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 研究はブラジル（サンパウロ大学）で実施され、対象疾患はアンゴラのマラリアだが、アンゴラ・ブラジルともに対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空。実際の感染症発生イベントではなく学術研究報告のためDISMISS。

article.articleHeadline: Why more children are at risk of Hepatitis A despite better hygiene: What parents need to know
article.articleSummary: More than 50% of children aged 1–5 years in India remain vulnerable to Hepatitis A as improved sanitation reduces early exposure, making timely vaccination crucial. Hepatitis A is a viral liver infection spread mainly via contaminated food or water or close contact. Infected children under 6 often have no symptoms; when present, symptoms typically appear 2–6 weeks post-infection and include fever, fatigue, pale stools and dark urine. Most children recover with hydration, nutrition and rest, but relapse can occur for up to 6 months and may require hospitalization in rare cases. The epidemiological shift toward later childhood or adolescence can yield more severe illness, underscoring vaccination as a key prevention strategy. Vaccination is recommended starting at 12 months, with a second dose at 18–19 months to protect before school exposure. Emphasize hand hygiene and vaccination as complementary protections, and advise vigilance for fatigue, loss of appetite, stomach pain or jaundice after local outbreaks in urban and semi-urban India.

triage.headline_ja: 衛生環境の改善にもかかわらず、なぜより多くの子供がA型肝炎のリスクにさらされているのか：保護者が知っておくべきこと
triage.triage_reason: 特定の集団感染やアウトブレイクの報告ではなく、A型肝炎の疫学的傾向とワクチン接種の重要性を説明する一般的な健康啓発記事であるため。
triage.notes: 記事は具体的なアウトブレイクの報告ではなく、インドにおけるA型肝炎の疫学的シフトとワクチン接種推奨に関する一般的な健康情報記事のため、対象国リストへの計上は見送り。

article.articleHeadline: 世卫组织：刚果（金）埃博拉疫情已致796人死亡
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has killed 796 people.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has caused 796 deaths as of July 16, 2026. The World Health Organization reports the outbreak spreading faster than past epidemics, with about two-thirds of cases occurring in areas lacking specialized treatment facilities. Transmission chains remain undiscovered in parts of the country. Over 21,000 community health workers have been trained to support control efforts, and progress in Ebola vaccine development and deployment is noted. Ongoing armed conflict severely hampers access for health workers and some treatment centers have been attacked. The WHO emphasizes strengthening patient care and ensuring safe, dignified burials as immediate priorities amid the continuing outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行で796人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（死者796人）で、過去の流行より速い拡大、治療未整備地域や武力紛争による対応困難がありIHR基準に複数該当するためフルRRAへ。
triage.notes: WHOが過去の流行より速い拡大を指摘し、武力紛争による医療アクセス制限・治療施設への攻撃も報告されており、国際的な支援・監視が必要な深刻な事案。

article.articleHeadline: В Уганде выписали последнего пациента с лихорадкой Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Uganda, the last patient with Ebola fever was discharged.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 July 2026, Uganda’s Ebola virus disease outbreak ends with the discharge of the last confirmed patient, starting a 42-day surveillance period after which the outbreak will be formally declared finished. The Uganda outbreak totaled 20 cases with 2 deaths. The World Health Organization confirmed the discharge and noted the countdown begins at that moment. On 17 May, WHO declared the Congo and Uganda Ebola outbreaks a public health emergency of international concern, citing a high regional risk of spread. The report marks a milestone in the regional Ebola response and emphasizes ongoing vigilance to prevent future transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダでエボラ熱の最後の患者が退院
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダのエボラ流行終息（最終患者退院、42日間のサーベイランス開始）を報じる内容であり新規発生ではないが、コンゴ（DRC）の並行流行やサーベイランス期間終了確認のため継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主対象はウガンダの流行終息だが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCはWHOにより同時にPHEIC対象とされた流行地として言及されているため verified_locations に含めた。42日間のサーベイランス期間終了（正式な流行終息宣言）を要フォロー。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Ebola spreder sig hurtigere i DR Congo end tidligere udbrud
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Ebola is spreading faster in DR Congo than in previous outbreaks.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 July 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo is experiencing an Ebola outbreak driven by the Bundibugyo variant. More than 2,000 cases have been reported since the outbreak was declared on 15 May, with 796 deaths. The World Health Organization warns that this outbreak is spreading faster than any previous Ebola outbreak. The Bundibugyo strain is described as rare and is fueling transmission across the country. Ebola typically causes severe fever and can progress to uncontrolled bleeding, often with fatal outcome. The virus spreads through close contact with the bodily fluids of infected people. No further details on laboratory confirmation or import/export are provided in the report. The current outbreak ranks as the third-largest on record.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:コンゴ民主共和国でエボラが過去の流行より速く拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで2000例以上・死者796人と大規模化し、WHOが過去最速の拡大と警告しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大な公衆衛生事象である。
triage.notes: 致死率は約39.8%（796/2000）と高く、稀なブンディブギョ株による全国的拡大が指摘されている。史上3番目の規模の流行として報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola spreading in DRC 'faster than any previous outbreak': WHO chief
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is spreading faster than any previous outbreak. By July 16, 2026, authorities confirmed more than 2,000 Ebola cases and 796 deaths since the outbreak was declared on May 15, making it the third-largest Ebola outbreak on record. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that in the past month the outbreak expanded faster than ever before. The report notes ongoing transmission within DR Congo but does not specify the infection source or any imported/exported cases. The information underscores the urgent need for intensified surveillance and rapid public health response as the outbreak persists.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、DRCで『過去最速』の拡大速度を記録:WHO事務局長
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで史上最速のペースで拡大し、2000例以上・796人の死亡が確認されており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長による公式声明を含み、過去最大級のエボラ流行として国際的注目度が高い。感染源や越境事例の詳細は記事内で不明。

article.articleHeadline: أوغندا تعلن خروج آخر مصاب بإيبولا من المستشفى
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda announces the discharge of the last Ebola patient from the hospital.
article.articleSummary: Uganda declared the Ebola outbreak contained after discharging the last patient from hospital, signaling successful containment of a spillover from neighboring Democratic Republic of Congo. Uganda now aims to complete 42 days without new cases—the WHO guideline representing two full incubation periods—to be declared Ebola-free. Across the border, the DRC has reported over 2,000 infections and 754 deaths, with WHO cautioning the true total could be 2–4 times higher. Uganda recorded only 20 infections and 2 deaths, mostly Congolese cross-border arrivals; hundreds of contacts were isolated for 21 days and released. Authorities remain vigilant and plan stronger cross-border interventions to limit transmission. The response has been praised as among the fastest Ebola outbreak responses by regional health officials. For the Bundibugyo strain, no vaccine or treatment exists yet, though the first antiviral clinical trial began recently.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、最後のエボラ患者の退院を発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCで2,000人超の感染・754人の死亡という大規模なエボラアウトブレイクが継続しており、国境を越えたウガンダへの飛び火も発生していることから、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダ側の封じ込め成功を報じているが、発生源であるDRCでは大規模な感染・死亡が継続しており、対象国リストに含まれるDRCを主要な発生地域として評価した。ウガンダ（Republic of Uganda）は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。Bundibugyo株にはワクチン・治療薬が未確立で、抗ウイルス薬の臨床試験が開始されたばかりという情報あり。

article.articleHeadline: مرضى فيروس إيبولا يفرّون من مستشفى في الكونغو بعد هجوم
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus patients flee from a hospital in Congo after an attack.
article.articleSummary: An attack by an angry crowd at Nyakondi Hospital in Ituri province, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, forced Ebola patients and emergency staff to flee. Up to 10 Ebola patients receiving care escaped after the perimeter was breached and the power generator failed, leaving the facility without electricity. A woman who had come to the hospital for delivery died around 3:00 pm from severe anemia; relatives offered blood donation, but transfusions are prohibited during Ebola outbreaks. The incident highlights persistent challenges in outbreak response in eastern DRC, including distrust of medical teams, community resistance, and insecurity, which disrupt treatment, isolation, and containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでの襲撃事件後、エボラ患者が病院から逃走
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱患者の逃走により隔離・治療体制が崩壊し、感染拡大リスクが高まっている。加えて治安不安と地域社会の不信が対応を妨げており、国際的関心・支援の必要性が高い。
triage.notes: 隔離患者の逃走により感染連鎖の追跡が困難になる可能性が高く、コミュニティの不信・治安悪化が対応の障害となっている。続報でエボラ拡大の有無を要確認。

article.articleHeadline: WHO "콩고서 에볼라 빠르게 확산"···약 800명 사망
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Ebola Spreading Rapidly in the Democratic Republic of the Congo ... About 800 Dead.
article.articleSummary: Over 2,000 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 796 deaths have been recorded in the Democratic Republic of the Congo since the outbreak was declared on May 15, according to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. He described the outbreak as the third-largest in history and warned that transmission has accelerated, with the last month showing faster spread than any previous outbreak. AFP reported these figures on July 16, underscoring ongoing transmission within the DRC and illustrating the scale of the current outbreak as of July 16.

triage.headline_ja: WHO「コンゴでエボラが急速に拡大」…約800人死亡
triage.triage_reason: WHO事務局長が史上3番目の規模の流行と警告し、感染者2,000人超・死者796人、拡大加速中であり、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長による公式声明であり信頼性が高い。史上3番目の規模かつ拡大加速中との警告があり、フルRRAへの移行が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Chefe da OMS diz que surto de Ebola no Congo é o 'mais rápido da história' | Jovem Pan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO chief says Ebola outbreak in Congo is the fastest in history | Jovem Pan
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading faster than any previous outbreak, according to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. Since its May 15 declaration, more than 2,000 cases have been confirmed with deaths rising to 796, making it the third-largest Ebola outbreak on record. Congolese health authorities reported on July 15 over 2,000 cases and 754 deaths. The outbreak is expanding into new areas at an unprecedented pace, with Doctors Without Borders calling for urgent reinforcement of the response. In under five weeks, confirmed cases nearly tripled and deaths nearly quintupled. WHO notes about 80% of new cases are not on known contact lists and originate from unknown transmission chains, complicating containment.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、コンゴのエボラ流行は「史上最速」と発言
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱が史上最速のペースで拡大し、死者数も急増しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当するため。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長が『史上最速の流行』と明言し、国境なき医師団も緊急支援強化を要請。感染経路不明の症例が80%を占め、封じ込めが困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: RD Congo : l'OMS annonce le premier essai clinique contre le variant Bundibugyo d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: WHO announces the first clinical trial against the Bundibugyo Ebola virus variant
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus variant outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), epicenter in the Ituri region of the northeast, with Bunia and Rwampara concentrating about 90% of confirmed cases. More than 2,000 cases have been confirmed across five provinces, with 754 deaths; Uganda reports 20 cases and 2 deaths. The outbreak is among the largest Bundibugyo events on record and appears more contagious than Zaïre and Sudan strains, though with about 25% fatality. The WHO announced the first clinical trial of a treatment for Bundibugyo: Obeldevisir (EBO-PEP), an oral antiviral for post-exposure prophylaxis to roughly 1,000 high-risk contacts aged 12+, enrolled near Ebola treatment centers run by ALIMA and MSF. Daily follow-up for 21 days, final visit at 42 days; a sub-protocol covers under-12s and pregnant or lactating women. Separately, the PARTNERS trial in Ituri evaluates MBP134 monoclonal antibodies and Remdesivir, while the UK approves a Phase 1 Oxford vaccine trial for Bundibugyo.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:WHOがエボラ出血熱ブンディブギョ変異株に対する初の臨床試験を発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCで2000例超・死亡754人という大規模なブンディブギョ型エボラ流行がウガンダにも拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも20例・2死亡が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。WHO・MSF・ALIMA・英国オックスフォード大学等による国際的な治療・ワクチン開発が進行中であり、既に国際支援が動いている状況。

article.articleHeadline: Research News ; ਡ੍ਰੋਨ ਰਾਹੀਂ ਟੀਬੀ ਦੇ ਸੈਂਪਲ ਭੇਜਣ 'ਤੇ ਜਾਂਚ ਦੇ ਸਮੇਂ ਤੇ ਮਰੀਜ਼ਾਂ ਦੇ ਖ਼ਰਚੇ 'ਚ ਆਵੇਗੀ ਭਾਰੀ ਕਮੀ - Research News Sending TB samples via drone will drastically reduce testing time and patient costs
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sending TB samples via drone will drastically reduce testing time and patients' costs.
article.articleSummary: As of July 16, 2026, the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR), under its 'I-Drone' initiative, evaluated a drone-based system in Telangana's Yadadri-Bhuvanagiri district to move sputum samples from primary health centers and sub-centers to TB laboratories. The study enrolled 840 participants. Central Health Ministry officials noted that, after initiating drone transport, the average TB diagnostic turnaround fell from 15 days to 5 days, enabling faster diagnosis and treatment initiation. Economically, patient costs dropped dramatically—from about ₹9,451 using conventional methods to roughly ₹91 with the drone-based phase—driven by reduced travel costs, less lost work time, and having sample collection near patients' homes. The report highlights potential for lowered time-to-diagnosis and patient burden through drone-assisted TB sample transport; findings reported by ICMR and MoHFW.

triage.headline_ja: ドローンによるTBサンプル輸送で検査時間と患者負担が大幅減少
triage.triage_reason: これは結核診断の物流改善に関する研究報告であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や新規アウトブレイクを示すものではない。
triage.notes: 既知の疾患（結核）に対する診断・輸送システムの効率化に関する研究報告であり、新規感染症イベントやアウトブレイクではないため対象国に該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Pemkot Jaksel libatkan camat dan lurah dalam pengendalian rabies
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: South Jakarta City Government involves sub-district heads and urban village heads in rabies control.
article.articleSummary: Rabies control efforts in South Jakarta involve sub-district heads (camat) and urban village heads (lurah) to accelerate vaccination of rabies-transmitting animals (HPR). Mayor Syafrin Liputo calls for widespread socialization to inform residents early and help them plan pet care. Officials urge inventories of both stray and owned rabies-carrying animals to foster a healthier environment. The Jakarta KPKP Service (Dinas Ketahanan Pangan, Kelautan, dan Pertanian) reports free rabies vaccination ongoing through outreach and posts at RPTRA and Balai RW. Target: vaccinate about 10,200 HPR in South Jakarta, including dogs, cats, monkeys, and civets. The program also aims to sterilize 2,500 stray cats in 2026 to control the urban cat population and address community complaints.

triage.headline_ja: 南ジャカルタ市政府、狂犬病対策に郡長・村長を関与させる
triage.triage_reason: 南ジャカルタにおける通常の狂犬病予防接種・不妊手術プログラムの行政運営に関する記事であり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は狂犬病媒介動物（HPR）へのワクチン接種と野良猫の不妊手術という平時の予防プログラムについての内容であり、症例数や死亡者数など具体的な流行状況の記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: 哈工大调查450名感染艾滋病人士，发现：患艾滋病的人，有4大共性_手机网易网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Harbin Institute of Technology surveys 450 people infected with AIDS and finds that AIDS patients share four common characteristics.
article.articleSummary: Harbin Institute of Technology surveyed 450 people living with AIDS in Harbin, China, and identified four common characteristics. 1) Acquaintances are treated as safe; transmission occurs via bodily fluids regardless of relationship. 2) Post-exposure prophylaxis is treated as a backup, not primary protection; it is most effective within 72 hours of exposure, and missed doses reduce protection. 3) Health is judged by appearance; the HIV/AIDS window period can be up to three months, during which infection can be transmitted despite negative tests. 4) Testing is often delayed; more than 70% are diagnosed only 2–5 years after infection, allowing immune damage. Today ART can yield long life, but late treatment complicates care. Recommendations: maintain safe-sex measures, seek PEP within 72 hours, and use free anonymous testing at local CDCs with results in 10–15 minutes.

triage.headline_ja: ハルビン工業大学がHIV感染者450人を調査、感染者に共通する4つの特徴を発見
triage.triage_reason: これは新規アウトブレイクではなく、既知のHIV感染に関する啓発・教育目的の調査記事であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態には該当しない。
triage.notes: 既知の風土病(HIV)に関する啓発記事であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態を示す内容ではないため対象国に該当しても除外扱いとした。

article.articleHeadline: Mamba Water sofre recolhimento de lote por presença de bactéria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mamba Water recalls batch due to presence of bacteria.
article.articleSummary: On 16 July 2026, Brazil’s Anvisa suspended sale and consumption of two batches of 350 ml Mamba Water after tests detected Pseudomonas aeruginosa. The recall marks the third Brazilian case involving the same bacterium in a few months, following an April recall of over 100 Ypê cleaning-product lots and a June recall of Crystal water. Contamination was found in quality-control analyses conducted by the manufacturer, HNK BR Indústria de Bebidas Ltda, which voluntarily notified Anvisa. Affected batches are Lot 13 (produced 3 April 2026; best before 3 April 2027) and Lot 14 (produced 4 April 2026; best before 4 April 2027). Pseudomonas aeruginosa is an opportunistic pathogen; risk is highest for immunocompromised individuals—children, the elderly, cancer patients, transplant recipients, and those with uncontrolled HIV or on immunosuppressants—where infections can affect urinary tract, lungs, skin, or bloodstream. Brazil imposes zero tolerance for this bacterium in water, prompting immediate recall.

triage.headline_ja: マンバウォーター、細菌混入により一部ロットを回収
triage.triage_reason: 製品リコールであり、感染症の集団発生や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はなく、HIVはリスク因子として言及されているのみ。
triage.notes: 本記事は水製品の細菌汚染によるリコールに関するものであり、HIVは免疫不全リスク因子として言及されているに過ぎず、感染症発生事例ではない。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo's healthcare workers go on strike as Ebola epidemic spreads
article.articleSummary: Health workers in the Democratic Republic of Congo are going on strike over unpaid wages, amid an Ebola outbreak the World Health Organization says is spreading faster than in any previous outbreak. As of 16 July 2026, the DRC has recorded more than 2,000 Ebola cases and at least 754 deaths. The strike adds strain to outbreak response as authorities race to treat patients, trace contacts, and contain transmission across affected regions. The situation underscores the gravity of the epidemic in the DRC and the challenges facing frontline workers. WHO warnings about accelerated spread emphasize the urgency of funding and staffing to sustain surveillance and patient care.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国の医療従事者、エボラ流行拡大の中でストライキ実施
triage.triage_reason: WHOが過去最速のペースで拡大していると警告するエボラ流行(2000例超、754人死亡)に加え、医療従事者のストライキが対応能力を著しく損なっており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 医療従事者のストライキが感染対策・接触者追跡・患者治療能力を低下させるリスク要因として重要。WHOによる過去最速拡大の警告あり、国際支援の緊急性が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: ΠΟΥ: Η επιδημία Έμπολα στο Κονγκό εξαπλώνεται ταχύτερα από ποτέ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: The Ebola outbreak in Congo is spreading faster than ever.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization Chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, declared in mid-May, is spreading faster than all previous outbreaks, marking it as the third-largest on record. By July 16, 2026, the disease has caused 796 deaths and more than 2,000 confirmed cases in the DRC. The report characterizes the progression as rapid relative to recent outbreaks, indicating substantial transmission and ongoing containment challenges. The article does not provide details on affected cities, laboratory confirmation specifics, infection sources, or imported/exported cases beyond the cited counts. WHO continues to monitor and coordinate international response efforts. The article does not discuss vaccination efforts or travel advisories in the cited report.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：コンゴのエボラ流行、これまでで最も速いスピードで拡大
triage.triage_reason: WHO事務局長が過去最速の拡大速度と警告し、死者796人・症例2000人超と規模も大きく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: 致死率は約39.8%（796/2000）と高く、感染拡大速度が過去のアウトブレイクを上回るとされている点が特に懸念される。詳細な地理的分布やワクチン接種状況は不明であり、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: مرضى إيبولا وفرق الطوارئ يفرون من مستشفى في الكونغو بعد هجوم
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola patients and emergency teams flee from a hospital in the Democratic Republic of the Congo after an attack.
article.articleSummary: Nyankunde Hospital in Bunia, Ituri province, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, was attacked by an angry crowd on Wednesday, forcing Ebola patients and emergency staff to flee. A woman who had come to give birth died around 3 pm from severe anemia; relatives offered blood, but transfusions are prohibited during Ebola outbreaks. Up to 10 Ebola patients receiving treatment at the hospital fled, and the power generator stopped, leaving the facility without electricity. The incident underscores the difficulties of controlling Ebola in Ituri and eastern DRC, where distrust of medical teams, community resistance, and insecurity repeatedly hamper treatment and outbreak containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国の病院襲撃後、エボラ患者と緊急対応チームが逃走
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の治療施設が襲撃され、患者最大10名が未治療のまま地域社会に流出したため、感染拡大リスクと公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が認められる。
triage.notes: 病院襲撃により隔離治療が中断され、未治療のエボラ患者が地域社会に拡散した可能性が高く、感染拡大防止の観点から緊急のフォローアップが必要。

article.articleHeadline: InfoGripe: número de casos de VSR diminui, mas se mantém alto em muitos estados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: InfoGripe: the number of RSV cases decreases, but remains high in many states.
article.articleSummary: RSV cases are decreasing nationwide but remain high in many states. The latest InfoGripe bulletin (Week 27, 5–11 July) shows RSV-associated SRAG trending down in both the long (six weeks) and short (three weeks) terms, yet SRAG remains elevated in several states. Nationally, five states—Mato Grosso do Sul, Minas Gerais, Paraná, Santa Catarina, and Rio Grande do Sul—have SRAG at alert/risk/high risk with a long-term growth signal through week 27. Seventeen states also show alert/risk/high risk without long-term growth. RSV-related SRAG continues increasing in the Southern Region (Paraná, Rio Grande do Sul, Santa Catarina) plus Minas Gerais and Maranhão, while many other states stabilize or decline. Influenza A–related severe cases stay high in Minas Gerais, Paraná, and Roraima; influenza B–related severe cases rise in the Center-South but show slowing in Ceará, Goiás, Maranhão, Mato Grosso do Sul, Paraná, and São Paulo. Across Brazil, 115,203 SRAG cases this year, 60,200 lab-positive, 39,743 negative, 8,218 awaiting.

triage.headline_ja: InfoGripe：RSVの症例数は減少しているが、多くの州で依然として高水準を維持
triage.triage_reason: 季節性RSV・インフルエンザの通常のサーベイランス報告であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、複数州で重症急性呼吸器症候群（SRAG）が高水準に留まっており経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: InfoGripeによる定期的な季節性呼吸器感染症サーベイランス報告。RSVおよびインフルエンザA/Bによる重症急性呼吸器症候群（SRAG）が複数州で高水準だが、全国的には減少傾向にある通常の季節性疾患動向として評価。

article.articleHeadline: Προειδοποίηση ΠΟΥ για Έμπολα στη ΛΔ Κονγκό: "Εξαπλώνεται ταχύτερα σε σχέση με προηγούμενες επιδημίες"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warning about Ebola in DR Congo: "Spreading faster than previous outbreaks."
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is spreading faster than any previous outbreak, according to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. Declared in mid-May, the outbreak ranks as the third-largest on record and is advancing more rapidly in recent months. As of July 16, 2026, it has caused 796 deaths and surpassed 2,000 confirmed cases in the DR Congo. The WHO chief’s remarks highlight the unusually swift transmission and the growing public health challenge associated with this event. The article emphasizes the timeline and magnitude of the outbreak, noting the warning from WHO about accelerated spread relative to earlier outbreaks. This situation signals a critical level of concern for Ebola virus disease in the DR Congo.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱について警告：「過去の流行より速く拡大している」
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国で過去最速レベルで拡大し、796人死亡・2000人超の症例が確認されており、WHOも警告を発していることからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長自らが過去最速の拡大速度を指摘しており、致死率も高い（796死亡/2000症例超）。歴代3番目の規模となっており、国際的な支援・監視が急務と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: سكان يهاجمون مستشفى يعالج مرضى إيبولا في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Locals attack a hospital treating Ebola patients in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Locals attacked Nyakondi Hospital in Ituri Province, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, forcing the evacuation of Ebola patients and emergency staff after a mob hurled stones and damaged the perimeter wall. Francois Berukan Odéros, a clinical biologist at the facility, said relatives of a woman who died during childbirth were among the demonstrators; the patient died from severe anemia. Hospital officials had refused a blood transfusion because transfusions are prohibited during an Ebola outbreak. The assault came as up to 10 Ebola patients undergoing treatment at the hospital fled. Medical teams subsequently left, and the power generator stopped functioning, leaving the facility dark and patients unpowered. The incident highlights security and infection-control risks amid an ongoing Ebola outbreak in the region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの住民がエボラ患者を治療する病院を襲撃
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱のアウトブレイク下で病院が襲撃され、患者が逃走・治療体制が崩壊するという異常事態であり、感染拡大リスクと国際的懸念が高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にZimbabweが含まれているが、記事本文はDRCイトゥリ州の事案のみを主題としているため除外。エボラ患者が病院から逃走した点は感染拡大の観点から特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Число умерших от Эболы в ДР Конго достигло 796
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from Ebola in DR Congo has reached 796.
article.articleSummary: Lab-confirmed Ebola virus disease cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo have reached 2,073, with 796 deaths, according to local authorities cited by The Guardian. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain (Bundibugyo ebolavirus). The World Health Organization first declared the outbreak on May 17. WHO Emergency Programme Director Dr. Chikwe Ihekweazu warned that the true number of infections could be two to four times higher than official tallies, signaling underreporting in surveillance. The report emphasizes ongoing transmission in affected areas and the challenges of monitoring and responding to the outbreak. All figures cited refer to laboratory-confirmed cases, underscoring a substantial disease burden as health authorities intensify surveillance, contact tracing, and patient management in affected communities as of July 16, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ死者数が796人に達する
triage.triage_reason: 確定症例2,073件・死亡796人と規模が大きく、過小報告の懸念や継続的な感染拡大が指摘されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: WHOが2026年5月17日にアウトブレイク宣言済み。実際の感染者数は公式集計の2〜4倍の可能性があるとWHO幹部が警告しており、サーベイランス強化が急務。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in Uganda und DR Kongo: Letzter Ebola-Patient in Uganda aus Krankenhaus entlassen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Uganda and DR Congo: Last Ebola patient in Uganda discharged from hospital.
article.articleSummary: Uganda marks being Ebola-free after discharging the last patient, with a 42-day WHO countdown to certification. Uganda reported 20 total cases since May, all imported from neighboring Democratic Republic of Congo; 15 were Congolese and 5 Ugandan contacts, with two deaths. In the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), the outbreak has escalated: over 2,000 confirmed cases and more than 700 deaths, spanning multiple provinces, including Haut-Uélé near the South Sudan border and Tshopo near the Central African Republic. The virus is the Bundibugyo variant, with vaccines and therapies only recently developed. The WHO declared an international public health emergency in May. The region’s fragile health systems, ongoing conflict, and shortages hinder containment. Borders were closed by Uganda and Rwanda in June; several countries restrict entry from DRC. A U.S. doctor infected in DRC was treated in Frankfurt; international response prioritizes case finding and isolation.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダとコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：ウガンダの最後のエボラ患者が退院
triage.triage_reason: DRCでWHOがPHEICを宣言した大規模エボラ流行（2000例超・700人超死亡）が継続し、ウガンダへの越境感染や渡航制限も発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大事案。
triage.notes: ウガンダはエボラ終息宣言に向けた42日間のカウントダウン中だが対象国リストに含まれず除外。DRCではブンディブギョ株による大規模流行が継続し、周辺国（南スーダン、中央アフリカ共和国、ルワンダ）との国境地域にも拡大。米国人医師のフランクフルト治療例あり。

article.articleHeadline: Толпа закидала камнями больницу, где находились инфицированные Эболой
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The crowd stoned the hospital where Ebola-infected people were located.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri Province, began on May 15. As of July 16, 2026, there are 2,073 laboratory-confirmed cases and 796 deaths. In Ituri, a mob attacked a hospital treating Ebola patients, prompting staff and patients to flee; authorities are searching for those who escaped, with the exact number unknown. The attack followed the death of a laboring woman from severe anemia; relatives protested the medical team for not performing a blood transfusion, noting such procedures are prohibited during Ebola outbreaks. The incident underscores ongoing transmission risks and challenges to outbreak response in Ituri, while laboratory confirmation of cases continues and Ituri remains the epicenter.

triage.headline_ja: 群衆がエボラ感染者がいた病院に投石
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州で確認症例2,073人・死亡796人という大規模エボラ流行が継続中であり、暴徒による病院襲撃で患者・スタッフが逃走し感染拡大リスクが増大している。
triage.notes: 病院襲撃により感染者・接触者の追跡が困難になっている点は、アウトブレイク管理上の重大なリスク要因として注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: République démocratique du Congo | L'épidémie d'Ebola en RDC se propage " plus rapidement " que toutes les précédentes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo | The Ebola outbreak in the DRC is spreading faster than any previous ones.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak, declared two months ago, is spreading faster than any previous surge and constitutes the 17th outbreak in the country. In the northeast Ituri province, 2,003 cases and 796 deaths have been reported, making it the third-largest Ebola outbreak on record; the 2018–2020 outbreak reached about 2,300 deaths from 3,500 cases. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that more than 80% of new cases are detected outside known contact lists, signaling transmission chains escaping surveillance. Health capacity has increased to over 800 beds, 60 laboratories, and ~80% contact-tracing. No vaccine or treatment exists for the Bundibugyo variant yet, but trials cover MBP134, remdesivir, and a ChAdOx1 vaccine safety study; obeldesivir PEP trial also started. Uganda reports two deaths among 20 cases, now with zero active cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ出血熱の流行、過去のどの流行よりも「速く」拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大）に該当し、症例数・死者数が急増し監視網から外れた伝播が指摘されるなど、フルリスク評価が必要な重大シグナルである。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境例（2例・死亡2例、現在活動症例ゼロ）が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。エボラ・ブンディブギョ株に有効なワクチン・治療薬が未確立であり、監視網を逃れる伝播（新規症例の80%超が既知接触者リスト外）が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: 乌干达最后一名伊波拉患者出院 力争病例清零
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda's last Ebola patient discharged; aims for zero cases.
article.articleSummary: Uganda discharged its last Ebola patient on July 16, starting a 42-day countdown to declare the country Ebola-free under WHO guidelines. The patient, a Congolese citizen, recovered and was discharged from Mulago National Referral Hospital in Kampala, with a discharge certificate from the health minister. A WHO representative said the outbreak was controlled thanks to preparedness and vigilance, noting the Bundibugyo virus has had a relatively low case-fatality rate. Since mid-May, Uganda has reported 20 Bundibugyo Ebola cases, with 15 infections acquired after crossing from the DRC. As of June 22, Uganda has reported no new cases. In the DRC, 62 new cases were reported on Thursday, bringing the total to 2,073, though the WHO cautions that actual infections could be at least double. Public health activities were conducted at the Kpandba IDP Camp in Ituri Province’s Djugu District.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダで最後のエボラ患者退院、症例ゼロを目指す
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準に2項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク）し、DRCでは新規62例を含む累計2073例と継続的なアウトブレイクが確認されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダは症例ゼロに近づいているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは継続的なエボラアウトブレイク（Bundibugyo株、越境感染歴あり）が確認されており、WHOは実際の感染者数は報告の倍以上の可能性を指摘している点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: More than 80% of new Ebola cases in Congo detected outside contact lists: WHO
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak has reached 2,073 cases and 796 deaths as of 16 July 2026, with more than 80% of new infections detected outside known contact lists, indicating transmission chains are being missed. Ituri province remains the outbreak’s biggest concern, and about two-thirds of deaths occur in communities that never access health facilities. Declared two months ago, the outbreak is the third-largest on record and spreading faster than previous epidemics. Response measures include expanding laboratory capacity from one to 16 facilities, increasing treatment capacity to over 800 beds, and raising contact follow-up to nearly 80%. Vaccines and treatments are in trials, including the ChAdOx1 vaccine — first safety trial began Monday, monoclonal MBP134, remdesivir, and obeldesivir. So far 377 people recovered. A funding gap exceeds $400 million; armed conflict hinders access; Bunia treatment center was attacked yesterday. Uganda reports last confirmed case discharged today, 42-day countdown, 20 cases, 2 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでの新規エボラ症例の80%以上が接触者リスト外で検出：WHO
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行は史上3番目の規模で急速に拡大しており、新規症例の80%以上が既知の接触者リスト外で検出されるなど感染連鎖の把握が困難な状況。ウガンダへの越境例も報告され、国際的関心・支援ニーズも高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも症例（20例、死亡2例）が報告され42日間のカウントダウンが開始されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。資金不足（4億ドル超）、武装勢力による治療センター襲撃など対応上の重大な障壁が存在する。

article.articleHeadline: एम्स में चलाया गया डेंगू मुक्त सफाई अभियान
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: AIIMS Conducted a Dengue-Free Cleaning Drive
article.articleSummary: AIIMS campus in Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh, conducted a dengue-free hostel campaign featuring extensive cleanliness drives and public-awareness activities. A joint team from AIIMS, the health department, and the municipal corporation engaged with students and residents in hostels, residential complexes, and guest houses to explain dengue's causes, symptoms, and prevention. They stressed that the dengue mosquito breeds in clean, stagnant water and urged attendees to prevent waterlogging and ensure clean water storage. The drive aimed to curb mosquito-borne disease transmission through sanitation, water-management, and awareness on Thursday morning as part of the ongoing dengue-free hostel program. The event underscored ongoing efforts to reduce dengue risk in educational settings in Gorakhpur.

triage.headline_ja: AIIMSでデング熱撲滅清掃キャンペーンが実施される
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の予防啓発・清掃活動に関する日常的な公衆衛生キャンペーンの報道であり、感染拡大や異常事態を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は特定の症例数や流行状況ではなく、予防啓発キャンペーンの実施報告に過ぎない。デング熱は対象疾患ではあるが、本記事の内容は通常の公衆衛生活動であり、シグナルとしての緊急性はない。

article.articleHeadline: Anvisa Recolhe Dois Lotes da Água Mamba Water após Detectar Bactéria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anvisa recalls two batches of Mamba Water after detecting bacteria.
article.articleSummary: Brazil's Anvisa recalls two batches of Mamba Water still mineral water after detecting Pseudomonas aeruginosa in internal quality controls. The 350 ml cans, batches 13 and 14, were produced on April 3–4, 2026 and expire April 2027. The agency suspended sale, distribution and use of these lots and ordered corrective actions by the manufacturer, HNK BR Indústria de Bebidas Ltda., following voluntary notification. This marks the third such recall in Brazil in months, after more than 100 Ypê lots were found contaminated in April and a Crystal water batch in June. Pseudomonas aeruginosa is an opportunistic microbe; it can cause infections of lungs, urinary tract, skin or blood in immunocompromised individuals, while posing low risk to healthy people. Brazilian law bans any presence of this organism in drinking water. No consumer cases were reported yet.

triage.headline_ja: Anvisa、マンバウォーター2ロットを細菌検出のため回収
triage.triage_reason: 製品回収であり、消費者への感染事例は報告されておらず、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性、国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 規制当局(Anvisa)による予防的製品回収。消費者の感染症例は報告なし。同種の水製品回収が過去数ヶ月で3件目だが、いずれも公衆衛生危機には至っていない。

article.articleHeadline: Вирус Эболы стал распространяться быстрее: в ДР Конго погибли уже почти 800 человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola virus is spreading faster: nearly 800 people have already died in the DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of July 16, 2026, the World Health Organization reports an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) with 2,073 cases and 796 deaths, the fastest-growing surge yet. The pace surpasses the 2018–2019 outbreak, which reached about 2,000 cases after ten months. The outbreak has spread to two new provinces. WHO cautions the true scale could be two to four times higher than official counts, with a new Ebola strain raising concerns about transmissibility. There is a risk of cross-border spread to South Sudan. Earlier figures noted deaths had doubled over two weeks, with 15 July listing 754 confirmed cases. The situation indicates ongoing transmission and a need for intensified public health responses to contain the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスの拡散が加速：コンゴ民主共和国で既に約800人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラの症例・死亡者数が急増し過去最速のペースで拡大、新規株による感染力増大や国境を越えた拡散リスクも指摘されており、IHR基準を複数満たす重大な公衆衛生事象である。
triage.notes: スーダン（南スーダン）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。WHOは実際の症例数が公式発表の2〜4倍に達する可能性を指摘しており、新変異株による伝播性増加も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: مدير الصحة العالمية: 15ألف مخالط لـ إيبولا ونهدف الوصول لصفر من الحالات - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Director of Global Health: 15,000 Ebola contacts and we aim to reach zero cases - Youm7
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak remains largely confined to the Democratic Republic of Congo. At a Geneva press briefing via video, WHO Director-General Dr. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus emphasized that all interventions must be implemented together to rapidly and broadly control Ebola, with the DRC government leading the response. Every detected case and its contacts are traced; about 15,000 contacts are on the follow-up list, with roughly 80% daily follow-up achieved, monitoring contacts for 21 days. The challenge is not tracking known contacts but finding all cases in the community, requiring a broader collective response. Funding for the preparedness and response plan stands at only about 30% of the needed amount. The overarching goal remains zero Ebola cases, with intensified, coordinated global solidarity and adequate resources.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長:エボラ接触者1万5千人、感染ゼロを目指す
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクであり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響とヒト-ヒト感染拡大のリスクがあり、IHR基準を2つ以上満たすためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事はジュネーブでのWHO記者会見の内容であり、発生地域自体はコンゴ民主共和国。資金調達が必要額の約30%に留まり、国際的な支援強化が求められている点が特筆される。

article.articleHeadline: पूर्वी सिंहभूम: पोटका में मलेरिया नियंत्रण अभियान तेज, 51 गांवों में जांच के बाद 30 लोग संक्रमित - potka malaria campaign 30 infected in 51 villages
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: East Singhbhum: Malaria control drive intensified in Potka; 30 people infected after screening in 51 villages.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 July 2026, in Potka block of East Singhbhum district, India, a focused malaria control drive reports 30 cerebral malaria cases detected among 2,366 people screened across 51 villages. Health authorities have begun village-level treatment for all infected individuals and are supplying the necessary medicines. Health workers are conducting ongoing community awareness on malaria prevention and the importance of timely testing. Dr. Sukant Seet, the Acting Chief Medical Officer, said the campaign remains focused on effective containment of cerebral malaria and urged residents not to ignore even a mild fever, to promptly contact health officials for testing and follow treatment regimens. The effort emphasizes rapid diagnosis and local management to prevent spread within rural communities.

triage.headline_ja: 東シングブーム県:ポトカでマラリア対策キャンペーン強化、51村での検査後30人感染確認
triage.triage_reason: 地域限定のマラリア対策活動であり、既存の風土病に対する通常の公衆衛生対応であるため、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: マラリアはインドの当該地域における風土病であり、地方自治体レベルで通常の対策・治療活動が実施されている状況。重症度（脳マラリア）についての詳細情報は不足しているが、既存の管理体制内で対応可能とみられる。

article.articleHeadline: Жертвами вспышки Эболы в Конго стали почти 800 человек - Новости на Вести.ru
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nearly 800 people have died in the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo - News on Vesti.ru
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 2,073 cases and 796 deaths as of July 16, 2026, according to World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus at a briefing at WHO headquarters. Initiated in May, the outbreak is the third-deadliest in DR Congo’s history, with transmission accelerating over the past month compared with prior outbreaks. The circulating strain is described as distinct from the Zaïre variant that caused earlier epidemics. Russia has announced readiness for serial production of a vaccine for the new Ebola strain, underscoring vaccine development efforts tied to the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクによる死者、ほぼ800人に - Vesti.ru ニュース
triage.triage_reason: DRCで新規株によるエボラ出血熱が2,073症例・796死亡に達し、過去の流行より感染拡大が加速している異常事態であり、WHO事務局長が国際会見で言及するなど社会的関心も高いためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: ロシアはワクチン量産準備を発表しているのみで、発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。循環株はZaïre株と異なる新規変異株とされ、詳細な特性・国際的拡大リスクについては続報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in DRC 'faster than any previous outbreak' - WHO
article.articleSummary: As of 16 July 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo is spreading faster than in any previous outbreak. Since the outbreak was declared on 15 May, more than 2,000 cases and 796 deaths have been confirmed in DR Congo, making it the third-largest Ebola outbreak on record. The rare Bundibugyo species is involved, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. Cases have been detected in five DR Congo provinces and in neighbouring Uganda. The pace has outrun the 2018–2020 outbreak, which took more than 10 months to reach 2,000 cases. Key challenges include that more than 80% of new infections are detected outside known contact lists, and about two-thirds of deaths occur in communities without access to care in health facilities. The outbreak unfolds amid armed conflict in Ituri; a treatment centre in Bunia was attacked yesterday.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱、『過去最速のペースで拡大』-WHO
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、致死率の高いエボラ出血熱が過去最速ペースで拡大、ワクチン・治療法のない稀少株が武力紛争地域で国境を越えて拡大しているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境例も報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。稀少なBundibugyo種でワクチン・治療法未承認、武力紛争下でBuniaの治療センターが攻撃を受けるなど対応が著しく困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Число погибших от Эболы в ДР Конго достигло почти 800 человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death toll from Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached nearly 800.
article.articleSummary: Death toll from Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached nearly 800. As of July 16, 2026, the World Health Organization reports 2,073 Ebola cases and 796 deaths. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus told a briefing at WHO headquarters that this outbreak is the third-largest Ebola outbreak in the DRC’s history and has been spreading faster in the past month than any prior event. The ongoing outbreak remains active and rapidly expanding across affected regions of the DRC, underscoring the need for sustained surveillance and response measures. The report highlights the scale and pace of transmission, marking this as a critical public health emergency within the central African nation.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ死者数、約800人に達する
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上3番目の規模のエボラ流行が急速に拡大しており、死者数がほぼ800人に達するなど重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であるためフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長が直接ブリーフィングで言及するなど、国際的な注目度が高い。史上3番目の規模かつ過去1ヶ月で最速の拡大速度とされ、深刻度・異常性ともに高い。

article.articleHeadline: L'OMS affirme que l'épidémie d'Ebola " n'est pas hors de contrôle "
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO says the Ebola outbreak is not out of control.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo is not out of control, per the World Health Organization. As of July 16, 2026, about 2,100 cases and ~800 deaths have been reported; roughly 60% of deaths occur in communities outside health facilities. The outbreak is the third-largest and is progressing faster than previous ones, aided by testing capacity that now delivers several thousand daily tests. About four in five contacts of infected individuals have been traced, but four in five of those contacts remain unobserved. Community mistrust is a major hurdle, with a treatment center attacked in Bunia, one of the epicenters. Efforts prioritize rapid patient access to care; more than 800 people can be treated, with mortality of 10–15% in facilities versus 60–70% in communities.

triage.headline_ja: WHOは「エボラ流行は制御不能ではない」と主張
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部でエボラ出血熱が約2,100症例・約800人の死亡を記録し、過去3番目の規模かつ拡大速度が速く、地域社会の不信感や治療センターへの攻撃も発生しており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: WHOはコントロール可能と主張しているが、感染追跡率の低さ（接触者の8割が未観察）、地域社会の不信感、治療施設への攻撃など流行制御上の重大な課題が存在する。続報でWHOの公式リスク評価やIHR緊急委員会の動向を注視する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: ΠΟΥ: Η επιδημία Έμπολα στη ΛΔ του Κονγκό εξαπλώνεται ταχύτερα από παλιότερες
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading faster than earlier outbreaks.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 July 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading faster than any previous outbreak, according to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. Declared in mid-May 2026, the outbreak has killed 796 people and more than 2,000 laboratory-confirmed cases in the DRC. WHO characterizes it as the third-largest Ebola outbreak on record, with rapid transmission in recent months. The report notes the ongoing outbreak but provides no further details on transmission sources, clinical symptoms, laboratory confirmation methods, or imported/exported cases. The information underscores urgent public health response needs in the DRC and ongoing WHO surveillance and guidance.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行は過去の流行より速いスピードで拡大している
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで史上3番目に大きい流行となり、796人死亡・2000人以上の確定症例と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、WHOも異例の急速拡大を指摘しているためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長による声明であり信頼性は高いが、感染源・臨床症状・検査手法・輸出入症例等の詳細情報は不明。続報でのフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Humanitarian workers evacuated after violence erupts at DR Congo's Ebola treatment center
article.articleSummary: Violence erupted overnight at Nyakunde General Hospital, an Ebola treatment center in Ituri province, DR Congo, prompting evacuation of humanitarian workers involved in the outbreak response. The unrest followed the death of a pregnant woman at the facility, with angry community members firing guns and targeting the center. A humanitarian convoy was evacuated as security deteriorated, and some Ebola patients receiving treatment may have fled. The response to the Ebola outbreak remains hindered by insecurity, attacks on health workers and facilities, community mistrust, patients leaving treatment centers, and frontline responders’ protests over working conditions and unpaid allowances. As of July 16, 2026, Congolese authorities report 119 health workers and frontline responders infected, with 60 deaths. The incident underscores ongoing challenges in controlling Ebola at its Ituri epicenter.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ治療センターで暴力発生、人道支援従事者が避難
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の進行中のアウトブレイクにおいて治療施設への暴力・患者離脱・医療従事者感染多数（119名感染、60名死亡）が発生しており、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 治療センターでの暴力により患者の逃亡・支援活動の中断が発生しており、地域社会の不信感、医療従事者への攻撃、未払い手当を巡る抗議など、対応を阻害する複合的要因が存在する。続報でのアウトブレイクの拡大状況・国際対応の要否を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ: число жертв вспышки Эболы в Конго приблизилось к 800
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: The death toll from the Ebola outbreak in the Congo has approached 800.
article.articleSummary: Two months after its declaration, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has resulted in 2,073 cases and 796 deaths, with the death toll approaching 800, according to World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. Speaking at a briefing at WHO headquarters, he noted that this outbreak is the third-largest Ebola event on record in the DRC and that transmission has accelerated over the past month, outpacing every previous outbreak in the country. The report underscores the magnitude of ongoing transmission and the urgent public health response needed to contain spread. The briefing underscores the ongoing transmission and the urgent need for sustained public health measures to curb the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：コンゴのエボラ流行による死者数が800人に近づく
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ流行が過去最大級の規模となり、感染拡大が加速しているとWHOが発表しており、公衆衛生上深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長による公式発表であり、DRC史上3番目に大きいエボラ流行として感染拡大が加速している。致死率は約38%（796/2073）と高く、継続的な監視とフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola se răspândește în RDC "mai rapid față de oricare alt focar anterior", transmite OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is spreading in DR Congo "faster than any previous outbreak," says WHO.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 July 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo is spreading faster than in any previous outbreak. Since the outbreak was declared on 15 May in Ituri Province, more than 2,000 cases have been confirmed and 796 deaths reported. The 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC now affects five provinces and Uganda, making it the third-largest in history. The virus is Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is currently no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. Transmission occurs through close contact and bodily fluids; about 80% of new cases are detected outside known contact lists, indicating transmission chains are escaping surveillance. Approximately two-thirds of deaths occur in communities without access to medical care. Response challenges include a highly complex security context, with an Ebola treatment center in Bunia attacked.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がDRCで「これまでのどの流行よりも速く」拡大していると世界保健機関(WHO)が発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の複数該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大〔ウガンダへの拡大〕）に加え、ワクチン未承認のBundibugyoエボラウイルスによる大規模流行かつ治安上の対応困難があり、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事にウガンダへの拡大も言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。DRCの第17次流行で、致死率が高く、監視をすり抜ける感染連鎖や治安上の攻撃事案が発生しており、非常に深刻な状況。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: إيبولا يتفشى في الكونغو أسرع من أي وقت سابق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Ebola is spreading in Congo faster than ever before.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization says Ebola is spreading in the Democratic Republic of Congo faster than ever, potentially four times the official figures. Since May, a Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in eastern DRC may be the continent’s fastest; authorities report at least 1,926 infections and 702 deaths across three provinces, with confirmed infections also in neighboring Uganda as of July 13, 2026. The virus has no approved treatment or vaccine for this strain. WHO notes that 80% of new infections in eastern DRC arise from transmission chains that are unknown and outside contact tracing lists, hindering isolation and response. Chikwe Ihekweazu of Africa CDC says many recent deaths occurred in communities without access to healthcare, illustrating containment challenges. Bunia in Ituri province is among the hardest-hit locations.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：エボラ出血熱がコンゴでこれまでにない速さで拡大
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で過去最速ペースのエボラ流行が発生し、感染者1,926人・死者702人、ウガンダへの越境感染も確認されており、IHR基準を複数満たすため。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも感染確認との記述があるが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。WHOはこの株に承認された治療法・ワクチンがないと指摘しており、感染連鎖の8割が接触者追跡外であることから封じ込めが困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: بعد تعافي آخر مصاب.. أوغندا تبدأ العد التنازلي لإعلان انتهاء إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After the recovery of the last patient, Uganda begins the countdown to declare the end of the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Uganda began a 42-day countdown on 2026-07-16 to declare the end of its Ebola outbreak after the last patient left hospital. WHO guidelines require 42 days with no new infections, covering two incubation cycles. Uganda reported 20 cases and 2 deaths, mostly among Democratic Republic of Congo nationals who crossed the border. In the DRC, authorities tallied over 2,000 confirmed Ebola cases and 754 deaths since mid-May, with WHO warning that actual numbers may be 2–4 times higher. Despite relatively open borders, Uganda’s figures were limited. The declaration of end status will depend on completing the 42-day clearing period without new cases.

triage.headline_ja: 最後の感染者の回復を受け、ウガンダはエボラ流行終息宣言へのカウントダウンを開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCで2000例超・754人以上の死亡者を伴う大規模なエボラ流行が継続中であり、既に国境を越えてウガンダへ感染が広がった実績があるため、IHR基準に複数該当しフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダの流行は終息段階にあるが、感染源であるDRCでは2000例超・754人以上の死亡が報告され、WHOは実数がさらに2〜4倍多い可能性を指摘。DRCの流行は依然進行中とみられ、越境感染リスクが継続している点に留意。ウガンダはGeoNames対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: L'épidémie d'Ebola en RD Congo se propage "plus rapidement que toutes les précédentes", alerte l'OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in DR Congo is spreading faster than all previous outbreaks, WHO warns.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo Ebola outbreak declared mid-May is spreading faster than all previous epidemics, now the third-largest Ebola outbreak on record. As of 16 July 2026, the outbreak has 2,003 cases and 796 deaths. The northeast Ituri province is the epicenter, with more than 80% of new cases detected outside known contact lists, signaling transmission chains escaping surveillance. About two-thirds of deaths occur in communities without formal healthcare. Response capacity has improved to over 800 hospital beds, 60 laboratories, and contact tracing near 80%. There is no vaccine or treatment for the Bundibugyo Ebola variant involved, but trials are under way for MBP134 monoclonal antibody and remdesivir, and a ChAdOx1 vaccine safety trial has begun; post-exposure prophylaxis with obeldesivir is being evaluated. Uganda reports two deaths among 20 cases; no current cases in Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、「過去のどの流行よりも速く」拡大とWHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱がDRCで史上3番目の規模に拡大し、サーベイランスを逃れる感染連鎖が80%を超え、ウガンダにも波及していることから、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し国際的懸念が高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの症例（20例中2死亡）が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。ワクチン・治療薬の臨床試験が進行中であり続報の注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: مدير الصحة العالمية 15ألف مخالط لـ إيبولا ونهدف الوصول لصفر من الحالات
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General: 15,000 Ebola contacts, and we aim to reach zero cases.
article.articleSummary: On 16 July 2026, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus held a video press conference in Geneva on Ebola and public health. He stated the outbreak remains largely confined to the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and emphasized the goal of zero cases, not partial success. The DRC government leads the response, tracing every detected case and all contacts, with daily monitoring for 21 days. About 15,000 contacts are under follow-up, with roughly 80% observed daily, yet hidden community cases persist, demanding broader collective action. Internationally, the preparedness and response plan has attracted only around 30% of the required funding, limiting scale-up. Tedros urged genuine global solidarity with the DRC to protect health, resources, and regional stability, warning that failure to act now could necessitate greater effort and cost later, while the objective remains eradication to zero Ebola transmissions.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長：エボラの接触者15,000人、目標はゼロ症例達成
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクについてWHO事務局長が記者会見で言及し、資金不足や隠れた感染例の存在など国際的懸念が示されている。
triage.notes: ジュネーブはWHO記者会見の開催地であり、発生地域はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）である。国際的な資金不足（必要額の約30%のみ確保）が対応の障壁となっている点が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Analyse d'incidents liés à Ebola - Signaux CPT (du 16 mai au 1er juillet 2026)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Analysis of Ebola-Related Incidents - CPT Signals (May 16 to July 1, 2026).
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease response in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu is hindered by violence, crime, and pushback against health measures. In the 47 days from May 16 to July 1, 2026, 68 incidents were documented, with response teams directly targeted in 51, raising safety and operational concerns. Safe, dignified burials and body handling are the leading friction drivers (22 incidents), concentrated in the Bunia health zone. Accusations tying Ebola to the response—predominantly in Mongbwalu (10 of 14 such cases)—fuel violence, including claims that humanitarian workers introduced the virus. Friction remains highly localized: two health zones account for 26 of the incidents (nearly 40%). The analysis maps affected zones to targeted recommendations, emphasizing localized action over broad characterizations to guide the ongoing response. Ituri, Bunia, and Mongbwalu are central to the dynamics observed.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ関連事案の分析 - CPTシグナル（2026年5月16日〜7月1日）
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国（イトゥリ州、南北キブ州）でエボラ出血熱の対応が暴力や住民の抵抗により妨げられており、公衆衛生上重大な影響とヒト-ヒト感染リスクが継続している。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ対応チームへの暴力・妨害事案の分析であり、感染拡大の具体的な症例数や死亡者数は記載されていないため、国際的拡大や渡航制限に関するリスクは不明とした。安全な埋葬慣行への抵抗や、対応者がウイルスを持ち込んだとの誤解が暴力の主因となっており、対応の継続的な困難さが懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola related incident analysis - Community Perception Tracker's signals (16 May to 1 July 2026)
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo—Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu—unfolds amid armed violence, criminality and resistance to public health measures. From 16 May to 1 July 2026, 68 incidents affecting response teams were documented over 47 days, with 51 (75%) directly targeting personnel, highlighting risks to continuity of operations. Safe and dignified burials and body return were the leading friction source (22 incidents), highly concentrated in Bunia Health Zone. Most Ebola-related accusations targeted the response itself (10 of 14), notably in Mongbwalu where claims that humanitarian actors introduced the virus drive violence. Friction is highly localized: two health zones accounted for 26 of 68 incidents (about 40%). The analysis identifies the concerned health zones and provides priority geography for recommendations to enable targeted action rather than describe a broad climate.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ関連インシデント分析 - コミュニティ認識トラッカーのシグナル（2026年5月16日〜7月1日）
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国（イツリ、南北キブ州）で進行中のエボラ対応チームに対する暴力・妨害事案が多発しており、公衆衛生対応の継続性に深刻なリスクをもたらしている。国際的な関心・支援が必要なため、フルリスク評価に進むべきと判断。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ症例の疫学データではなく、対応チームへの暴力・妨害事案（安全埋葬への抵抗、責任転嫁等）の分析であり、既存のエボラアウトブレイク対応における社会的緊張を扱っている。症例数・死亡数など疫学的重症度データは本記事には含まれず、続報での確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: مدير الصحة العالمية: 15 ألف مخالط لإيبولا ونسعى للوصول لصفر حالات
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Director-General of the World Health Organization: 15,000 Ebola contacts, and we aim to reach zero cases.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-07-16, the World Health Organization held a video briefing on Ebola in Geneva with Dr. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. He emphasized a coordinated, comprehensive response and noted that the Democratic Republic of Congo leads efforts through case and contact tracing, with about 15,000 contacts being followed and daily monitoring around 80%. Despite these measures, undetected community transmission persists, calling for broader societal action. He warned that delaying containment will raise costs, stating current resources cover only about 30% of what is needed. Solidarity with the DRC is essential to protect public health and socio-economic interests. Success depends on achieving zero Ebola cases; there is no room for partial success.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長:エボラ接触者1万5千人、感染ゼロを目指す
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラの地域内感染が未検出のまま継続しており、接触者追跡や資源不足など公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念があるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: スイス・ジュネーブはWHOブリーフィング開催地であり、実際の発生地域ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Usuários reclamam de falta de testes para Covid-19 e gripe em USs de Curitiba
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Users complain about lack of tests for COVID-19 and influenza in Curitiba's health units.
article.articleSummary: Curitiba, Brazil, faces winter-driven rises in COVID-19 and influenza activity. As of 2026-07-16, residents report testing shortages at Boqueirão and Ouvidor Pardinho health posts, though the Municipal Health Secretariat (SMS) confirms a testing protocol. COVID-19 tests are available to all units and exceed 5,800 in use with about 7,000 in stock; testing is offered to patients meeting protocol criteria, prioritizing high-risk groups such as pregnant people, older adults, and immunocompromised individuals. The SMS did not provide numbers of tests performed. Influenza testing is not available in health units because influenza is not a mandatory-notification disease; surveillance relies on sentinel monitoring. Curitiba’s sentinel units—Urgent Care Units (UPAs) Campo Comprido, Cajuru, and CIC—collect weekly samples for the Paraná State Central Laboratory (Lacen-PR) to monitor circulating respiratory viruses. COVID-19 testing follows warning-symptom criteria, with red flags prompting care at Central Health or a health post.

triage.headline_ja: クリチバの保健所でCOVID-19とインフルエンザの検査不足をめぐり利用者が苦情
triage.triage_reason: 冬季の季節的な呼吸器感染症活動の増加と検査体制に関する報道であり、異常性や重篤性、国際的拡大の懸念を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 季節性のCOVID-19・インフルエンザ流行に伴う検査体制への不満を報じる地域ニュースであり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や国際的リスクは認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Anvisa manda recolher água Mamba Water após bactéria que atingiu Ypê e Crystal
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anvisa orders recall of Mamba Water after bacteria that affected Ypê and Crystal.
article.articleSummary: Two lots (13 and 14) of Mamba Water mineral water, 350 ml, produced on April 3–4, 2026 and expiring April 2027, were recalled in Brazil after routine tests detected Pseudomonas aeruginosa. Anvisa published the voluntary recall on July 16, 2026; sale, distribution, and use of the identified cans have been halted. The action follows earlier recalls of Crystal and Ypê brands. About 82% of the affected volume had already been blocked from circulation. Bottling occurred at Bebidas Poty S.A.; corrective steps were taken with the supplier. Pseudomonas aeruginosa is an environmental bacterium that poses greater risk to diabetics, immunocompromised individuals, cystic fibrosis patients, and hospitalized patients; infections can involve blood, skin, bones, ears, eyes, lungs, urinary tract, and heart valves, and may require ventilation or cause septic shock. Consumers with affected lots should not consume the product and contact SAC for a refund starting July 16, 2026 (email or phone).

triage.headline_ja: Anvisa、ImpêとCrystalに続きバクテリア汚染を受けMamba Water水の回収を命令
triage.triage_reason: 製品リコールに関する規制対応の記事であり、実際の感染症患者報告や公衆衛生上の広範な影響は確認されていないため、シグナルとして識別する基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 本記事は感染症の発生事例ではなく、規制当局（Anvisa）による製品リコールに関する報道。Pseudomonas aeruginosaの検出による予防的措置であり、実際の患者発生は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: SII signs Gates MRI pact to manufacture promising TB vaccine candidate
article.articleSummary: On 16 July 2026, Serum Institute of India (SII) and Gates Medical Research Institute (Gates MRI) announced a manufacturing pact for M72/AS01E tuberculosis vaccine candidate. Pune-based SII will develop capacity to manufacture and supply the vaccine for high TB-burden countries, subject to ongoing Phase-III trials and regulatory approvals, enabling scalable, affordable production for low- and middle-income nations where TB remains a leading killer. TB causes over one million deaths annually worldwide. The M72/AS01E asset, developed by Gates MRI after licensing from GSK, is among the most advanced TB vaccines and could become the first new vaccine to prevent pulmonary TB in adults in more than a century, complementing BCG. SII’s deal follows other global partnerships this month, including a Bundibugyo ebolavirus vaccine Phase I trial by Oxford Jenner Institute, and dengue therapeutic trials involving Brazil, Malaysia, and Thailand. SII serves over 170 countries and aims for low-cost production at scale.

triage.headline_ja: SIIがゲイツMRIとTBワクチン候補製造で提携
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はTBワクチン製造に関する企業間提携の発表であり、感染症の発生や流行に関するイベントではないため、シグナルとして扱う必要はない。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン製造・研究開発に関する産業ニュースであり、実際の感染症発生地域を示すものではない。地域情報（India, Brazil, Thailand, Malaysia等）はワクチン開発・臨床試験の関係国であり、疾病発生地とは異なる。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola. L'OMS affirme que l'épidémie d'Ebola "n'est pas hors de contrôle"
