article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola. The WHO says the Ebola outbreak is not out of control.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo; the WHO says the epidemic, the third-largest to date, is not yet out of control, though it is advancing faster than previous waves. About 2,100 cases and roughly 800 deaths have been identified; two months have produced this count, whereas it previously took about ten months to reach a similar level. Testing capacity has improved to thousands per day, and authorities have intensified all response efforts, but officials say this remains insufficient. Approximately 80% of contacts of infected people have been traced, yet surveillance among traced contacts is weak, with around 80% not observed. Community distrust is high. A health center was attacked in Bunia, one of the outbreak’s epicenters. Efforts prioritize rapid access to care: more than 800 patients can be treated, with mortality around 10–15% in health facilities versus 60–70% in communities.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：WHOは「流行は制御不能ではない」と表明
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で史上3番目に大きいエボラ流行が急速に拡大しており、致死率が高く公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と異常性が認められるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国東部（ブニアを含む）でのエボラ流行に関するもので、感染拡大速度が過去の波より速く、コミュニティでの致死率が60-70%と非常に高いことが指摘されている。国際的拡大や渡航制限に関する明示的言及はないため不明と評価。

article.articleHeadline: RDC/Ebola : un centre de traitement attaqué, le personnel humanitaire évacué
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC/Ebola: a treatment center attacked, humanitarian staff evacuated.
article.articleSummary: On July 16, 2026, violence in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo disrupted the Ebola response when assailants attacked the Ebola treatment center at Nyakunde General Hospital in Ituri province. The assault followed the death of a pregnant woman admitted there, triggering overnight clashes that left multiple dead and forced evacuation of a humanitarian convoy. Some Ebola patients reportedly fled the center amid the chaos. The outbreak declared in mid-May in Ituri has grown to over 2,000 confirmed Ebola cases nationwide, with the World Health Organization warning the true toll may be two to four times higher. The response is hampered by insecurity, attacks on health workers and facilities, community mistrust, patient withdrawals, and frontline staff protests over working conditions and unpaid compensation. Authorities report 119 health workers and frontline responders infected, including 60 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: DRC/エボラ:治療センターが襲撃され、人道支援スタッフが避難
triage.triage_reason: エボラ大規模流行（2000例超、致死率高い）に加え治安悪化による治療センター襲撃・患者逃亡・医療従事者感染多数が発生しており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大・対応困難のリスクが高い。
triage.notes: 治安悪化・武装勢力による攻撃がエボラ対応を著しく妨げており、WHOは実際の症例数が報告の2〜4倍の可能性を指摘。医療従事者119名感染、60名死亡と深刻な状況。

article.articleHeadline: UNICEF subraya la necesidad de "una acción colectiva más enérgica y una respuesta más rápida" ante el ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UNICEF stresses the need for "a stronger, more vigorous collective action and a faster response" in the face of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) exceeds 2,000 confirmed cases and 750 deaths. As of 16 July 2026, UNICEF calls for stronger, faster collective action and sustained international solidarity to contain the epidemic, centered in Ituri with spread to North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo amid conflict, displacement and restricted access. Four priorities: mobilize communities and counter misinformation; strengthen prevention and infection control; protect children affected; and bolster community surveillance. Response must be integrated with other emergencies—malnutrition, cholera, polio, displacement—while maintaining essential services including health care and schooling. UNICEF seeks urgent funding; current resources amount to only about 25% of the required amount. DRC, which declared the last Ebola outbreak ended in December 2025 (Kasai), remains a global reference in Ebola management.

triage.headline_ja: UNICEF、エボラ対策における「より強力な集団行動と迅速な対応」の必要性を強調
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が2000症例・750死亡を超え、複数州に拡大し紛争・避難民状況下で対応が困難化しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準共に複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事はUNICEFの声明を中心に、既存の大規模エボラ流行（2000症例超・750死亡超）の深刻化と資金不足（必要額の約25%のみ確保）を報告。既に進行中のアウトブレイクだが、規模拡大と国際支援要請の観点からフルRRA継続監視が必要。マラリア栄養失調・コレラ・ポリオとの複合対応も課題として言及。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de ebola na RDC se propaga 'mais rápido' do que os anteriores, alerta OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the DRC is spreading faster than previous outbreaks, WHO warns.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, declared two months ago, is spreading faster than any prior Ebola epidemic, according to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus on July 16, 2026. The outbreak has reached 2,003 cases with 796 deaths, making it the third largest Ebola outbreak on record. By comparison, the 2018–2020 outbreak in the DRC took more than 10 months to reach 2,000 cases and resulted in about 3,500 cases and nearly 2,300 deaths, the deadliest for the country. The current outbreak’s rapid growth underscores the ongoing global health concern and the need for enhanced surveillance and response. The article does not specify transmission sources or laboratory confirmation details.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、過去最速のスピードで拡大とWHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで過去最速のペースで拡大しており、2000例超・死亡796例と重大な公衆衛生上の影響があり、国際的拡大リスクも懸念されるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長が過去のエボラ流行と比較し拡大速度の速さを警告。感染経路や検査確定の詳細は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola en RD Congo se propaga 'más rápido' que los precedentes, alerta la OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo spreads 'faster' than previous outbreaks, WHO warns.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is spreading faster than prior epidemics, prompting warnings from WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. As of now, 2,003 Ebola cases and 796 deaths have been reported. The Ituri province is the epicenter, with more than 80% of new infections detected outside known contact lists. The Bundibugyo variant, for which there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment, is driving this outbreak. The 2018–2020 DRC outbreak reached about 2,000 cases after more than 10 months; this outbreak is already on a faster trajectory. WHO began clinical trials this month of MBP134, a monoclonal antibody, and the antiviral remdesivir (separately or in combination) to curb transmission. No vaccine or approved therapy exists yet for Bundibugyo-related Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、過去の流行より『速く』拡大とWHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な拡大速度、国際的拡大リスク）に加え、ワクチン・治療薬未承認のBundibugyo株による致死率の高いアウトブレイクであり、フルRRAへの移行が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 致死率約39.7%（796/2003）。80%以上の新規感染が既知の接触者リスト外で検出されており、感染連鎖の追跡が困難な状況。ワクチン・特異的治療法が存在しないBundibugyo variantが原因であり、2018-2020年流行より速いペースで拡大している点が重大な懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en RD Congo se propaga "más rápido" que los precedentes, alerta la OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the DRC is spreading faster than previous outbreaks, WHO warns.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading faster than any prior outbreak, according to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. As of 16 July 2026, 2,003 cases and 796 deaths have been reported. It is the third-largest Ebola outbreak on record; the 2018–2020 DRC outbreak took more than 10 months to reach 2,000 cases and caused about 2,300 deaths among 3,500 cases. The northeast Ituri Province is the epicenter, with over 80% of new cases detected outside known contact lists. There is no vaccine or treatment for the Bundibugyo variant driving this outbreak, but WHO began clinical trials this month with two therapies—monoclonal antibody MBP134 and the antiviral remdesivir—used separately or in combination.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱の流行、過去最速のペースで拡大とWHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: WHO事務局長が過去最速の拡大速度と警告し、症例2,003件・死亡796件、有効なワクチン・治療薬未確立、新規症例の80%超が既知の接触者リスト外という制御不能な状況であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: WHOはBundibugyo変異株に対する治療薬（モノクローナル抗体MBP134、抗ウイルス薬レムデシビル）の臨床試験を開始。過去最大級（3番目）のエボラ流行であり、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: تفشي فيروس إيبولا في الكونغو هو الأسرع على الإطلاق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: The Ebola virus outbreak in Congo is the fastest ever.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization warns that the Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading faster than any prior outbreak. As of July 16, 2026, more than 2,000 cases and 796 deaths have been confirmed since the surge was declared two months ago, making it the third-largest EVD outbreak on record. The outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare strain with no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. Infections have been reported across five Congolese provinces, including Ituri in the northeast, with cases spilling over into Uganda. Transmission occurs mainly through close contact with contaminated bodily fluids; about 80% of new infections are among people not listed as contacts. Two-thirds of deaths occur in communities without healthcare access. Security issues hinder response, including an attack on a treatment center in Bunia, Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関:コンゴのエボラウイルス感染爆発は史上最速
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当する深刻なエボラ流行(Bundibugyo株、致死率高、ワクチン未承認、国境を越えウガンダへ拡大)であり、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの症例流出が報告されているが、対象国リストにウガンダは含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。WHOが史上最速の流行と警告しており、稀少株(Bundibugyo)でワクチン・治療薬未承認、治安問題により対応が困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Последний пациент с Эболой в Уганде выписался из больницы - Новости на Вести.ru
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The last Ebola patient in Uganda was discharged from the hospital - News on Vesti.ru
article.articleSummary: On July 16, 2026, Uganda discharged the last patient with a laboratory-confirmed Ebola virus disease diagnosis, starting a 42-day countdown to declare the outbreak over if no new cases occur. The World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus reported Uganda’s totals at 20 cases and 2 deaths. Separately, the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Ebola toll neared 800 deaths. The 42-day period begins with the last confirmed case discharged, after which the outbreak in Uganda would be considered ended if no new infections arise. The report reiterates Ebola’s high danger level, notes the existence of a vaccine, and states this outbreak is not expected to spark a new global pandemic. The article also references remarks by Russian Academy of Sciences academician Gennady Onishchenko.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダで最後のエボラ患者が退院 - Vesti.ruニュース
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は重篤度が高く国際的拡大リスクを伴う疾患であり、DRCでは死者数が800人に迫るなど深刻な状況が継続しているため、IHR基準の複数該当が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はウガンダでの終息プロセス（ウガンダは対象国リスト外のため除外）だが、DRCで死者数が800人に迫っているとの記載があり、DRCにおけるエボラ流行は依然として重大な公衆衛生上の懸念である。続報でDRCの状況を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Gefährliches Virus: Symptome von Ebola-Patient in Frankfurt bessern sich - Deutschland & Welt - Rhein-Zeitung
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dangerous virus: Symptoms of an Ebola patient in Frankfurt are improving.
article.articleSummary: As of July 16, 2026, an Ebola patient treated at Frankfurt University Hospital is stable and showing symptom improvement under supportive therapy. The patient, a US citizen and Samaritan’s Purse disaster-relief worker with no direct patient contact, contracted Bundibugyo ebolavirus in the Democratic Republic of Congo and arrived at Frankfurt Airport by Monday night for treatment. He is reported to be improving and remains in stable condition. Samaritan’s Purse operates Ebola treatment centers in the Congo and notes its teams include medical, infection-control, and logistics personnel; the organization has assisted Ebola responses in 2014 and 2018. The university hospital has previously treated Ebola patients and other hemorrhagic fever cases, including one Ebola patient and two infections with Lassa virus, illustrating ongoing preparedness for imported cases.

triage.headline_ja: 危険なウイルス：フランクフルトのエボラ患者、症状が改善
triage.triage_reason: 既知のコンゴ(DRC)エボラ流行由来の輸入症例がドイツで治療されている事例。直接接触なく管理下にあるが、エボラという疾患特性上、重症度・社会的関心が高くPICKUPと判断。
triage.notes: 患者はコンゴ(DRC)でBundibugyo型エボラウイルスに感染し、フランクフルト大学病院で治療中。直接患者接触のない救援活動従事者であり、症状は改善傾向。ドイツ・米国は対象国リスト外のためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: WHO advarer: Spreder sig hurtigere end før
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Warns: Spreading Faster Than Before.
article.articleSummary: 2000+ Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo since May 15, with 796 deaths. WHO warns the outbreak, driven by the rare Bundibugyo variant, is the third-largest on record and is spreading faster than any prior Ebola outbreak. In the past month, more than 80% of new infections are outside known contact lists, indicating weak case tracing. The outbreak is active across five provinces in DR Congo and neighboring Uganda. Ebola symptoms include fever and bleeding; there is no approved vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo. About two-thirds of deaths occur in communities that have not received treatment, complicating control amid an ongoing armed conflict. A hospital in Ituri province was attacked; a woman who had gone to give birth died of blood loss after transfusion restrictions prevented blood donation by relatives, prompting evacuation of staff and patients.

triage.headline_ja: WHOの警告:これまでよりも速く拡大している
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱(ブンディブギョ株)がDRコンゴで2000人以上の症例・796人の死亡を出し、過去最大級の速さで拡大、ウガンダにも波及しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの波及が記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。武力紛争下での対応困難、ワクチン・治療薬未承認の希少株(ブンディブギョ型)である点が重要。

article.articleHeadline: El ébola avanza rápido en el Congo: ya es el tercer peor brote histórico y alarma a la OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spreads rapidly in the Congo: it is already the third-worst outbreak in history and has alarmed the WHO.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri province, with 2,073 cases and 796 deaths. WHO characterizes it as the third-largest Ebola outbreak in history, expanding rapidly, with over 80% of new infections detected outside known contact lists and about two-thirds of deaths occurring in communities without isolation. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus cautions two months since official declaration, as transmission outpaces projections. The response includes over 800 treatment beds, 16 diagnostic laboratories, and training for more than 21,000 community health workers. Experimental interventions advance: MBP134 monoclonal antibody and remdesivir antiviral regimens, plus the ChAdOx1 vaccine initiating its first safety trial under Oxford, and post-exposure prophylaxis with obeldesivir underway. In Uganda, the outbreak appears contained, with the last patient discharged, 20 cases and 2 deaths, and a 42-day countdown to declare end of the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱が急速に拡大：史上3番目に深刻な流行となりWHOが警戒
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上3番目の規模のエボラ流行が急速に拡大し、死者796人・感染経路不明が8割超と深刻化しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも症例が確認されたが、記事によれば流行は制圧され最終患者も退院済み（対象国リストにウガンダは含まれないため verified_locations には含めない）。WHOは公式に「史上3番目に大きいエボラ流行」と位置づけ、伝播が予測を上回っていると警告している。

article.articleHeadline: L'épidémie d'Ebola en RD Congo se propage "plus rapidement que toutes les précédentes", alerte l'OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in DR Congo is spreading "faster than any previous outbreaks," WHO warns.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 July 2026, the Ebola outbreak declared two months earlier in the Democratic Republic of Congo is spreading faster than any previous outbreak, and is now the third-largest in history. The country counts 2,003 cases and 796 deaths, with total across the epidemic surpassing 2,000 cases. The Ituri province remains the main hotspot, where more than 80% of new infections are detected outside known contact lists, signaling ongoing transmission chains eluding surveillance. Health authorities report capacity improvements, with over 800 hospital beds available for patient care, 60 laboratories, and contact-tracing coverage around 80%. There is currently no vaccine or treatment for the Bundibugyo Ebola variant, though trials are underway for MBP134 and remdesivir, and a ChAdOx1 vaccine safety study has begun. A post-exposure prophylaxis trial with obeldesivir also started. Uganda reports two deaths from 20 cases, now zero cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、「過去のどの流行よりも速く」拡大とWHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な拡大速度、国際的拡大）、WPRO基準も全て該当。史上3番目の規模で死者796人、ワクチン・治療薬未確立のため即時のフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも症例（20例中2死亡、現在は0例）が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。イトゥリ州はDRC国内の行政区分のため国名に統合。80%の新規感染が既知の接触者リスト外で検出されており、サーベイランスをすり抜ける伝播が継続している点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: В ДР Конго толпа атаковала больницу с больными Эболой, пишут СМИ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the DRC, a mob attacked a hospital with Ebola patients, media report.
article.articleSummary: Mob attacked a hospital in Ituri Province, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, where Ebola patients were being treated; several patients, up to about ten, fled as stones were hurled and fencing was broken. The hospital’s medical team evacuated; the generator that powered the facility stopped after the assault. The Congolese army opened an investigation, and humanitarian group Samaritan’s Purse evacuated its staff from a nearby Ebola treatment center. The incident followed the death of a woman who came to give birth and died from anemia; relatives offered blood for transfusion, but transfusions are prohibited during an Ebola outbreak. WHO had previously designated the Congo–Uganda Ebola outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, with a high regional risk, highlighting cross-border transmission concerns.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で、群衆がエボラ患者のいる病院を襲撃したとメディアが報道
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICと認定済みのエボラ流行下で、患者が病院から逃走する事態が発生し感染拡大リスクが高まっているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生地域に含まれるが、記事本文はコンゴ民主共和国（イトゥリ州）での事案が主題であり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。病院襲撃により感染管理が破綻し、患者の逃走・輸血禁止規定違反などエボラ拡大の懸念が強い。

article.articleHeadline: Почти 800 человек умерли от лихорадки Эбола в ДР Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nearly 800 people have died from Ebola fever in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: EBOLA virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues as of 16 July 2026. The World Health Organization reports 796 deaths among 2,073 registered cases, with 62 new infections identified in the past 24 hours. The agency cautions the true case count may be higher than official tallies. The outbreak has spread rapidly in eastern DR Congo, affecting five regions as of mid-July. By 15 July, DR Congo had 2,011 cases and 754 deaths; updated figures on 16 July show 2,073 cases and 796 deaths. In May, WHO designated the Congo–Uganda Ebola situation as a public health emergency of international concern, signaling risk of further spread beyond the affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ熱により約800人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイクで死者796人・症例2073人と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、WHOがPHEICを宣言するなど国際的拡大リスクも認められるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生地域として記載されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。WHOは2026年5月にコンゴ・ウガンダのエボラ状況をPHEICに指定。

article.articleHeadline: ΠΟΥ: Η επιδημία Έμπολα στο Κονγκό εξαπλώνεται ταχύτερα από πριν
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: The Ebola epidemic in the Congo is spreading faster than before.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization warns that Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of Congo is spreading at an alarming speed, faster than any previous outbreak. The outbreak, declared in mid-May, is centered in Ituri province in northeastern DRC and constitutes the 17th Ebola outbreak in the country. As of mid-May, more than 796 people have died and confirmed cases exceed 2,000; latest counts show 2,003 cases and 796 deaths. It is the third-largest Ebola outbreak ever recorded. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that the transmission speed in recent months is higher than any past period. The Ituri region accounts for the majority of spread; over 80% of new cases are outside of known contact lists, indicating ongoing chains of transmission that evade surveillance. About two-thirds of deaths occur in communities where patients did not seek care in health facilities, complicating containment.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:コンゴのエボラ流行、過去最速のペースで拡大
triage.triage_reason: WHOが史上3番目の規模のエボラ流行として警告し、感染拡大が過去最速との報告があり、死者数・症例数も甚大で国際的関心・支援の必要性が高い。
triage.notes: 80%以上の新規症例が既知の接触者リスト外であり、サーベイランスを逃れた伝播チェーンが継続している点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Haut-Uélé : les leaders communautaires outillés à l'élaboration des messages de sensibilisation contre Ebola. - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Upper Uele: Community leaders equipped to develop Ebola awareness messages.
article.articleSummary: On 16 July 2026 in Isiro, Haut-Uélé, northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo, a session was held to design key Ebola-awareness messages for community leaders. The concise messages are intended for rapid dissemination during community meetings, religious services, markets, radio and TV broadcasts, home visits, and social groups to ensure the population understands Ebola prevention. The awareness package will be produced in French, Lingala, and Swahili and first submitted to the provincial governor for validation before broad distribution. Emmanuel Arama, the provincial minister of Communication and Media, stated the aim is for messages to be short, reliable, and easily shared to reinforce barrier measures that halt Ebola virus transmission. The session was attended by ACP communications experts, the provincial government’s executive secretary, the DPS health-communication task-force, and members of Haut-Uélé’s Provincial Youth Council.

triage.headline_ja: オー・ウエレ州：地域リーダーがエボラ啓発メッセージ作成の研修を受ける
triage.triage_reason: エボラに関する啓発活動の報告であり、実際の症例発生や感染拡大に関する具体的情報が記載されていないため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本記事はエボラに関する住民啓発メッセージ作成のための会合についての報告であり、実際の患者発生や症例数などの疫学情報は含まれていない。DRCはエボラ流行の既往地域であるため、背景に感染拡大リスクへの懸念がある可能性はあるが、記事内容からは断定できない。

article.articleHeadline: Hugo Garay: "Estamos trabajando para evitar que la sarna ingrese a Santa Cruz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hugo Garay: "We are working to prevent scabies from entering Santa Cruz."
article.articleSummary: Santa Cruz, Argentina, aims to prevent entry of ovine scabies (sheep scabies) as neighboring provinces report infections. A new protocol for arriving comparsas (carnival groups) requires pre-notification of tools, clothing, worker numbers, and adherence to sanitary measures. By late July, the Provincial Agrarian Council will join Senasa for training to strengthen early detection and enable on-the-ground recognition of the disease in other provinces. Garay emphasizes that coordinated state-producer actions have kept Santa Cruz free of ovine scabies, but an incursion would worsen drought-era hardships. The province showcased its producers at the Palermo Rural Exhibition to promote Santa Cruz products and access new markets, highlighting maize trials in Perito Moreno and peas in Gobernador Gregores, alongside the Río Gallegos animal-feed plant to supply raw materials and create jobs. Guanaco fiber trades around $150, signaling future diversification.

triage.headline_ja: ウーゴ・ガライ:「サンタクルスへの疥癬侵入を防ぐため取り組んでいます」
triage.triage_reason: アルゼンチンの羊疥癬（動物疾患）に関する内容であり、対象国リストに該当する地域での発生ではなく、公衆衛生上の緊急性も低い。
triage.notes: 疥癬（Scabies）は羊の動物疾患（ovine scabies）であり、ヒトの感染症イベントではない。発生地域にPhilippinesが記載されているが記事内容はアルゼンチンのサンタクルス州に関するものであり、対象国リストのいずれにも該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Vall Companys reducirá a la mitad sus inversiones y dividendo en 2026 por la peste porcina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vall Companys will cut its investments and dividend in half in 2026 due to swine fever.
article.articleSummary: African swine fever (ASF) outbreak detected in Barcelona, Bellaterra on 28 November forced Vall Companys to deploy a contingency plan that included a 61 million euro provision to mitigate market closures and export blockages. In 2025, the group earned 4.626 billion euros in revenue (up 11%), but net profit fell to 245.4 million euros, down 12% from 2024. The plan expects 2026 dividends to be halved to 36 million euros and investments trimmed to 85 million euros, versus 193.2 million euros invested in 2024 for modernization. ASF remains a grave risk to the meat sector by depressing pig prices and constraining export markets. Despite this, flour and poultry divisions posted positive results, and pork exports reached 35% of sales, led by Central Europe, ahead of Asia. Vall Companys pursues Latin American growth: Chile in 2026 with Coexca/Master Agroindustrial and Argentina with Grupo Pacuca (14 million dollars loan). Since 2016, it has minority stakes in Peru, Colombia, Uruguay, Brazil; Mexico is 75% owned.

triage.headline_ja: Vall Companys社、アフリカ豚熱の影響で2026年の投資額と配当金を半減へ
triage.triage_reason: スペイン・バルセロナでのアフリカ豚熱（ASF）発生に伴う一企業の経済的影響（投資・配当削減）を報じる内容であり、対象国リストに該当する国での発生事例はなく、人の公衆衛生への影響も認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はスペイン・カタルーニャ州のASF発生による食肉企業（Vall Companys）の経済的影響を報じるもの。ブラジル・チリ・アルゼンチン等はASF発生地ではなく、同社のラテンアメリカ事業展開先として言及されているのみで、疾病発生とは無関係。対象国での発生事例なしのためverified_locationsは空。動物衛生・貿易上の問題であり、人の感染症シグナルとしては該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Health: UNDP tips Ugandan professional drivers on Ebola prep
article.articleSummary: UNDP Uganda handed Ebola preparedness supplies to Uganda Professional Drivers' Network at Nateete Transport Terminal, Kampala, July 16. The donation includes 145 infrared thermometer guns; 63 20-litre pedal-operated water containers with stands; 510 disposable gloves; 710 containers of liquid detergent soap; 950 bars of soap; and 710 cans of hand sanitizers, to strengthen hygiene and infection prevention at transport hubs as part of Uganda's Ebola readiness, risk communication and community engagement. The handover was attended by the Ministry of Health, Ministry of Works and Transport, KCCA, transport associations, bus operators, truck drivers' representatives and development partners, highlighting transport workers as frontline partners in preventing transmission due to cross-border travel, including routes to Democratic Republic of the Congo. Equipment will be distributed to bus terminals, taxi parks and driver associations to improve hygiene, surveillance and safer workplaces while continuing public health messaging. Uganda recently discharged last Ebola patient from Mulago Hospital.

triage.headline_ja: 保健：UNDPがウガンダのプロドライバーにエボラ対策を助言
triage.triage_reason: 記事はウガンダにおけるUNDPによるエボラ対策物資の配布という予防活動を報じるものであり、新規発生や異常事態を示す内容ではない。対象国（DRC等）は越境移動の文脈で言及されているのみで、実際の発生地ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダ国内の予防的物資配布に関する内容。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれず、DRCは越境移動ルートとしての言及のみで実際の発生地ではないため、verified_locationsは空とした。また記事は「ウガンダの最後のエボラ患者がムラゴ病院から退院した」と述べており、現行アウトブレイクは終息傾向にあると考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Taco Bell opportunity overshadowed by cyclospora parasite scare
article.articleSummary: Cyclospora parasite outbreak causing diarrhea is overshadowing Yum! Brands' Taco Bell international expansion push. The company, which operates Taco Bell (8,700+ restaurants globally and 1,100 overseas, up from ~500 in 2019), aims to hit 3,000 Taco Bells abroad by end-2030, with Germany and Poland flagged by JPMorgan as next key markets; biggest overseas markets currently the UK, Spain, and India. Yum! emphasizes franchise partners to accelerate international growth, with >85% of operating income coming from KFC and Taco Bell. International sales rose 11% in 2025, beating the US 6% growth; in Q1 this year international growth accelerated to 16%. JPMorgan analyst John Ivankoe notes a ~6% CAGR for combined Taco Bell and KFC store counts. In the near term, the stock faces volatility as customers may reduce visits due to the cyclospora outbreak spreading throughout the country.

triage.headline_ja: タコベルの海外展開の好機、サイクロスポーラ寄生虫による混乱で影が薄れる
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は米国内で発生しているサイクロスポーラ症アウトブレイクがTaco Bellの株価・事業に与える影響を扱うビジネス記事であり、対象国（ポーランド・スペイン・ドイツ・インド・英国）は海外展開先市場として言及されているのみで、実際のアウトブレイク発生国ではない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は米国内でのサイクロスポーラ症アウトブレイクによるTaco Bell株価への影響であり、対象国リストの国々（ドイツ・ポーランド・インド・英国・スペイン）はいずれも海外展開先市場としての言及に過ぎず、感染症発生国として特定されていない。

article.articleHeadline: بسبب هجوم.. مرضى "إيبولا" يفرون من مستشفى في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Due to an attack, Ebola patients flee from a hospital in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Mob attack on Nyakondi Hospital in Ituri, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, forced Ebola patients and emergency staff to flee, disrupting electricity and hindering outbreak containment. Relatives of a patient who died after seeking care for childbirth due to severe anemia were among the rioters, who hurled stones and damaged the hospital perimeter on Wednesday, July 15, 2026. The hospital had refused a family blood donation because blood transfusions are prohibited during the Ebola outbreak. The report provides no Ebola case or death counts or laboratory-confirmation details. The incident underscores ongoing security and operational challenges in responding to the Ebola outbreak in eastern DRC.

triage.headline_ja: 襲撃により、エボラ患者がコンゴ民主共和国の病院から逃走
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱という国際的懸念疾患のアウトブレイク対応中に、病院襲撃による患者の逃走・感染制御の中断が発生しており、地域拡大や封じ込め失敗のリスクが高い。
triage.notes: 症例数・死亡数・検査確定情報は記事中に記載なし。病院襲撃により感染制御活動（隔離・治療）が中断された点がリスク上重要。

article.articleHeadline: Zambia : Government Puts An End To Cholera Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Zambia has officially declared an end to the cholera outbreak that began in August last year, after more than four weeks with no confirmed cases. The Ministry of Health reported 1,627 cholera cases and 26 deaths across 25 districts during the outbreak. Permanent Secretary Kennedy Lishimpi said the declaration is paired with ongoing investments in water, sanitation and hygiene, strengthened disease surveillance, and progress toward cholera elimination by 2030. The country has established local cholera vaccine manufacturing, mobilised cross-border collaboration, and set up Presidential Cholera Task Forces across Africa. Citizens were urged to maintain prevention measures: regular handwashing, safe water, clean surroundings, and seeking prompt medical attention for acute watery diarrhea or vomiting. The ministry will sustain surveillance and multi-sectoral control plans. On Measles, cases rose with enhanced vaccination in five districts; first-dose coverage exceeds 95%, but about 87% of children miss the second dose.

triage.headline_ja: ザンビア:政府がコレラ流行の終息を宣言
triage.triage_reason: コレラ流行は終息宣言済みで新規シグナルとしての緊急性は低いが、麻疹症例の増加とワクチン第2回接種率の低さ（未接種87%）が今後の流行リスクとして注視が必要。
triage.notes: コレラ流行（2025年8月開始、1627例・26死亡）は4週間新規症例なしで終息宣言。麻疹は5地区でワクチン接種強化中も第2回接種率が低く(87%未接種)、今後の再流行リスクとして継続監視が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : l'épidémie d'Ebola en RDC se propage 'plus rapidement' que les précédentes, alerte l'OMS - RTBF Actus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: The Ebola outbreak in the DRC is spreading faster than previous outbreaks, WHO warns - RTBF Actus.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak is the third-largest ever, spreading faster in recent months than previous epidemics. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, 2,003 cases and 796 deaths have been reported as of July 16, 2026. By comparison, the 2018 Ebola outbreak in DRC took more than ten months to reach 2,000 confirmed cases. Transmission is especially concerning in Ituri province, where most new cases still escape contact tracing, though patient care and testing are progressing. The World Health Organization has launched clinical trials for several treatments and a vaccine. Uganda, the neighboring country, reports zero active cases. Ongoing surveillance, laboratory confirmation, and strengthened public health responses are needed to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行は過去の流行よりも「速く」拡大している、とWHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の史上3番目に大きい流行で、感染拡大速度が過去の流行を上回っており、接触者追跡が追いついていないことから、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクがある。
triage.notes: ウガンダは近隣国として言及されているが、活動症例はゼロと報告されており、実際の発生国はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Reuters: в ДР Конго пациенты с Эболой сбежали из больницы после нападения толпы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Reuters: Ebola patients in the DRC fled from the hospital after a mob attack.
article.articleSummary: Ebola patients and medical staff fled Nyankunde Hospital in Ituri Province, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, after an enraged crowd attacked the facility. Relatives of a patient who died after arriving for delivery hurled stones, damaged fencing, and triggered the hospital exodus. A medical biologist said relatives offered to donate blood, but transfusions are prohibited during Ebola outbreaks. After the assault, staff abandoned the hospital, the generator stopped, and several Ebola patients escaped. The incident occurs amid an ongoing DRC Ebola outbreak, which has 2,073 confirmed infections and 796 deaths reported to date.

triage.headline_ja: Reuters報道：コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ患者が暴徒襲撃を受け病院から逃走
triage.triage_reason: 既存の大規模エボラ流行（確定2,073例、死亡796例）の最中に病院襲撃で患者が逃走する異常事態が発生し、感染拡大リスクと医療体制崩壊の懸念があるため。
triage.notes: 病院からのエボラ患者逃走及び医療スタッフの避難により、感染拡大や隔離体制の崩壊が懸念される。既存の大規模流行状況と合わせ、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola spreading in DRC 'faster than any previous outbreak' -- WHO
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is spreading faster than any previous outbreak, with more than 2,000 confirmed cases and 796 deaths since its May 15 declaration, about two months ago. The 17th DRC Ebola outbreak has reached five provinces and extended into neighbouring Uganda. The Bundibugyo species, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment, drives the crisis. WHO notes that about 80% of new cases are detected outside known contact lists, and roughly two-thirds of deaths occur in communities that never received care in a health facility. The outbreak unfolds in a complex, armed-conflict environment; on Wednesday a treatment centre was attacked in Ituri’s capital Bunia. Responders are ramping up, but transmission remains challenging and continues beyond established transmission chains.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、DRCで『過去最速』の拡大 ― WHO
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ(ブンディブジョ株)アウトブレイクが過去最速のペースで拡大し、2000例超・死者796人、隣国ウガンダへも拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの拡大が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。承認されたワクチン・治療法がないブンディブジョ株であること、武装紛争地域での対応の困難さ、80%が接触者リスト外で検出されている点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de ebola já provoca 754 mortes e ultrapassa 2 mil casos na África
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak has already claimed 754 lives and surpassed 2,000 cases in Africa.
article.articleSummary: As of July 16, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo is amid one of its largest Ebola outbreaks, with over 2,000 confirmed cases and 754 deaths. MSF reports unprecedented spread, with infections tripling in under five weeks and deaths quintupled, prompting calls for immediate reinforcement. The outbreak began in April and is now the third-largest Ebola epidemic in the DRC in about five decades. WHO notes roughly 80% of new infections are not linked to known contacts, indicating unknown transmission chains, and many patients die before receiving care. The Bundibugyo variant may have a true burden 2–4 times higher than official counts. There are no approved vaccines or strain-specific treatments, though a clinical antiviral study began this week. Origin of transmission remains under investigation.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行、アフリカで死者754人・感染者2000人超に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で過去50年で3番目に大きいエボラ流行が急拡大しており、感染経路不明の症例が8割を占め、承認済みワクチン・治療薬もないため国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められる。
triage.notes: MSFとWHOが増援を要請しており、感染経路不明の症例が多いことから今後の拡大が懸念される。ワクチン・治療薬未承認のため管理可能性にも課題あり。続報でWHOのPHEIC評価等を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: WHO reports nearly 800 Ebola deaths in Congo two months after outbreak's start
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 2,073 reported cases and 796 deaths, two months after it was declared. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said at a briefing at WHO headquarters in Geneva on July 16, 2026, that the outbreak is the third-largest in the DRC’s recorded history and has spread faster over the past month than any previous Ebola outbreak. The death toll nears 800 as transmission continues across affected areas, prompting ongoing surveillance, response efforts, and sustained international support. These figures illustrate the rapid dynamics of the outbreak and the ongoing public health challenge in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴでのエボラ流行開始から2カ月で死者数約800人に達したと報告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC史上第3位の規模で急速拡大しており、致死率も高く国際的な支援も継続的に求められているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: WHO本部（ジュネーブ、スイス）は会見場所であり発生地域ではないため除外。DRCにおけるエボラ流行が主題。

article.articleHeadline: University of Oxford launches trial of new vaccine for rare deadly virus
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths as of 16 July 2026, with Ituri province—centered on Bunia—hardest hit. WHO reports about 80% of new cases from unknown transmission chains; the WHO IHR Emergency Committee declared a public health emergency of international concern on 17 May 2026, amid ongoing spread since May 15. Oxford University launches first-in-human trials of the ChAdOx1 Ebola BDBV Vaccine (Recombinant) to prevent Bundibugyo virus infection, using technology similar to the Oxford-AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine. The Oxford Vaccine Group will enroll 50 healthy adults aged 18–55 in Headington, Oxford, randomizing to single-dose, two-dose, or saline placebo arms. Group 1 (10 participants) will receive a two-dose schedule with a six-month booster; Group 2 (40) will receive a single dose or placebo. Follow-up for one year; compensation up to £1,200 (group 1) or £790 (group 2).

triage.headline_ja: オックスフォード大学、まれな致死性ウイルスに対する新規ワクチンの試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス流行が2,011例・754名死亡に達し、WHOがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言済みであり、感染経路不明の症例が約8割を占めるなど深刻かつ異常な状況にある。
triage.notes: 記事タイトルはオックスフォード大学のワクチン治験に関するものだが、サマリーの主題はDRCで進行中のPHEIC宣言済みエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)大規模流行である。UK（英国）は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Flu, H1N1 rampant in Kerala; 4,405 cases of influenza reported
article.articleSummary: Kerala reports 4,405 influenza cases and 49 deaths amid widespread influenza A (H1N1) activity this season; trend suggests cases could surpass last year. Four influenza deaths were recorded on Tuesday in Thiruvananthapuram, involving individuals aged 55–85. Surveillance of influenza-like illnesses and severe acute respiratory infections has been intensified, and treatment protocols have been revised. Health officials urge respiratory hygiene, with home care for mild cases and fluids; Oseltamivir is effective against H1N1 and high-risk individuals should seek medical advice and start treatment promptly. High-risk groups include the elderly, those with diabetes, hypertension, asthma, cardiovascular or renal issues, immunocompromised patients, pregnant women, and young children. Older adults may show fewer classic flu signs but face greater risk of severe complications and bacterial pneumonia. Annual flu vaccination remains the best prevention, though protection varies, and vaccines do not guard against non-H1N1 flu-like illnesses.

triage.headline_ja: ケーララ州でインフルエンザ・H1N1が猛威、4,405件のインフルエンザ症例を報告
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1)の症例・死亡増加が報告されているが、既知の病原体であり国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いため、フルRRAには至らないが継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1)の流行拡大であり、既知の病原体・既存の治療法（オセルタミビル）・ワクチンが存在するため、パンデミック相当のリスクは低いと考えられる。高齢者・基礎疾患保有者の死亡例増加に注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de ebola na RDC se propaga 'mais rápido' do que os anteriores, alerta OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the DRC is spreading faster than previous outbreaks, WHO warns.
article.articleSummary: 2,003 Ebola cases and 796 deaths reported in the Democratic Republic of Congo as of July 16, 2026, two months after outbreak declaration. WHO warns the Bundibugyo variant outbreak is spreading faster than any prior Ebola outbreak, ranking as the third-largest on record. The northeast Ituri province is the epicenter, with more than 80% of new cases detected outside existing contact lists, hindering tracing and containment. There is no vaccine or approved treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola virus; however, the WHO has initiated clinical trials this month with two therapeutics: MBP134 monoclonal antibody and the antiviral remdesivir, used alone or in combination. By comparison, the 2018–2020 outbreak in the DRC reached about 2,000 cases in over 10 months and caused roughly 2,300 deaths among 3,500 cases. No details on imported/exported cases are provided.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、過去最速のペースで拡大とWHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国で過去最速のペースで拡大し、症例の80%以上が接触者リスト外で検出され封じ込めが困難な状況であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準共に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 承認されたワクチン・治療薬がないブンディブギョ株による流行で、過去のエボラ流行と比較しても拡大速度が異例に速い。WHOによる治験開始など国際支援の動きあり。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en RD Congo se propaga "más rápido" que los precedentes, alerta la OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in DR Congo is spreading "faster" than previous outbreaks, WHO warns.
article.articleSummary: As of July 16, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading faster than any previous epidemic and is the third-largest Ebola outbreak on record. Since its declaration two months ago, it has reached 2,003 cases and 796 deaths. The 2018–2020 outbreak in the DRC involved about 3,500 cases and nearly 2,300 deaths, making this current event particularly alarming due to its rapid growth. The principal hotspot is Ituri province in the northeast, where more than 80% of new cases are detected outside known contact lists, complicating tracing efforts. There is no vaccine or treatment for the Bundibugyo variant driving this outbreak, but clinical trials began this month of MBP134 monoclonal antibody and the antiviral remdesivir, alone or in combination.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、WHOが「過去最速」の拡大速度を警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで史上3番目の規模に急拡大し、80%以上が接触者リスト外で発生するなど制御困難な状況であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大なシグナル。
triage.notes: ワクチン・治療薬が存在しないBundibugyo variantによる流行で、モノクローナル抗体MBP134とレムデシビルの臨床試験が開始されたばかり。2018-2020年流行を上回るペースで拡大しており、フルRRAが必要。

article.articleHeadline: 高雄登革熱境外移入增至11例　大寮區病媒蚊陽性率上升　校園查獲4處孳生源 - OwlNews
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Imported dengue fever cases in Kaohsiung rise to 11; Daliao District vector mosquito positivity rate increases; four breeding sites found on campuses - OwlNews.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 July 2026, Kaohsiung City Health Bureau reports 18 confirmed dengue cases this year: 7 locally transmitted and 11 imported. The latest imported cases are in the Daliao District: a 27-year-old Vietnamese migrant and a 21-year-old Cambodian student returning from abroad and developing fever, myalgia, and arthralgia; NS1 positive and PCR confirmed dengue virus infection. Cumulatively, 11 imported and 7 locally acquired cases have been recorded this year. Campus inspections found four dengue-positive breeding containers (water wells, buckets, flower pots, basins) requiring cleanup. In week 27, the district's Aedes mosquito positivity rate reached 10%, up from week 26, with rainfall increasing standing water and transmission risk. Authorities urge schools to inspect campuses during summer and promote Summer Battle Against Imported Dengue program, offering free repellent and a 500 NT voucher for eligible returnees. Clinicians should screen travelers with fever or musculoskeletal pain for dengue and report travel history.

triage.headline_ja: 高雄の登革熱、国外由来感染者が11例に増加　大寮区の媒介蚊陽性率上昇　学内で4カ所の発生源発見
triage.triage_reason: 台湾高雄市における登革熱の輸入例・局地感染例の通常の季節的サーベイランス報告であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 台湾（高雄市）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。記事中のフィリピン・ベトナム・カンボジアは輸入症例の出身地として言及されているのみで、実際の発生国ではないため、いずれも対象国リストに該当する国での主題イベントとは認められない。

article.articleHeadline: After Vietnam, India develops its own vaccine against African Swine Fever - The Tribune
article.articleSummary: India has developed its own indigenous MA-104 Cell-Based Live Attenuated African Swine Fever (ASF) vaccine for pigs, announced by Union Agriculture Minister Shivraj Chouhan at the ICAR’s 98 Foundation Day. The vaccine, created by ICAR-NIHSAD in Bhopal, uses an Indian field isolate and marks a milestone in disease preparedness and self-reliance in livestock health. African Swine Fever is a highly contagious viral disease with near-100% mortality in domestic and wild pigs. After Vietnam, India now has an indigenous ASF vaccine; globally, ASF vaccines are licensed and circulating in Vietnam, while clinical trials or emergency import approvals are underway in the Philippines, Indonesia, Malaysia, and Myanmar. Previously, India relied on strict farm biosecurity and culling. ICAR envisions broader technology transfer and aims to strengthen self-reliance through commercialisation of vaccines and licensing, reducing dependence on government funding.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムに続きインドがアフリカ豚熱の独自ワクチンを開発
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はインドにおけるアフリカ豚熱（ASF）ワクチンの自国開発という前向きな技術進展のニュースであり、新規アウトブレイクの発生報告ではない。ASFはヒトに感染しない動物疾病であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はインドでのASFワクチン開発発表が主題。ベトナム・フィリピン・インドネシア・マレーシア・ミャンマーは各国のワクチン導入状況の文脈として言及されているのみで、当該国での新規アウトブレイク発生を報じるものではないため除外した。ASFはヒトに感染しない家畜疾病であり、IHR/WPRO基準上のヒト公衆衛生リスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: Vall Companys factura 4.626 milions i activa un pla de contingència per la pesta porcina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vall Companys bills 4.626 million and activates a contingency plan for swine fever.
article.articleSummary: Vall Companys posted 2025 revenue of 4.626 billion euros and a net profit of 245.4 million euros (net margin 5.3% on third-party sales), consolidating leadership in Spain’s agri-food sector. Following the African swine fever (ASF) outbreak declared in Serra de Collserola on 28 November 2025, the group activated a contingency plan: a 61 million euro provision, dividend cut to 36 million (from 72), and 2026 capex trimmed from 190 to 85 million. ASF dealt a severe blow to the Spanish pork sector, causing full market closures (Japan, Mexico) and partial/regionalized access (China, Philippines), with prices collapsing at Mercolleida. In 2025, 35% of pork production was exported, mainly to Central Europe ahead of Asian markets; flour and poultry sales remained largely domestic (~10% exports). The group invested 193.2 million euros in modernization (cumulative 600 million since 2020). Latin America expansion continued with 2026 deals in Chile and Argentina and a 14 million USD subordinated loan. 17,336 direct jobs (+20.3%) and 155.95 million euros in taxes/Social Security.

triage.headline_ja: Vall Companysが46億2600万ユーロを計上、豚熱に対する緊急対応計画を発動
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はスペインで発生したASF（アフリカ豚熱）による大手食肉企業の財務・経営対応を報じる企業ニュースであり、対象国での実際の発生事例ではない。中国・フィリピンは輸入制限（貿易影響）としてのみ言及されている。
triage.notes: 発生地域はスペイン（Serra de Collserola）であり、対象国リストに含まれない。中国・フィリピン・日本・メキシコは輸入規制措置の対象として言及されているのみで、当該国内での発生ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Συναγερμός από τον ΠΟΥ: "Η επιδημία Έμπολα στη ΛΔ του Κονγκό εξαπλώνεται ταχύτερα σε σύγκριση με τις προηγούμενες"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alert from the WHO: "The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading faster than previous outbreaks."
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is expanding faster than any previous outbreak, per WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. Declared in mid-May, the epidemic has surpassed 2,000 confirmed cases and 796 deaths as of July 16, 2026, making it the third largest Ebola outbreak on record. The report emphasizes accelerated transmission in recent months compared with earlier waves. The article does not provide details on infection sources, laboratory confirmation, or imported/exported cases. This situation underscores the urgent need for intensified public health response in the DRC to curb transmission and prevent further spread within the country.

triage.headline_ja: WHOからの警告:「コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行は過去の流行と比較してより速く拡大している」
triage.triage_reason: WHO事務局長が過去最速の拡大と警告する大規模エボラ流行で、2000例超・796人死亡と重篤性が高く、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長による公式声明があり、感染規模・死亡者数・拡大速度から史上3番目に大きいエボラ流行とされる。続報でのRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Vall Companys eleva su negocio en Aragón hasta los 941 millones pese al impacto de la peste porcina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vall Companys boosts its business in Aragon to 941 million euros despite the impact of swine fever.
article.articleSummary: African swine fever (ASF) outbreak declared in late November 2025 led to the closure of major international pork markets, including Japan, Mexico, China and the Philippines, impacting Vall Companys’ earnings. In 2025, its Aragón region generated 941 million euros in revenue, up 4.1%, about 20.3% of the group’s 4.626 billion euros; group revenue rose 12%. The company employed 2,713 in Aragón and invested 14.6 million there. To mitigate ASF effects, Vall Companys booked a 61 million euro provision for livestock inventory devaluation, cut the planned dividend from 72 to 36 million, and reduced 2026 investments from 190 to 85 million. Despite headwinds, Aragón investments continued across six production centers and a distribution warehouse in Ejea de los Caballeros, Tardienta, Sástago, Zaragoza and Calamocha, including the Cárnicas Cinco Villas slaughterhouse and Jamcal. International expansion proceeded in 2026 with Chile (Coexca) and Argentina (Grupo Pacuca), plus the Biovall Heparine Science project with Bioibérica.

triage.headline_ja: Vall Companys社、豚熱の影響にもかかわらずアラゴン州での事業を9億4100万ユーロに拡大
triage.triage_reason: スペイン・アラゴン州における2025年11月発生のASFに関する企業業績記事であり、対象国（日本・中国・フィリピン等）は輸出停止先として言及されているのみで、実際の発生国はスペイン（対象国リスト外）。新規の公衆衛生シグナルではない。
triage.notes: 記事はスペイン・アラゴン州の食肉企業の財務業績に関する経済ニュースであり、ASF自体は既に2025年11月に発生した既知の事象。中国・フィリピン等は輸出市場の閉鎖先として言及されているのみで、発生国はスペイン（対象国リスト外）のため verified_locations は空。

article.articleHeadline: Idosa passa por cirurgia no joelho e morre dias depois por infecção em Campo Grande - Boca do Povo News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Elderly woman undergoes knee surgery and dies days later from infection in Campo Grande - Boca do Povo News
article.articleSummary: 79-year-old woman dies from a knee infection after knee surgery for a fracture at Hospital El Kadri in Campo Grande, Brazil. The death occurred in the early hours of Wednesday, July 15, 2026. She had been discharged post-surgery, then returned three days later to seek care at another hospital with an infection in the knee and died after several days of hospitalization. The case is registered as a death by atypical fact at the Cepol precinct in Campo Grande and is under investigation. The report notes a postoperative knee infection as the cause of death; no laboratory confirmation or additional details on the infection source are provided.

triage.headline_ja: カンポ・グランデで膝の手術を受けた高齢女性、数日後に感染症で死亡 - Boca do Povo News
triage.triage_reason: 個別の術後感染による死亡例であり、公衆衛生上の異常性や拡大リスク、社会的関心の高まりを示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 単一症例の術後感染による死亡であり、病原体不明・アウトブレイクの兆候なし。地元警察による異常死としての捜査対象だが公衆衛生イベントではない。

article.articleHeadline: Flu Singapura Merebak di Sumsel, Mengapa Palembang Jadi Daerah dengan Kasus Terbanyak?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Singapore Flu Spreads in South Sumatra: Why Has Palembang Become the Area with the Most Cases?
article.articleSummary: HFMD (Hand, Foot and Mouth Disease) outbreaks surged in South Sumatra, Indonesia, with Palembang recording the most cases. By week 23 (end of June 2026), 628 HFMD cases were reported province-wide; Palembang accounted for 118 cases, the highest share. Other districts followed: PALI 82; Musi Banyuasin and Prabumulih 78 each; Muara Enim 65; Lahat 62; Lubuk Linggau 54; Empat Lawang, OKU Timur, and Musi Rawas Utara with 3 each. The spike began in April 2026, linked to seasonal transition and inadequate hygiene practices. HFMD is a viral disease primarily affecting children under five to seven years, though adults can be infected. Palembang’s high mobility and numerous child gathering venues—schools, playgrounds, shopping centers, and indoor spaces—likely drive transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 南スマトラでシンガポールインフルエンザ(手足口病)が拡大、なぜパレンバンが最多の感染地域になったのか？
triage.triage_reason: 手足口病(HFMD)はインドネシア南スマトラで季節性の流行として報告されており、重症化や死亡例の記載はなく、IHR基準は該当しないが、子供を中心とした感染拡大の可能性があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 季節的な手足口病(HFMD)の流行報告であり、重症例や死亡の言及はない。地域メディアによる報道のみで、国際的関心や渡航制限の兆候は見られない。フランス(Paris)は発生地域リストに含まれるが記事の主題ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Rio Branco aparece entre capitais com alerta para casos de síndrome respiratória
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rio Branco among capitals under alert for cases of respiratory syndrome.
article.articleSummary: Fiocruz’s InfoGripe bulletin for Epidemiological Week 27 (5–11 July 2026) shows Acre state in Brazil with elevated Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) activity. Rio Branco, the state capital, is among five capitals (also Aracaju, Campo Grande, Goiânia, and Porto Alegre) with SRAG at alert, risk or high risk, displaying a long-term upward trend over six weeks. National SRAG cases are declining overall, driven by reduced hospitalizations from respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), though RSV remains circulating at high levels. In 2026 Brazil has recorded 115,203 SRAG cases, with 60,200 testing positive for a respiratory virus. Among confirmed infections, RSV represents 40.2%, rhinovirus 30.2%, influenza A 20.8%, influenza B 4.5%, and COVID-19 4.5%. RSV is a major contributor to bronchiolitis in young children.

triage.headline_ja: リオブランコ、呼吸器症候群警戒対象の州都に含まれる
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの季節性重症急性呼吸器症候群(SRAG)サーベイランス報告であり、RSV・インフルエンザによる通常の季節変動として説明可能。異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: FiocruzのInfoGripe週報に基づく国内サーベイランス情報。RSV・ライノウイルス・インフルエンザA/Bなど既知の季節性病原体による小児気管支炎等が主体で、全国的にはSRAG症例数は減少傾向。一部州都（リオブランコ含む）で上昇傾向が見られるが、季節性変動の範囲内と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Ebola - Jean-Marc Mambidi Koloboro exige des mesures urgentes et concrètes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo-Kinshasa: Ebola - Jean-Marc Mambidi Koloboro demands urgent and concrete measures.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has recorded over 2,000 cases and more than 740 deaths across five provinces: North Kivu, South Kivu, Ituri, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo. Parliamentarian Dr. Jean-Marc Mambidi Koloboro (Watsa, Haut-Uele) urged urgent, concrete containment measures after the Health Public Minister’s briefing to the National Assembly. Despite about 54 million USD mobilized for the response, field challenges include non-payment of health workers, strikes, and shortages of personal protective equipment. He called for stronger funding with technical and financial partners to ensure robust follow-up of contacts to interrupt transmission. Citizens are urged to remain vigilant, as no province is immune in this ongoing Ebola outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ－ジャン=マルク・マンビディ・コロボロ議員が緊急かつ具体的な対策を要求
triage.triage_reason: 5州にまたがる2,000例超・740名超の死亡を記録する大規模エボラ流行であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるため、フルRRAに進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 医療従事者への未払い、ストライキ、PPE不足など対応体制の脆弱性が指摘されており、資金・技術支援の必要性が明示されている。北キブ州も影響地域として言及されているが対象国リストの発生地域は一括してDRCとして扱う。

article.articleHeadline: Vall Companys factura 4.626 millones y activa un plan de contingencia por la peste porcina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vall Companys invoices 4.626 million and activates a contingency plan due to swine fever.
article.articleSummary: African swine fever (ASF) outbreak declared November 28, 2025 in the Collserola hills near Barcelona triggers contingency measures at Vall Companys. 2025 revenue reached €4.626 billion, up 11% YoY, but net profit fell to €245.4 million (5.3% net margin). The plan included a €61 million provision, dividend cut to €36 million, and cutting 2026 capex from €190 million to €85 million. ASF triggered full pork exports bans in Japan and Mexico and partial blocks in China and the Philippines, pressuring Mercolleida prices. In 2025, 35% of pork production was exported, chiefly to Central Europe; the flour and poultry division exported ~10%. Vall Companys expanded in Latin America in 2026, signing Chile (Coexca via Master Agroindustrial) and Argentina (Grupo Pacuca) deals with a US$14 million participative credit. The group ended 2025 with 17,336 direct jobs and €155.95 million in taxes and social security.

triage.headline_ja: Vall Companys社、豚熱（アフリカ豚熱）により46億2600万ユーロの売上を計上し、緊急対応計画を発動
triage.triage_reason: ASF発生地はスペイン・カタルーニャ地方であり、対象国リストに該当しない。記事は企業の経済的影響に関する内容で、対象国（日本・メキシコ・中国・フィリピン）は輸出規制の対象として言及されているに過ぎず、発生国ではない。
triage.notes: ASF発生地はスペイン（Catalunya/Barcelona）であり、CEPR対象国リストに含まれない。日本・メキシコ・中国・フィリピンは輸出禁止/規制措置の対象国として言及されているのみで、疾病発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外。動物疾病であり人への直接的健康被害はないため、公衆衛生上の懸念は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de ebola na RDC se propaga 'mais rápido' do que os anteriores, alerta OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the DRC spreads 'faster' than previous outbreaks, WHO warns.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) caused by the Bundibugyo variant is spreading faster than any previous epidemic. Declared two months ago, it has reached 2,003 cases and 796 deaths. Ituri province in the northeast remains the epicenter, with more than 80% of new cases detected outside known contact lists. There is no vaccine or approved treatment for Bundibugyo; however, the World Health Organization (WHO) has begun clinical trials in July 2026 of two therapies: MBP134 monoclonal antibody and remdesivir, given alone or in combination. The WHO director-general Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus called it the third-largest Ebola outbreak on record, noting that the 2018 outbreak took over 10 months to reach 2,000 cases and ultimately caused roughly 2,300 deaths among about 3,500 cases (2018–2020).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、過去よりも『速く』拡大とWHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで急速に拡大し、既に2,003例・796死亡と過去最大級の流行規模に達しており、ワクチン・承認治療薬もないため国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 80%以上の新規症例が既知の接触者リスト外で検出されており、感染源追跡が困難な状況。WHOは過去最大級の流行と評価し、臨床試験薬の投入を開始。致死率は約40%と高い。

article.articleHeadline: WHO警告：剛果民主共和國伊波拉疫情傳播速度創歷史新高 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo spreading at a record pace - Ming Shi News Network
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak spreading at record pace: since May 15 in Ituri, the 17th Ebola outbreak has surpassed 2,000 confirmed cases and 796 deaths across five provinces and into Uganda, though most cases remain in Ituri. Ebola spreads mainly via close contact and infected bodily fluids. WHO has expanded capacity to 800 treatment beds and 16 laboratories, yet transmission outpaces response; more than 80% of new cases are identified outside known contacts and about two-thirds of deaths occur in communities without care. The outbreak is caused by the rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, with no approved vaccine or therapy yet. Trials include monoclonal MBP134, antivirals remdesivir and obeldesivir, and Oxford University’s ChAdOx1 vaccine safety trial. Ongoing conflict in Ituri hampers response; a Bunia treatment center was attacked. Funding gap for WHO-Africa CDC plan exceeds $400 million.

triage.headline_ja: WHO警告：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱、過去最速のペースで拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC5州とウガンダに拡大し、2000例超・死者796人と深刻化。ワクチン未承認で紛争地域での対応困難という異常事態であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの感染拡大が報告されているが、対象国リストにウガンダは含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCが主な発生地域として明確に特定される。承認済みワクチン・治療法がなく、資金不足（4億ドル超）と紛争による対応困難が深刻度を高めている。

article.articleHeadline: В Конго толпа разгромила больницу, где лечились пациенты с Эболой
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, a mob ransacked a hospital where Ebola patients were being treated.
article.articleSummary: In Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of Congo, a mob attacked and ransacked a hospital treating Ebola patients. The incident followed the death of a woman who came to give birth but died from anemia; relatives wanted a blood transfusion, which staff refused due to Ebola outbreak restrictions. After the death, the attack escalated; the facility lost power when the generator was damaged, and staff and patients, including those with Ebola, fled. The army said it would investigate. Samaritan's Purse said it would evacuate its personnel from the nearby Ebola treatment center. As of July 16, 2026, the World Health Organization has declared the Congo-Uganda Ebola outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern since May 2026. Congo has reported over 2,000 infections and about 800 deaths. The outbreak involves a rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, for which a vaccine is under development.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ患者が治療されていた病院を暴徒が破壊
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言した希少株（ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス）による大規模流行下で、病院への暴徒襲撃により患者が逃走・治療体制が崩壊しており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: 記事にはウガンダも発生地域として記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。病院襲撃による治療中断・患者逃走はエボラ拡散リスクをさらに高める重大事案。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : plus de 2 000 cas d'Ebola dont 754 décès
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: over 2,000 Ebola cases, including 754 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) worsens, with over 2,000 confirmed cases and 754 deaths reported. In a July 15, 2026 MSF statement, the Bundibugyo strain is driving the third-largest Ebola epidemic in the DRC, with cases tripling from 650 to about 2,000 in under five weeks and deaths quintupled from about 130 to over 700 by July 12. The outbreak is spreading geographically beyond major cities, amid limited access to care, overwhelmed surveillance, and mounting pressure on treatment centers. MSF urges Congolese authorities and international partners to rapidly scale up the response across all fronts—community engagement, surveillance, screening/diagnosis, patient care, survivor support, and safe, dignified handling of remains and burials—while ensuring other urgent health needs are addressed. The WHO has launched the first antiviral trial against Bundibugyo, for which no vaccine or specific treatment exists.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:エボラ症例2,000人超、うち754人死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCで急拡大するエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)アウトブレイクであり、症例・死亡者数が急増し地理的にも拡大しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: MSFとWHOが介入し、ワクチン・特異的治療薬がない中で抗ウイルス薬治験が開始されている。致死率が高く、症例数が短期間で急増している点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Odisha: Over 40 hospitalised following gastroenteritis outbreak in Kendrapara
article.articleSummary: As of 16 July 2026, a gastroenteritis outbreak in Kendrapara district, Odisha, has hospitalized 44 people from Lokapada, Chandiagadi, Giribandha, Padanapur and Demala villages in Aul block. More than 40 individuals were admitted to the community health centre in Aul with vomiting, diarrhoea, stomach cramps and weakness. District teams collected water and stool samples and sent them to a Cuttack laboratory to identify the causative agent. Health workers are conducting door-to-door surveillance, distributing ORS packets, and advising residents to drink boiled water and maintain hygiene. Officials suspect contaminated drinking water from uncovered wells and storage tanks as the trigger. Adequate medicine stocks exist and preventive measures have been intensified in the affected villages. No lab confirmation yet; the outbreak remains under close surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: オディシャ州:ケンドラパラ郡で胃腸炎の集団発生、40人以上が入院
triage.triage_reason: 地域的な水系感染疑いの胃腸炎集団発生で入院者が多いが、原因病原体は未特定で国際的拡大の懸念は低く、継続的な情報収集が必要。
triage.notes: 汚染された飲料水（未被覆の井戸・貯水タンク）が原因と疑われており、水系感染症としての性質が強い。ラボ確認待ちで病原体は未特定。地元当局により対応中で、外部支援の必要性は現時点で示唆されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Death Toll in DR Congo Reaches 796 - WHO Chief
article.articleSummary: Ebola death toll in DR Congo reaches 796, according to the WHO Chief, as of 16 July 2026. The article’s published date is 2026-07-16. Beyond the headline figure, the body concentrates on transport-time reductions and regional integration in Africa (notably Botswana and Namibia), offering no additional epidemiological details. No information is provided on new cases, symptoms, laboratory confirmation, infection sources, or vaccination status. The piece thus presents the Ebola tally as a headline datum rather than elaborating outbreak dynamics or containment measures. In sum, Ebola-related data are limited to the stated death toll and location, with the remainder of the text focusing on infrastructure and trade topics in southern Africa.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ死者数、796人に達す－WHO事務局長
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱による死者数が796人に達しており、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響を伴う継続中のアウトブレイクであるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事本文はボツワナ・ナミビアとの地域統合や輸送時間短縮に関する内容が中心で、エボラの症例詳細（新規感染者数、感染源、ワクチン接種状況等）は記載されていない。ボツワナ・ナミビアはエボラとは無関係の文脈で言及されているため、verified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS asegura que el brote de ébola en la R.D. del Congo no está fuera de control
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO says the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is not out of control.
article.articleSummary: WHO says the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is not out of control, though the situation remains very difficult due to insecurity, population displacement, and challenges in getting patients to health facilities. Emergency director Chikwe Ihekweazu, returning from a field visit to Ituri (the outbreak epicenter), said the response is a marathon requiring sustained effort and resources. The agency estimates that of 50 new daily cases, 30–40 individuals may have remained ill for weeks and died without seeking care, identified only through samples taken before burial. Hospital capacity has been expanded to over 800 beds for Ebola patients, improving survival when patients are quickly moved to treatment centers. In Ituri, armed conflict hampers access, contact tracing, and epidemiological surveillance. Violence has displaced over 100,000 recently, adding to about one million displaced previously. Despite challenges, teams are strengthening infection prevention and control and coordinating daily with the Congolese Ministry of Health.

triage.headline_ja: WHOはコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱の発生は制御不能ではないと発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の継続的な流行であり、紛争による対応困難、多数の未発見死亡例、人口移動を伴うことからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: イトゥリ州における武力紛争が対応・監視を著しく妨げており、1日50例中30-40例が未治療のまま死亡していると推定される点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Gates Medical Research Institute, Serum Institute ink agreement to manufacture novel TB vaccine
article.articleSummary: TB vaccine candidate M72/AS01E moves into manufacturing under a pact between Gates Medical Research Institute and Serum Institute of India (SII). SII will invest over $100 million to strengthen readiness and capacity to support potential supply in high TB burden countries. SII was chosen for its track record with WHO-prequalified vaccines and ability to produce at scale affordably and to rigorous standards; local manufacturing in Indonesia and South Africa will support the supply chain. Technology transfer for antigen manufacture has begun; GSK will supply the AS01E adjuvant. Gates MRI sponsors Phase III, funded by Gates Foundation and Wellcome. Phase III began March 2024, enrolling 20,000 participants at 54 sites. Sites in South Africa, Kenya, Malawi, Zambia and Indonesia. 2b showed ~50% protection against progression to active pulmonary TB in HIV-negative adults 18–50. WHO estimates impact: 76 million TB cases prevented, 8.5 million lives saved, and $41.5 billion over 25 years.

triage.headline_ja: ゲイツ医学研究所とセラム・インスティテュートが新規結核ワクチンの製造契約を締結
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は結核ワクチン（M72/AS01E）の製造・供給体制構築に関する製薬業界ニュースであり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクや症例急増を報告するものではないため、シグナルとして取り扱う必要はない。
triage.notes: 本記事は結核（TB）ワクチンの製造契約・臨床試験進捗に関する内容であり、疾患のアウトブレイクを報告するものではない。ザンビア、インドネシア、インドは治験実施国・製造拠点として言及されているが、実際の感染症発生イベントではないため、参考情報として記載するに留める。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Ebola outbreak disrupting US-backed minerals deal, sources say
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, which has killed almost 800 people, is disrupting a major US-backed minerals partnership. Travel restrictions and quarantines hinder staff movement as suppliers, consultants and investors postpone visits, delaying expansion of the US-Congo Strategic Partnership Agreement signed in 2025 to counter China investments. Congo remains the world's top cobalt producer and second-largest copper supplier, with deposits of germanium, lithium and tantalum. The US and China have expanded minerals deals with Kinshasa. The US Embassy in Kinshasa has urged Americans not to travel and warned quarantines of up to 21 days at personal cost. The State Department cites progress on the Lobito Corridor and facilitating US investment. Sources say a Washington meeting to review US company interest was postponed; discussions continue in Paris and Brussels, with a July review canceled due to travel constraints.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行、米国支援の鉱物取引に支障
triage.triage_reason: DRCで約800人が死亡する大規模エボラ流行が発生し、渡航制限や検疫により国際的な鉱物取引・投資活動にも支障が出ており、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ流行が米国主導の鉱物パートナーシップに与える経済的・外交的影響を中心に報じており、発生国はDRCのみ。ブリュッセルやパリ、米国は協議・外交対応の場として言及されているに過ぎず、発生地域ではない。死者数約800人という規模から重大な公衆衛生イベントと判断し、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola spreading in DR Congo 'faster than any previous outbreak': WHO - Africa - World
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo spreading faster than any previous event. By 2026-07-16, there are 2,000+ confirmed cases and 796 deaths since the outbreak was declared on 2026-05-15 in Ituri, northeastern DR Congo amid armed conflict. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in DR Congo, with spread across five provinces and into neighboring Uganda. The causative virus is the rare Bundibugyo species, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. Transmission occurs through close contact and infected bodily fluids. Response challenges include more than 80% of new cases detected outside known contact lists, and about two-thirds of deaths occurring in communities without health-facility care. The outbreak unfolds in a complex environment, with a treatment centre attacked in Bunia, Ituri. Cross-border transmission risk to Uganda underscores ongoing international threat.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が「過去のどの流行よりも速く」拡大：WHO
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目、WPRO基準5項目すべてに該当し、WHOも異例の速さでの拡大と警告している重大なアウトブレイクであるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境伝播リスクが指摘されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。武力紛争下での対応困難、承認済みワクチン・治療薬がないブンディブギョ種による流行である点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: نساند الدول المجاورة لتعزيز قدراتها على اكتشاف إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: We support neighboring countries to strengthen their capacity to detect Ebola.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said at a Geneva briefing that WHO will continue helping neighboring countries, including South Sudan, strengthen Ebola detection, diagnosis, and health-worker training. He noted the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s 21-day waiting period for travelers from infected areas, implemented to reduce virus spread after a health worker was infected in France. He emphasized reducing public anxiety while enabling travel and trade in line with Emergency Committee recommendations, using a risk-based approach. The measures are part of broader efforts to prevent transmission, especially after 2,073 Ebola cases were reported. WHO is working with governments to balance public health protection with timely entry of experts and international support.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：近隣諸国のエボラ検出能力強化を支援
triage.triage_reason: DRCで2,073例のエボラ症例が報告されており、フランスでの医療従事者感染や渡航制限措置など国際的拡大・貿易渡航制限に関わる事案であるためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事はWHO事務局長によるジュネーブでのブリーフィング内容で、DRCのエボラアウトブレイク（2,073例）とフランスでの医療従事者感染後の渡航制限措置について言及。スーダン・フランス・スイスは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。
