article.articleHeadline: Região de Ribeirão Preto tem 1º caso de gripe aviária em ave silvestre de SP em 2026 - ACidade ON Ribeirão Preto
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ribeirão Preto region records first case of avian influenza in a wild bird in São Paulo in 2026 - ACidade ON Ribeirão Preto
article.articleSummary: First case of highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) in a wild bird in São Paulo state, Brazil, confirmed in the Ribeirão Preto region. The LFDA-SP verified IAAP in a wild heron (Irerê, also called marreca-viúva or paturi) rescued in an urban area and sent to Guaíra Zoo (Barretos region). Samples were collected July 8; confirmation announced July 15. Sanitary measures include restricting animal movement at the zoo, epidemiological investigation, and active surveillance within 10 km of the initial site (three farms; two currently in sanitary empty period with no birds). Public guidance states that consuming poultry and eggs does not transmit the disease; avoid handling sick birds and follow official veterinary guidance. As of July 16, 2026, no human cases have been reported in São Paulo. Surveillance continues for individuals involved in notification; contact Ribeirão Preto’s Regional Department of Defesa Agropecuária at (16) 3603-8789 for suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州リベイラン・プレット地域で2026年初の野鳥における鳥インフルエンザ症例
triage.triage_reason: 野鳥における高病原性鳥インフルエンザ確認事例で人への感染はなく、家禽業への影響も限定的だが、動物衛生上の監視継続が必要なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 野鳥1羽での確認事例であり、人への感染報告なし。周辺農場の監視は継続中だが、現時点で家禽業や公衆衛生への深刻な影響は見られない。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية ندعم الدول المجاورة لتعزيز قدراتها على الكشف المبكر عن إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO supports neighboring countries to strengthen their capacities for early detection of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: July 16, 2026 – The World Health Organization (WHO) is helping neighboring countries, including South Sudan, strengthen early detection, diagnosis, and health-worker training for Ebola virus disease (EVD) in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). In Geneva, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said the response uses risk-based measures, including a 21-day window for anyone who has lived in an outbreak area before leaving the DRC; exemptions exist for international staff and some domestic travel to avoid hampering responders. With more than 2,073 EVD cases reported in the DRC, experts say the true number could be 2–4 times higher and warn of possible spread to South Sudan and other neighbors. WHO and partners are expanding rapid diagnostics, traveler-information at entry/exit points, and frontline training, while Bunia-based health workers pursue care and safe burials. Funding remains under 30% of the response goal, which seeks zero infections.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラウイルス病の早期探知能力強化のため近隣諸国を支援
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で2,073例以上のエボラ症例が報告され、近隣国への拡大懸念とWHOによる渡航関連措置（21日間の観察期間）が導入されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ流行とWHOによる南スーダンなど近隣国への支援策について述べている。ジュネーブはWHO本部所在地として言及されているのみで発生地ではない。南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Bactéria achada em detergentes da Ypê é encontrada em água mineral Mamba Water; venda é suspensa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A bacterium found in Ypê detergents has been found in Mamba Water mineral water; sale is suspended
article.articleSummary: As of 16 July 2026, Brazil's Anvisa suspended sale of Mamba Water after routine testing found Pseudomonas aeruginosa. Affected 350 ml still water batches 13 and 14, produced 3–4 April and expiring April 2027, are being recalled. The same bacterium has appeared in Ypê and Crystal products, prompting prior recalls. About 82% of the implicated lots have been blocked; no consumer infections have been reported. The contamination was identified by HNK BR Indústria de Bebidas Ltda.; refunds can be arranged via SAC at contato@mambawater.com.br or 0800 888 1090 (Mon–Sat, 9h–21h). Pseudomonas aeruginosa is common in industrial settings and can pose serious risk to immunocompromised individuals, causing infections ranging from fever, chills, and fatigue to cough-with-difficulty breathing, urinary symptoms, skin infections, eye/ear issues, diarrhea, or vomiting, potentially leading to sepsis or organ failure. High-risk groups include cancer patients, transplant recipients, uncontrolled HIV, long-term corticosteroid use, autoimmune disease, diabetes, and hospitalized patients.

triage.headline_ja: Ypêの洗剤で見つかった細菌がMamba Waterのミネラルウォーターからも検出され、販売停止に
triage.triage_reason: 製品回収事例で感染者報告なし、ヒト-ヒト感染の懸念もなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は認められない。
triage.notes: HIVは高リスク群の例示として言及されているのみで、感染症流行イベントではなく製品回収・食品安全事案。消費者感染の報告なし。

article.articleHeadline: OMS alerta que surto de Ébola é o mais rápido de sempre na RDCongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns that the Ebola outbreak is the fastest on record in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak, declared in May in Ituri province, is spreading faster than any prior outbreak, the WHO director-general said on 2026-07-16. The Bundibugyo strain is responsible, with 2,003 cases and 796 deaths reported to date; the 2018–2020 outbreak reached about 2,300 deaths among 3,500 cases. More than 80% of new infections are detected outside known contact lists in Ituri, implying transmission chains elude surveillance; about two-thirds of deaths occur in communities with limited health facilities. Capacity has expanded to over 800 beds, 60 laboratories, and roughly 80% contact follow-up. There is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo, but trials have begun for MBP134 and remdesivir, and a ChAdOx1 vaccine safety study started this week. Obeldesivir post-exposure prophylaxis trials are also underway. Uganda reports 2 deaths in 20 cases but currently no active cases. Transmission is via bodily fluids, causing hemorrhagic fever.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行は過去最速のペースで拡大していると警告
triage.triage_reason: WHO事務局長が過去最速のエボラ流行拡大を警告しており、感染連鎖が監視網をすり抜けている(80%が接触者リスト外)など、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの症例(2死亡/20例、現在活動症例なし)も報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。ワクチン未承認で治療法も限定的、複数の治験(MBP134, remdesivir, ChAdOx1, obeldesivir)が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Hong Kong's COVID‑19 activity surges to one‑year high, with 45 severe adult cases and 7 deaths recorded - Dimsum Daily
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong reports COVID‑19 activity at a one‑year high, with 45 severe adult cases and 7 deaths in the past four weeks as cases rise since June. SARS‑CoV‑2 positivity reached 9.79% (5–11 July) and wastewater concentrations about 500,000 copies per litre. Influenza season has begun, with 8.75% positivity and 0.55 hospital admissions per 10,000; influenza A (H3) 53%, A (H1) 33%, B 14%. The prevailing local SARS‑CoV‑2 strains are NB.1.8.1 and PQ.16.1.1. About 80% of severe COVID‑19 cases involve individuals aged 65+, and over 90% have pre‑existing conditions; none had booster doses in the prior six months. Officials warn of a new cyclical wave and urge high‑risk groups to wear masks and maintain hygiene. Vaccination: boosters advised six months after last dose or infection; current vaccines for 12+ available until Sept 5 while a new batch is procured; vaccination for children 6 months–11 years to resume in Q4 after stock arrives.

triage.headline_ja: 香港のCOVID‑19活動が1年ぶりの高水準に急増、成人重症例45件・死亡7件を記録
triage.triage_reason: COVID‑19重症例・死亡の増加とインフルエンザ流行開始が重なり、当局が新たな流行波を警告しており、行政・社会的関心が高いためフルRRAでの精査が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性のCOVID‑19再流行とインフルエンザシーズン開始について述べており、香港特別行政区の情報は中国(China)として集約。重症・死亡は主に高齢者・基礎疾患保有者に集中しており、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda cere ridicarea restricțiilor de călătorie după externarea ultimului pacient cu Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda calls for the lifting of travel restrictions after the discharge of the last Ebola patient.
article.articleSummary: Uganda discharges the last confirmed Ebola patient, a Congolese national treated at Mulago National Referral Hospital in Kampala, triggering a 42-day WHO-mandated monitoring period to determine if the country can be declared Ebola-free. The current Ugandan outbreak has 20 cases and 2 deaths and is considered imported from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). As of July 14, 2026, DRC reports 2,073 cases and 796 deaths. Uganda urges 15 countries to lift travel restrictions, noting economic harm, while the United States maintains a Level 4 travel advisory. Authorities warn the risk remains high and intensify cross-border cooperation with DRC, including deploying 50 health workers and four mobile laboratories to assist in containment. The Bundibugyo strain has no licensed vaccine; Uganda participates in trials, and Oxford Vaccine Group has begun a Phase I study for a candidate vaccine with Ugandan involvement.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、エボラ最後の患者退院を受け渡航制限解除を要求
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱のアウトブレイクがDRCからウガンダに越境し、渡航制限や国際協力が発生しているため、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCは主題として越境感染源として明記されているため含める。米国はレベル4渡航勧告発出国として言及のみ。

article.articleHeadline: Cegah Penyakit Tuberkulosis, Rutan Baturaja Gandeng Dinkes OKU Skrining Warga Binaan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prevent Tuberculosis, Baturaja Detention Center Teams Up with OKU Health Office to Screen Inmates.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 July 2026, Baturaja Class IIB Detention Center in Baturaja, OKU Regency, South Sumatra, Indonesia, is coordinating with the OKU Health Office to implement free health checks and tuberculosis (TB) screening for inmates. A coordination meeting held on 15 July 2026 aligned on the inmate population to be screened, medical logistics, TB screening tools, and deployment of medical staff inside the prison. The initiative aims to safeguard inmates’ right to health services and enable early TB detection to prevent transmission in the high-risk prison environment. OKU Dinas Kesehatan welcomes the plan and pledges full collaboration to minimize TB spread through targeted preventive and curative actions. The program is expected to be realized soon, contributing to a clean, healthy, and conducive prison setting.

triage.headline_ja: 結核予防のため、バトゥラジャ拘置所がOKU保健局と連携し収容者のスクリーニングを実施
triage.triage_reason: 通常のルーチン予防・スクリーニング活動の報道であり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 刑務所という高リスク環境でのTBスクリーニングは長期曝露リスクの観点から該当するが、これは予防的・日常的な保健活動であり、緊急のシグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: El ébola golpea con fuerza a la República Democrática del Congo y ya es el tercer brote más grande de la historia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola hits the Democratic Republic of the Congo hard, and is already the third-largest outbreak in history.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached a critical level, now the third-largest outbreak in history with 2,073 confirmed cases and 796 deaths since the epidemic began. The World Health Organization warns the pace is accelerating, especially in Ituri Province. More than 80% of new infections are detected outside known contact lists, signaling active community transmission, and about two-thirds of deaths occur within communities before care is sought. Response capacity has expanded to over 800 treatment beds and 16 diagnostic centers, with more than 21,000 trained community health workers. Trials are underway for MBP134 monoclonal antibody, remdesivir, the Oxford University ChAdOx1 vaccine, and obeldesivir for exposed individuals; 377 people have recovered with early diagnosis. In Uganda, the last patient was discharged, initiating a 42-day countdown to declaring the outbreak ended there (20 cases, 2 deaths). As of 16 July 2026, international alert remains.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国で猛威を振るい、史上3番目の規模の流行に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上3番目の規模のエボラ流行が進行中で、地域社会内感染が拡大し、ウガンダへの越境も確認されているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも症例が確認されているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ウガンダは最終患者退院により42日間のカウントダウンが開始され、終息宣言に向かっている。

article.articleHeadline: Pacientes com Ebola e profissionais de saúde fogem de ataque a hospital no Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Patients with Ebola and healthcare workers flee from an attack on a hospital in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Patients with Ebola and healthcare workers fled Nyakunde Hospital in Ituri province, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, after an angry crowd attacked the facility on Wednesday, hindering efforts to contain the deadly outbreak. In Bunia, the mob stormed the hospital, hurling stones and damaging the fence, according to François Berocan Uderos, a medical biologist at Nyakunde. The crowd reacted to the death of a woman who had come to give birth but developed severe anemia, Uderos said. The incident represents another setback in the response to the Ebola outbreak in the region, illustrating security and access challenges that disrupt patient care and infection control.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ患者と医療従事者が病院襲撃から逃亡
triage.triage_reason: 進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクの中で病院が襲撃され、患者・医療従事者が逃亡し感染制御が妨げられている。公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と対応の困難さがあり、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 病院襲撃により感染制御・患者管理が妨げられ、エボラ患者が地域社会に戻る可能性があり、アウトブレイクの拡大リスクが高まっている。治安上の課題が対応能力を著しく低下させている点に注意。

article.articleHeadline: ΠΟΥ: Η επιδημία Έμπολα στη ΛΔ του Κονγκό εξαπλώνεται ταχύτερα σε σύγκριση με τις προηγούμενες
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: The Ebola epidemic in the DR Congo is spreading faster than previous outbreaks.
article.articleSummary: As of July 16, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has 2,003 confirmed cases and 796 deaths, two months after it was declared in mid-May. The World Health Organization warns the outbreak is spreading faster than all previous Ebola outbreaks, ranking as the third deadliest ever recorded in the country. The main concern is transmission in Ituri province in the northeast, where over 80% of new cases occur outside known contact lists, indicating ongoing transmission chains that evade surveillance. About two-thirds of deaths occur in communities—among people who never received care in a health facility. By comparison, the 2018–2020 outbreak reached 2,000 confirmed cases after more than 10 months and caused about 2,300 deaths. The report underscores rapid spread and surveillance gaps rather than laboratory details.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、過去の流行より速いペースで拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで急速に拡大し、致死率も高く、サーベイランス網を逃れる伝播が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 80%以上の新規症例が既知の接触者リスト外で発生しており、監視体制の限界とヒト-ヒト感染の継続が強く示唆される。過去最速のペースでの拡大が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola spreading in DRC 'faster than any previous outbreak': WHO
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola virus disease outbreak (17th) declared May 15 in Ituri, northeastern DRC. Ebola spreads through close contact and infected bodily fluids. By 16 July 2026, >2,000 cases and 796 deaths confirmed, making it the third-largest outbreak on record and spreading faster than prior events; cases detected across five DRC provinces and in Uganda, though most are in Ituri. The current outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo species, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. Response capacity has risen to about 800 treatment beds and 16 laboratories, yet over 80% of new cases are found outside known contact lists and about two-thirds of deaths occur in communities without care. 377 recoveries reported. Trials include MBP134 monoclonal antibody and remdesivir (under way in Ituri since July 2); the ChAdOx1 vaccine safety trial began this week, and obeldesivir post-exposure prophylaxis trial began on Tuesday. A treatment centre was attacked in Bunia; funding shortfall exceeds $400 million for a joint WHO-Africa CDC plan.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、DRCで『過去最速』のペースで拡大：WHO
triage.triage_reason: DRCで2,000例超・796人死亡に達し過去最速の拡大速度、承認済みワクチン・治療薬なし、ウガンダへの越境拡大も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの感染拡大が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。Bundibugyo種による流行で承認ワクチン・治療薬が存在しない点、資金不足（4億ドル超）が管理可能性の懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola en RD Congo avanza más rápido que brotes anteriores
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in DR Congo spreads faster than previous outbreaks.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo declared about two months ago is spreading faster than all previous Ebola epidemics, according to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. As of July 16, 2026, a total of 2,003 cases and 796 deaths have been reported. The WHO leader called it the third-largest Ebola outbreak ever recorded, noting that transmission has accelerated in recent months. By comparison, the 2018–2020 DRC epidemic took more than 10 months to reach 2,000 confirmed cases and caused nearly 2,300 deaths among about 3,500 illnesses. The article does not provide details on symptoms, laboratory confirmation, infection source, or imported/exported cases beyond these numbers. The outbreak remains active, with the declaration dating to roughly May 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ、過去の流行より速いペースで拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで過去最速のペースで拡大し、2000例超・死者796人と重大な公衆衛生上の影響があり、IHR基準複数該当のためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長が過去最速の拡大速度と史上3番目の規模と指摘。致死率は約39.7%（796/2003）で高い。症状・感染源・検査確定・輸出入例の詳細は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ сообщила о выписке последнего пациента с Эболой в Уганде
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO reports the discharge of the last Ebola patient in Uganda.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 July 2026, the World Health Organization reports Uganda has discharged the last patient with confirmed Ebola virus disease, starting a 42-day countdown to ending the outbreak in Uganda. Uganda recorded 20 cases and 2 deaths during the outbreak. In the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), the Ebola outbreak has infected about 2,000 people and caused 796 deaths, marking it as the third-largest Ebola outbreak in history. The DRC outbreak began in May and is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; there are no vaccines or treatments available for this strain. The WHO designated the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), underscoring international concern and the ongoing need for surveillance, response efforts, and management of potential imported/exported cases across borders.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがウガンダで最後のエボラ患者の退院を報告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行はPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）に指定され、約2000人感染・796人死亡と史上3番目の規模であり、ワクチン・治療法もない深刻な状況のため。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCの流行はブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス株によるもので、ワクチン・治療法が存在しない点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola spreading in DRC 'faster than any earlier outbreak'
article.articleSummary: As of 16 July 2026, Ebola is spreading in the DR Congo faster than any prior outbreak. In two months since the outbreak was declared on 15 May, DR Congo has confirmed more than 2,000 cases and 796 deaths, with cases in five provinces and in Uganda; majority remain in Ituri. The 17th outbreak is centered in conflict-torn Ituri, where armed conflict hampers access and a treatment centre was attacked in Bunia. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo Ebola virus, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. Trials underway include MBP134 monoclonal antibody and remdesivir; a ChAdOx1 vaccine trial began, and obeldesivir post-exposure prophylaxis started. About 377 people have recovered. 80% of new cases are detected outside known contact lists; two-thirds of deaths occur among those who never reach care. Capacity now includes 800 beds and 16 laboratories, but funding shortfalls exceed $400 million for joint WHO-ACDC plan.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラが『これまでのどの流行よりも速く』拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生した第17次エボラ流行が2000例超・796人死亡と急拡大し、ウガンダにも越境、承認されたワクチン・治療薬がなく資金不足も深刻なため、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境例が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。武装紛争によるアクセス制限、資金不足（$400M超）が管理可能性を著しく低下させている。

article.articleHeadline: Bệnh nhân Ebola cuối cùng xuất viện, Uganda đếm ngược đến ngày hết dịch
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The last Ebola patient discharged, Uganda counts down to the day the outbreak ends.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Uganda ends as the last patient is discharged after a negative test, with a 42‑day period to declare the outbreak over if no new cases emerge. Uganda reported 20 cases (15 from the Democratic Republic of Congo and 5 Ugandan citizens) and 2 deaths, yielding a case fatality rate under 10%. The initial case surfaced in mid‑May after a patient who had traveled from eastern DRC was infected with Bundibugy o ebolavirus. The outbreak originated in eastern DRC, notably Ituri province, and crossed the border into Uganda. WHO Uganda representative Kasonde Mwinga credited preparedness and ongoing rapid response teams for containment. The Ebola situation in the DRC remains complex. WHO notes that about 80% of new cases in eastern DRC have unknown transmission sources, hindering tracing and control efforts.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ最後の患者が退院、ウガンダは流行終息宣言へのカウントダウンへ
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダでのエボラ流行は終息に向かっているが、感染源であるDRC東部（イトゥリ州）では新規感染の約80%で感染経路不明という状況が続いており、国境を越えた再拡大リスクが残るため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダでの流行終息だが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。感染源であるDRC（イトゥリ州）のみverified_locationsに含めた。DRC東部での感染経路不明の継続的な発生は引き続き注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Americans returning home from Ebola epicenter denied entry for 21 days
article.articleSummary: Americans returning from the Ebola epicenter in the Democratic Republic of Congo will be barred from boarding U.S.-bound flights for 21 days, unless they first wait in a third country. The Bundibugyo-strain outbreak has sickened nearly 2,000 people and caused 719 deaths; Ituri province is the epicenter. The CDC warns the risk to the general U.S. public remains low and urges avoiding areas with sick individuals, while travelers may face a DO NOT BOARD order. Uganda and South Sudan outbreaks share the region; those travelers may return to the U.S. if they pass enhanced screening at four airports: Washington Dulles International, Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta, George Bush Intercontinental, and John F. Kennedy International. Two American humanitarian workers in the DRC tested positive and were flown to Germany; a doctor in the DRC also tested positive and recovered there. The WHO declared the outbreak an international emergency on May 17.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行の震源地から帰国するアメリカ人、21日間の入国拒否措置
triage.triage_reason: WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態(PHEIC)を宣言したコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行（約2000人感染、719人死亡）で、渡航制限措置や国際的な感染拡大（米国人・ドイツへの搬送例）が確認されているため。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（イトゥリ州が震源地）でのエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）流行を主題としている。米国・ドイツ・ウガンダ・南スーダンは対応措置や関連情報として言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。WHOは2026年5月17日に国際緊急事態を宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: Layanan Kesehatan Hewan Gratis untuk Cegah Penyakit Zoonosis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Free Veterinary Health Services to Prevent Zoonotic Diseases
article.articleSummary: Blitar City Government launched free mobile veterinary health screenings at Pasar Banggle, Blitar, East Java, on July 16, 2026, engaging animal-rescue volunteers to gather stray cats for examinations by veterinary staff. Aligned with Blitar City’s 704th anniversary, the initiative expands access to health checks for both pets and free-ranging animals that could harbor disease. It aims to improve animal welfare while preventing zoonotic transmission to people, notably Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) and other contagious illnesses. By partnering with the community and animal-loving groups, authorities seek to strengthen animal health surveillance and raise awareness of preventive measures in the local environment.

triage.headline_ja: 人獣共通感染症予防のための無料動物健康サービス
triage.triage_reason: 実際の疾病発生ではなく、動物福祉と予防啓発を目的とした無料獣医健診イベントの紹介記事であり、公衆衛生上の懸念事象ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はFMD発生報告ではなく、Blitar市の予防的動物健康診断イベントに関する内容。実際の症例発生情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: ASF outbreak: Kohima bans pig movement
article.articleSummary: African Swine Fever (ASF) has been confirmed in Kohima district, Nagaland, with outbreaks at Peducha Village, Phezoucha L Khel and P Khel of Kohima Village, and the Razha area near Dzü-ü River (NH-29). Deputy Commissioner B Henok Buchem issued containment orders: a 1-km Infected Zone and a 10-km Surveillance Zone. Immediate ban on import, export and movement of live pigs and pork products within, into or out of the zones; all pork markets and butchery shops within zones to close until further notice. Pig farmers must restrict farm visitors, disinfect premises, report unusual pig illness or death, and ensure safe burial of carcasses per official protocols; dumping carcasses in rivers or open areas is prohibited. Public urged to avoid meat from unknown sources. Violations will attract action under the Prevention and Control of Infectious and Contagious Diseases in Animals Act, 2009 and other laws. Measures take effect immediately.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ豚熱(ASF)発生：コヒマ市が豚の移動を禁止
triage.triage_reason: ASFは家畜(豚)のみに感染するウイルス性疾患で人への健康影響はないが、移動制限や市場閉鎖など経済・行政対応が発生しており、地域拡大の可能性を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: ASF(アフリカ豚熱)は人畜共通感染症ではなく、公衆衛生上の直接的リスクは低い。地方自治体(コヒマ市)による豚の移動禁止・市場閉鎖などの家畜疾病対応が中心。今後の拡大や経済的影響について続報を注視する。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda já não tem casos de pessoas infetadas pelo vírus ébola - Renascença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda no longer has any cases of people infected with the Ebola virus - Renascença.
article.articleSummary: Uganda has no active Ebola virus infections after the last patient recovered and was discharged from Mulago Hospital's Ebola Treatment Unit. The Ugandan Ministry of Health announced no new infections since June 22, contrasting with the Democratic Republic of Congo where cases continue to rise. Although there are no current cases, Uganda must wait 42 days without any new infections to be declared free of Ebola. Health Minister Chris Baryomunsi told reporters it was encouraging to see the final patient leave the Ebola treatment unit, a view shared with the World Health Organization's Uganda representative, Kasonde Mwinga. The 42-day waiting period starts from the date of the last confirmed case; if no new infections occur, Uganda will be declared Ebola-free.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、エボラウイルス感染症例なしに ― Renascença
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダでのエボラ終息は前向きな進展だが、記事内でDRCにおける症例増加が継続していると言及されており、コンゴ盆地地域全体でのエボラ流行拡大リスクが懸念される。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダにおけるエボラ終息（42日間の監視期間待ち）だが、対比としてDRCで症例が増加中との記載があるため、DRCも関連国として記録。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: India's Serum Institute partners with Gates MRI to make expiremental TB vaccine
article.articleSummary: India's Serum Institute will manufacture an experimental tuberculosis vaccine under an agreement with Gates Medical Research Institute, potentially the first new TB shot in more than 100 years if approved. The candidate, M72/AS01E, has been in development for two decades and is in a late-stage trial. Serum Institute plans to invest more than $100 million to scale manufacturing and prepare for future supply, pending approval. Gates MRI will transfer the technology and know-how to produce the vaccine antigen, while GSK will supply the AS01E adjuvant. GSK originally developed the candidate and licensed it to Gates MRI, which is sponsoring the late-stage trial with support from the Gates Foundation and Wellcome. TB is the world's leading infectious killer; WHO data cite nearly 11 million infections and 1.23 million deaths in 2024. Highest-burden countries include India, Indonesia, the Philippines, China, Pakistan and Nigeria. The vaccine could avert 76 million cases and save 8.5 million lives over 25 years.

triage.headline_ja: インドのセラム・インスティテュート、ゲイツMRIと提携し実験的結核ワクチンを製造
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は結核ワクチン開発・製造提携に関する事業ニュースであり、新規アウトブレイクや異常な公衆衛生事象ではないため、シグナルとして扱う必要はない。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン開発・製造契約に関する報道であり、特定の国での結核アウトブレイクを報じるものではないため、対象国リストへの発生地域割り当ては行わない。

article.articleHeadline: Пациенты с Эболой сбежали из больницы в Конго после нападения толпы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Patients with Ebola escaped from the hospital in Congo after a mob attack.
article.articleSummary: In eastern Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri Province, a hospital was attacked by an angry mob, leading to patients undergoing Ebola treatment escaping. A clinic employee, described as a medical biologist, reported a laboring woman died of anemia at the facility, and doctors could not transfuse due to restrictions tied to the Ebola outbreak. Around 15:00 local time, the assault intensified as the crowd threw stones and breached fences, with up to ten patients fleeing and staff evacuated. Earlier, Ebola case counts had surpassed 1,000, signaling the ongoing outbreak in Congo. The incident highlights security and access challenges amid public health measures during the epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ患者が暴徒の襲撃後に病院から逃走
triage.triage_reason: エボラ感染者1000人超という深刻な流行下で、暴徒による病院襲撃と患者逃走という異常事態が発生し、感染拡大・治安リスクが高いためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: エボラ治療中の患者が病院襲撃を機に逃走したことで、隔離体制が崩れ感染拡大リスクが増大している。既存のDRCエボラアウトブレイク（症例1000人超）の悪化要因として重大視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: В ДР Конго толпа атаковала больницу с пациентами с Эболой
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, a mob attacked a hospital housing Ebola patients.
article.articleSummary: On July 16, 2026, in Ituri province, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, a mob attacked a hospital housing Ebola patients after the death of a woman admitted for labor. Staff fled, electricity was cut, and several Ebola patients escaped. The attack followed the woman’s death from severe anemia and a family demand for a blood transfusion, which was refused due to Ebola precautions. The incident highlights distrust and security risks that hinder outbreak containment, with Reuters noting such episodes repeatedly disrupt efforts. Health workers have warned of strikes over pay. The current outbreak numbers stand at 2,073 confirmed cases and 796 deaths to date.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で、群衆がエボラ患者を収容する病院を襲撃
triage.triage_reason: 進行中のエボラ流行（確定2,073例、死亡796例）において、暴徒による病院襲撃で患者が逃走し感染拡大・封じ込め阻害のリスクが高まっているため。
triage.notes: 病院襲撃によりエボラ患者数名が逃走し、地域社会への感染拡大リスクが増大。医療従事者の給与未払いによるストライキの懸念もあり、対応能力の低下が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-infected US citizen doing better in Frankfurt hospital
article.articleSummary: An Ebola-infected US citizen being treated at Frankfurt University Hospital is reported to be slightly better and in stable condition as of 2026-07-16. The patient, a Samaritan's Purse disaster-relief staff member with 15 years in foreign missions, worked in logistics and had no direct contact with patients. Ebola is a contagious, potentially fatal disease; the latest outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has been hard to contain, partly due to the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no vaccine or specific treatment at present. Patients with hemorrhagic fever, including Ebola, are transported in specially equipped aircraft and treated in high-security isolation units away from regular wards. Samaritan's Purse notes it has teams running two Ebola treatment centres in Congo and aiding health authorities; the organization has previously assisted in 2014 and 2018. Past Ebola cases have been treated at Frankfurt Hospital.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染した米国人、フランクフルトの病院で回復傾向
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生中のエボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株、ワクチン・特効薬なし）流行に関連し、患者の国際搬送事例も発生しており、公衆衛生上の深刻さと国際拡大リスクの観点からフルRRAに進めるべき事案。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼は米国人患者のフランクフルトでの治療状況だが、背景にあるDRCでのエボラ流行（Bundibugyo株、ワクチン・治療薬なし、抑制困難）が本質的な公衆衛生上の懸念事項。ドイツ・米国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: "الصحة العالمية": تفشي "إيبولا" في الكونغو الديمقراطية الأسرع على الإطلاق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "World Health Organization": The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is the fastest ever.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is the fastest on record, with over 2,000 confirmed cases and 796 deaths within about two months of the outbreak declaration on May 15 in Ituri's Bunia area, amid armed conflict. It is the third-largest Ebola outbreak on record. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare strain for which there is no licensed vaccine or approved therapy, is responsible. Cases have been reported across five Congolese provinces and into Uganda, indicating cross-border transmission. Transmission is through close contact and exposure to infected body fluids. About 80% of new infections are among people not listed in known contact tracing chains; roughly two-thirds of fatalities occur in communities without access to healthcare facilities. A treatment center in Bunia was attacked, illustrating the challenging security context.

triage.headline_ja: 「世界保健機関」：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行は史上最速
triage.triage_reason: WHOが史上最速のエボラ流行と発表し、2000例以上・796人死亡、ウガンダへの越境伝播、ワクチン未承認株、武装紛争下での治療センター攻撃など複数の深刻な要因が確認されるため、フルリスク評価に進むべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境伝播が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。武装紛争下での対応困難、ワクチン未承認のBundibugyoエボラウイルス株であることが特筆される。

article.articleHeadline: 健康时间 - 刚果民埃博拉疫情正以"前所未有"的速度扩散引发关注
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Time - The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading at an unprecedented rate, drawing attention.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo spreads at unprecedented speed. As of July 16, 2026, confirmed cases exceed 2,000 across five provinces, with 754 deaths (mortality over 37%). The World Health Organization calls it the third-most severe Ebola outbreak it has faced and the fastest monthly spread, noting 80% of new cases have no traceable exposure. Ituri Province in the northeast is the epicenter, contributing over 90% of new infections amid ongoing conflict that hampers response. There is no vaccine or proven cure yet; WHO has launched a clinical trial of an Ebola antiviral, enrolling thousands aged 12+ with direct contact to a confirmed case within five days but asymptomatic. International support totals about $1.5 billion. UNICEF warns that focusing on Ebola should not neglect other health needs such as cholera, polio, and maternal care; health workers face salary delays, which the government pledges to resolve.

triage.headline_ja: 健康時間 - コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ疫情が「前例のない」速度で拡散し、注目を集めている
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で2,000例超・致死率37%超のエボラ流行がWHOの過去3番目に深刻な規模で急拡大しており、追跡不能な感染経路が8割を占め国際的拡大リスクと社会的関心が非常に高い。
triage.notes: コレラ・ポリオも言及されているがWHO・UNICEFの懸念表明レベルであり、記事の主題はエボラ拡大。紛争地域(イトゥリ州)での対応困難も報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: ارتفاع حالات إيبولا لـ 80 إصابة فى اليوم - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Ebola cases rise to 80 per day - Youm7
article.articleSummary: As of 16 July 2026, Ebola cases have risen to about 80 per day, with the daily average around 50, amid an outbreak in Tshopo Province. Causes cited: intensified response, including surveillance, expanded lab testing, and 15 labs in affected districts; more than 2,000 tests daily across affected areas. In Tshopo's five health zones—Mangwalo, Rambara, Bunia, Nisi, and Yakondi—many patients still fail to reach health facilities. Approximately 60% of deaths occur in the community, implying many infections occurred weeks earlier and are only detected after death via burial swabs. The top priority is rapid patient admission to treatment centers, with capacity boosted to over 800 beds and support from multiple partners.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：エボラ感染者数が1日あたり80人に増加 - Youm7
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国トショパ州でエボラ出血熱の患者数が1日80人に急増しており、死亡の60%がコミュニティで発生するなど公衆衛生上深刻な影響が見られるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にKisumu（ケニア）が含まれるが、記事サマリーではDRCトショパ州の流行のみが言及されており、ケニアでの発生は確認できないため除外。BuniaはDRC国内の健康区域名として記載されている可能性があり、DRC国内の事象として扱った。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola spreading in DRC at faster pace
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo is spreading faster than during any previous outbreak, with more than 2,000 cases and 796 deaths since the outbreak was declared on May 15. The World Health Organization called it the third-largest Ebola outbreak on record, noting rapid expansion in the past month. In Ituri province, Nyakunde Hospital was attacked by an angry crowd, forcing Ebola patients and responders to flee; power failed and several patients escaping. The episode underscores mistrust, community resistance, and insecurity hampering containment. Samaritan's Purse evacuated staff from an Ebola treatment centre beside Nyakunde as the situation deteriorated. The Congo's 17th outbreak has reached 2,073 confirmed cases and 796 deaths. Uganda discharged its last Ebola patient, leaving a 42-day countdown; Uganda has 20 Bundibugyo cases, 15 linked to Congo, with no new cases since June 22.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱がこれまでにない速さで拡大
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国での過去最大級（史上3番目の規模）のエボラ流行が急速に拡大しており、ウガンダへの越境例も確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの感染例（Bundibugyo由来）が記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。地域社会の抵抗や病院襲撃など封じ込めを妨げる要因が複数存在し、状況は深刻化している。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية ارتفاع حالات إيبولا لـ 80 إصابة فى اليوم
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Ebola cases rise to 80 per day.
article.articleSummary: Ebola cases are rising in the Democratic Republic of Congo's Tshopo Province, with daily new infections reaching about 80 on some days and an average near 50. WHO experts cited intensified response activities—epidemiological surveillance, expanded laboratory testing, and now 15 laboratories across affected districts—alongside community engagement to encourage early care. Despite these efforts, many patients still never reach health facilities; roughly 60% of deaths occur in the community, with most new daily cases likely infected weeks earlier and dying before seeking care, and only diagnosed posthumously from samples taken before burial. The immediate priority is rapid patient access to treatment centers; capacity has been expanded to over 800 beds, with more than 2,000 tests conducted daily in the affected areas, including the five health zones in Tshopo: Mangwalo, Rambara, Bunya, Nesi, and Yakondi.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:エボラ感染者数、1日あたり80人に増加
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラの新規感染が1日最大80例に急増し、地域内死亡が6割を占めるなど公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクがあるため、フルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: WHOが介入し、検査能力・病床拡充など国際支援が既に行われている状況。コミュニティでの死亡率が高く、感染拡大制御が困難な状況が続いている。

article.articleHeadline: В Конго разъяренная толпа напала на больницу с больными Эболой
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, an enraged mob attacked a hospital housing Ebola patients.
article.articleSummary: On the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ituri Province, a mob attacked a hospital housing Ebola virus disease (EVD) patients, triggering patients undergoing treatment to flee. A pregnant woman died of anemia at the hospital after a blood transfusion was refused because of a transfusion ban in effect during the EVD outbreak. The assault occurred around 15:00 local time. Up to ten patients escaped and medical staff evacuated. The Congolese army has launched an investigation into the incident. In response, humanitarian group Samaritan's Purse evacuated its staff from a nearby Ebola Treatment Center. This incident underscores security challenges amid ongoing EVD transmission in the region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ患者のいる病院を激怒した群衆が襲撃
triage.triage_reason: 進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク下で、治療施設が暴徒に襲撃され患者が逃走・医療スタッフが避難する事態が発生。感染拡大・対応能力低下のリスクが高く、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: エボラ患者最大10名が施設から逃走し、感染管理体制が崩壊するリスクがある。コンゴ軍が調査を開始し、Samaritan's Purseがスタッフを避難させるなど、国際的な人道支援体制にも影響が及んでいる。続報でのアウトブレイク拡大状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: En RDC, un centre anti-Ebola attaqué à Nyakunde, en Ituri
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the DRC, an Ebola treatment center attacked in Nyakunde, Ituri.
article.articleSummary: In Ituri, Democratic Republic of Congo, the Ebola treatment center in Nyakunde near Bunia was attacked by FPIC militiamen and angry youths on the night of July 15, 2026, destroying the facility and forcing four Ebola patients to flee into the community. Earlier that afternoon, a pregnant woman died at Nyakunde hospital due to lack of blood, underscoring medical strain. Gunfire continued through the night into Thursday morning, halting Ebola response activities. The FPIC accused the army of killing its commander; the FARDC rejected the claim, saying no operation targeted local armed groups. This marks a second attack on Nyakunde’s Ebola center, intensifying concerns for outbreak control in Ituri, a region with a history including a 2002 massacre at Nyakunde hospital.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州ニャクンデでエボラ治療センターが襲撃される
triage.triage_reason: エボラ治療センターへの武装襲撃により患者4名が地域社会に逃げ出し、対応活動が停止したため、感染拡大リスクとアウトブレイク制御への深刻な懸念がある。
triage.notes: エボラ治療センターへの2回目の襲撃で、患者が地域社会に逃亡したことによりヒト-ヒト感染拡大のリスクが高まっている。治安不安（FPICとFARDCの対立）が対応活動を妨げており、国際支援が急務と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Figyelmeztetést adott ki a WHO: négyszer akkora lehet a baj a megállíthatatlanul terjedő ebolajárvány miatt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO has issued a warning: the situation could be four times worse due to the unstoppable Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo variant Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is the largest and fastest-spreading on record. Since emerging in May, authorities report about 796 cases and 754 deaths, with confirmed cases exceeding 2,000. The WHO director-general Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned the outbreak could be two to four times more severe than official tallies. MSF confirmed rapid transmission, noting the number of confirmed cases tripled in just over five weeks and deaths more than quintupled. There is no vaccine or cure for Bundibugyo Ebola at present; however, WHO has begun a clinical trial evaluating the antiviral obeldesivir for post-exposure prophylaxis in contacts of confirmed cases. Gilead Sciences’ oral investigational drug, already shown to be effective against some filoviruses, is referenced as a potential treatment option pending further evaluation.

triage.headline_ja: WHOが警告：制御不能に拡大するエボラ流行の被害は実際には4倍に達する可能性
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でブンディブギョ株エボラの過去最大規模の急速拡大が確認され、WHOが公式集計の2〜4倍の深刻度を警告しており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: 致死率が非常に高く（約95%相当の報告値だが集計精度に疑義あり）、WHOが公式統計の過小評価を警告している点が特に重大。ワクチン・治療薬が未承認であり、臨床試験段階の抗ウイルス薬obeldesivirへの依存が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: UNICEF urge reforzar respuesta ante brote de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UNICEF urges strengthening the response to the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 July 2026, UNICEF reports the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 2,000 cases and more than 750 deaths, with transmission across five provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Upper Uele, and Tshopo; Ituri is the main focus. The response is hindered by armed conflict, displacement, insecurity, and limited access to affected communities. UNICEF priorities include reinforcing infection prevention and control, mobilizing communities to counter misinformation, protecting girls and children affected, and boosting epidemiological surveillance in high-risk zones. The agency emphasizes that Ebola cannot be tackled in isolation, as communities also face malnutrition, cholera, polio, and displacement, requiring sustained health services and preparedness for the next school year. UNICEF urges increased funding, noting it currently has only about 25% of the resources needed, despite its own funding and international support.

triage.headline_ja: UNICEF、エボラ発生への対応強化を要請
triage.triage_reason: DRCで2000例超・750人超の死者を伴うエボラ流行が5州に拡大しており、IHR基準の複数該当及び国際支援の必要性が明確なため。
triage.notes: コレラ・ポリオも同地域で併発しているが、記事の主題はエボラ流行への対応強化要請であるため主疾患としてエボラを中心に評価した。

article.articleHeadline: OMS: Epidemia de Ebola din Congo se răspândeşte "mai rapid" decât cele anterioare / Au fost semnalate 2.003 cazuri, dintre care 796 de decese / Nu există niciun vaccin şi niciun tratament împotriva variantei Bundibugyo a virusului
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: The Ebola outbreak in Congo is spreading "faster" than previous ones / 2,003 cases have been reported, of which 796 deaths / There is no vaccine and no treatment against the Bundibugyo variant of the virus.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Bundibugyo variant) is spreading faster than previous outbreaks. As of 16 July 2026, 2,003 cases and 796 deaths have been reported, with Ituri province the focus as new transmissions exceed 80% of cases from outside known contact lists. About two-thirds of deaths occur in communities without healthcare facility access. There is currently no vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo; however, clinical trials have begun for MBP134 monoclonal antibody and remdesivir, separately or together, and a ChAdOx1 vaccine safety study is underway. A trial evaluating post-exposure prophylaxis with obeldesivir has also started. Response capacity includes over 800 beds, 60 laboratories, and contact monitoring up to 80%. A total of 377 recoveries are reported, indicating potential to end transmission with early diagnosis and care. Uganda reports 20 cases and two deaths, with no current Ebola patients.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：コンゴのエボラ流行は過去の流行より「速いペース」で拡大／2,003症例、うち796人死亡／ブンディブギョ株に対するワクチン・治療法は存在せず
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）がDRCで急速に拡大し、ワクチン・治療法が未確立、隣国ウガンダにも越境しておりIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダも症例報告があるが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ワクチン・治療薬未確立かつ感染経路の80%が接触者追跡外という点で管理困難性が高い。

locations.name: Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Pregnant women reminded to seek nurse advice before holiday planning amid Zika risk
article.articleSummary: UKHSA data show ongoing imported mosquito-borne infections through early 2026. Zika: eight cases reported Jan–Jun 2026 in England, Wales and Northern Ireland, already exceeding the 2025 total of seven; Indonesia was the exposure country in four cases. Dengue: 137 imported cases Jan–Jun 2026, with South-East Asia and South Asia as common regions; Thailand accounted for 27, Maldives 19. Chikungunya: 59 cases Jan–Jun 2026, Sri Lanka responsible for 18. Malaria: 557 cases across England, Wales and Northern Ireland January–May. Enteric fever: 287 travel-associated typhoid and paratyphoid fever Jan–Jun 2026. The UKHSA notes no Zika vaccine or treatment; protection against bites is key. Pregnant or trying to conceive should seek pre-travel advice from a nurse/clinic; check destination vaccination/antimalarial requirements; ensure food/water hygiene. Measles activity persists; ensure MMR up to date. Public health measures: mosquito bite prevention and safe travel planning.

triage.headline_ja: 妊娠中の女性はジカ熱リスクを踏まえ休暇計画前に看護師の助言を求めるよう呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 英国内における渡航関連感染症（ジカ熱・デング熱等）の定例サーベイランスデータの報告であり、新規のアウトブレイクや異常事象を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事はUKHSAによる英国内の輸入感染症（ジカ熱、デング熱、チクングニア熱、マラリア、腸チフス等）の定例統計報告であり、渡航者向け注意喚起が主旨。タイ・インドネシア・モルディブ・スリランカは曝露国として言及されているが、これらの国での流行状況自体を報じる記事ではないため、verified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Uganda is silent on updates following disclosure of Marburg outbreak
article.articleSummary: Uganda’s government has offered no updates on a June Marburg outbreak, with WHO repeatedly requesting information on the outbreak’s origin and scale through the International Health Regulations. Marburg, a viral hemorrhagic fever related to Ebola, can be highly fatal; the Angola outbreak (2004–2005) recorded 252 cases and 227 deaths. The Ugandan outbreak emerged after a U.S. embassy alert about a baby with Marburg in a Western Uganda displaced-persons camp; two cases were reportedly confirmed at onset, but Uganda has not publicly confirmed a second case or provided follow‑up. In the region, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has now reached about 2,100 cases and nearly 800 deaths. Uganda has reported 20 Ebola cases—either imported from DRC or acquired after entry. Uganda's Ebola episode is approaching closure; the final case was released, starting a 42-day countdown. Tedros urged care to curb community transmission, where two-thirds of deaths have occurred.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:マールブルグ病発生の公表後、ウガンダは続報を出さず沈黙
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダのマールブルグ発生に関するWHOへの情報開示拒否という異常事態に加え、隣接するDRCのエボラ流行が2,100症例・800人近い死者に達しており、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダのマールブルグ病流行に関するWHOへの情報非開示だが、ウガンダ・アンゴラは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCのエボラ流行（2,100症例、約800人死亡）が具体的数値とともに実質的に論じられているため、DRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。続報でウガンダのマールブルグ症例確定情報が得られ次第、再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza: casos recuam no país, mas MS e mais 4 estados mantêm alerta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza: cases fall nationwide, but MS and four more states remain on alert.
article.articleSummary: Brazil’s InfoGripe weekly report (week 27: Jul 5–11, 2026) shows a nationwide fall in SRAG cases, driven by reduced RSV hospitalizations, though RSV remains high in many states. In children under 4, declines are linked to RSV; in 5–14 years, fewer severe rhinovirus cases; in youths, adults and seniors, fewer influenza A hospitalizations. Five states—Mato Grosso do Sul, Minas Gerais, Paraná, Santa Catarina, and Rio Grande do Sul—are at alert or high risk with upward long-term trends; 17 states are at alert but stabilizing. Capitals at alert/risk: Aracaju, Campo Grande, Goiânia, Porto Alegre, Rio Branco. RSV continues rising in the South (PR, RS, SC) plus MG and MA; influenza A remains high in MG, PR, RR; influenza B rising in DF, MG, RJ, RS, SC with declines in CE, GO, MA, MS, PR, SP. COVID-19 hospitalizations up slightly only in Amazonas. Totals: 115,203 SRAG cases; 60,200 lab-positive; 39,743 negative; 8,218 awaiting. Prevention emphasizes vaccination and respiratory hygiene; masks if needed.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザ：全国的に症例減少も、MS州など5州は警戒継続
triage.triage_reason: 季節性呼吸器感染症（インフルエンザ、RSV、COVID-19）のサーベイランス定例報告であり、全国的には減少傾向。異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められず、通常の季節性動向の範囲内。
triage.notes: InfoGripeによる定例週次サーベイランス報告。一部州で警戒レベル継続だが、全国的には季節性の範囲内の動向であり、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : plus de 2.000 cas en deux mois, une propagation sans précédent
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: more than 2,000 cases in two months, an unprecedented spread.
article.articleSummary: Since May, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has risen to 2,073 cases and 796 deaths, third-largest outbreak, with transmission outpacing the response. Ituri province in northeast remains epicenter; more than 80% of new cases are not part of known contact lists, signaling untracked transmission chains. About two-thirds of deaths occur in communities where patients never sought care, and armed conflict hampers access, including an attack on a Bunia treatment center. Health capacity has expanded to over 800 beds, 16 laboratories, and contact tracing to 80%. Over 21,000 health workers are being trained, and burial procedures have been strengthened. The WHO and Africa CDC warn of a funding shortfall exceeding $400 million. Trials include MBP134 antibody and remdesivir; no licensed vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo; ChAdOx1 vaccine trial began; obeldesivir tested as post-exposure prophylaxis. In Uganda, 20 cases and 2 deaths, with a 42-day no-new-case window anticipated.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：2カ月で2,000人以上の感染、前例のない拡大
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱がDRCで急速に拡大し、80%以上が未追跡感染で国際的拡大やウガンダへの越境も確認されているため、IHR基準複数該当。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも20例確認されているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。WHO・Africa CDCによる資金不足（4億ドル超）の警告あり、武装勢力による治療センター攻撃が対応を妨げている。

article.articleHeadline: L'épidémie d'Ebola se propage à une vitesse record, prévient l'OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak is spreading at a record pace, the WHO warns.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading at a record pace, the WHO warns. A Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain, for which no vaccine is known, is centered in the war-torn Ituri province. Since May, indicators had signaled a looming health disaster, and by early July the ongoing outbreak had expanded beyond Ituri to two additional provinces. The article notes the lack of a known protective vaccine for this strain, complicating response efforts in a setting of armed conflict. The outbreak’s growth underscores ongoing challenges of surveillance, case identification, and containment in conflict zones in the DRC. Further updates on case counts, transmission chains, and imported/exported cases were not specified in the article.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行、記録的な速さで拡大とWHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: WHOが記録的速度での拡大を警告しており、ワクチン未確立のブンディブギョ株が紛争地域で複数州に拡大していることから、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: ワクチン未確立のブンディブギョ株であること、紛争地帯での対応困難さが特に懸念される。続報でケース数・伝播経路の情報確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola en la R.D. del Congo: la OMS advierte que "la situación es muy difícil"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the DRC: WHO warns that 'the situation is very difficult'.
article.articleSummary: As of July 16, 2026, the World Health Organization reports the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri, remains serious but not out of control. Security challenges, population displacement, and delays in patients seeking care hinder responses. WHO emergency chief notes the situation will require weeks and months of sustained effort and resources; not a quick fix. With an estimated 50 new Ebola cases daily, 30–40 of those may have remained ill for weeks and died without care, identified only after burial samples. Response efforts have expanded hospital capacity to more than 800 beds for Ebola patients, improving survival with rapid treatment transfer. Conflict between army and armed groups complicates access, contact tracing, and surveillance in Ituri, where over 100,000 people were displaced recently, joining nearly 1 million displaced previously. Teams are reinforcing infection prevention/control and coordinating daily with the Congolese Ministry of Health.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱流行：WHOが「状況は非常に困難」と警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行が継続し、1日あたり推定50例の新規感染、紛争による対応困難、大規模な避難民発生などIHR基準の複数項目に該当するためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 紛争による治安悪化とアクセス制限が対応を困難にしており、100万人近い避難民が存在する点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Tshopo : les préparatifs avancent pour l'installation de nouveaux centres de traitement d'Ebola (Ministre provincial de la Santé) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tshopo: Preparations are progressing for the installation of new Ebola treatment centers (Provincial Health Minister) - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo's Tshopo province drives rapid expansion of treatment capacity. Kisangani will host two new Ebola Treatment Centers, with a third to be built in Bafwasende near the Ituri border, replacing the temporary isolation units at Cinquantenaire Hospital. Centers are to be built by Doctors Without Borders (MSF) and International Medical Corps (IMC). Land rights are nearly finalized, and provincial Health Minister Dr. Simon Bokongo says construction will start within days to enable rapid care for people from Ituri, the outbreak epicenter, who exhibit Ebola-like symptoms, avoiding travel to Kisangani. This is Tshopo's first Ebola outbreak, officially declared 15 May 2026; as of 29 June 2026, five lab-confirmed cases and three deaths across three health zones. It is the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC in 50 years and the fourth in the Greater East region.

triage.headline_ja: チョポ州：エボラ治療センター新設の準備進む（州保健大臣）- ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国チョポ州における新規エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（州初）で、既に死亡例・検査確認例があり、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性）を2つ満たすためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 本アウトブレイクは2026年5月15日に正式宣言され、6月29日時点で検査確認例5件・死亡3件、3保健地区に及ぶ。DRC過去50年で17回目、大東部地域では4回目のエボラアウトブレイク。MSF・IMCが治療センター建設を支援しており、国際支援体制が既に稼働中。

article.articleHeadline: 海漂豬屍驗出豬瘟 金門豬肉禁運本島一周
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sea-drifted pig carcasses test positive for swine fever; Kinmen pork shipments banned to the main island for a week.
article.articleSummary: African swine fever (ASF) virus nucleic acid detected in a sea-drifted pig carcass found near Kinmen’s coast, Taiwan. The ~70-kg carcass was discovered by the Ninth Offshore Patrol Team at Jinhu Township’s Xintou coastline; samples collected, the carcass incinerated/buried, and surrounding area disinfected. Laboratory confirmation by the Veterinary Research Institute yesterday showed ASF virus nucleic acid positivity. To prevent spread, Taiwan’s Agriculture Ministry halted pork and pork products from Kinmen to the main island and other offshore islands, effective until July 22, contingent on a week with no new cases. Kinmen health authorities conducted health visits to 25 pig farms within a 10-km radius (5,033 pigs) with no abnormalities detected. Coast guard patrols, vessel checks, and cargo inspections will be intensified. The Central Disaster Response Center notes Kinmen’s proximity to Fujian and Xiamen and the Jiulong River outlets, and cites wind/current drift as the likely mechanism bringing the carcass ashore.

triage.headline_ja: 海に漂着した豚の死骸から豚熱（ASF）を検出、金門の豚肉出荷を本島へ1週間禁止
triage.triage_reason: 動物衛生（豚熱）の事案であり、対象国リストに含まれる国での確認された発生ではなく、人への健康影響も認められないため見送りとする。

article.articleHeadline: SP registra primeiro caso de gripe aviária de 2026 em ave silvestre | CNN Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo records the first avian influenza case of 2026 in a wild bird | CNN Brasil
article.articleSummary: São Paulo confirms the first Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza (HPAI) case of 2026 in a wild bird rescued in an urban area and sent to the Guaíra Zoo, in the Barretos Regional Department. The Federal Laboratory of Agricultural Defense (LFDA-SP) diagnosed HPAI on 16 July 2026. An epidemiological investigation and active surveillance have been initiated around the outbreak, with three farms within a 10 km radius under surveillance and restricted animal movement at the Guaíra Zoo. Consumption of poultry and eggs does not transmit the disease, but human infection occurs mainly through direct contact with infected birds. Sick or dead birds should not be handled without personal protective equipment, and Defesa Agropecuária should be notified if a case is suspected. The São Paulo State Health Secretariat (SES), together with the Agriculture and Livestock Secretariat (SAA) and Semil, is monitoring the avian influenza situation in the state.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州、2026年最初の鳥インフルエンザ症例を野鳥で確認 | CNN Brasil
triage.triage_reason: 野鳥での高病原性鳥インフルエンザ（HPAI）確認であり、人への感染は報告されていない。ブラジルでは家禽業への影響が懸念されるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 野鳥での症例であり人感染は確認されていない。農場周辺での監視強化や動物移動制限など、地域当局による通常の対応が実施されている。家禽産業への波及や貿易影響については続報を要確認。

article.articleHeadline: Haut-Uélé : aménagement d'un centre de traitement d'Ebola à Durba dans le territoire de Watsa - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Upper Uele: establishment of an Ebola treatment center in Durba in Watsa Territory - ACP.
article.articleSummary: As of July 16, 2026, in Durba, Watsa Territory, Haut-Uélé, northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo, an INRB laboratory facility and an Ebola treatment center are being prepared to receive suspected-case samples and manage Ebola virus disease (EVD) patients. The project, housed in the Durba trading center, stems from collaboration among Kibali Hospital (CHK), the provincial DPS, the Haut-Uélé government, and Kibali-gold. An on-site CHK laboratory is already functional thanks to Kibali-gold and provincial support. One suspected case had samples sent for analysis; results were negative, and no confirmed EVD case has yet been recorded. Hospital measures include handwashing, distancing, seating arrangements, and surveillance for Ebola signs. Officials call for vigilance and broad community participation in awareness campaigns across Watsa and Haut-Uélé. Durba lies over 350 km from Isiro, the provincial capital.

triage.headline_ja: オー・ウエレ州：ワツァ準州ドゥルバにエボラ治療センターを整備 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国北東部で疑い症例（検査結果は陰性）を受けエボラ治療センターの準備が進められているが、確定症例は報告されておらず、現時点では予防的対応の段階にあるため続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 確定症例は未報告（疑い症例1件は陰性）。エボラ流行歴のある地域（Haut-Uélé州）での予防的な治療センター整備活動。確定症例の発生有無について続報を要監視。

article.articleHeadline: RD Congo : l'épidémie d'Ebola se propage "plus rapidement" que toutes les précédentes, alerte l'OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: the Ebola outbreak is spreading faster than all previous outbreaks, WHO warns.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo variant, has reached 2,003 cases and 796 deaths, making it the third deadliest outbreak in the country and spreading faster than the 2018–2020 outbreak, which recorded about 2,300 deaths from 3,500 cases. The Ituri province in northeast DRC remains the epicenter, with more than 80% of new cases detected outside known contact lists, signaling transmission chains escaping surveillance. About two-thirds of deaths occur in communities where patients have not sought care in health facilities. The response reports over 800 beds available and 60 laboratories, with contact tracing up to 80%. There are no vaccines or treatments approved for Bundibugyo yet; trials of MBP134 monoclonal antibody and remdesivir are underway, and a safety trial of the ChAdOx1 vaccine has begun, alongside a post-exposure prophylaxis study using obeldesivir. Uganda reports two deaths among 20 cases; as of 14 July 2026, no active cases remain.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ出血熱の流行は過去のどの流行よりも「速く」拡大していると、WHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で2,003症例・796死亡に達し、過去の流行より速いペースで拡大しているとWHOが警告。ワクチン・治療薬未承認かつ監視網を逃れる伝播が多数確認されており、国際的拡大（ウガンダへの越境）も発生している。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも症例が報告されているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。Bundibugyo変異株に対する承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在しない点が特に懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda entlässt letzten Ebola-Patienten: Hoffnung auf Ende
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda discharges the last Ebola patients: Hope for an end.
article.articleSummary: Uganda has discharged the last Ebola patients, triggering the 42-day period required under international guidelines before the outbreak can be officially declared over, provided no new cases appear. During this interim, Uganda's Ministry of Health urged vigilance for Ebola symptoms such as fever, vomiting, diarrhea, or unexplained bleeding. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, the outbreak continues to spread. Since mid-May, more than 2,000 people have been infected, with 2,073 confirmed cases and 796 deaths reported. At present, 737 patients are being treated in clinics and isolation centers. Ebola virus infection is life-threatening and spreads through close contact and body fluids. The current Congo outbreak is particularly hard to contain, because the Bundibugyo strain has no licensed vaccine or specific therapy yet. Since early July, two antiviral therapies are undergoing clinical trials.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、最後のエボラ患者を退院させる：終息への希望
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で2,073人感染・796人死亡という深刻なエボラ流行が継続中であり、ワクチン未承認株のため制御が困難なため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: ウガンダ側は隔離期間に入り終息の兆しがあるが、コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）では流行が拡大中でありBundibugyo株にはワクチン・特異的治療法が未確立。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: India News | Gates MRI, Serum Institute of India Sign Agreement to Manufacture Tuberculosis Vaccine Candidate
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-07-16, Gates Medical Research Institute (Gates MRI) and Serum Institute of India (SII) signed an agreement to manufacture the novel tuberculosis vaccine candidate M72/AS01E. The vaccine, currently in Phase 3, could be the first new TB vaccine in more than a century, addressing TB—the world’s leading infectious killer—especially in low- and middle-income countries. SII will transfer technology and invest over $100 million to strengthen manufacturing readiness; GSK will supply the AS01E adjuvant. Phase 3 trial started March 2024 and enrolled 20,000 participants by April 2025 across 54 sites in South Africa, Kenya, Malawi, Zambia, and Indonesia. Phase 2b data (3,575 participants) showed ~50% protection against progression to active pulmonary TB in HIV-negative adults 18–50. WHO estimates suggest a vaccine with this efficacy could prevent 76 million TB cases, save 8.5 million lives, and $41.5 billion for households over 25 years; potential for adult/adolescent use in high TB burden countries.

triage.notes: 本記事はTBワクチン候補M72/AS01Eの製造提携に関する報道であり、疾病発生や流行状況を報じるものではない。Phase3試験実施国（南アフリカ、ケニア、マラウイ、ザンビア、インドネシア）は言及されているが、いずれも試験実施地としての言及であり、疾病発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: الغذاء والدواء تعلن إنجازا نوعيا بتسجيل أول مطعوم محلي للمكورات الرئوية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Food and Drug Authority announces a major milestone in the registration of the first locally produced pneumococcal vaccine.
article.articleSummary: Jordan's Food and Drug Administration (FDA) announced the registration of the TQ-PCV 13-valent Pneumococcal Polysaccharide Conjugate Vaccine, 0.5 ml, the first locally produced pneumococcal vaccine in the Kingdom. The vaccine is manufactured under contract with China's Walvax Biotech for Al-Taqadum for Pharmaceuticals in Jordan, to immunize children from 3 months to 5 years and protect against 13 serotypes of Streptococcus pneumoniae by promoting immune development. The achievement follows completion of technical and scientific evaluation by the Drug Directorate's Biological Medicines Registration and the Sera and Vaccines Committee under Jordan's FDA. Dr. Rana Obaidat, Director General, calls the registration a milestone for national pharmaceutical development, boosting innovation, drug security, and competitiveness, and reinforcing Jordan's status as a regional hub for pharmaceutical industry and innovation. Dated 16 July 2026.

article.articleHeadline: La OMS alerta de que el brote de ébola en RDC ya es el tercero mayor registrado y pide más apoyo internacional
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns that the Ebola outbreak in the DRC is already the third-largest on record and calls for more international support.
article.articleSummary: WHO reports Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as of 16 July 2026, has reached 2,073 cases and 796 deaths, making it the third-largest on record. Focus remains on Ituri province, where over 80% of new cases are detected outside known contact lists, signaling undetected transmission chains. About two-thirds of deaths occur in community settings before patients reach health facilities. Response capacity exceeds 800 beds and 16 laboratories, with contact tracing approaching 80% and over 21,000 community workers engaged in surveillance and awareness. Safe and dignified burials have improved. Trials underway include MBP-134 monoclonal antibody and remdesivir; a ChAdOx1 vaccine safety study has begun; and a post-exposure prophylaxis antiviral study is planned. With no licensed vaccines or treatments yet, 377 recoveries have been attributed to early diagnosis and clinical care. Insecurity in eastern DRC hampers access; Bunia treatment center was attacked. International funding gaps exceed $400 million.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行が過去3番目の規模に達したと警告し、国際的支援拡大を要請
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで2,073例・796人死亡に達し過去3番目の規模の流行となっており、未検出の感染連鎖や治安悪化による対応困難、国際的資金不足が指摘されるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 80%以上の新規症例が既知の接触者リスト外で検出されており、市中での感染連鎖の把握が困難な状況。治安悪化により治療センターが攻撃を受けるなど対応能力への深刻な影響あり。国際資金不足が4億ドル超と報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: В Конго от лихорадки Эбола умерли почти 800 человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, nearly 800 people have died from Ebola virus disease.
article.articleSummary: 2,073 Ebola virus disease cases and 796 deaths have been reported in the Democratic Republic of Congo, according to the World Health Organization. The outbreak is spreading faster than during the 2018–2019 episode, with WHO noting high regional risk and declaring the situation a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17. By June 24 at 13:40 local time, the first Ebola case was identified in France, indicating an imported/exported case. The current focus remains the DRC, with ongoing transmission and international concern. The article does not provide laboratory confirmation details or explicit infection sources. Keywords: Ebola, Democratic Republic of Congo, France, WHO emergency, imported case, outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱によりほぼ800人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が2018-2019年より急速に拡大し、WHOがPHEICを宣言、フランスへの越境輸出例も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: フランスでの症例は輸入例であり、発生自体はDRCが主体のため、DRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。フランスは対象国リストにも含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Plus de 2.000 cas de rougeole chez les enfants territoire de Punia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 2,000 measles cases among children in Punia Territory
article.articleSummary: Punia Territory in Maniema reports a measles outbreak since June, with 2,089 cases and 21 deaths among children under five at the General Reference Hospital, per Dr. Amisi Makutano. Health authorities urge parents to avoid self-medication and announce an integrated vaccination campaign against measles, rubella, and poliomyelitis. The campaign targets children aged 6 months to 15 years to cover all age groups affected by the outbreak. The triple-dose campaign aims to prevent further transmission, strengthen mass vaccination, and protect vulnerable children amid precarious health conditions. The effort follows directives from higher authorities, signaling coordinated action to curb the outbreak and reduce morbidity and mortality in Punia Territory.

triage.headline_ja: プニア準州で子どもたちの間で麻疹症例が2,000件を超える
triage.triage_reason: 5歳未満児を中心に2,089症例・21死亡という重大な麻疹アウトブレイクであり、致死率も高く、公衆衛生への深刻な影響とワクチン接種キャンペーンなど管理支援の必要性が認められる。
triage.notes: 2,089症例・21死亡という規模は深刻であり、麻疹・風疹・ポリオの統合ワクチンキャンペーンが計画されている。感染拡大が国境を越えるかは不明だが、地域内での大規模流行として要注視。

article.articleHeadline: Costa Rica detecta por primera vez un virus en garrapatas que no había sido identificado en Centroamérica
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Costa Rica Detects for the First Time a Virus in Ticks That Had Not Previously Been Identified in Central America.
article.articleSummary: Costa Rica and Central America report the first detection of Jingmen tick virus in ticks, found in Valle La Estrella, Limón. The virus was detected in Amblyomma mixtum ticks collected from horses (97 samples analyzed between Oct 2023 and May 2024); ticks from vegetation tested negative. There is no evidence the virus causes disease in people or animals in Costa Rica, and no diagnostic test beyond the PCR used in the study is available. Whether horses participate in transmission remains uncertain, though the virus could involve other hosts given the tick’s broad vertebrate range. Genomic analysis at the Pasteur Institute (France) reveals a local Costa Rican variant linked to Europe and Western Asia lineages, distinct from Brazilian African-associated lineages. No detections were found in Ciudad Colón, Heredia, Monte de la Cruz, or Vara Blanca; preliminary comparisons with Panama show regional viral differences. The finding prompts enhanced surveillance and prevention efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コスタリカ、中米で未確認だったウイルスをマダニから初めて検出
triage.triage_reason: 中米で未確認だったジングメンウイルスがマダニから初検出されたが、ヒトや動物への病原性の証拠はなく、対象国での発生でもないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: コスタリカ、パナマ、ブラジル、フランス（パスツール研究所での解析）が言及されているが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空。ヒト・動物への病原性は未確認で、監視強化の段階。

article.articleHeadline: В Конго уже 796 человек стали жертвами лихорадки Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, 796 people have already fallen victim to Ebola fever.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains active, with the World Health Organization reporting 2,073 cases and 796 deaths as of July 16, 2026. The pace of transmission is accelerating, and the current outbreak is developing much faster than the 2018–2019 epidemic—where the 2,000-case mark was surpassed after about ten months—this threshold has been reached in a far shorter timeframe. International public health officials express serious concern over the rapid spread. Authorities are urged to intensify case finding, accelerate vaccination campaigns, and strengthen containment efforts to curb transmission. The report underscores growing toll and the need for continued surveillance by WHO and national health authorities to guide response. No specific details on transmission source or laboratory confirmation are provided in the brief.
