triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱が2,073症例・796死亡と大規模化し、過去の流行より拡大速度が速いことからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、国際的な懸念も高い。
triage.notes: 致死率は約38%（796/2073）と高く、2018-2019年流行より急速な拡大が指摘されている。感染源・検査確定の詳細は不明。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola au Nord-Kivu: la sensibilisation renforcée auprès des intervenants dans le domaine du transport - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in North Kivu: enhanced awareness among transport sector stakeholders - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in Beni, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, highlighted on 16 July 2026 as transport sector stakeholders were mobilized to reinforce prevention efforts. About 30 confirmed EVD cases and roughly 20 deaths have been reported in Beni, with the outbreak now affecting several health zones. Officials say the disease was imported from Ituri province and spread largely through public transport, especially inter-location travel. Patrick Muhindo Banyanga, provincial Transport Division head, and Désiré Buyana urged doubling awareness in the transport sector and adherence to barrier measures. Transport workers pledged intensified outreach. On the Beni-Butembo axis, taxi operators known as Leo Leo have reduced passengers from six to four to implement social distancing, reflecting measures to curb transmission and bolster the response.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州のエボラ:交通機関関係者への啓発強化 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRC北キブ州ベニで確認例約30例・死亡約20例のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが複数の保健地区に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため精査が必要。
triage.notes: イツリ州からベニへの輸入例が公共交通機関を介して拡大しており、致死率が高い（約67%）ため重症度が高いと判断。渡航・貿易制限の実施有無は記事内で言及なし。

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19: 12 infections, 4 deaths in Andhra between Jun 26-Jul 16
article.articleSummary: Covid-19: 12 infections, 4 deaths reported in Andhra Pradesh between June 26 and July 16, 2026. Cases were sporadic, not a cluster. Kadapa accounted for 8 infections and 3 of the deaths; Kakinada 1 death; Guntur 2 infections; Visakhapatnam 1 infection. The first 2026 case was in Kadapa on June 26; 11 more infections were reported July 1–16, with two cases from close contact exposure. 67 tests were conducted June 26–July 15; 11 positives in Andhra Pradesh and one detected at Christian Medical College, Vellore, Tamil Nadu. Among the infected, 3 are in home isolation, 2 in hospital, and 3 have recovered. All four deaths involved individuals with comorbidities such as hypertension, diabetes, and renal issues.

triage.headline_ja: コロナ19:アーンドラ・プラデーシュ州で6月26日〜7月16日の間に12件感染、4件死亡
triage.triage_reason: 散発的な症例で基礎疾患を有する患者の死亡が中心であり、クラスター形成や異常な拡大は見られないため、通常のサーベイランス報告と判断される。
triage.notes: COVID-19は既に地域流行状態にあり、本記事は定例の症例報告に留まる。死亡例は全て基礎疾患（高血圧、糖尿病、腎疾患）を有する患者であり、クラスターではなく散発例として報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: منظمة الصحة العالمية تحذر من سرعة تفشي فيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization warns of the rapid spread of the Ebola virus
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is spreading faster than any previous outbreak, the WHO warns. Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said more than 2,000 infections and 796 deaths have been confirmed since the outbreak was announced two months ago, making it the third-largest Ebola outbreak on record. The 2018–2020 outbreak took more than ten months to reach 2,000 cases; current transmission is accelerating. Outbreak was declared on May 15 in Ituri province in the northeast, an area with armed groups; infections have been detected in five provinces and neighboring Uganda. The surge is caused by the rare Bundibugyo strain, transmitted by close contact and bodily fluids, with no approved vaccine or treatment. More than 80% of new infections are among people not listed in known contact lists, and about two-thirds of deaths occur in communities without healthcare access. A treatment center in Bunia was attacked on Wednesday.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関(WHO)、エボラウイルスの急速な拡大に警鐘
triage.triage_reason: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国における過去最速のエボラ拡大を警告し、2000人超の感染・796人の死亡、近隣国ウガンダへの拡大も確認されており、IHR基準を複数満たす重大な公衆衛生イベントである。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダへの感染拡大にも言及しているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。武装勢力の存在や治療センターへの攻撃など、対応の困難さを示す情報あり。

article.articleHeadline: هجوم على مشفى في الكونغو يدفع مرضى إيبولا وفرق الطوارئ إلى الفرار
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An attack on a hospital in Congo forces Ebola patients and emergency teams to flee.
article.articleSummary: An angry crowd attacked Nyakondi Hospital in Ituri province, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, forcing Ebola patients and emergency teams to flee and rendering the facility inoperable. A medical official said the attack followed the death of a woman needing a blood transfusion; during the outbreak, blood transfusions were restricted, and the hospital refused a donation due to these rules. The incident underscores challenges in eastern DRC, where distrust of medical teams, community resistance, and insecurity hamper treatment and containment of Ebola. As of two months since the outbreak declaration, the World Health Organization reports over 2,000 Ebola cases and 796 deaths, making this the third-largest outbreak on record. Response efforts face hurdles including limited vaccines for some strains, ongoing insecurity, and misperceptions about isolation and prevention.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでの病院襲撃によりエボラ患者と緊急対応チームが避難を余儀なくされる
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部イトゥリ州で2000人超の感染者、796人の死亡者を出す過去3番目に大きいエボラ流行が継続中であり、病院襲撃により対応体制が損なわれている。公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的関心の高さからフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 病院襲撃・地域住民の不信・治安不安がアウトブレイク対応を阻害しており、WHOも大規模流行として報告。今後の感染拡大や対応の遅延リスクに注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Humanitarian workers escape violence at DR Congo Ebola treatment center: Report
article.articleSummary: Violence at Ituri's Nyakunde Ebola treatment center prompted evacuation of humanitarian workers from Africa CDC, WHO, Samaritan Purse, and FHI 360 after angry residents ransacked the center over a dead body; four patients fled, three remained; security intervened; pregnant woman died of anemia at Nyakunde General Hospital, where health protocols delayed handing over the body. Ituri province — responsible for about 90% of more than 2,000 confirmed Ebola cases in DRC to date — continues to face insecurity, attacks on health facilities, and community mistrust. OCHA reports 45 response/aid worker injuries across 76 security incidents in Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu since the Congo outbreak began in May. UNICEF warned funding gaps, with only 25% of required resources available, urging faster, scaled containment actions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ治療センターで暴力、人道支援職員が避難:報道
triage.triage_reason: 既存のエボラアウトブレイク(確定2000例超)継続下で治療施設が襲撃され患者が逃走、接触者追跡の中断や地域拡大のリスクが高まっており、資金不足により国際支援が必要とされているため。
triage.notes: Ituri州はDRCエボラ確定症例の約90%を占める中心地。治安悪化により患者が治療センターから逃走し追跡不能となった点、資金確保が必要とされる資源不足（必要額の25%のみ確保）が特に懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola spreading faster than ever in DRC, WHO warns as cases top 2 000
article.articleSummary: DRC’s 17th Ebola outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo species (no approved vaccine or treatment), has surpassed 2,000 confirmed cases and 796 deaths, with the majority in Ituri province and cases also detected in five other DRC provinces and neighboring Uganda. Declared May 15, the outbreak is expanding faster than any previous DRC Ebola outbreak, now about two months on. Transmission occurs through close contact and infected bodily fluids; about 80% of new cases are outside known contact lists, and two-thirds of deaths occur in communities without care at health facilities. Response capacity has increased to 800 beds and 16 laboratories, but armed conflict in Ituri hampers access; a treatment centre was attacked in Bunia. Trials include MBP134 and remdesivir; safety testing of ChAdOx1 vaccine; obeldesivir PEP trial. A funding shortfall of over $400 million calls for urgent international support; emphasis on surveillance, safe burials, and clinical management.

triage.headline_ja: DRCでエボラ出血熱がかつてない速さで拡大、症例数2000人超えとWHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確認例2,000人・死者796人を超えるエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが過去最速で拡大しており、ウガンダへの越境伝播も確認されている。国際的資金不足と武力紛争による対応阻害も重なり、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの症例波及が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。武装紛争による対応の困難さ、4億ドル超の資金不足、承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在しない点も重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: Smrtonosni virus odnosi sve više života: Ebola se munjevito širi, sistem pred kolapsom - zdravstveni radnici stupili u štrajk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deadly virus taking more and more lives: Ebola spreading rapidly, the health system on the brink of collapse — healthcare workers have gone on strike.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surged to 2,011 confirmed cases with at least 754 deaths, in what authorities describe as the fastest-spreading outbreak in the country's history. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugjo (Bundibugyo) ebolavirus. Since onset on May 15, 753 patients are in isolation or hospital care and 366 have recovered. The World Health Organization notes over 100 health workers infected. About 80% of new cases arise from unknown transmission chains, and the so-called patient zero remains unidentified. Health-system strain is compounded by armed conflict, displacement, and attacks on facilities. Bunia General Hospital, the region’s largest, faces worker strikes over unpaid salaries; similarly, in Rvampari staff paused work but agreed to return if paid within 72 hours. Unlike the Zaire strain, Bundibugjo has no licensed vaccine or therapies; two experimental drugs are in trials in Ituri Province.

triage.headline_ja: 命を奪い続ける致死性ウイルス：エボラが急速に拡大、医療体制は崩壊寸前 — 医療従事者がストライキに突入
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)による大規模流行が発生し、確定症例2,011人・死者754人、医療従事者100人以上感染、ワクチン未承認という深刻な公衆衛生危機であり、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株にはワクチン・治療薬が未承認であり、80%が感染経路不明の市中感染。武力紛争と医療従事者ストライキにより対応能力がさらに低下しており、WHOによる国際的注視が必要な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia de ébola deja más de 750 fallecidos en República Democrática del Congo - teleSUR
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic leaves more than 750 dead in the Democratic Republic of the Congo - teleSUR
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri province) has surpassed 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths. Transmission has extended from Ituri into Alto Uélé and Tshopo, while Uganda reports its last patient discharged in Kampala and begins a 42-day observation to declare Ebola-free. MSF warns unprecedented spread amid healthcare capacity strain as Bunia and Mongbwalu facilities operate at or beyond capacity in a conflict-affected setting with internally displaced populations. WHO notes over 100 health workers infected and many new cases from unknown transmission chains. OCHA reports 11 decentralized labs processing up to 250 samples daily and 22 treatment centers with more than 700 beds. Armed hostilities in North Kivu and Ituri threaten response safety. Health workers in Bunia began a July 15 strike demanding salaries, bonuses, and PPE; payroll delays cited. Civil society warns strike could halt contact tracing and patient isolation across five provinces.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行、コンゴ民主共和国で750人以上が死亡
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ確定症例2,011件・死亡754人に達し、複数州へ拡大、医療従事者感染や不明感染経路、紛争地域でのストライキが対応を脅かしており、IHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダは最後の患者が退院し42日間の観察期間に入ったとの報告があるが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。主たる発生地はDRCイツリ州・アルトウエレ州・チョポ州。

article.articleHeadline: इबोला पर काबू के करीब युगांडा, 42 दिनों तक नया मामला नहीं मिला तो खत्म होगा प्रकोप
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda close to bringing Ebola under control; if no new cases for 42 days, the outbreak will end.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 July 2026, Uganda has discharged its last Ebola patient from Mulago National Referral Hospital in Kampala, initiating a 42-day surveillance period. If no new cases arise, the outbreak will be officially declared over. The World Health Organization and Health Minister Chris Baryomunsi said the patient tested negative and poses no transmission risk; this outbreak has a case-fatality rate around 10%, among the lowest for Ebola outbreaks. Since confirmation on May 15, 2026, Uganda has reported 20 confirmed cases: 15 Congolese nationals and 5 Ugandan nationals, with 2 deaths. The Bundibugyo strain was identified in a traveler from the Democratic Republic of Congo, which currently bears the highest burden of this strain. WHO officials credited strong preparedness and vigilant response throughout the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、エボラ制圧に近づく:42日間新規感染なければ流行終息へ
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は重篤度・国際的懸念が高い疾患であり、ウガンダ・DRC間の越境感染例が確認されているため、終息間近とはいえ継続的モニタリングが必要と判断した。
triage.notes: 主な発生地であるウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは感染者の国籍（15名がコンゴ人）及び同株の最大負担国として言及されているため含めた。流行は終息に向かっているが、越境感染事例があるため経過観察を継続すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Súčasná epidémia eboly v Kongu je najrýchlejšia zo všetkých, upozornila WHO
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The current Ebola epidemic in the Congo is the fastest of all, the WHO warned.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo faces the fastest Ebola virus disease outbreak on record, according to the WHO. In roughly two months since the outbreak was declared, over 2,000 confirmed cases and 796 deaths have been reported, making it the third-largest Ebola outbreak in history. The seventeenth Ebola outbreak in the DRC began in Ituri province on May 15, and cases have appeared across five provinces and in neighboring Uganda. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. Despite intensified response, more than 80 percent of new cases are detected outside known contact lists, indicating transmission chains are slipping. About two-thirds of deaths occur in communities where people never accessed health care in a facility. Transmission occurs through close contact and infected bodily fluids.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、過去最速とWHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: WHOが過去最速規模のエボラ流行と警告しており、致死率・拡大規模ともに深刻で、隣国ウガンダへの国際的拡大も確認されているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの感染拡大が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。承認されたワクチン・治療法がないBundibugyoエボラウイルスによる流行であり、症例の80%以上が接触者リスト外で検出されるなど感染制御が困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Médico relata fuga de pacientes com Ebola por ataque a hospital na RD Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctor reports Ebola patients' escape after attack on hospital in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak-related attack in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo forced evacuation of Ebola patients and staff from Nyakunde Hospital in Ituri province after a furious crowd attacked the facility on Wednesday afternoon and night (the 15th), protesting the death of a pregnant woman who developed severe anemia. Hospital officials said about 10 Ebola patients were receiving care when the crowd struck; several fled and staff left; the generator powering the unit also stopped. The woman died around 15:00 local time; family members offered blood for transfusion, but transfusions are prohibited during Ebola outbreaks. The incident highlights security and trust challenges hampering Ebola response in eastern DRC, where violence disrupts containment. The country’s current 17th Ebola outbreak has 2,073 confirmed cases and 796 deaths. The army opened an investigation into Nyakunde disturbances; health workers warn of strain and strikes due to workload and pay.

triage.headline_ja: 医師が語る、DRコンゴでの病院襲撃によるエボラ患者の逃亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ患者の逃亡・治療中断という公衆衛生上深刻な事態であり、既に大規模流行(2,073症例・796死亡)が進行中でヒト-ヒト感染拡大リスクが高いためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: エボラ患者の逃亡により地域内での感染拡大リスクが高まっており、治安不安が対応を阻害している。継続的な症例・死亡数の増加状況を注視する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Σήμα κινδύνου από τον ΠΟΥ - Η επιδημία εξαπλώνεται "ταχύτερα από τις προηγούμενες"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: WHO issues a warning — the outbreak is spreading faster than previous outbreaks.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, declared mid-May 2026, is spreading faster than any previous outbreak, according to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. He told reporters in Geneva that it ranks as the third-largest Ebola outbreak on record and is expanding more rapidly in recent months than earlier incidents. As of July 16, 2026, the outbreak has caused 796 deaths and more than 2,000 confirmed cases across the DRC. The warning highlights sustained transmission and the need for intensified public health measures, surveillance, and international support to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：WHOが警告を発表 - 流行は「これまでより速いペースで」拡大
triage.triage_reason: WHO事務局長が公式に警告を発表し、796人死亡・2000人超の症例という重大な公衆衛生上の影響があり、過去最速の拡大というIHR基準複数該当およびWPRO基準複数該当のため。
triage.notes: スイス・ジュネーブはWHO本部所在地としての言及であり、発生国はDRCのみ。過去最大級かつ最速拡大の流行としてWHOが公式警告を発出しており、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Alarm u WHO-u: Više od 80 posto novih slučajeva ebole otkriveno izvan popisa kontakata
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alarm at the WHO: More than 80 percent of new Ebola cases detected outside the contact list.
article.articleSummary: DRC's Ebola outbreak, declared two months ago, now totals 2,073 cases and 796 deaths, marking it the third-largest Ebola epidemic and spreading faster than any prior outbreak. More than 80% of new cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have been detected outside known contact lists, signaling ongoing gaps in transmission chain tracking. The primary concern remains intense transmission in Ituri province, with about two-thirds of deaths occurring in communities that never sought treatment at health facilities. Despite deterioration, progress includes expanding laboratory capacity from one site to 16, increasing treatment capacity to over 800 beds, and achieving around 80% contact-tracing coverage. Trials of vaccines and treatments are underway, including the ChAdOx1 vaccine (first safety trial began Monday), MBP134 monoclonal antibody, remdesivir, and the antiviral obeldesivir.

triage.headline_ja: WHOで警鐘:新規エボラ症例の80%以上が接触者リスト外で検出
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行は2,073例・796死亡と過去最大級規模で、80%以上の新規症例が既知の接触者リスト外から検出されるなど、伝播チェーン把握の破綻と急速な拡大が示唆されており、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 致死率が高く(796/2073≈38%)、接触者追跡外での感染拡大が続いていることから、既に国際的懸念事例(PHEIC相当)として扱われている可能性が高い。続報でWHOの正式評価・国際対応状況を確認する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: इबोला पर काबू के करीब युगांडा, 42 दिनों तक नया मामला नहीं मिला तो खत्म होगा प्रकोप | Bunia: Ebola outbreak in Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda close to bringing Ebola under control; if no new cases are reported for 42 days, the outbreak will end | Bunia: Ebola outbreak in Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of July 16, 2026, Uganda discharged its last Ebola patient from Mulago National Referral Hospital, triggering a 42-day monitoring period to determine if the outbreak has ended. The patient’s test results were negative, and officials say there is no longer a risk of transmission; the person may return home and resume normal activities. WHO representatives credited Uganda’s preparedness and vigilant response, noting the outbreak’s case fatality rate of about 10%, among the lowest seen in Ebola events. Uganda first confirmed Ebola on May 15 after a traveler from the Democratic Republic of the Congo tested positive for the Bundibugyo strain, which remains most associated with DRC outbreaks. To date, Uganda has 20 confirmed cases (15 Congo nationals, 5 Ugandan nationals) and 2 deaths. If no new cases arise within 42 days, the outbreak will be officially declared over; Bunia, DRC context underscores cross-border risk.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、エボラ制圧に近づく：42日間新規感染なければ流行終息へ｜ブニア：コンゴでのエボラ流行
triage.triage_reason: エボラという重篤な病原体でコンゴ民主共和国からウガンダへの越境感染が確認されており、IHR基準（深刻性・国際的拡大）を2項目満たすためフルリスク評価への移行を推奨する。
triage.notes: 本記事の流行発生地はウガンダ（対象国リスト外）であり、DRCは感染者の国籍・株の由来として言及されているのみで、実際の症例発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めていない。ただし国境を越えた感染拡大リスクとしてDRC側の継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: इबोला पर काबू के करीब युगांडा, 42 दिनों तक नया मामला नहीं मिला तो खत्म होगा प्रकोप - Punjab Kesari
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda Nears Control of Ebola; Outbreak Will End If No New Cases Are Reported for 42 Days.
article.articleSummary: Uganda is nearing formal outbreak end as the last Ebola patient was discharged after testing negative, initiating a 42-day monitoring period in Kampala. If no new cases emerge within 42 days, the outbreak will be officially declared over. Since confirming on May 15, 2026, Uganda has reported 20 confirmed Ebola cases (15 Congolese nationals and 5 Ugandan nationals) with 2 deaths. The patient discharge occurred at Mulago National Referral Hospital, with authorities noting the individual can return home and resume normal life. WHO representatives attributed the low case-fatality rate of about 10% to strong preparedness. The outbreak traces to the Bundibugyo strain, linked to a traveler from the Democratic Republic of Congo, where this strain is most active. The 42-day period begins now to confirm absence of further transmission. Keywords: outbreak, preparedness, Bundibugyo, Kampala, DRC, Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、エボラ制圧に近づく；42日間新規症例なければ流行終息
triage.triage_reason: 既知のエボラ流行が終息段階にあることを伝える続報であり、新規のシグナルとしての異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダにおけるエボラ流行の終息プロセス（最終患者退院、42日間モニタリング開始）を報じる続報。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれず、DRCは感染者の由来国として言及されているのみで、DRC国内での流行発生を主題とした記事ではないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: WHO warns DR Congo Ebola outbreak is outpacing response as Uganda reaches milestone
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak in Ituri is the third-largest on record, with 2,273 cases and 796 deaths after two months. Transmission is accelerating, with over 80% of new infections detected outside known contact lists; about two-thirds of deaths occur in people who never seek facility care. Ituri province remains the main hotspot; Bunia Ebola treatment centre was attacked, hampering operations. Treatment capacity increased to 800+ beds, labs to 16, and contact follow-up to about 80%. Over 21,000 community health workers trained; safe and dignified burials improving; 377 recoveries recorded. Uganda reports 20 confirmed cases and 2 deaths since May 15; last patient discharged, initiating a 42-day countdown. 15 imported cases from DRC, 5 local transmission. Funding gap >$400 million for Africa CDC-WHO plan; UNICEF says only 25% of required funding available.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、DRCのエボラ流行が対応を上回るペースで拡大と警告、一方ウガンダは節目に到達
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上3番目に大きいエボラ流行が進行中で感染が加速しており、ウガンダへの越境伝播も発生。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、資金不足によりWHOが警告を発する重大事案。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも症例が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。感染拡大加速・資金不足・治療施設への攻撃など、フルRRAでの詳細評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: RD Congo: La epidemia de ébola fuera de control
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: The Ebola epidemic is out of control.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is surging in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri (Bunia) and North Kivu, with reported over 2,000 cases and 796 deaths; authorities warn the epidemic may be two to four times higher than official counts. In Bunia, on the first day of June, volunteers transporting a coffin for a deceased patient were attacked by locals, underscoring resistance to WHO-recommended safe burial practices designed to curb transmission. The outbreak involves the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, for which there is no vaccine and no proven effective treatment yet. Ongoing conflict and militia activity in war-affected areas impede movement of doctors, tracing of contacts, and care for patients, while Red Cross and other responders face threats. Community dialogue remains essential to counter rumors, reduce fear, and improve adherence to preventive measures.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラの流行が制御不能に
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ワクチン・有効治療法未確立のブンディブギョ株）が2,000例超・死者796人と拡大し、紛争地帯での対応困難や安全埋葬への抵抗など、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクを伴う異常事態であるため。
triage.notes: ワクチン・有効治療法が確立されていないブンディブギョ株であること、紛争による対応阻害、実際の症例数が公式発表の2〜4倍の可能性がある点は重大なリスク要因。フルRRAでの詳細評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Venezuela, Estados Unidos, calor extremo en Europa, ébola... Las noticias del jueves
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Venezuela, United States, extreme heat in Europe, Ebola... Thursday's news.
article.articleSummary: El Niño strengthening could aggravate Venezuela’s earthquake displacement, with the IOM integrating climate risk into response planning as aid shifts to recovery. About 7,000 people are in collective shelters and more than 10,000 services have been delivered, with 20,000 residents in shelters receiving assistance; a 12-month call to sustain emergency aid and housing follows. Independent UN human rights experts denounce the arbitrary dismissal of at least 135 US immigration judges since January 2025, warning such purges undermine due process. Europe records roughly 10,000 heat-related deaths this summer; WHO urges treating heat as an emergency, publishing updated guidance on alerts, surveillance, protecting the vulnerable, hospital readiness, and risk communication. The Democratic Republic of the Congo Ebola outbreak is the third-largest, with 2,073 cases and 796 deaths in two months. The Middle East conflict could push 23 million children into poverty.

triage.headline_ja: ベネズエラ、米国、欧州の猛暑、エボラ出血熱…木曜日のニュース
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが2ヶ月で2,073症例・796死亡（致死率約38%）と報告され、史上3番目の規模とされる重大な公衆衛生事象であるため。
triage.notes: 本記事は国連ニュースの複数トピックまとめ記事であり、ベネズエラの地震避難や米国移民判事解雇、欧州の猛暑は本エボラ事象とは無関係。エボラに関する詳細情報（発生州、感染経路、対応状況等）は本文に記載がなく、続報での確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Isiro: le gouvernement déplore le retrait d'une malade présentant les signes d'Ebola de l'hôpital - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Isiro: The government deplores the withdrawal of a patient presenting Ebola symptoms from the hospital - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Two Ebola-related deaths were reported in Isiro, Haut-Uélé, northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo, on 16 July 2026. A first family forcibly removed the body of a patient who died of Ebola at Pedu Hospital in Isiro, originating from the Ebola-affected PK 51 area of Nia-nia. A second family withdrew a patient with Ebola symptoms from Isiro University Clinics to a revival church, where she died. Authorities condemned these acts of incivility that threaten public health, and promised measures against the perpetrators. Félix Adima, head of the DPS Haut-Uélé communications task force, said the two deaths will be buried on 16 July 2026 by the Red Cross on site in Isiro. Officials stressed that Ebola is not treated in churches; funerals will follow sanitary procedures to prevent spread, and residents are urged to observe barrier measures daily.

triage.headline_ja: イジロ:政府、エボラの兆候を示す患者が病院から連れ出されたことを非難 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱による死亡例が複数報告され、遺体の不適切な取り扱いや患者の未承認の移動により地域社会での感染拡大リスクが高まっているため、フルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: 遺体の強制持ち出しや患者の教会への移送など、公衆衛生対応を妨げる行動が報告されており、感染拡大リスクの管理に懸念がある。

article.articleHeadline: Acre segue em alerta para síndrome respiratória, aponta Fiocruz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Acre remains on alert for respiratory syndrome, according to Fiocruz.
article.articleSummary: Acre remains on alert for Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) per Fiocruz, though nationwide respiratory illness in decline. For Epidemiological Week 27 (July 5–11), Acre is among 17 states with high SRAG incidence; Rio Branco is among five capitals with SRAG activity rising over the last six weeks. RSV continues to drive bronchiolitis and other respiratory infections in children up to two years, while influenza A remains the leading cause of deaths among those 65+. In Rio Branco, trends reflect broader regional concern: Aracaju, Campo Grande, Goiânia, and Porto Alegre also show growth. Fiocruz emphasizes prevention (handwashing, covering coughs, masking when needed, avoiding contact when symptomatic) and up-to-date vaccination. Nationally, Brazil recorded 115,203 SRAG cases in 2026; positives: RSV 40.2%, rhinovirus 30.2%, influenza A 20.8%, influenza B 4.5%, COVID-19 4.5%; RSV accounts for 57.2% of positives in the last four epidemiological weeks.

triage.headline_ja: アクレ州、フィオクルスの指摘により呼吸器症候群への警戒が継続
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内で例年見られる季節性呼吸器感染症（RSV、インフルエンザ、COVID-19）のサーベイランス報告であり、全国的には減少傾向、異常性や国際的拡大の兆候はない。
triage.notes: 季節性呼吸器症候群（SRAG）の定例疫学報告であり、フィオクルスによる国内モニタリングの一環。全国的には症例減少中で、特定州（アクレ等）で高水準が続くのみ。パンデミック相当のシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Главные новости дня | четверг: Украина, Палестина, Эбола, Кипр
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Top news of the day | Thursday: Ukraine, Palestine, Ebola, Cyprus
article.articleSummary: Airstrikes last night in Ukraine killed and wounded civilians and damaged homes and civil infrastructure, with humanitarian access increasingly constrained as drones proliferate; nearly half of frontline and border communities face high or extreme access restrictions. The UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres expresses serious concern over Israel's decision to grant city status to the West Bank settlement of Givat Ze'ev, noting it does not change the area's legal status and that settlements, including East Jerusalem, violate international law and Security Council resolutions. The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading at unprecedented pace; in the last month there have been 2,073 cases and 796 deaths, with WHO expanding responses and initiating clinical trials of several therapies. Guterres will visit Cyprus July 27–29 to meet Greek- and Turkish-Cypriot leaders, while the Security Council conducts a closed session on Cyprus.

triage.headline_ja: 今日の主要ニュース｜木曜日：ウクライナ、パレスチナ、エボラ、キプロス
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）でエボラ出血熱が「前例のない速さ」で拡大しており、直近1か月で2,073症例・796死亡という深刻な公衆衛生インパクトがあり、WHOが対応拡大と治療薬臨床試験を開始している。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事はUNニュースの日次まとめであり、ウクライナ・パレスチナ・キプロスの話題は対象国リストに該当しないため除外。エボラのみがDRCで発生している主題として該当する。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو هجوم على مستشفى إيبولا يهدد جهود احتواء الوباء
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo: Attack on an Ebola hospital threatens outbreak containment efforts.
article.articleSummary: Three Ebola patients remained at Nyankunde Hospital in Ituri Province, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, as more than ten Ebola patients fled after an angry mob attacked the facility and damaged its fence, and a power generator failed. A woman who had arrived to give birth died from severe anemia; her family offered blood, but transfusions were barred during the outbreak. The violence underscores challenges in containing the seventh Ebola outbreak in the DRC, which has logged 2,073 confirmed infections and 796 deaths since it was declared in May. Samaritan's Purse evacuated staff from an adjacent Ebola treatment center as security deteriorated. The Congolese armed forces opened an investigation into the violence. Some patients remained in critical condition without treatment as clinics face distrust, community resistance, and security outages amid broader security and economic tensions linked to a US-backed mining deal.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：エボラ病院への襲撃が流行封じ込め努力を脅かす
triage.triage_reason: エボラ患者が病院襲撃により逃走し、輸血拒否による死亡例も発生するなど、既存の大規模流行（感染2,073例・死亡796例）の封じ込めが暴力とコミュニティの不信により著しく損なわれており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 第7次エボラ流行（2026年5月宣言）継続中、Ituri州の治療センターへの暴力的襲撃により患者が逃走・治療中断。国際NGO（Samaritan's Purse）はスタッフを避難させており、治安悪化と鉱山利権を巡る経済的緊張が背景にある。続報でWHO・国際社会の対応状況を要確認。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS en alerta por un virus "similar al ébola": Por qué nuestra preparación actual es insuficiente
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO on alert over an Ebola-like virus: Why our current preparedness is insufficient.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus, an Ebola-like filovirus, is causing an outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo after the death of a nurse. WHO data up to June 11 show 695 confirmed cases and 138 deaths, indicating rapid spread beyond previous Uganda and DRC outbreaks. Boston University virologist Nancy Sullivan, in a NEJM article, warns that preparedness cannot focus only on headline pathogens; delays in sample collection, transport, and laboratory confirmation hinder isolation, contact tracing, and control measures. Early Bundibugyo symptoms include severe hemorrhagic fever and often resemble malaria or typhoid, complicating diagnosis in rural DRC where specimens must be sent to centralized labs. There are no approved therapies or vaccines for Bundibugyo, underscoring the need for multinational operational readiness and the development of broad-spectrum countermeasures to act against any lethal virus before it escalates.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがエボラに似たウイルスに警戒：現在の備えが不十分な理由
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でブンディブギョウイルス（エボラ様フィロウイルス）の感染拡大が確認され、695例・138人死亡と重篤で、有効な治療薬・ワクチンが存在しないためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダも過去の流行地として言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。米国ボストンは研究者の所属地であり発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 世卫组织警告刚果（金）埃博拉疫情蔓延速度超过应对能力
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading faster than the response capacity.
article.articleSummary: On July 16, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading faster than the response capacity, with 2,273 confirmed cases and 796 deaths. In eastern Ituri province, transmission remains intense, with more than 80% of new infections identified outside known contact lists and about two-thirds of deaths occurring among community patients who never sought medical care. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that the outbreak’s pace outstrips response capacity, and armed conflict hampers relief; one Ebola treatment center in Bunia was attacked. Response capacity has expanded to over 800 beds, 16 laboratories, and close-contact tracing near 80%, with more than 21,000 community health workers trained. 377 people have recovered. In neighboring Uganda, 20 cases and 2 deaths have been reported since May 15; the last patient was discharged after two negative tests, starting a 42-day countdown. Funding gaps exceed $400 million; UNICEF says only 25% funded.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行が対応能力を超えて拡大していると警告
triage.triage_reason: 確認症例2,273例・死亡796例と規模が大きく、武力紛争による対応阻害、資金不足、ウガンダへの越境拡大がありIHR基準を複数満たすため。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも症例が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。資金不足（$400M超のギャップ、25%のみ充足）と武力紛争による対応困難が特筆される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC: propagation sans précédent, attaque d'un centre de traitement et appel à une intervention politique, l'OMS lance un cri d'alarme
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: unprecedented spread, attack on a treatment center, and a call for political intervention; the WHO sounds the alarm.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is spreading at an unprecedented pace, with Ituri bearing the brunt. As of 16 July 2026, 2,073 cases and 796 deaths have been reported, making it the third-largest Ebola outbreak on record; progression in the past month has been the fastest yet. In Ituri, transmission remains intense, with more than 80% of new cases detected outside known contact lists and about two-thirds of deaths in communities without timely access to care. The WHO and Africa CDC are intensifying the response: treatment capacity exceeds 800 beds; laboratories expanded from 1 to 16; contact tracing near 80%; over 21,000 health workers trained; burials improved. Trials include MBP134 and remdesivir, a ChAdOx1 vaccine trial, and obeldesivir post-exposure prophylaxis. Uganda reports 20 cases and 2 deaths; last patient discharged, starting a 42-day countdown. Bunia treatment center was attacked, underscoring insecurity and need for political intervention.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：前例のない拡大、治療センターへの攻撃、政治的介入への呼びかけ―WHOが警鐘を鳴らす
triage.triage_reason: 史上3番目の規模となったDRCのエボラ流行が前例のないペースで拡大し、ウガンダへの越境例も発生、WHOが警鐘を鳴らしていることからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも20例・2死亡が報告され最終患者退院により42日カウントダウン開始と記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。治療センターへの攻撃など治安面の懸念も報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: JJ: Jundiaí intensifica ações de prevenção contra hepatites virais
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: JJ: Jundiaí intensifies prevention measures against viral hepatitis
article.articleSummary: Jundiaí intensifies prevention of hepatitis A, B, and C under the national 'Yellow July' campaign, aiming to broaden information access, vaccination, prevention, rapid testing, and early diagnosis to prevent complications. Led by the Health Promotion Secretariat and the Municipal STI/HIV/AIDS and Viral Hepatitis Program, via the Testing and Counseling Center (CTA) and local health services. Free guidance, prevention, and expanded rapid testing will be offered at multiple sites: Friday, July 17, 2026, 08:00–15:00 at UBS Pitangueiras, Rua Itália, 91; Friday, July 17, 2026, 14:00–16:00 at UBS Tamoio, Rua Orestes Barbosa; Saturday, July 18, 2026, 08:30–11:00 at CTA, Rua Palmira Cervi Bárbaro, 91, Vila Hortolândia, and Núcleo Integrado de Saúde, Avenida Carlos Salles Block, 74, Anhangabaú. Open to all residents, with guidance and rapid tests for hepatitis B and C.

triage.headline_ja: JJ: ジュンジアイ市がウイルス性肝炎予防対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 「イエロージュライ」キャンペーンに基づく通常の啓発・予防活動であり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 定例の公衆衛生啓発キャンペーン報道であり、シグナルとしての緊急性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola spreading in DRC 'faster than any previous outbreak': WHO
article.articleSummary: Ebola in DRC’s 17th outbreak declared May 15 in Ituri, northeast DRC, with cases now in five provinces and neighbouring Uganda; majority in Ituri. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo Ebola, a rare strain with no approved vaccine or treatment. As of 2026-07-16, transmission is outpacing response; over 80% of new cases are detected outside known contact lists and about two-thirds of deaths occur in communities without facility care. National capacity has expanded to 800 treatment beds and 16 laboratories. So far, 377 people have recovered, indicating survival with early diagnosis and safe care. Trials are underway for MBP134 monoclonal antibody and remdesivir; the ChAdOx1 vaccine safety trial started, and obeldesivir post-exposure prophylaxis trial began for contacts. A treatment centre was attacked in Bunia amid a conflict-affected environment, and a funding shortfall of over $400 million for the WHO/Africa CDC plan hampers response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱、WHO『これまでで最速の流行』
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生中のエボラ出血熱（第17次流行）がこれまでで最速のペースで拡大し、ウガンダへの越境伝播、承認済みワクチン・治療薬の不在、資金不足が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの症例拡大が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。稀なブンディブギョ株による流行であり、承認済みワクチン・治療薬がない点、資金不足（4億ドル超）、治療施設への攻撃など、公衆衛生・治安両面でのリスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: L'Assemblée nationale auditionne le ministre de la Santé sur Ebola et adopte un rapport sur la pêche et l'aquaculture
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The National Assembly questions the Minister of Health on Ebola and adopts a report on fishing and aquaculture.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is ongoing in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with Ituri province the main epicenter. During the National Assembly plenary on July 15, 2026, Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba outlined the evolution of the outbreak, noting 2,011 total cases across affected zones. He stressed mobility challenges for response teams and limited disease awareness in some communities. He reassured MPs and the public that no Ebola case has been confirmed in Kinshasa to date, despite circulating rumors. Members questioned the resources mobilized, the response strategy, and prevention measures to protect populations. The session also addressed other parliamentary matters, including a bill on state of siege extension in Nord-Kivu and Ituri and a report on fishing and aquaculture.

triage.headline_ja: 国民議会がエボラ出血熱について保健大臣を聴取し、漁業・養殖業に関する報告書を採択
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の流行が継続しており、累計2,011症例に達している。国会で保健大臣が聴取されるなど政治的関心も高く、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価に進むべき事案。
triage.notes: キンシャサでの症例は否定されているが、噂が流布している点は社会的関心の高さを示す。イトゥリ州が主要な流行地であり、北キブ州・イトゥリ州では非常事態宣言の延長も審議されている。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ: вспышка Эболы в ДР Конго стала третьей по масштабам в истории
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: The Ebola outbreak in DR Congo became the third largest in history.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's ongoing Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, has reached 2,073 cases and 796 deaths in two months, ranking as the third-largest on record. Ituri Province remains hardest hit, with more than 80% of new cases among people not on known contact lists, signaling numerous undetected transmission chains. About two-thirds of deaths occur outside healthcare facilities, highlighting access gaps. Response measures include more than 800 treatment beds, 16 laboratories (up from 1), and contact tracing covering ~80%, with over 21,000 community workers trained. No approved vaccines or therapies exist yet, but trials are under way for MBP134 monoclonal antibody, remdesivir, and an early safety study of Oxford University’s ChAdOx1 vaccine; remdesivir is also being explored for prophylaxis among contacts. So far, 377 patients have recovered. Armed conflict hampers access; a treatment center in Bunia was attacked. WHO cites a funding gap exceeding $400 million and calls for urgent donor support.

triage.headline_ja: WHO: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、史上3番目の規模に
triage.triage_reason: 史上3番目の規模のエボラ流行で、致死率が高く、未検出の感染連鎖が多数示唆されており、武装紛争によりアクセスも困難で国際支援が必要とされているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ワクチン・治療薬は未承認で複数の治験が進行中。資金ギャップが4億ドル超とWHOが警告。武装勢力による治療施設への攻撃も発生しており、対応の障壁となっている。

article.articleHeadline: Ataque a hospital en el Congo provoca la huida de pacientes con ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Attack on a hospital in the Congo prompts Ebola patients to flee.
article.articleSummary: Assault on Nyakunde hospital in Ituri province, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, forced Ebola patients and emergency staff to flee, suspending hospital operations. The violence followed the death of a severely anemic woman who needed a blood transfusion; blood donation requests were restricted due to Ebola containment measures. The incident highlights distrust toward medical teams, local resistance, and insecurity that complicate outbreak response and containment. As of 16 July, the outbreak has surpassed 2,000 infections and 796 deaths, making it the third-largest Ebola outbreak on record. Ongoing challenges include limited vaccines for certain strains, fragile security, and ongoing conflict hindering access, along with gaps in public understanding of isolation and prevention measures.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの病院襲撃によりエボラ患者が逃走
triage.triage_reason: 感染者2,000人超・死者796人に達する史上3番目に大きいエボラ流行であり、治安悪化と病院襲撃により封じ込めが困難化しているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 病院襲撃・住民の不信感・治安不安がアウトブレイク対応を著しく妨げており、国際的支援と安全確保が急務。

article.articleHeadline: PSO: Ebolos virusas KDR plinta greičiau nei bet kurio buvusio protrūkio metu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: The Ebola virus in the DRC is spreading faster than during any previous outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 July 2026, Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading faster than any prior outbreak. Since the outbreak was declared two months ago, there have been more than 2,000 confirmed cases and 796 deaths, making it the third-largest Ebola outbreak on record. The event is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there are no licensed vaccines or approved treatments. Cases have been reported across five DRC provinces and in neighboring Uganda. Transmission occurs via close contact and contaminated body fluids. About 80% of new cases are outside known contact lists, and roughly two-thirds of deaths occur in communities that never sought formal health care. The outbreak overlaps with armed conflict in Ituri Province, where a treatment center in Bunia was attacked.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:コンゴ民主共和国のエボラウイルスは過去のどの流行よりも速く拡大している
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで急速に拡大し、2000人超の感染・796人の死亡、複数州及び隣国ウガンダへの拡大、ワクチン・治療薬未承認、武力紛争との重複など複数のIHR基準・WPRO基準に該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生地域に含まれるが対象国リストには含まれないため除外。ワクチン・治療薬未承認、80%が接触者リスト外、武力紛争地域での治療センター襲撃など管理困難な要素が多い。

article.articleHeadline: أوغندا تعلن خروج آخر مصاب بـ "إيبولا" تمهيداً لإعلان خلو البلاد من الفيروس
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda announces the discharge of the last Ebola patient as it prepares to declare the country Ebola-free.
article.articleSummary: Uganda is set to declare Ebola-free after discharging the last patient, ending an outbreak of the Bundibugyo strain. As of 2026-07-16, Uganda reported 20 Ebola infections and 2 deaths, most involving Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) nationals who crossed the border. The DRC has logged more than 2,000 confirmed cases and 754 deaths since mid-May. Ugandan authorities credited highly effective contact tracing and patient follow-up for containment. Under World Health Organization guidelines, Uganda must complete 42 days without any new cases to be officially Ebola-free. There is currently no vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo; however, the WHO noted the first clinical trial of an antiviral treatment began on Tuesday. Regional health officials have lauded Uganda’s response as the fastest Ebola outbreak containment to date.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、最後のエボラ患者退院を発表 ― 同国のエボラ終息宣言に向けて
triage.triage_reason: DRCで2,000例超・754人死亡という大規模なエボラ流行が継続しており、ウガンダへの越境感染も確認されているため、国際的拡大リスクと重症度の観点からIHR基準複数該当。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外したが、記事の主眼はウガンダのエボラ終息であり、感染源となったDRCの流行状況（2,000例超・754人死亡）は継続的な国際拡大リスクとして重要。ワクチン・治療薬が存在しないBundibugyo株であることも懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Súčasná epidémia eboly v Kongu je najrýchlejšia zo všetkých - Svet SME
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: The current Ebola epidemic in Congo is the fastest of all - World SME.
article.articleSummary: Current Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading faster than any previous outbreak, according to the World Health Organization. Since the outbreak was declared two months ago, more than 2,000 cases and 796 deaths have been confirmed, making it the third-largest Ebola outbreak on record. The 17th outbreak in the country was declared on May 15 in Ituri Province. Cases have appeared in five provinces and in neighboring Uganda, indicating cross-border transmission. The outbreak is caused by the rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no approved vaccine or therapy. Despite intensified response, WHO notes that over 80% of new cases are detected outside known contact lists, showing ongoing transmission chains. About two-thirds of deaths occur in communities where people never received healthcare in a facility.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:コンゴの現在のエボラ流行は過去最速のペースで拡大
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生中のエボラ流行は過去最速の拡大速度で2000人超の症例・796人の死亡を記録し、ウガンダへの越境伝播も確認されており、承認済みワクチン・治療法がないBundibugyoエボラウイルスによる流行のため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境伝播が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。ワクチン・治療法が存在しないBundibugyoエボラウイルス株による流行であり、致死率・拡大速度の観点から極めて深刻な事案。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : le gouvernement provincial réceptionne dix ambulances pour renforcer la riposte contre Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: the provincial government receives ten ambulances to bolster the Ebola response - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ten ambulances were received by the Ituri provincial government in Bunia to strengthen the Ebola virus disease (EVD) response, during an official ceremony presided over by General-Major Gaby Kasongo Mulumba. The donation demonstrates central government commitment to protecting Ituri residents from the Ebola outbreak and to saving lives by reinforcing field-response capabilities. Mulumba urged beneficiaries to use the vehicles responsibly to improve speed, efficiency, and coordination of interventions. The handover underscores support from President Félix-Antoine Tshisekedi Tshilombo for the Ebola fight and overall outbreak response. The report provides no case or death counts, focusing instead on asset enhancement to bolster ongoing Ebola containment efforts in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ州:州政府がエボラ対応強化のため救急車10台を受領 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の継続的な対応活動に関する記事だが、症例数や死者数などの疫学情報がなく、既知の流行への支援強化を報じる内容のため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事は既存のエボラ流行に対する物資支援（救急車寄贈）に焦点を当てており、新規症例数・死亡者数などの疫学データは含まれていない。既知のアウトブレイクの継続対応であるためIHR基準上は「異常/予想外」に該当しないと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Combate à dengue no inverno em Marília: seguem ações de prevenção e medicação do Lira
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Combating dengue in winter in Marília: prevention actions and Lira's medication continue.
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Marília, São Paulo, Brazil, is addressed during winter with ongoing prevention actions. The report highlights public-health measures to curb dengue transmission and notes that Lira's medication continues to be available or used, though no clinical or epidemiological details are provided. The text does not specify dengue case counts, laboratory confirmations, symptoms, infection sources, or information on imported/exported cases. Published on 2026-07-16, the article appears to be an update focused on prevention activities and related medication news, rather than a full outbreak report. It includes media links and contact details but lacks deeper data on outbreaks, transmission dynamics, or patient-level information. Keywords implied by the piece include outbreak prevention and public health measures, with no explicit vaccination details mentioned in the excerpt.

triage.triage_reason: デング熱は当該地域の風土病であり、本記事は日常的な予防活動の報告に過ぎず、症例数や異常な流行拡大等の具体的情報がない。
triage.notes: 冬季における通常の予防活動の報告記事であり、症例数や異常事態を示す情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Grup Vall Companys reduce a la mitad las inversiones por la peste porcina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Grup Vall Companys halves its investments due to swine fever.
article.articleSummary: African swine fever (ASF) outbreak declared in Barcelona in November last year prompted Grup Vall Companys to implement a contingency plan with 61 million euros in provisions and to cut dividends and investments by roughly half. The company finished 2025 with revenue of 4.626 billion euros, up 11%, but net profit fell 12% to 245.4 million, blamed on global instability and ASF’s impact on the pork sector. The 61 million provision reflects livestock value devaluation; dividends were reduced from 72 million to 36 million, and capital expenditure for 2026 was slashed from 190 million to 85 million. The ASF outbreak led to total export market closures for meat and byproducts (notably Japan and Mexico) and partial closures with regionalization in China and the Philippines, contributing to depressed prices at Mercolleida. The Barcelona-based group emphasizes the crisis as a severe blow to competitiveness in Spanish pork.

triage.headline_ja: Grup Vall Companys、豚熱（ASF）の影響で投資額を半減
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はスペイン・バルセロナで昨年11月に確認されたASF発生に伴う企業（Vall Companys社）の財務・投資動向に関する経済記事であり、新規の公衆衛生シグナルではない。動物疾患であり対象国での新規発生事例でもない。
triage.notes: ASFはスペイン・カタルーニャ州バルセロナで発生した動物疾患であり、対象国（中国・フィリピン等）は輸出規制対象として言及されているのみで、発生国ではない。ヒトへの健康影響はなく、経済記事としての性質が強い。

article.articleHeadline: Súčasná epidémia eboly v Kongu je najrýchlejšia zo všetkých, upozornila WHO
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The current Ebola outbreak in the Congo is the fastest of all, WHO warned.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is the fastest on record, with >2,000 confirmed cases and 796 deaths since it was declared two months ago (15 May) in Ituri province. The 17th outbreak has spread across five provinces and into neighboring Uganda. It is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. Transmission occurs through close contact and infected bodily fluids. Despite intensified responses, more than 80% of new cases are detected outside known contact lists, signaling ongoing gaps in transmission tracing. About two-thirds of fatalities occur in communities that have not sought healthcare in facilities, highlighting community-based spread. No vaccine or therapy is approved for this strain, and the outbreak remains active across multiple provinces with cross-border concerns to Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、過去最速とWHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱がコンゴで急速拡大し複数州とウガンダへ越境、承認ワクチン・治療法がなく公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ワクチン・治療法未承認の亜種（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）であり、症例の80%以上が既知接触者外で検出されるなど伝播追跡に課題がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola útočí rýchlejšie než kedykoľvek predtým. WHO varuje pred desivou bilanciou a nezastaviteľným šírením nákazy
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola strikes faster than ever before. WHO warns of a terrifying toll and unstoppable spread of the contagion.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 July 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo is in its 17th Ebola outbreak, declared 15 May in Ituri Province. The epidemic is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. More than 2,000 confirmed cases and 796 deaths have been reported across five provinces, with cases also in neighboring Uganda. Transmission remains via close contact and infected bodily fluids. Despite intensified response, WHO notes that over 80% of new infections are identified outside known contact lists, indicating undetected transmission chains. The current outbreak is the third-largest Ebola outbreak on record, and it is spreading faster than the 2018–2020 wave, which took more than ten months to reach 2,000 cases. Approximately two-thirds of deaths occur in communities lacking access to healthcare. Austria reported a suspected case linked to the outbreak in late May 2026.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がかつてない速さで拡大。WHOは恐るべき死亡者数と制御不能な感染拡大を警告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で第17次エボラ流行が発生し、2000例以上・死者796人、ワクチン未承認のブンディブギョ株による国際的拡大（ウガンダ、オーストリア疑い例）が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・オーストリアでの症例も報告されているが、対象国リストにはコンゴ民主共和国のみが該当するため他国は除外した。承認済みワクチン・治療法がないブンディブギョ株による流行であり、感染連鎖の80%が既知の接触者リスト外で確認されるなど制御困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil entrega banco nacional de antígenos para febre aftosa na Argentina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil delivers the national antigen bank for foot-and-mouth disease in Argentina.
article.articleSummary: Brazil delivered the National Antigen Bank for Emergency Response to Foot-and-Mouth Disease to Argentina. The facility, Brazil's first owned antigen bank, was developed through a partnership among MAPA (Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock), Tecpar, and Biogénesis Bagó to support emergency responses under official contingency plans. The ceremony will take place at 9:00 a.m. on Friday, July 17, 2026, in Garín, Buenos Aires Province, at Biogénesis Bagó’s plant on Ruta Panamericana Km 38.5. Attendees include MAPA, Tecpar, Biogénesis Bagó, Argentina’s Senasa, and the Brazilian Embassy in Buenos Aires. The delivery marks Brazil’s first antigen bank for Foot-and-Mouth Disease and aims to bolster rapid response capacities within the national sanitary contingency strategy.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、口蹄疫緊急対応のための国家抗原バンクをアルゼンチンに引き渡す
triage.triage_reason: 実際の口蹄疫発生事例ではなく、ブラジルとアルゼンチン間の抗原バンク引き渡し式典に関する外交・防疫協力の記事であり、対象国（ブラジル）での疾病発生を報じるものではない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はアルゼンチンでの抗原バンク引き渡し式典であり、実際の疾病発生地は言及されていない。ブラジルは抗原バンクの供与国であり発生国ではないため、対象国リストとの合致なし。

article.articleHeadline: Serum Institute, Gates Medical Research Institute partners to manufacture new TB vaccine
article.articleSummary: TB vaccine M72/AS01E: Serum Institute of India (SII) will invest over US$100 million to manufacture the vaccine if approved, expanding manufacturing readiness for potential global demand. Gates Medical Research Institute (Gates MRI) and SII will transfer production know-how; GSK will continue supplying the AS01E adjuvant. The candidate is in final Phase 3 trials, following enrollment of about 20,000 participants at 54 sites in South Africa, Kenya, Malawi, Zambia and Indonesia; enrollment closed in April 2025. Phase 2b data from 3,575 participants showed roughly 50% protection against progression to active pulmonary TB over three years in HIV-negative adults aged 18–50. WHO estimates that a vaccine with this efficacy could prevent 76 million TB cases, save 8.5 million lives, and reduce TB household costs by US$41.5 billion over 25 years. If successful, large-scale production could supply adults and adolescents in high-burden countries; SII plans to work with Indonesia and South Africa manufacturers.

triage.headline_ja: セラム・インスティテュートとゲイツ医療研究所、新しいTBワクチンの製造で提携
triage.triage_reason: これはTBワクチン開発・製造に関するビジネス/研究提携のニュースであり、疾病アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はTBワクチン(M72/AS01E)の第3相試験と製造提携に関する内容で、感染症アウトブレイクの発生情報ではない。臨床試験実施国として南アフリカ、ケニア、マラウイ、ザンビア、インドネシアが挙げられ、製造拠点としてインドが関与しているが、これは疾病発生シグナルではなくワクチン開発ニュースのため見送りと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda begins 42-day watch to be declared Ebola-free after discharging last patient
article.articleSummary: Uganda begins a 42-day countdown under WHO guidelines to be declared Ebola-free after discharging the last patient, leaving the country with no active confirmed cases as of 2026-07-16. The 42 days equals two Ebola incubation periods and requires no new confirmed infections. The May outbreak originated from a man who travelled from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) for medical treatment and tested positive, prompting intensified surveillance, contact tracing and treatment. While Uganda nears the milestone, the DRC remains at the center of a regional outbreak with ongoing transmission, now its 17th Ebola outbreak across multiple provinces. Projections show spread north toward South Sudan, aided by conflict and porous borders, raising cross-border risk; Kenya, a regional hub, remains on heightened preparedness due to close ties with Uganda and South Sudan.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、最後の患者退院後にエボラ出血熱終息宣言に向けた42日間の監視を開始
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は常に公衆衛生上重大な疾患であり、DRCでは第17次アウトブレイクが継続し南スーダンへの越境拡大リスクも指摘されているため、IHR基準複数該当でフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダの終息宣言に向けた動きだが、ウガンダ・南スーダン・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは第17次アウトブレイクの中心地として記事内で明確に言及されており、地域拡大リスクの主要因であるため verified_locations に含めた。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Ebola leviää Kongon demokraattisessa tasavallassa nopeammin kuin aiemmat epidemiat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Ebola spreads in the Democratic Republic of the Congo faster than previous epidemics.
article.articleSummary: As of July 16, 2026, Ebola is spreading across the Democratic Republic of the Congo at a rate that outpaces all prior Ebola outbreaks. The World Health Organization reports more than 2,000 confirmed Ebola cases and about 800 deaths to date. The outbreak began with the first identified case roughly two months earlier, and the number of cases has built rapidly since then. The transmission has extended across five provinces within the DRC and has crossed into the neighboring country of Uganda, indicating regional spread. According to the WHO Director-General, this epidemic ranks as the third-largest in history by case count, underscoring the scale and urgency of the response required.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:エボラ出血熱、コンゴ民主共和国で過去の流行より速いスピードで拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な拡大速度、国際的拡大＝ウガンダへの越境）に加え、WPRO基準も全項目該当するため、フルリスク評価に進むべき事案。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。史上3番目の規模のエボラ流行とWHO事務局長が言及しており、非常に高い緊急性を要する事案。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue: Campinas alerta 27 bairros com maior risco de transmissão
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue: Campinas alerts 27 neighborhoods with the highest risk of transmission.
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Campinas, Brazil: The Health Secretariat released the 29th Arboviroses Alert for 2026 on July 8, identifying 27 neighborhoods with high dengue transmission risk. High-risk areas span East (Jardim Novo Flamboyant, Jardim Nova Esperança, Jardim Boa Esperança, Vila Brandina, Chácara da Barra); Northwest (Cidade Satélite Íris I, Jardim São Judas Tadeu, Residencial São Luiz, Jardim Campina Grande); North (Parque Beatriz, Jardim Miranda, Vila Dutra, Jardim Aurélia); Southwest (Jardim Santa Lucia, Jardim Yeda, Vila Palacios, Parque Residencial Vila União); South (Jardim Monte Cristo, Jardim Marisa, Jardim São Domingos, Vila Palmeiras I & II); Southeast (Vila Ipê, Jardim das Oliveiras, Jardim Amazonas, Parque Jambeiro, Parque Indústria). From Jan 1 to Jul 14, 2026, Campinas had 3,415 confirmed dengue cases. Between Jan 1 and Jun 30, 2026, 820,643 property visits for breeding-site control and education, plus 53,382 visits for costal nebulization, were conducted. Emphasis on door-to-door inspections and community engagement to remove Aedes aegypti breeding sites; residents should empty standing water and maintain water storage hygiene.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱：カンピーナスが感染リスクの高い27地区に警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・カンピーナスにおける通常のデング熱流行対策・注意喚起であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。地域内での定例的な公衆衛生対応の一環と判断される。
triage.notes: デング熱はブラジルで毎年流行する風土病であり、本記事は地方自治体による予防的注意喚起・媒介蚊対策の報告。重症例数や死亡者数の言及はなく、深刻な公衆衛生上のインパクトを示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: L'épidémie d'Ebola en RDC se propage "plus rapidement" que toutes les précédentes, alerte l'OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the DRC is spreading "faster" than all previous ones, WHO warns.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is spreading faster than prior episodes, with 2,073 cases and 796 deaths reported as of July 16, 2026. Ituri province in the northeast is the epicenter, where more than 80% of new cases are detected outside known contact lists, indicating transmission chains escaping surveillance. Response capacity includes over 800 beds, 60 laboratories, and contact tracing up to about 80%. Uganda reports 20 cases and 2 deaths but currently has no active cases. There is no vaccine or treatment for the Bundibugyo Ebola variant; clinical trials have begun for MBP134 and remdesivir. A funding gap exceeding $400 million remains to meet the $518 million joint WHO/CACM plan, urged to donors as an investment in national security.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、過去のどの流行より「速く」拡大とWHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱がDRCで急速に拡大し、感染経路の追跡が困難な状況にあり、隣国ウガンダにも波及、国際的な資金支援要請も出ておりIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダも感染地域として記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ワクチン・治療法が確立していないBundibugyo型エボラであり、資金不足が深刻な状況。

article.articleHeadline: जमशेदपुर में मलेरिया के खिलाफ 'श्रीलंकामॉडल': 3 से 5 वर्षों में पूर्वी सिंहभूम को मलेरिया मुक्त बनाने की तैयारी - jamshedpur malaria east singhbhum adopts sri lanka model
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Jamshedpur, the 'Sri Lanka model' against malaria: Preparations to make East Singhbhum malaria-free within 3 to 5 years.
article.articleSummary: East Singhbhum district near Jamshedpur, Jharkhand, is implementing the Sri Lanka model to eradicate malaria and cerebral malaria. In a 16-day drive, over 115,000 suspected cases were tested, uncovering more than 1,700 malaria and cerebral malaria cases and 8 deaths. The district has identified 1,069 high-risk villages, with Potka, Dumaria, Musabani, and Ghatshila as the most vulnerable. Key elements include immediate testing for every fever case, free treatment for positives, intensified surveillance around patients’ homes, elimination of mosquito breeding sites, and door-to-door follow-up. In hotspot areas, dedicated teams, fogging, anti-larval spraying, and distribution of medicated nets will be scaled up. The plan prioritizes reducing infection and mortality first, then aims to declare East Singhbhum malaria-free within 3–5 years through 24/7 field work by ANM, Sahiya, MPW, medical officers, and local administration.

triage.headline_ja: ジャムシェドプルでマラリア対策『スリランカモデル』：3〜5年以内に東シングブームをマラリア撲滅地域にする準備
triage.triage_reason: 既存のマラリア流行地域における継続的な対策強化の報道であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限の懸念は低いが、死亡例と多数の症例が報告されており経過観察が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Should you start wearing a mask again? Doctors explain amid fresh Covid concerns
article.articleSummary: Covid-19 cases reported from Andhra Pradesh in India have sparked concerns of a potential surge, but experts say there is no evidence of a nationwide wave. Localized clusters are being monitored with intensified surveillance, testing, contact tracing, and genome sequencing. While Omicron subvariants are under watch, no more virulent strain is indicated. Healthcare systems report better preparedness, including diagnostics, oxygen, ICU readiness, and vaccination- or infection-induced hybrid immunity reducing severe outcomes. RT-PCR remains the gold standard for active infection; antibody tests help assess response. The episode echoes a June 2025 uptick driven by Omicron subvariants such as LF.7, XFG, JN.1, NB.1.8.1. High-risk groups—older adults, diabetes, kidney disease, cancer, chronic lung disease, immunosuppression—should remain vigilant. Mask use is advised in fever, cough, sore throat, or exposure, especially in crowded or healthcare settings.

triage.headline_ja: マスクをまた着用すべきか？新たなコロナ懸念の中で医師が解説
triage.triage_reason: インド・アンドラプラデシュ州で局地的なCOVID-19クラスターが報告されているが、専門家は全国的な流行の証拠はないとしており、既知のオミクロン系統による限定的な増加に留まる。

article.articleHeadline: SP confirma primeiro caso de gripe aviária em ave silvestre em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: SP confirms first case of avian influenza in a wild bird in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza (HPAI) was confirmed in São Paulo State, Brazil—the first 2026 case—after a July 8 sample analyzed by the Federal Laboratory of Agricultural Defense (LFDA-SP) and linked to the Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock and Food Supply. Confirmation occurred July 15. Measures include restricting animal movement at a zoo and epidemiological investigation with active surveillance in three poultry farms within a 10-kilometer radius; two farms are under sanitary embargo with no birds on site. Authorities emphasize that consuming poultry or eggs does not transmit the disease. Human infection occurs mainly through direct contact with infected birds; residents should follow guidance from the Official Veterinary Service (SVO) and avoid touching birds with clinical signs. The São Paulo health secretariat (SES), along with SAA and Semil, are monitoring, and the contingency plan updated in 2023/2025 remains in effect; no human cases reported.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州、2026年初のグリップ・アビアリア（鳥インフルエンザ）野鳥感染例を確認
triage.triage_reason: 野鳥1例のHPAI検出で人への感染はなく、既に地域的な封じ込め措置が取られているが、H5系統は流行・パンデミック化の可能性があるため継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 本症例は野生鳥類のみで人への感染報告はなく、動物衛生当局による監視・隔離措置が既に実施されている。HPAI H5系統の世界的拡大傾向を踏まえ、今後の続報（家禽・人への感染拡大の有無）に注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 12 COVID cases, 4 deaths reported in A.P. since June 26, but no need to worry, says health official
article.articleSummary: COVID-19: In Andhra Pradesh, 12 cases were reported between June 26 and July 16, with four deaths among patients who had comorbidities (three from Kadapa and one from Kakinada). Kadapa recorded the highest case count (eight); other cases were in Mangalagiri (Guntur), Visakhapatnam, and Kakinada. Health Secretary G. Veerapandian said there is no cluster outbreak, with cases drawn from different mandals. Between June 26 and July 15, 67 people were tested in the state. Nationally, 339 COVID-19 cases have been recorded since July 1, led by Kerala (115), Karnataka (64), Maharashtra (43), Tamil Nadu (39), followed by Andaman and Nicobar Islands (18), Delhi (18), and Rajasthan (12). IMA COVID Task Force notes cyclical respiratory-virus spread and that infections may subside by August end as immunity and vaccination bolster protection. Genome sequencing from Andhra Pradesh to NIV Pune is pending; dominant regional variants may include BA.3.2, XFG, NB.1.8.1.

triage.headline_ja: アーンドラ・プラデーシュ州で6月26日以降COVID症例12件、死亡4件を報告も、保健当局者は「心配ない」と発言
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のCOVID-19症例増加であり、保健当局は明確にクラスター発生ではなく心配不要と発言している。異常性・重篤性・国際的拡大リスクはいずれも認められない。
triage.notes: 疾患タグにNipahが含まれているが、記事本文・サマリーには一切言及がなく誤タグと考えられる。死亡例はすべて基礎疾患保有者であり、当局はクラスター発生を否定、季節性の呼吸器ウイルス流行の一環と説明している。

article.articleHeadline: HCR : l'agence alerte sur la menace d'Ebola pour les déplacés et les réfugiés en RDC et en Ouganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UNHCR: The agency warns of the Ebola threat to the displaced and refugees in the DRC and Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Ebola threatens displaced and refugee populations in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo and along Uganda’s border, where the UNHCR warns of a rising risk of transmission amid worsening humanitarian conditions. Widespread destruction of homes has displaced thousands, who now have only the clothes they wear. The HCR stresses urgent needs for soap, hydroalcoholic gel, and reliable access to health services to curb a potentially deadly outbreak. Prevention and awareness activities have been stepped up, drawing on lessons from past epidemics such as mpox, but the agency cautions that these efforts are not enough to meet the scale of need and appeals for intensified international support. Burundi has taken in tens of thousands of Congolese refugees, but resources are overstretched, forcing families to choose between safety and survival. HCR calls for immediate humanitarian aid to protect vulnerable populations.

triage.headline_ja: UNHCR:コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダの避難民・難民にエボラの脅威、機関が警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラの流行リスクが人道危機下の避難民・難民に及ぶ可能性が高く、国際的拡大や対策不十分による流行しやすさが懸念されるため、フルRRAへ進めるべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 記事はUNHCRによる人道支援appealであり、具体的な症例数や確定診断情報は記載されていない。ウガンダ・ブルンジも言及されるが、主題はコンゴ民主共和国東部の避難民・難民におけるエボラ流行リスク。ウガンダ・ブルンジは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Epidemia DRK rozwija się najszybciej w historii
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: DRK epidemic is developing at the fastest rate in history.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization notes the current Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is the fastest-growing in history, with over 2,000 infections and 796 deaths two months after its May 15 declaration. The outbreak is centered in Ituri province (northeast DR Congo) and has also appeared in North Kivu, South Kivu, and Upper Uele, marking the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC since 1976. About two-thirds of fatalities occurred in communities outside formal health systems. The strain is Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which no vaccine or licensed therapy exists. This week, Oxford University began the first safety trial of the ChAdOx1 vaccine, and in early July two treatment approaches against the outbreak strain entered clinical testing. Neighboring Uganda reports no active cases currently after 20 infections and two deaths earlier.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行は史上最速のペースで拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで史上最速の拡大ペースを見せ、2000人以上感染・796人死亡と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、ワクチン未承認の株であることから国際的拡大リスクも高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダは過去の症例（現在は活動症例なし）として言及されているのみで、現在進行中の主題ではないため verified_locations には含めない。ワクチン未承認のBundibugyo株であり、致死率・拡大速度ともに極めて高い懸念事例。

article.articleHeadline: Larvae found at homes, health dept issues notices amid dengue drive | Chandigarh News
article.articleSummary: As of 16 July 2026, Panchkula district is intensifying malaria and dengue control during the monsoon. Mosquito larvae were found in homes, and notices were issued to affected households. A high‑risk area campaign includes door‑to‑door surveys, water-container inspections, and distribution of IEC pamphlets to educate residents. Deputy Commissioner Satpal Sharma urged regular water supply in Kalka, Pinjore and slum areas and prompt leakage repairs to reduce water storage that fosters breeding; he also ordered fogging, sanitation, and action on larvae by the municipal bodies. Special inspections of scrap warehouses in Madhawala, Surajpur and Nanakpur were directed. A joint health–PWD–town planning committee will inspect construction sites to prevent breeding. Dengue‑awareness audio messages will be played at health centres, public places and religious sites. Dr Kajal Kambhra highlighted that regular water supply and addressing stagnation at DLF‑area construction sites are needed to curb dengue.

triage.headline_ja: 家庭で幼虫発見、デング対策強化の中で保健局が通知書を発行 | チャンディーガルニュース
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング・マラリア予防活動に関する通常の行政対応報道であり、異常な発生や重症例の急増を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: モンスーン期の季節的なベクター対策活動の一環であり、パンチクラ地区での日常的な公衆衛生対応。症例数や重症度の具体的データは記事に含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola au Haut-Uélé : la protection des peuples autochtones Pygmées réclamée à Isiro - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Haut-Uélé: Protection of the indigenous Pygmy peoples demanded in Isiro - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola has been officially declared in Haut-Uélé, in Isiro, Democratic Republic of Congo. Faustin Engwanime Ababu, coordinator of the APCH (Association des Premiers Congolais du Haut-Uélé), appeals for evacuation of protective materials to extend Ebola awareness to indigenous Pygmy camp bases. The association notes Pygmies often rely on traditional remedies and may avoid health facilities, underscoring the need for targeted risk communication and hygiene interventions to halt spread. APCH requests concrete items—buckets, disinfectants, and chlorine—for the Ebola response teams to reach these communities. They plan on-site sensitization drives at pygmy bases but have not yet secured supplies. Ababu also highlights Law No. 22/030 of 15 July 2022, praising its protection of indigenous rights. The appeal emphasizes non-marginalization of pygmies during the outbreak and urges timely support to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: オー・ウエレ州のエボラ:イジロで先住民ピグミー族の保護が要請される - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の公式発生宣言があり、脆弱な先住民コミュニティへの対応課題も報告されているため、フルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の致死率と伝播性、加えて先住民ピグミー族が伝統療法に依存し医療施設を避ける傾向があることから、対応が困難な集団への感染拡大リスクが懸念される。物資（バケツ、消毒剤、塩素）の不足が対応の障害となっている点も注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: U.S. bars commercial flights for travelers recently in Congo during Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has grown to more than 1,900 confirmed infections and over 700 deaths across multiple provinces. In response, the Trump administration introduced travel restrictions barring U.S. citizens and nationals who have recently been in Congo from boarding commercial flights to the United States; affected travelers must remain outside Congo for 21 days before returning on commercial air service. U.S. Embassy guidance was updated to reflect that anyone who has been in Congo within the previous 21 days will be barred from U.S.-bound flights. Officials say the measures are linked to the evolving outbreak, though no duration is announced. Former CDC official Dr. Daniel Jernigan called the policy unusual and warned of potential unintended consequences such as shifting responsibility, underreporting travel history, and challenges in overseas outbreak response recruitment. Containment efforts continue across the region.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、コンゴでのエボラ流行を受け同国滞在者の商業便搭乗を禁止する新渡航規則を導入
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で1900人超の感染・700人超の死亡という大規模なエボラ流行が続いており、米国が渡航制限を導入するなど国際的対応も発生しているため、IHR基準を複数満たしフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 米国は流行発生地域ではなく渡航制限を導入した対応国であるため、verified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola spreading more quickly in DRC, while Uganda is close to being virus-free
article.articleSummary: Ebola is spreading in the Democratic Republic of Congo more rapidly than in any previous outbreak, with 2,073 confirmed infections and 796 deaths after 62 new cases, as of 2026-07-16. The 17th outbreak, declared May 15 in Ituri province, is now the third-largest on record; the WHO notes more than 2,000 cases were reached in two months, compared with over 10 months in 2018–2020. The true tally could be at least double the reported figure, and more than 80% of new cases are detected outside known contact lists, indicating hidden transmission chains. Five DRC provinces and neighboring Uganda are affected, with Ituri bearing the majority. In Uganda, Bundibugyo Ebola strain: 20 cases total, 15 linked to travel from the DRC. Uganda discharged its last patient on 2026-07-16, triggering a 42-day countdown to Ebola-free status. Bunia General Hospital staff strike over pay compounds health-system strain.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱がより急速に拡大、一方ウガンダはウイルス根絶に近づく
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ流行は過去最速のペースで拡大し、隠れた感染連鎖が示唆されるほか、国境を越えてウガンダへも拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダも影響を受けているが対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCの5州（イトゥリ州が中心）で流行が拡大しており、報告数の過小評価や隠れた感染連鎖、医療従事者のストライキによる医療体制逼迫が懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: MG EM ALERTA POR DOENÇAS RESPIRATÓRIAS - Carmo Web TV 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Minas Gerais on alert for respiratory diseases - Carmo Web TV 2026.
article.articleSummary: Minas Gerais, Brazil, is among five states under high alert for rising severe acute respiratory illness (SARI) cases, per Fiocruz’s InfoGripe bulletin dated 16 July 2026. National SARI trends show declines over six weeks (long term) and three weeks (short term), but cases continue to rise in Minas Gerais, MS, Paraná, Santa Catarina, and RS. RSV diagnoses are up, especially in children 0–2 years, with influenza A likewise elevated. Even as the seasonal period ends countrywide, severe influenza A remains high in Minas Gerais, Paraná, and Roraima. Severe influenza B is increasing in Centro-Sul states including DF, MG, RJ, RS, and SC. Prevention emphasizes respiratory hygiene, handwashing, masking when needed, isolating with symptoms, and up-to-date vaccination. SARI incidence is highest in children under 2; mortality rises in adults 65 and older.

triage.headline_ja: ミナスジェライス州、呼吸器疾患警戒態勢へ - Carmo Web TV 2026
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のRSV・インフルエンザA/B増加によるSARI警戒だが、全国的には減少傾向にあり、通常の季節性流行の範囲内と考えられるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 季節性呼吸器感染症（RSV、インフルエンザA/B）によるSARI増加。ブラジル国内の複数州（ミナスジェライス、パラナ、サンタカタリーナ、リオグランデドスル等）で警戒レベル。全国的には減少傾向にあり、既知の季節性パターンの範囲内と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Andhra Pradesh reports 2 more Covid-19 deaths, toll climbs to 4
article.articleSummary: As of July 16, 2026, Andhra Pradesh reports 2 more Covid-19 deaths, raising the toll to 4. A total of 12 people tested positive for SARS-CoV-2 between June 26 and July 16, with Kadapa district reporting eight infections, followed by Guntur (2), Visakhapatnam (1), and Kakinada (1). The first Kadapa case emerged June 26; eleven additional cases were detected July 1–16, including two close contacts, with no cluster identified. Of the 12 cases, three are in home isolation, two in hospitals, and three have recovered and been discharged. The four deaths occurred—three in Kadapa and one in Kakinada—primarily among patients with pre-existing conditions such as hypertension, diabetes, and kidney disease. Five samples were sent to NIV Pune for genome sequencing on July 9; results are awaited. Authorities say the situation is under control; masks and avoidance of crowded places are urged.

triage.headline_ja: アーンドラ・プラデーシュ州でCOVID-19による死者がさらに2人、累計4人に
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の小規模な国内発生であり、基礎疾患を有する患者の死亡が中心。当局は状況をコントロール下にあるとしているが、ゲノム解析結果待ちのため続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 見出しと記事サマリーはCOVID-19の小規模クラスターに関するもの。Bluedotの疾患名にNipahが含まれているが、記事本文には言及がなく無関係と判断。基礎疾患を有する患者の死亡が中心で、当局は制御下と説明している。
