article.articleHeadline: SP confirma primeiro caso de gripe aviária em ave silvestre em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo Confirms First Case of Avian Influenza in a Wild Bird in 2026.
article.articleSummary: On 15 July 2026, São Paulo’s Federal Laboratory for Agricultural Defense (LFDA-SP) confirmed the state’s first case of Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza (HPAI) in 2026. The infection involved an irerê, a wild bird rescued in an urban area and transported to Guaíra Zoo in Barretos’ regional municipality. Samples were collected July 8 by Defesa Agropecuária (SAA). In response, authorities interdicted animal movement at the zoo and launched epidemiological investigations with active surveillance around three farms within a 10-km radius; two farms are in a sanitary fallow and have no birds. The SAA says poultry consumption and eggs do not transmit the disease; human infection occurs mainly through direct contact with infected birds. No human cases in São Paulo to date. The contingency plan, updated 2023 and 2025, guides response.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州、2026年最初の野鳥における鳥インフルエンザ症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: 野鳥1羽での高病原性鳥インフルエンザ確認であり、人への感染や家禽への拡大は報告されておらず、既存の対応計画に基づき管理されているため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 野生動物における単発症例で、人への感染や家禽への拡大なし。既存の防疫計画（2023・2025年更新）に基づき通常対応中。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : un hôpital attaqué, des patients en fuite, et une riposte que l'OMS dit dépassée
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: a hospital attacked, patients on the run, and a response that the WHO says is outdated.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo escalates as Nyakunde hospital in Ituri province's Irumu territory is overrun by grieving relatives on July 15, 2026; a woman dying in childbirth after transfusion was refused during the outbreak highlights medical access constraints. The attack prompted patient flight as the hospital’s generator failed; Samaritan's Purse evacuated staff. The Congolese army opened an investigation; authorities emphasize danger stemmed from mistrust, not a gunfight. On July 16, 2026, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned this is the third-largest Ebola epidemic, spreading faster than any prior outbreak. Congo reports 2,073 confirmed cases and 796 deaths, with 62 new cases in a day; WHO estimates the true scale at least double. About 80% of new cases are detected outside known contact lists, and two-thirds of deaths occur in communities without care, signaling transmission gaps. Continent-wide funding for the WHO-Africa CDC plan exceeds $400 million short of the $518 million target; field responders are unpaid, triggering strikes, while 800 treatment beds and 16 labs exist compared with one lab before. By contrast, 377 have recovered.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：病院が襲撃され、患者は逃走、WHOは対応が追いついていないと発言
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行は史上第3位の規模で過去最速のペースで拡大しており、資金不足・医療アクセス制約・病院襲撃事件など複数のIHR/WPRO基準に該当するため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長が過去最大級・最速拡大の流行と警告。確定2,073例、死亡796例、新規62例/日。新規症例の80%が既知の接触者リスト外で検出され、伝播経路の把握が困難な状況。資金は目標の$518Mに対し$400M以上不足し、現場対応者の未払いによるストライキも発生。病院襲撃事件は住民の不信感が背景にあり、医療アクセスへの深刻な影響が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Health dept. urges safe food habits after 3 shigellosis cases
article.articleSummary: A three-person shigellosis cluster in Kochi, Kerala, linked to a hotel following meals on July 10–11. Three of 15 samples tested positive for Shigella; cases reported in Ponnurunni, Malayidamthuruth, and Nettoor on July 15. Hotel food samples have been sent for testing, results awaited. An FIR has been registered against the eatery after a complaint by Tony Peter; his family’s samples were negative. District Medical Officer emphasizes the disease is not fatal and urges safe food practices to prevent further spread; three patients who sought medical help have been discharged. Statewide in July, 12 suspected and 79 confirmed Shigella cases have been registered, with one death in July and eight deaths this year."

triage.headline_ja: 健康局、シゲラ症3例発生を受け安全な食習慣を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: ケララ州コーチンのホテル関連で小規模なシゲラ症クラスターが発生し、州全体では死亡例も報告されているが、今回の3症例自体は非致死的で局所的な食中毒事案であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは見られない。
triage.notes: 州全体で7月に12件の疑い例と79件の確定例、7月に1名・年間8名の死亡が報告されているが、今回報道の3症例クラスター自体は非致死的で、地元保健当局により対応が進められている。国際的な拡大や渡航制限の兆候はなく、続報を注視する。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda Ends Ebola Outbreak Countdown After Last Patient Discharged
article.articleSummary: Uganda discharged its last Ebola patient, a Congolese national at Mulago National Referral Hospital’s Ebola Isolation Centre, initiating a 42-day countdown to officially declare the outbreak over. The Bundibugyo strain has a case fatality rate of about 10%, attributed to strong health system response, early detection, prompt treatment, and support from frontline workers, surveillance teams, laboratory personnel and international partners. The 42-day wait, per WHO guidelines, requires no new confirmed cases during two incubation periods before the outbreak can be officially declared over. Surveillance remains heightened in districts bordering the Democratic Republic of Congo, where transmission continues. Uganda seeks to resume normal travel and trade with countries that had imposed restrictions, supported by strengthened isolation unit capacity—Mulago's facility has now been used three times in epidemics. WHO reiterates preparedness investments as key to the success.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、最後の患者退院を受けエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクの終息カウントダウンを開始
triage.triage_reason: エボラという重篤な疾患であり、DRC国境地域での感染継続や渡航・貿易制限の解除交渉など国際的影響・関心が続いているため、フルRRAでの継続評価が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダでのアウトブレイク終息だが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ただしDRC国境地域での感染継続が明記されているためDRCを検証済み地域として計上した。

article.articleHeadline: Spravodajstvo - Súčasná epidémia eboly v Kongu je najrýchlejšia zo všetkých, upozornila WHO
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News - The current Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is the fastest of all, WHO warned.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak on record. Since the outbreak was declared two months ago, more than 2,000 cases and 796 deaths have been confirmed, making it the third-largest Ebola epidemic in history. The 17th outbreak was declared May 15 in Ituri Province, with cases in five provinces and into neighboring Uganda. The circulating strain is Bundibugyo, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. Transmission occurs mainly through close contact and infected bodily fluids. More than 80% of new cases are detected outside known contact lists, indicating undetected transmission chains, and about two-thirds of deaths occur in communities without access to healthcare in facilities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国における現在のエボラ流行は史上最速、WHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: 史上最速拡大のエボラ流行で2000例超・796人死亡、複数州及び国境を越えてウガンダにも拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境が言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。ワクチン・治療薬未承認のBundibugyo株が流行しており、既知接触者リスト外での新規症例が8割超と伝播の把握が困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Врачи экстренно бросили медицинский центр: город в Конго оказался во власти смертельной угрозы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors urgently abandoned the medical center: a city in the Congo found itself under a deadly threat.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola virus disease outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri Province) worsened after a medical center was attacked, forcing staff to evacuate and up to ten confirmed or suspected Ebola patients to flee isolation. The incident follows the death of a laboring mother; blood transfusion could not be performed because biosafety rules during an active outbreak regulate handling of blood and body fluids. With hospital security compromised, evacuated patients may seed further transmission, complicating control efforts amid an ongoing outbreak of Ebola in the DRC, with total cases exceeding 1,000 nationwide. Common symptoms include sudden high fever, severe weakness, muscle and headache pain, followed by vomiting, diarrhea, and sometimes both internal and external bleeding. Authorities and international health partners are attempting to locate the fugitives under challenging conditions and restore trust in health measures.

triage.headline_ja: 医師団が緊急に医療センターを放棄：コンゴのある都市が致命的な脅威にさらされる
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の患者が病院襲撃により隔離施設から逃走し、全国で1000人以上の症例がある進行中のアウトブレイクの制御が困難化しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 病院襲撃により隔離患者が逃走し、感染拡大リスクが増大している点が特に懸念される。続報でのフォローアップと患者追跡状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue cases down in Chennai Municipal Corporation compared with last year.
article.articleSummary: As of July 16, 2026, dengue cases in the Chennai Municipal Corporation are reported to be lower than last year, according to the Department of Entomology. Mosquito-control measures to curb mosquito-borne diseases have been intensified across Chennai to strengthen vector control. Despite these efforts, there have been complaints that dengue incidence is rising. However, the department states that the dengue burden in 2025 has now been greatly reduced. The report centers on Chennai and places dengue within the broader context of preventive mosquito-control work. No laboratory-confirmed case counts or specific outbreak details are provided, and there is no mention of imported or exported cases. The focus remains on local transmission and ongoing public health measures to reduce mosquito populations and associated dengue risk in the city.

triage.headline_ja: チェンナイ市におけるデング熱症例、昨年より減少
triage.triage_reason: デング熱は当該地域の流行病であり、記事は昨年比で症例が減少していると報告。異常性や重大な公衆衛生影響は見られず、社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: デング熱は例年チェンナイで発生する既知の流行病であり、今回は症例減少を報告する内容。具体的な症例数や検査確定情報はなし。

article.articleHeadline: UoH Research Suggests L. Johnsonii Isolated From Homemade Curd Can Suppress Intestinal Pathoge
article.articleSummary: Hyderabad, India—Lactobacillus johnsonii strain isolated from homemade curd suppresses Enteropathogenic Escherichia coli (EPEC) and its infection model pathogen Citrobacter rodentium in preclinical tests, and reduced infection-related colon damage in mice. Researchers at the University of Hyderabad (Dr. Vijay Morampudi, School of Life Sciences) reported in Frontiers in Immunology (published July 10) that the strain survived simulated gastric acid and bile, adhered to human intestinal cells, and reduced EPEC biofilm formation by ~60%, while removing more than half of attached EPEC bacteria. The work suggests L. johnsonii as a multifunctional probiotic with effects from nutrient competition, biofilm disruption, and small antimicrobial compounds. The study remains preclinical: no human patients, and the mouse component used antibiotic-treated female mice. Authors caution that further genomic and safety assessments are needed before clinical conclusions, noting the isolate’s resistance to kanamycin and gentamicin during testing.

triage.headline_ja: ホーミーメイドカードから分離されたL. Johnsoniiが腸内病原体を抑制する可能性を示唆するUoHの研究
triage.triage_reason: 本研究は前臨床段階の基礎研究であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の懸念事象ではない。
triage.notes: 実際のアウトブレイクではなく、プロバイオティクス研究に関する学術記事のため対象国への発生事象なしと判断。

article.articleHeadline: WHO varuje: Ebola sa šíri rýchlejšie než kedykoľvek predtým
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns: Ebola is spreading faster than ever.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading faster than any prior outbreak. Since it was declared two months ago, there have been over 2,000 confirmed cases and 796 deaths, making it the third-largest Ebola outbreak in history. The 2018–2020 epidemic took more than ten months to reach 2,000 cases, but this outbreak has accelerated, especially in the last month. The seventeenth outbreak was declared on May 15 after several deaths in Ituri Province. Cases have appeared across five provinces and in neighboring Uganda. The current surge is caused by the rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. Despite a heightened response, more than 80% of new cases are detected outside known contact lists, signaling undetected transmission chains; about two-thirds of deaths occur in communities without routine healthcare access.

article.articleHeadline: Uganda discharges its last Ebola patient
article.articleSummary: Uganda discharged its last Ebola patient—a Congolese citizen who has fully recovered—marking a tightening path toward declaring the outbreak over after a 42-day waiting period under international guidelines, provided no new cases occur. The discharged case was imported from the Democratic Republic of Congo. Uganda's health ministry urged vigilance for Ebola symptoms (fever, vomiting, diarrhoea, unexplained bleeding). In Congo, the outbreak continues to spread; since mid-May, confirmed cases exceed 2,000, with 2,073 cases and 796 deaths reported, and 737 patients currently hospitalized or in isolation. Ebola is life-threatening and transmitted by bodily contact and fluids. The Bundibugyo type remains without a specific vaccine or therapy; two antiviral approaches are in clinical testing since early July.

triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で2000例超・死亡796人の大規模なエボラ流行が継続しており、既にウガンダへの国際的な拡大（輸入症例）も確認されているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。コンゴでは流行が継続中であり、Bundibugyo型には特異的ワクチン・治療法が存在しない点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: The Lessons About Ebola the U.S. Wants to Forget
article.articleSummary: DRC’s Ebola outbreak is the third-largest ever, with over 2,000 cases and 754 deaths; WHO projects more than 8,000 cases and about 1,400 deaths by mid-September, and CDC worst-case estimates above 20,000 by mid-August. The piece, written by a physician-epidemiologist who treated Ebola in Guinea in 2014, credits investments and coordination that have strengthened capacity in Kinshasa, Kampala, and the Africa CDC. Early detection, once delayed by misidentifying Bundibugyo as Zaire, has improved; Congo now has testing capacity in the thousands per day. Vaccines and antibody therapies exist for Zaire, with stockpiles ready, and Uganda’s 2022 Sudan outbreak demonstrated rapid vaccine trial readiness. Finally, outbreak outcomes depend on rapid, scaled responses by WHO, Africa CDC, and the Congolese government; the article also notes the United States’ diminished recent involvement, citing no CDC specialists and halted USAID deployments during Uganda’s 2025 outbreak amid canceled contracts.

triage.headline_ja: 米国が忘れたがっているエボラの教訓

triage.notes: 記事はThe Atlanticによる分析記事で、DRCの現行エボラ流行（史上3番目の規模）を中心に、米国のCDC・USAIDによる関与縮小を論じている。ウガンダの2022年および2025年の流行にも言及があるが、対象国リスト外であり、かつ本記事の主題はDRCの流行であるため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Spreading Faster in DR Congo Than Any Previous Outbreak -- WHO - Diaspora Digital Media (DDM News) - Nigeria Breaking News, Africa and World News and Updates
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is spreading faster than any previous outbreak, with over 2,000 cases and 796 deaths confirmed since it was declared on May 15, two months ago. It is caused by the Bundibugyo species, for which there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment. Unlike Zaire-lineage outbreaks, health workers lack licensed vaccines. More than 80% of new cases are detected outside known contact lists, and about two-thirds of deaths occur among people who never seek care at a health facility; WHO modelling suggests the true scale could be 2–4 times higher than reported. The outbreak has reached five provinces—Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, and Haut-Uele—and Uganda; up to 95% of new cases originate in Ituri. Treatment capacity has risen to over 800 beds and labs from 1 to 16. Armed conflict hampers access; a Bunia treatment centre was attacked. A shortfall of over $400 million remains for the joint response plan, while 377 have recovered and trials for treatments and vaccines are underway in Ituri.

article.articleHeadline: Mãe procura academia para ajudar bebê convulsionando e descobre Influenza A
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mother seeks a gym to help a convulsing baby and discovers Influenza A.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A diagnosed in a 10-month-old baby in Campo Grande, Brazil, after convulsions led the mother to suspect choking. In the early hours of Monday the 13th, a gym staffer at Evoque on Rua Rui Barbosa in Jardim Paulista performed first aid to restore breathing; hours later at Santa Casa a second convulsion prompted medical evaluation. Rapid tests confirmed Influenza A infection. Neuropediatric assessment linked the seizures to the viral illness, noting febrile seizures can be common in early childhood and may present as absence-like events rather than full-body tremors. The mother reported the child had no classic flu symptoms at first; fever developed within 48 hours and another convulsion occurred. By Thursday the 16th the child was responding to treatment.

article.articleHeadline: पूर्वी सिंहभूम में मलेरिया का कहर: 90 शिविरों में 10 हजार से अधिक जांच, मिले 89 नए मरीज; पोटका बना हॉटस्पॉट - east singhbhum malaria outbreak 89 new cases potka hotspot
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria outbreak in East Singhbhum: over 10,000 tests in 90 camps, 89 new cases; Potka has become a hotspot.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 July 2026, East Singhbhum, Jharkhand reports 89 malaria cases from 10,357 people tested across 90 camps, with cerebral malaria predominating (66 cases of Plasmodium falciparum), 22 cases of Plasmodium vivax, and 1 mixed infection. Potka block is the hotspot with 30 cases, followed by Musabani (19) and Dumri (17). In Potka, 51 villages were covered by intensified camps; 2,366 people were tested and 30 positives identified, with treatment started at village level and free medicines provided. Authorities urge residents not to ignore fever and to seek free testing at nearby camps or health centers. Ongoing control measures include medicated mosquito nets distribution and efforts to drain stagnated water and improve sanitation to curb transmission.

article.articleHeadline: SP confirma primeiro caso de gripe aviária em ave silvestre em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo confirms first case of avian influenza in a wild bird in 2026.
article.articleSummary: First confirmed case of Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza (HPAI) in São Paulo state in 2026, detected in a wild irerê rescued in an urban area and sent to Guaíra Zoo in the Barretos regional department. Laboratory confirmation by LFDA-SP on July 15, after samples collected July 8. Authorities imposed sanitary measures: halt animal movement at the zoo; epidemiological investigation and active surveillance within a 10-km radius of the index case; two nearby farms under sanitary quarantine (empty phase) with no birds on site. Consumption of poultry and eggs is not a transmission route. Human infection occurs mainly via direct contact with infected birds; the public should follow official veterinary guidance and avoid touching birds with clinical signs. If suspected cases or dead birds, contact Defesa Agropecuária. State Health Secretariat monitors jointly with SAA and Semil; contingency plan updated (2023/2025); no human cases in the state to date.

article.articleSummary: More than 2,000 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 796 deaths have been recorded in the Democratic Republic of the Congo since the outbreak was declared two months ago, making it the third-largest Ebola epidemic on record. The outbreak, the seventeenth in DRC, began May 15 in Ituri and has since spread to five Congolese provinces and to Uganda. It is driven by the rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, for which there is no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. The surge in new infections is outpacing past outbreaks; about 80% of new cases are among people not on known contact lists, indicating hidden transmission chains. Roughly two-thirds of deaths occur in communities without access to healthcare. The situation is worsened by ongoing armed conflict in northeastern DRC; a treatment center in Bunia, Ituri, was attacked on Wednesday.

article.articleHeadline: Mutirão reforça combate à dengue no bairro Santa Isabel e alerta para a importância da participação da população
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Task force strengthens the fight against dengue in the Santa Isabel neighborhood and emphasizes the importance of community participation.
article.articleSummary: On July 15, 2026, the Penedo Municipal Health Secretariat conducted another dengue-control mutirão in the Santa Isabel neighborhood (Cacimbinhas), deploying Endemias Combat Agents to inspect homes and eliminate Aedes aegypti breeding sites. Fifteen breeding sites were identified and either treated or removed. Litter disposed irregularly was found, contributing to water accumulation that favors mosquito proliferation; water-holding materials were collected with support from the Environmental and Public Services Secretariats. In addition to field work, agents reinforced prevention guidance: keep water tanks closed, remove containers that collect water, clean gutters, and discard waste properly. The Health Secretariat emphasized that dengue control relies on public participation, noting most breeding sites are inside homes and residents’ cooperation is essential to allow inspections and eliminate breeding sites. Waninna Mendonça, Secretary of Health.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An Isolated Case of Avian Influenza in a Wild Bird in the Region
article.articleSummary: Isolated case of Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza (HPAI) confirmed in a wild bird (irerê/marreca) rescued in the Reynaldo Stein neighborhood, Guaíra, São Paulo. The bird, not part of the Municipal Zoo, does not threaten zoo birds. Laboratory confirmation was by the Federal Laboratory of Agricultural Defense (LFDA-SP), following protocols from the São Paulo State Coordinating Agency of Agricultural Defense (CDA). The Zoo remains open after a technical inspection found no symptoms among resident animals. CDA mapped a 10-km radius, identifying three commercial farms and issuing preventive sanitary guidance. The São Paulo State Health Secretariat reports no human cases and that consumption of poultry and eggs remains safe. Public is urged not to handle wild sick or dead birds; report to the Municipal Guard, Defesa Agropecuária, or environmental agencies for safe removal. Situation monitored; no alarm.

article.articleHeadline: The Lessons About Ebola the U.S. Wants to Forget
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak is the third-largest, centered in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with more than 2,000 cases and 754 deaths. WHO projects 8,000+ cases and about 1,400 deaths by mid-September; CDC worst-case scenarios exceed 20,000 by mid-August. The outbreak involves Bundibugyo strain; earlier Congo testing for Bundibugyo was limited, but current capacity runs thousands of tests daily, reflecting improved detection since the 2013–16 West Africa crisis. Vaccines and antibody therapies exist for the Zaire strain, and a vaccine stockpile enables rapid deployment; Uganda’s 2022 Sudan outbreak saw an investigational vaccine trial start within three months, and a 2025 Uganda outbreak prompted a four-day trial launch. Bundibugyo vaccines and a treatment trial are under development. Coordinated response via WHO, Africa CDC, and Congolese authorities persists, though mistrust and conflict impede case finding. The US has funded extensively, with over $700 million committed and a further $1.4 billion sought.

article.articleHeadline: AP Reports 12 Covid-19 Cases, Four Deaths
article.articleSummary: Andhra Pradesh reports 12 Covid-19 cases and four deaths from June 26 to July 16, 2026. The first case was June 26 in Kadapa district; from July 1–16, 11 additional cases raised the total to 12, with Kadapa at eight, Guntur two, and Visakhapatnam and Kakinada one each. Of 67 suspected cases tested, 11 were positive between June 26 and July 15; one Kakinada case and another positive case were detected at Christian Medical College Vellore, Tamil Nadu (imported). The four deaths occurred in Kadapa (three) and Kakinada (one) and involved severe preexisting conditions. Five samples were sent to the National Institute of Virology in Pune; three patients were in home isolation, two hospitalized, and three discharged after treatment. Health officials urge continued preventive measures; India has 339 new cases since July 1, with Kerala 115, Karnataka 64, Maharashtra 43, Tamil Nadu 39, Andaman 18, Delhi 18, Rajasthan 12, and others.

As of July 16, 2026, the mid‑May flare has produced 2,073 confirmed cases and 796 deaths, according to World Health Organization director‑general Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. He described it as the third-largest Ebola outbreak on record and noted that transmission has accelerated in the past month. By comparison, the 2018–2020 outbreak took over ten months to reach 2,000 confirmed cases and caused nearly 2,300 deaths among about 3,500 cases. The report does not detail transmission sources in this summary but underlines rapid spread in the DRC and an ongoing public health response.

triage.headline_ja: WHOは、コンゴ民主共和国における現在のエボラ出血熱の流行が過去の流行よりも速いペースで拡大していると発表した
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで急速に拡大し、致死率も高く、WHOが史上3番目の規模と位置付けており、IHR基準・WPRO基準共に複数該当する重大なシグナルである。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長による直接の言及があり、致死率(約38%)も高く、感染拡大速度が過去の流行を上回っている点が特に懸念される。フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: SMS de Feira de Santana intensifica combate ao Aedes aegypti na Queimadinha com força-tarefa de mais de 30 agentes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Feira de Santana Municipal Health Secretariat intensifies the fight against Aedes aegypti in Queimadinha with a task force of more than 30 agents.
article.articleSummary: Feira de Santana's Health Secretariat launches a 20-day task force of over 30 agents in Queimadinha to intensify Aedes aegypti control, the dengue/chikungunya/Zika vector. Coordinated by the Center for Endemics Combat, teams will inspect homes, eliminate breeding sites, apply larvicide, and educate residents in two fronts. Queimadinha and Tomba are arbovirus hotspots. Chikungunya in 2026 totals 313 notifications with 201 confirmed (2025: 24/15; last year 35/23). Dengue (Jan–July 7, 2026) shows 1,373 suspected, 96 confirmed, 107 inconclusive; rest under investigation; 2025 had 1,371 notifications and 143 confirmations. Measures include removing water-collecting containers, sealing tanks, cleaning gutters, tire disposal, and ensuring agent access with motorized vector control. Eggs develop in 7–10 days; eggs can survive over a year, and rainfall increases breeding risk.

triage.headline_ja: フェイラ・デ・サンタナ市保健局、30人以上の特別部隊でケイマジーニャ地区のネッタイシマカ対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 地域的なデング・チクングニア・ジカのベクター対策強化に関するルーティン報告であり、症例数は前年並みで急増や異常な重症化は確認されないが、蚊媒介感染症の継続的曝露リスクがあるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 地方自治体レベルでの通常の蚊対策活動報告。チクングニア症例は前年比増加傾向（201確認 vs 前年15）だが、致死率や重症度に関する情報はなく、局地的な公衆衛生対応として継続監視が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: СЗО алармира: Еболата во Конго се шири побрзо од која било претходна епидемија
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns: The Ebola outbreak in Congo is spreading faster than any previous outbreak.
article.articleSummary: WHO warns that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is spreading faster than any previous outbreak. In just two months there have been more than 2,000 cases with 796 deaths. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said this is already the third-largest Ebola outbreak ever; the 2018–2020 outbreak took 10 months to reach 2,000 confirmed cases, whereas this surge reached that level much sooner. The outbreak, declared May 15, centers in Ituri province in the northeast, a mineral-rich region where armed groups operate. It is driven by a rare Bundibugyo strain with no approved treatment or vaccine. Despite strengthened response, many new cases are identified among people not linked to known contacts—over 80% outside contact lists, signaling incomplete transmission tracing. Ongoing security concerns include attacks on an Ebola treatment center in Bunia, aggravating access to care.

triage.headline_ja: WHO警告：コンゴのエボラ流行は過去のどの流行よりも急速に拡大している
triage.triage_reason: WHOが過去最速の拡大速度と警告し、致死率の高さ、治療・ワクチン未承認株、武装勢力による治安悪化、接触者追跡不能な症例が80%超と、複数のIHR基準・WPRO基準に該当するため。
triage.notes: 承認された治療法・ワクチンがないBundibugyo株による流行で、80%以上の症例が既知の接触者リスト外から確認されており、感染連鎖の追跡が困難。治安悪化（治療センターへの攻撃）も対応を阻害している。

article.articleHeadline: НЕ НИ СТИГА ЖЕГАТА: Лекари обявиха червен код заради вируса Зика!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: We can't stand the heat: Doctors declare a red alert because of the Zika virus!
article.articleSummary: Zika cases in the United Kingdom rise to nine in 2026, triggering UKHSA red alert for Zika and other mosquito-borne tropical infections; no vaccine exists and infection during pregnancy can cause severe fetal brain damage. Indonesia records the largest Zika cluster with four cases; infections are also linked to travelers returning from Thailand, Malaysia, the Maldives, and Singapore. Chikungunya cases double to 59 in January–June 2026, mainly among travelers from Sri Lanka, causing crippling joint pain that can last months or years. Dengue reaches 137 cases in the first half of 2026, with a record 34 in June, and transmission now reported in Europe (Croatia, France, Italy, Spain, Portugal). Malaria rises to 557 cases by May 2026. Typhoid and paratyphoid total 287 cases in H1, with most UK cases tied to travel to India, Pakistan, and Bangladesh. Climate warming expands mosquito habitats; travelers should follow advisories, use repellents, wear covered clothing, and ensure strict food/water hygiene.

triage.headline_ja: 耐えられない暑さ：医師らがジカウイルスによりレッドアラートを宣言
triage.triage_reason: 英国UKHSAが蚊媒介感染症（ジカ、チクングニア、デング、マラリア、腸チフス等）の増加でレッドアラートを発令し、気候変動による媒介域拡大や欧州域内伝播も報告されているため、社会的関心とWPRO基準の複数該当がみられる。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼は英国（UKHSA）における渡航関連感染症サーベイランスの警報であり、タイ・マレーシア・モルディブ・シンガポール・インド・パキスタン・バングラデシュ・スリランカは渡航歴（感染源国）としての言及に留まる。インドネシアのみ『最大クラスター（4例）』として実際の発生が明記されているため、対象国としてはインドネシアのみをverified_locationsに含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Niepokojące dane WHO. Epidemia wymyka się spod kontroli?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alarming WHO data. Is the epidemic slipping out of control?
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s northeastern Ituri Province is the epidemic’s epicenter, with additional clusters in North Kivu, South Kivu and Haut-Uele. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus and marks the 17th Ebola outbreak in DR Congo since 1976. Declared May 15, it is spreading faster than previous outbreaks, ranking as the third-largest by pace behind only the 2018 event, which caused about 2,300 deaths and 3,500 confirmed cases. Transmission chains remain poorly controlled, with roughly two-thirds of deaths occurring in communities outside formal healthcare. Uganda reported 20 infections with 2 deaths but currently has no active infections. There is no vaccine or approved therapy for Bundibugyo ebolavirus yet. Oxford University began safety testing of the ChAdOx1 vaccine this week, and early July saw two treatment-trial launches for this strain.

triage.headline_ja: 気になるWHOのデータ。エピデミックは制御不能になりつつあるのか？
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でBundibugyoエボラウイルスによる大規模アウトブレイクが進行中で、過去最速級の拡大速度、ワクチン・治療薬未承認、国外(ウガンダ)への越境感染も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの感染例が報告されているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ワクチン・治療薬の臨床試験が開始されており、今後の展開を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de vírus sincicial respiratório recuam em crianças no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Respiratory syncytial virus cases decline among children in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: RSV cases decline across Brazil, with bronchiolitis in children up to two years and reduced SRAG hospitalizations driving a drop in SRAG among children up to four, according to Fiocruz’s InfoGripe bulletin released July 16, 2026. Despite national improvement, five states — Mato Grosso do Sul, Minas Gerais, Paraná, Santa Catarina, and Rio Grande do Sul — show long‑term rising trends and are flagged at alert or high risk. Age patterns vary: RSV drives SRAG in young children; in youth, adults and older adults, hospitalizations are down as influenza A falls; in 5–14-year-olds, milder rhinovirus–related SRAG drives improvement. Mortality remains concentrated in those 65+, primarily due to influenza A. By 2026, Brazil reports 115,203 SRAG cases; positive labs: RSV 40.2%, rhinovirus 30.2%, influenza A 20.8%, SARS-CoV-2 4.5%, influenza B 4.5%. Recommendations emphasize hand hygiene, respiratory etiquette, masking when isolation is not possible, and vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで小児のRSウイルス感染症例が減少
triage.triage_reason: 季節性呼吸器感染症（RSV・インフルエンザ）の通常のサーベイランス報告であり、全国的には症例数が減少傾向。一部州で長期的増加傾向はあるが、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性呼吸器感染症（RSV、インフルエンザA/B、ライノウイルス）に関する定期サーベイランス報告（Fiocruz InfoGripe）。全国的には改善傾向で、一部州（マットグロッソドスル、ミナスジェライス、パラナ、サンタカタリーナ、リオグランデドスル）で長期増加傾向あり要観察だが、パンデミックポテンシャルや異常性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: تفشي إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية الأسرع في التاريخ - أردو بوینت
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the fastest in history - Urdu Point
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has become the third-largest on record, with 2,003 infections and 796 deaths reported over two months, according to the World Health Organization. The surge is centered in Ituri Province, where more than 80% of new cases are identified outside contact-tracing lists, and where most fatalities occur in communities far from treatment centers. The outbreak is described as the fastest-spreading in history. Health authorities report expanding treatment and testing capacity and have initiated clinical trials for vaccines and therapies targeting the Bundibugyo strain. The development underscores ongoing transmission and challenges in surveillance and care in remote areas within the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行、史上最速の拡大 - Urdu Point
triage.triage_reason: 史上3番目の規模かつ最速拡大とされるエボラ流行で、致死率が高く、接触者追跡外の症例が多いため、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクを有する。
triage.notes: 2,003感染、796死亡（致死率約40%）。イツリ州が中心で、80%以上が接触者追跡リスト外の新規症例。Bundibugyo株を標的としたワクチン・治療薬の臨床試験開始。WHOが史上3番目の規模・最速拡大と評価しており、フルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Santa Cruz plans more work on West Cliff, illness outbreak could hit local economy
article.articleSummary: Santa Cruz plans to move about 600 feet of West Cliff Drive inland next year, covering completed emergency repairs and a future road realignment near Lighthouse Field. A Lighthouse Point hazard study is underway to assess converging sea caves and recent rock falls, as erosion in this coastal segment accelerates due to sea level rise and larger storms. Signs warn the public, and officials emphasize caution as erosion is viewed as inevitable in this area. Separately, speculation about a food-borne illness outbreak affecting dozens of states could impact Monterey Bay’s agriculture. Max Teplitski, chief scientist at the International Fresh Produce Association, urges that crop blame be supported by robust data, not rumors or off-the-record comments. Cilantro rumors persist, with lettuce potentially next. In 2025, Monterey County produced nearly $1.6 billion in lettuce.

triage.headline_ja: サンタクルーズ市、ウェストクリフの追加工事を計画、疾病流行が地域経済に打撃の可能性
triage.triage_reason: 記事は米国カリフォルニア州の海岸浸食対策が主題であり、食品由来疾患の噂は根拠不明の推測レベルに留まる。対象国（フィリピン等）への言及もなく、シグナルとしての実体がない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は米国カリフォルニア州サンタクルーズの海岸浸食対策であり、食品由来疾患は噂レベルで詳細不明。発生地域にフィリピン(Calabarzon)が含まれるが記事内容に関連する記述は一切なし。対象国は含まれないため空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: पोटका में 2366 लोगों की जांच में 30 मलेरिया संक्रमित मिले
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Potka, 30 malaria cases detected in screening of 2,366 people.
article.articleSummary: 30 malaria cases detected among 2,366 villagers screened across 17 villages in Potka Block through 51 screening camps. Blood samples were tested and 30 positives identified, with on-site treatment provided to the patients. Health officials cautioned that fever lasting three days prompts testing, but many residents are not reaching government health centers, hindering malaria control efforts. They urged preventive measures including sleeping under mosquito nets, seeking prompt testing for persistent fever, and preventing standing water to reduce mosquito breeding. The report highlights ongoing malaria surveillance in Potka and emphasizes community engagement and accessible screening and treatment to curb transmission, underscoring the need for timely care to prevent escalation.

triage.headline_ja: ポトカで2366人を検査し30人がマラリア陽性
triage.triage_reason: 地域のルーチンなマラリア監視活動であり、通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内で異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: マラリアは当該地域の風土病であり、記事はルーチンのスクリーニングキャンプと予防啓発活動を報じたもの。特段の異常発生や重症例増加の記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα στη ΛΔ Κονγκό: 828 νεκροί σε 2.124 επιβεβαιωμένα κρούσματα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: 828 dead in 2,124 confirmed cases.
article.articleSummary: As of 17 July 2026, Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has 2,124 laboratory-confirmed cases and 828 deaths since the outbreak was declared on 15 May. The Bundibugyo strain currently has no licensed vaccine or therapy. The outbreak is spreading faster than previous ones, with confirmed cases surpassing 2,000 within two months, according to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. National authorities, with international support, are intensifying containment and surveillance efforts. Ebola causes hemorrhagic fever, and the disease has resulted in more than 15,000 deaths in Africa over the past five decades. The deadliest DRC outbreak occurred during 2018–2020, with about 3,500 cases and nearly 2,300 deaths."}

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ出血熱：確定症例2,124件中828人死亡
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱がDRCで急速に拡大しており（過去の流行より速いペース）、ワクチン・治療法未確立の株であることから、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長が過去の流行より速いペースでの拡大を指摘しており、致死率は約39%（828/2124）と高い。ワクチン・治療法が未確立のBundibugyo株であることも懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Febre maculosa mata 17 pessoas em São Paulo em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rocky Mountain spotted fever kills 17 people in São Paulo in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Rocky Mountain spotted fever (RMSF) caused 17 deaths in São Paulo state during the first seven months of 2026, from 18 officially recorded cases this year. From 2020–2025 the state logged 489 RMSF cases and 244 deaths. Fatalities in 2026 occurred across at least five regions: three deaths each in Piracicaba, Sorocaba, and Campinas; one in Santo André; and one in São José dos Campos. The latest victim, Rubens Allan Bizarro, 37, of Americana, died June 30; cause confirmed July 14 after the Instituto Adolfo Lutz report. Infection site is under investigation by PVCE. Americana reports 22 notifications this year (16 discarded, 5 under investigation, 1 death confirmed); Araras records two deaths and 25 suspected cases, including two children who died in January. Public health measures stress avoiding tick habitats, wearing light clothing, routine body checks, early diagnosis, rapid treatment, and integrated surveillance with epidemiological, environmental, and laboratory sectors.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年、サンパウロ州でロッキー山紅斑熱により17人死亡
triage.triage_reason: 2026年のサンパウロ州における紅斑熱（RMSF）は18症例中17人死亡と致死率が過去の平均（約50%）を大きく上回っており、深刻な公衆衛生影響と異常な致死率上昇が認められるためIHR基準を2つ満たす。
triage.notes: RMSFはダニ媒介性で人-人感染はないため国際的拡大リスクは低いが、2026年の致死率（約94%）は過去平均（約50%）より顕著に高く、感染経路特定・環境要因の調査が進行中。継続的なモニタリングとフルリスク評価が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo confirma caso de gripe aviária em ave silvestre
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo confirms a case of avian influenza in a wild bird.
article.articleSummary: São Paulo, Brazil, confirms a case of avian influenza in a wild bird. The broader report, published 16 July 2026, analyzes how Brazil’s poultry sector must broaden indicators and transparency to track evolving international buyer expectations. Brazil remains the world’s largest exporter of chicken meat, but leadership depends on sustainability, traceability, health, and animal welfare integrated into supply chain practices, not only production efficiency. The Observatório do Frango (Alianima) uses SWOT to identify drivers of competitiveness: strengths include integrated production, quality and biosafety management, technical capacity, and readiness to adopt new technologies; weaknesses include limited transparency and fragmented coordination across chain links. Ongoing market pressures from Mercosur–EU talks and a push for origin, production processes, and environmental/social indicators push firms to formalize welfare metrics. About 1.5 billion birds are raised under higher-welfare densities, about 27.7% of national production. A collective, long-term leadership is urged to transform initiatives into measurable commitments.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州、野鳥での鳥インフルエンザ感染例を確認
triage.triage_reason: 野鳥での鳥インフルエンザ確認事例だが、ヒトへの感染や公衆衛生への直接的影響についての情報がなく、記事の主眼も家禽輸出産業の透明性向上に関する内容であるため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 野鳥での単発の鳥インフルエンザ確認事例であり、ヒト感染例ではない。記事本文はブラジルの家禽輸出産業の透明性・持続可能性に関する分析が中心で、公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: OMS alerta que brote en RD Congo se propaga más rápido que epidemias anteriores
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: WHO warns that an outbreak in DR Congo is spreading faster than previous epidemics.
article.articleSummary: Two months after Ebola was declared in the Democratic Republic of Congo, the outbreak is spreading faster than any previous epidemic. The World Health Organization reports 2,003 cases and 796 deaths, making it the third-largest Ebola outbreak on record and the fastest to reach around 2,000 cases (roughly two months vs. over 10 months in 2018–2020). The northeast Ituri province is the focal point, where more than 80% of new cases are detected outside known contact lists, hindering containment and raising transmission risk. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo variant, for which there is currently no vaccine or approved treatment. This month, clinical trials began for MBP134 monoclonal antibody and the antiviral remdesivir, either alone or in combination. The response relies on early detection, isolation, supportive clinical care, protection of health workers, contact tracing, and community engagement, as vaccine-based tools remain unavailable.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱:WHOがコンゴ民主共和国の流行が過去の流行より速く拡大していると警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで過去最速のペースで拡大しており、致死率も高く、ワクチン・承認治療法が存在しないため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大なシグナルである。
triage.notes: 感染者の80%以上が既知の接触者リスト外で検出されており、封じ込めが困難な状況。ワクチンが存在しないBundibugyo株が原因で、モノクローナル抗体とレムデシビルの臨床試験が開始されたばかり。致死率は約40%と高い。

article.articleHeadline: Επιδημία Έμπολα στο Κονγκό: Πάνω από 800 οι θάνατοι
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic in Congo: More than 800 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has 2,124 laboratory-confirmed cases and 828 deaths, outbreak declared on May 15. The Bundibugyo strain is involved, for which there is no vaccine or treatment. As of July 17, 2026, the World Health Organization warns the outbreak is spreading faster than previous ones, with confirmed cases exceeding 2,000 within two months, unlike the 2018 outbreak that took more than ten months to reach similar levels. Ebola, a viral hemorrhagic fever, has killed more than 15,000 people in Africa over the last 50 years. The DRC’s 2018–2020 outbreak was the deadliest, with almost 2,300 deaths among roughly 3,500 cases. The article highlights ongoing monitoring and public health responses to an evolving outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行：死者800人超
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ（ブンディブギョ株、ワクチン・治療法なし）が過去の流行より急速に拡大し、既に2,000人超の確定症例・828人の死者が発生しており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ異常な事態でWHOも警戒している。
triage.notes: 記事はブンディブギョ株によるエボラ流行で、ワクチン・治療法が存在しない点が特に懸念される。2018-2020年流行を上回るペースで拡大しており、フルRRAが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Κονγκό: Ξεπέρασαν τους 800 οι νεκροί από Έμπολα - 2.124 τα επιβεβαιωμένα κρούσματα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: Ebola death toll surpasses 800 — 2,124 confirmed cases.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports 2,124 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 828 deaths as of July 16, during the 17th outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, declared on May 15. The outbreak is spreading faster than previous episodes, with WHO chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus noting cases surpassed 2,000 within two months, compared with over ten months in 2018. The disease is caused by the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola virus, for which there is no vaccine or approved treatment. Ebola hemorrhagic fever has killed more than 15,000 people in Africa over five decades. The 2018–2020 outbreak in DR Congo was the deadliest, with about 2,300 deaths among roughly 3,500 cases. Ongoing surveillance and public health response remain ongoing in DR Congo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ:エボラ死者数800人超え、確認症例2,124件
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の大規模アウトブレイクで、過去より急速に拡大しており、ワクチン・承認治療法が存在しないため公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長も過去のアウトブレイクとの拡大速度比較に言及しており、国際的関心が高い。ワクチン・治療法がないブンディブギョ株であることも重症度・拡大リスクを高めている。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ сообщило о резком увеличении случаев лихорадки Эбола в ДР Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO reported a sharp increase in Ebola fever cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: 2,073 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 796 deaths have been reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as of 2026-07-16. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus described the outbreak as the third-largest on record and noted that transmission over the past month has accelerated faster than any previous outbreak. The report recalls the 2018 DRC outbreak that reached 2,000 cases after more than ten months. Le Figaro also notes that the deadliest Ebola outbreak in the country occurred from 2018 to 2020, with about 3,500 cases and roughly 2,300 deaths. The article emphasizes precautionary measures and adherence to health guidance to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の症例が急増したと発表
triage.triage_reason: WHO事務局長が史上3番目の規模と表明し、感染拡大速度が過去最速との報告があり、公衆衛生上深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: 2073症例・796死亡と報告され、致死率は約38%。過去最大級の流行として国際的注目度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Prevention needed to curb mosquito-borne diseases in the rainy season - Global New Light Of Myanmar
article.articleSummary: During Myanmar's rainy season, dengue fever transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes, along with malaria, seasonal influenza, acute diarrhoea, dysentery, typhoid fever, and other respiratory infections, pose increased health risks. Health authorities urge preventive measures, including eliminating mosquito breeding sites and resting places, maintaining clean homes and surroundings, ensuring proper drainage, and practicing good personal hygiene with frequent handwashing. Public awareness campaigns should inform residents that Aedes mosquitoes bite mainly during the day and rest in dark indoor spaces, reinforcing bite-prevention strategies and regular inspections to remove breeding habitats. To curb diarrhoeal diseases, health messages stress safe water, clean food handling, thorough cooking of vegetables, fruits, meat, and fish. Overall, strengthening immunity through nutritious clean food and hygiene is emphasized, since prevention is presented as better than cure during the rainy season (as of 2026-07-16).

triage.headline_ja: 雨季における蚊媒介性疾患の予防対策の必要性 - ミャンマー・グローバル・ニューライト紙
triage.triage_reason: 特定の異常発生や症例数の急増を報告するものではなく、雨季恒例の一般的な予防啓発記事であるため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は毎年恒例の雨季における蚊媒介性・水系感染症の予防啓発キャンペーンであり、具体的な発生数や異常な流行を示すデータは含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Viral Outbreak Prompts CDC Travel Advisory for Costa Rica
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya outbreak prompts CDC travel advisory for Costa Rica: local transmission in Playa Langosta, Santa Cruz, and Guanacaste with 45 suspected cases, 4 confirmed, and 17 possible per Costa Rica’s Ministry of Health. The U.S. Embassy notes Costa Rican nationals and foreigners are affected. CDC issues Level 2: Practice Enhanced Precautions; travelers should use insect repellent, wear long sleeves and pants, and stay in air-conditioned or screened accommodations. Vaccination is recommended for areas with outbreaks; pregnant women should not travel due to risk to newborns. In the United States, 2026 has 75 travel-associated chikungunya cases across the U.S. and territories. Chikungunya is a mosquito-borne virus; symptoms include fever, muscle pain, fatigue, and rash, usually resolving in 1–2 weeks, but severe joint pain can persist and requires hospitalization in infants or the elderly. Local transmission means the virus circulates in local mosquitoes, not only imported cases. Originating in Tanzania in 1952; name from Makonde language meaning the pain described by patients.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルス性感染症の流行によりCDCがコスタリカへの渡航勧告を発令
triage.triage_reason: コスタリカにおけるチクングニア熱の局地的流行であり、対象国（フィリピン等）は主題ではないため、対象国に関するシグナルとしては該当しない。
triage.notes: 発生地域にPhilippinesが含まれるが、記事サマリーの主題はコスタリカでの発生であり、フィリピンでの発生は言及されていないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch Ebola diễn biến phức tạp
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak develops in a complex manner.
article.articleSummary: As of 17 July 2026, 2,011 confirmed Ebola cases and 754 deaths have been reported in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with the outbreak spanning 5 provinces. WHO warns the true scale could be 2-4 times the official count. MSF reports unprecedented rapid spread and urges intensified health-response measures. A key challenge is that the index patient has not yet been identified, while conflict-driven evacuations and mining-related activities hinder contact tracing of thousands exposed. In response to cross-border risk, the U.S. CDC has advised that U.S. citizens who have traveled to the DRC may be barred from returning home until completing a 21-day quarantine in a third country. Sources include AFP, WHO, MSF, and AP.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行が複雑な様相を呈している
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で2,000例超・死亡754例、5州に拡大するエボラ大規模流行であり、指標患者未特定・接触者追跡困難・米国が渡航制限措置を検討するなど、IHR基準を複数満たす重大シグナルである。
triage.notes: 米国は発生地域として記載されているが、実際の流行はDRC国内で発生しており、米国は渡航制限措置の主体に過ぎないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: ЕБОЛАТА ВО КОНГО СЕ ШИРИ СО РЕКОРДНО ТЕМПО: За два месеца над 2.000 случаи и 796 починати, предупредува СЗО
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo Spreading at a Record Pace: In Two Months, Over 2,000 Cases and 796 Deaths, WHO Warns
article.articleSummary: As of July 16, 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading at a record pace. In two months, over 2,000 cases and 796 deaths are reported, making this wave the third-largest Ebola outbreak on record. Declared May 15 in Ituri province, northeast DRC, the outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with no approved treatment or vaccine. Despite intensified response, more than 80% of new infections occur among people not on known contact lists, signaling incomplete tracing of transmission chains. Security in Ituri, amid armed conflict, hampers containment; an Ebola treatment center in Bunia was attacked, further complicating efforts. Rapid spread, limited health access, and instability pose ongoing challenges to stopping the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ、記録的な速さで拡大：2ヶ月で2,000人以上の症例と796人の死者、WHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで記録的な速さで拡大し、致死率が高く、武装紛争により対応が困難な状況で、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 承認された治療薬・ワクチンがないBundibugyo型エボラウイルスによる流行で、史上3番目の規模。新規感染の80%以上が既知の接触者リスト外であり、感染連鎖の追跡が不完全。武装紛争と治療センターへの攻撃が対応を著しく困難にしている。

article.articleHeadline: エボラ熱、感染２千人超／ＷＨＯ、急速拡大に危機感
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola fever tops 2,000 infections; WHO expresses alarm over rapid spread.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 2,073 confirmed infections and 796 deaths, according to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus on July 16, 2026. The outbreak, centered in eastern Congo, is expanding faster than past Ebola outbreaks. More than 80% of new cases involve people not previously identified as contacts, signaling gaps in transmission tracing. Health authorities have expanded facilities to over 800 beds and 16 laboratories, but response is hampered by ongoing conflict between government forces and armed groups and by attacks on treatment sites. There is currently no approved vaccine for the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola. On July 13, Oxford University announced the world’s first clinical trial of a vaccine targeting this strain.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱、感染２千人超／ＷＨＯ、急速拡大に危機感
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で2,000人超・死者796人のエボラ大規模流行が急拡大しており、追跡不能な感染経路（80%超）や紛争による対応困難、承認済みワクチン不在という重大な公衆衛生上の脅威が複数該当するため。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長が直接言及する規模の流行であり、既存株用ワクチンが未承認（Bundibugyo株）、紛争による治療拠点への攻撃など対応の複雑性が高い。フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: इबोला पर काबू के करीब युगांडा, 42 दिनों तक नया मामला नहीं मिला तो खत्म होगा प्रकोप
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola near containment in Uganda; outbreak will end if no new cases are reported for 42 days.
article.articleSummary: Uganda's Ebola outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain imported from the Democratic Republic of Congo, is nearing containment. The last patient was discharged from Mulago National Referral Hospital in Kampala after testing negative, triggering a 42-day surveillance period. If no new cases emerge in this window, the outbreak will be officially declared over. To date, Uganda has reported 20 confirmed cases (15 Congolese nationals and 5 Ugandan nationals) and 2 deaths. WHO staff, including Kasonde Mawinga, credited strong preparation and vigilant response for keeping transmission limited, with a case fatality rate around 10%, among the lowest in recent outbreaks. The index case, identified on May 15, stemmed from a traveler from DRC; the strain responsible is Bundibugyo. The 42-day period begins with the last confirmed case no longer able to transmit the virus.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ収束間近のウガンダ、42日間新規症例なければ流行終息へ
triage.triage_reason: 既知のウガンダ・エボラ流行が収束段階にあるとの続報。新規拡大や国際的リスクの明確な悪化はないが、42日間の監視期間終了まで経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダにおけるエボラ流行の終息プロセスを報じており、対象国リストにウガンダは含まれない。DRCは病原株の由来国として言及されているのみで、DRC国内での新規発生の記述はないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Health experts bat for caution as minor tests positive for dengue in Nawanshahr - The Tribune
article.articleSummary: Dengue case reported in Nawanshahr district, Punjab, with a 13-year-old from Balachaur testing positive—the first case this season. Last year the district reported 60 dengue cases. Officials warn that reduced monsoon rainfall may boost breeding and drive up cases. To bolster surveillance, 50 teams have been formed across 470 villages, including larval surveillance by breeding checkers and door-to-door inspections by ASHA and multipurpose health workers, with larviciding at breeding sites. A District Administrative Complex meeting under the National Vector-Borne Disease Control Programme reviewed measures. Deputy Commissioner Gulpreet Singh Aulakh directed intensified larval surveys, immediate destruction of breeding sources, stronger inter-department coordination, and expanded cleanliness drives, plus the Har Shukarvaar, Dengue Te Vaar campaign urging regular cleaning of coolers, trays, pots and other water-collecting items. District Epidemiologist Dr Rakesh Pal described symptoms, prevention, and treatment, and urged public cooperation and prompt medical care for fever or dengue-like symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: ナワンシャールでデング熱陽性の未成年患者、専門家が注意を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: インド・パンジャブ州で今季最初のデング熱症例が報告され、行政が監視体制を強化しているが、単発症例で重篤化や国際的拡大の兆候はなく、季節性の通常対応の範囲内と考えられる。
triage.notes: デング熱は毎年季節性に発生する疾患であり、今回の記事は地域行政による予防的監視強化の内容が中心。前年同地区で60例の報告があり、今後の症例数増加を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: エボラ熱、感染２千人超　ＷＨＯ、急速拡大に危機感：東京新聞デジタル
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola fever infections exceed 2,000; WHO warns of a crisis as rapid spread accelerates.
article.articleSummary: By July 16, 2026, Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 2,073 confirmed cases and 796 deaths, with a one-month outbreak growth rate faster than past episodes. The epicenter remains eastern DR Congo, where authorities report that more than 80% of new infections are among people not previously traced as contacts, indicating gaps in case-finding. Responders have expanded health capacity to 800+ hospital beds and increased testing from one laboratory to 16, but ongoing conflict between government forces and armed groups, plus attacks on treatment facilities, impede control efforts. There is no approved vaccine for the Bundibugyo strain. Oxford University announced on July 13 the world's first vaccine clinical trial for this strain. Updated numbers reflect the WHO emergency declaration about two months prior.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱、感染２千人超　ＷＨＯ、急速拡大に危機感
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の感染者が2,000人を超え、WHOが緊急事態を宣言済み。ワクチン未承認かつ紛争地域での対応困難という重大なリスク要因が複数該当。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株には承認ワクチンがなく、オックスフォード大学が7月13日に世界初の臨床試験を発表。紛争により治療施設への攻撃が発生し、対応の障害となっている。新規感染者の80%以上が接触者追跡外であり、感染拡大の制御が困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Humanitarian workers evacuated after violence erupts at DR Congo's Ebola treatment centre
article.articleSummary: Violence at Nyakunde General Hospital’s Ebola treatment centre in Ituri, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, prompted evacuation of humanitarian workers after the death of a pregnant woman sparked attacks; several Ebola patients may have fled as security deteriorated. The response is worsened by insecurity, attacks on health workers, community mistrust, patient departures, and frontline protests over working conditions and unpaid allowances. Health authorities report 119 infected health workers/frontline responders, with 60 dead. The Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak, declared in mid-May, has reached five provinces and is the third-largest on record. Over 2,000 confirmed cases have been reported; latest figures cite 2,011 cases and 754 deaths. The WHO warns the true scale could be two to four times higher due to undetected transmission and rapid geographic expansion.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ治療センターで暴力発生、人道支援スタッフが避難
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の大規模流行（2,011症例、754人死亡）が5州に拡大し、治療施設での暴力・医療従事者への攻撃・患者逃走など公衆衛生対応が著しく悪化しているため。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスによる史上3番目に大きい流行で、WHOは未検出感染により実際の規模が報告の2〜4倍に達する可能性を警告。治安悪化・医療従事者への攻撃・未払い手当を巡る抗議活動が対応をさらに困難にしている。

article.articleHeadline: Συναγερμός για τον Έμπολα: Στο Κονγκό πάνω από 2.100 κρούσματα και 828 νεκροί
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola alert: in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, over 2,100 cases and 828 deaths.
article.articleSummary: As of 17 July 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) remains on a fast trajectory after being declared on 15 May. Authorities report over 2,100 confirmed cases and 828 deaths, with confirmed infections surpassing 2,000 in just two months. This marks the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no available vaccine or proven effective treatment. World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus has noted the unusually rapid spread compared with prior outbreaks in the country. Ebola, a hemorrhagic fever, has caused more than 15,000 deaths in Africa over the past five decades. The DRC’s 2018–2020 outbreak remains the deadliest on record there, with about 3,500 confirmed cases and nearly 2,300 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ警報:コンゴ民主共和国で2,100人以上の感染者、828人の死者
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱がDRCで急速に拡大しており、ワクチン・有効治療法がないブンディブギョ株による過去に類を見ない速い感染拡大が確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長も過去のDRC国内発生と比較して異例の速さでの拡大を指摘しており、ワクチン・有効治療法が確立していないブンディブギョ株であることから重症化・国際的拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak: Uganda starts 42-day countdown to being declared free of the virus
article.articleSummary: Uganda discharged its final confirmed Ebola patient, triggering a 42-day observation window to determine if the country can be declared Ebola-free after no new infections emerge. Uganda reports 20 confirmed cases and 2 deaths in its outbreak, linked to a patient who traveled from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) for treatment. The DRC remains the epicenter, with over 2,000 confirmed infections and about 800 deaths; officials caution actual numbers could be up to four times higher, with transmission proceeding through previously unidentified chains and two-thirds of deaths in communities without access to facility-based care. Bundibugyo strain circulating in the DRC has no approved vaccines or specific treatments. Uganda’s response used containment measures: case isolation, contact tracing, and targeted messaging. Regional response is hampered by health-system constraints, armed conflict, and distrust; international bodies seek substantial funding. The United States now requires a 21-day third-country stay for returning citizens.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行:ウガンダ、ウイルス終息宣言に向けた42日間のカウントダウンを開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCを震源に2000人超の感染・800人超の死亡が継続し、ウガンダへの越境伝播や米国の渡航制限措置も生じており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき事案。
triage.notes: ウガンダ及び米国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCが疫学的中心地であり、Bundibugyo株はワクチン・特異的治療法が未承認である点にも留意。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : 2 124 cas confirmés et 828 décès au 15 juillet, un premier cas détecté à Mahagi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: 2,124 confirmed cases and 828 deaths as of July 15, with the first case detected in Mahagi.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo totals 2,124 confirmed cases and 828 deaths (case fatality 39.0%) as of July 15, 2026, with 51 new confirmations and 32 deaths in the prior 24 hours. Ituri Province accounts for 89.6% of cases (1,904/692) and reports 41 of the latest confirmations across Bunia, Nizi, Rwampara, Mongbwalu, Lita, Damas, Kilo, Nia-Nia and Mahagi; two-thirds of daily deaths occur in the community. The first case was detected in Mahagi on the Uganda border, expanding transmission to 27 of 36 Ituri zones and prompting strengthened cross-border surveillance. Uganda has 20 confirmed cases and 2 deaths, with no new cases since June 21. North Kivu shows 199 cases and 119 deaths ( CFR 59.8%), with community deaths only. Transmission remains active in 45 of 46 zones; Miti-Murhesa (Sud-Kivu) has 50 days without a new case. 725 in isolation; 390 recovered; contact tracing 80.3% (10,195/12,693). Bundibugyo ebolavirus detected; no vaccine or specific treatment; Ervebo protects only Zaïre strain. A July trial of two experimental therapies is underway in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：7月15日時点で2,124人の感染確定例と828人の死亡、マハギで初症例確認
triage.triage_reason: 致死率39%の大規模エボラ流行がイトゥリ州を中心に拡大し、ウガンダ国境地域への越境伝播も確認されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダで20例確認されているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。実験的治療薬の試験がイトゥリで進行中であり、国際的な支援ニーズが高い。

article.articleHeadline: India Targets Foot-and-Mouth Disease-Free Status in Nine States to Boost Dairy Exports
article.articleSummary: India aims for foot-and-mouth disease (FMD)–free status in nine states within two years to access Europe’s dairy market. The states, identified for consistently low outbreaks and completed vaccination cycles, would be certified by the World Organisation for Animal Health, aiding the PM’s 2030 goal. A vaccination-and-traceability drive cut FMD outbreaks from 105 in 2021 to 40 last year; 38 crore animals now carry 13-digit IDs, with OTP-based verification. Indigenous vaccines for FMD, Classical Swine Fever (CSF) and PPR have been developed; a domestically produced African swine fever vaccine was launched. US tariffs of 58% in 2025 did not prevent seafood shipments rising to Rs 73,891 crore in 2025-26, aided by FTAs with over 100 countries. Inland fisheries remain a policy gap (2% of exports) though production rose 147% since 2014; drone transport proposed. Odisha’s brackish-water shrimp potential highlighted; Rs 123 crore under PM Matsya Sampada Yojana funds research, with KVK networks mobilized.

triage.headline_ja: インド、酪農輸出拡大に向け9州で口蹄疫フリー認証を目指す
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫・CSF・PPR・ASFなど家畜疾病に関する政策・輸出戦略の記事であり、ヒトへの公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常な流行拡大は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 本記事は家畜衛生政策・輸出戦略に関するものであり、ヒトの感染症リスクとは直接関係しない。動物疾病の管理状況は改善傾向（アウトブレイク減少）が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: WHO warns DR Congo Ebola outbreak is outpacing response as Uganda reaches milestone - Media Monitors Network (MMN)
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's two‑month Ebola outbreak in Ituri province continues to outpace response; 2,273 cases and 796 deaths reported as of 16 July 2026. Transmissions accelerating; over 80% of new infections detected outside known contact lists; about two-thirds of deaths occur in communities never treated in health facilities. Ongoing armed conflict hampers operations; an Ebola treatment centre in Bunia was attacked. Treatment capacity expanded to over 800 beds; laboratory capacity up from 1 to 16; contact follow‑up near 80%; more than 21,000 community health workers trained; safe and dignified burials improved. Despite no approved vaccines or treatments, 377 people have recovered. Uganda reports 20 confirmed cases and two deaths since 15 May; last confirmed patient discharged after negative tests, starting 42‑day countdown to end. Of Uganda's cases, 15 imported from DRC, 5 locally transmitted. Funding gaps exceed $400 million for Africa CDC/WHO response; UNICEF notes only 25% of required funding available.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがDRコンゴのエボラ流行が対応を上回っていると警告、ウガンダは節目に到達
triage.triage_reason: DRコンゴでのエボラ大規模流行(2273症例、796死亡)が対応能力を上回り、ウガンダへの越境伝播も確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの症例発生も報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。武装勢力による治療センター襲撃、資金不足(4億ドル超)、ワクチン・治療法未承認等、対応困難な状況が続いている。

article.articleHeadline: Jo 828 on kuollut ebolaan Kongon demokraattisessa tasavallassa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Already 828 have died of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: 2,124 confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, including 828 deaths, per the latest government update. The outbreak has spread to five provinces and into neighboring Uganda. On Wednesday, 51 new cases were identified in the eastern provinces of Ituri and North Kivu, with the first case detected about two months ago. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said the outbreak is spreading faster than any previous Ebola epidemic in the DRC and is likely the third-largest by case count. Transmission occurs through bodily fluids and direct contact. There is no vaccine or proven preventive treatment available for this outbreak. The case fatality rate is about 34% based on current WHO data.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ死者828人に
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで5州に拡大し、隣国ウガンダにも越境。致死率約34%で過去最速の拡大速度とWHOが指摘しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境が報じられているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ワクチン・治療法が未確立であることも重大な懸念点。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola se ha propagado más rápido que todas las epidemias anteriores, alerta la OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola has spread faster than all previous epidemics, WHO warns.
article.articleSummary: As of July 16, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 2,073 cases and 796 deaths, with the surge driven by the Ituri province where over 80% of new cases occur outside known contact lists. The spread is happening more quickly than any previous outbreak; the 2018 DRC Ebola episode surpassed 2,000 cases after about 10 months and caused roughly 2,300 deaths among 3,500 infections. A total of 377 people have recovered. There are no approved vaccines or treatments yet. The first safety trial of the ChAdOx1 vaccine, led by the University of Oxford, began this week, and a second trial is evaluating post-exposure prophylaxis with the antiviral obeldesivir. Ongoing conflict in eastern DRC hampers response, with a treatment center attacked in Bunia, underscoring security challenges to containment.

triage.headline_ja: エボラはこれまでのどの流行よりも速く拡大している、WHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ流行が過去最速のペースで拡大しており、致死率も高く、紛争地域での対応困難や治療施設への攻撃も発生しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 80%以上の新規感染者が既知の接触者リスト外で発生しており、感染連鎖の追跡が困難な状況。ワクチン・治療薬は未承認で、Oxford大学主導のChAdOx1ワクチン安全性試験が開始されたばかり。紛争地域での治療センター襲撃など、対応の安全確保が大きな課題。

article.articleHeadline: Θερίζει αυτός ο Εμπολα - Δεν υπάρχει εμβόλιο ούτε θεραπεία
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This Ebola is decimating - there is no vaccine or treatment.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo reports 2,124 laboratory-confirmed Ebola virus disease cases with 828 deaths as the outbreak, declared May 15, continues to spread. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC, caused by the Bundibugyo strain for which there is no licensed vaccine or treatment. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus noted cases exceeded 2,000 within two months, much faster than during 2018. Ebola, a viral hemorrhagic fever, has killed more than 15,000 people in Africa over the last 50 years. The most deadly DRC outbreak caused nearly 2,300 deaths among about 3,500 cases during 2018–2020. The report highlights ongoing transmission risk and the absence of targeted medical countermeasures for this strain.

triage.headline_ja: このエボラは猛威を振るっている - ワクチンも治療法もない
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確認例2,124人・死亡828人という大規模アウトブレイクであり、ワクチン・治療法がないBundibugyo株による急速な拡大が確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長も2018年流行より速いペースでの拡大を指摘しており、ワクチン・治療法が存在しないBundibugyo株による第17次DRCエボラ流行。致死率も高く、フルRRAが必要。

article.articleHeadline: زامبيا تعلن رسميًا انتهاء وباء الكوليرا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Zambia officially declares the end of the cholera epidemic.
article.articleSummary: On July 16, 2026, Zambia officially declared the end of its cholera epidemic after four consecutive weeks with no new confirmed cases. The outbreak, which began in August 2025, recorded 1,627 confirmed infections and 26 deaths across 25 provinces. The Ministry of Health announced the milestone at a Lusaka press conference, crediting coordinated efforts by the government, health workers, international partners, and strong community adherence to preventive measures. With transmission halted, authorities indicate the epidemic is controlled, though continued surveillance and vigilance are needed to prevent a relapse.

triage.headline_ja: ザンビア、コレラ流行の終息を正式発表
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はザンビアにおけるコレラ流行の終息宣言であり、新規の感染拡大や公衆衛生上の懸念を示すものではないため、シグナルとしての優先度は低い。
triage.notes: 2025年8月から続いたコレラ流行（累計感染者1,627人、死者26人）が4週間新規症例なしで終息宣言された旨の報告。今後の再発防止のための監視継続が言及されているが、現時点で新たなリスクは確認されていない。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: تفشي "إيبولا" في الكونغو الأسرع في التاريخ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: The Ebola outbreak in Congo is the fastest in history.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-07-16, the World Health Organization reports the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has become the third-largest on record, with 2,003 infections and 796 deaths in two months—the fastest spread toDate among past epidemics. More than 80% of new cases in Ituri Province are detected outside contact-tracing lists, and most fatalities occur in local communities far from treatment centers, hindering containment efforts. The health response has expanded testing and treatment capacity and launched clinical trials for vaccines and therapies targeting the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola, in an effort to curb transmission and reduce mortality.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関:コンゴのエボラ出血熱の流行は史上最速
triage.triage_reason: WHOが史上最速の拡大速度と報告し、2000例超・800人近い死者を出す大規模流行であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 接触者追跡外での新規症例が8割超と、感染連鎖の把握が困難な状況。ワクチン・治療薬の臨床試験も進行中であり、国際的な関与が既に進んでいる。

article.articleHeadline: Περισσότερα από 2.000 τα επιβεβαιωμένα κρούσματα Έμπολα στο Κονγκό - 828 είναι οι νεκροί
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 2,000 confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo — 828 are dead.
article.articleSummary: More than 2,000 confirmed Ebola cases and 828 deaths are reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The outbreak, the 17th Ebola event there, was declared on May 15 and is spreading faster than previous outbreaks, per WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. As of July 17, 2026, the country’s total cases reach 2,124 with 828 fatalities. The strain involved is Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no vaccine or treatment. Ebola causes hemorrhagic fever and has killed over 15,000 people in Africa in the past five decades. The most deadly DRC outbreak occurred during 2018–2020, with about 3,500 cases and roughly 2,300 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ確認症例が2,000人超に - 死者828人
triage.triage_reason: DRCで第17次エボラアウトブレイクが発生し、確認症例2,000人超・死者828人と重大な公衆衛生影響があり、WHO事務局長が過去より拡大が速いと言及するなど国際的拡大リスクも高いため。
triage.notes: ワクチン・治療法がないBundibugyo ebolavirus株による流行で、致死率は約39%と高く、過去の流行より拡大速度が速いとWHOが警告している。フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: زامبيا تعلن رسميًا انتهاء وباء الكوليرا - أردو بوینت
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Zambia officially declares the end of the cholera outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Zambia officially declared the end of its cholera outbreak after four consecutive weeks with no new confirmed cases. The Ministry of Health, at a Lusaka press conference, said the outbreak, which began in August 2025, is fully controlled. The recovery is attributed to coordinated efforts among the government, health sector staff, international partners, and strong community adherence to preventive measures and essential health practices to interrupt transmission. The outbreak had resulted in 1,627 confirmed cases and 26 deaths across 25 provinces. The declaration, as of July 2026, reflects sustained surveillance and ongoing readiness to prevent re-emergence, building on an interagency response that mobilized resources and public health measures throughout the country.

triage.headline_ja: ザンビア、コレラ流行の終息を正式発表
triage.triage_reason: 記事は流行終息の発表であり、新規感染や拡大の懸念はなく、4週間新規症例なしで公式に収束が宣言されている。
triage.notes: 本記事は過去の流行（2025年8月開始、累計1,627例・26死亡）の終息宣言であり、新たなリスクシグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: মুর্শিদাবাদে ডেঙ্গু আক্রান্ত ৩১৫, ঠেকাতে মাঠে নেমে পড়েছে স্বাস্থ্যদপ্তর, সতর্কতা জারি
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Murshidabad, 315 dengue patients; health department has taken to the field to curb it, warning issued.
article.articleSummary: Murshidabad district in West Bengal reports 315 dengue patients currently, up from about 150 cases by late June; previously 150 in the first week of June (23 weeks into the year), rising to 315 by the 29th week, with around 50 new cases weekly during the monsoon. Affected hospitals include district and sub-district facilities, Murshidabad Medical College Hospital. In response, the health department has launched a field-based 'transparency campaign' in hospitals to curb spread; vector control teams are deployed. Stagnant water due to rain and garbage piles accelerates mosquito larval breeding. Authorities warn municipalities and citizens to keep surroundings clean. Dengue tests kits are in adequate supply. Symptoms include fever, vomiting, abdominal pain, rash, body aches, and nasal bleeding; recommended care is rest, ample fluids, and paracetamol for fever and pain. Early reporting and lab confirmation are emphasized.

triage.headline_ja: ムルシダバードでデング熱315人、保健局が現場対応と警戒を発令
triage.triage_reason: 西ベンガル州ムルシダバード県で季節性のデング熱患者数が増加しているが、重症例や死亡の報告はなく、地元保健当局が通常の対応を行っている段階であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はない。
triage.notes: モンスーン期に伴う季節性のデング熱増加であり、インドでは毎年見られる典型的な動態。重症度・死亡者数についての明確な情報がなく、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: यमुनापार में मानसून की मार, कूड़े के ढेर से बढ़ा जलभराव और बीमारियों का संकट - delhi monsoon garbage yamunapar faces waterlogging health risks
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Monsoon hits Yamunapar; waterlogging worsened by heaps of garbage and a disease crisis.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 July 2026, monsoon rains have intensified waterlogging in East Delhi’s Yamuna Par area due to heaps of street-side garbage and open dumping of domestic waste and construction debris in Mandawali, Seelampur, Gokalpuri, Yamuna Vihar, and Shastri Park. Rainwater flows into clogged drains and sewers, worsening flooding, disrupting traffic and local businesses. Residents warn that stagnant water and filth increase mosquito breeding, elevating the risk of dengue and malaria. They allege lax sanitation and weak action against littering, calling for a special monsoon cleanup, regular drain maintenance, and strict fines for dumping. Local Councillor Shashi Chandna says cleaning is underway during the monsoon and gaps will be corrected. Temporary waste dumps near Mandawli Railway Gate are cited as a source of the problem.

triage.headline_ja: ヤムナー川流域(東デリー)でモンスーンによる被害、ゴミの山が水たまりと疾病リスクを悪化させる
triage.triage_reason: 現時点ではデング・マラリアの実際の症例報告ではなく、ゴミ放置と排水不良による蚊媒介感染症リスクの懸念を住民が訴える内容であり、具体的な健康被害の発生は確認されていない。
triage.notes: 記事は環境衛生・インフラ問題（ゴミ処理・排水不良）が主題であり、デング・マラリアは今後のリスクとして言及されているのみで実際の症例数や発生状況の報告はない。モンスーン期の毎年発生する地域的な衛生問題であり、異常性は低い。続報で実際の症例増加が報告されればWATCH以上に格上げを検討。

article.articleHeadline: 海漂豬屍驗出豬瘟 金門豬肉禁運本島一周
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sea-drifted pig carcass tests positive for swine fever; Kinmen pork shipments to the main island banned for one week.
article.articleSummary: As of July 16, 2026, a sea-drifted pig carcass off Kinmen tested positive for African swine fever (ASF) virus nucleic acid, confirmed by Taiwan’s Council of Agriculture’s Veterinary Research Institute. The ~70 kg carcass was found at the Xintou shoreline, Jinhu Township; authorities sampled, disinfected, and then burned/buried the animal, with surrounding areas disinfected. To prevent spread, Kinmen pork and pork products are banned from shipments to Taiwan’s main island and other outlying islands for one week, valid through July 22, pending a seven-day period with no new cases. Health inspections covered 25 pig farms within a 10 km radius (5,033 pigs) with no abnormalities detected. The incident is believed to stem from drifting from mainland ports (Fujian, Xiamen, Kowloon River outlets) via winds and currents. Coast Guard and animal health authorities will strengthen border and vessel inspections.

triage.headline_ja: 海に漂着した豚の死骸から豚熱（アフリカ豚熱）検出、金門の豚肉出荷を本島へ一週間禁止
triage.triage_reason: 動物由来（ASF）の単発事例であり、周辺農場25カ所（5,033頭）に異常なしで、人への健康影響や国際的拡大の懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 本事例は台湾金門島（Kinmen）で発見された漂着豚死骸からのASF検出であり、対象国リストに台湾は含まれない。中国本土（福建・厦門）からの漂流が疑われるが、中国本土での発生確認情報はなく推測に留まるため、verified_locationsは空とした。人への感染症ではなく動物衛生上の問題。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: تفشي إيبولا في الكونغو الأسرع في التاريخ - أردو بوینت
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Ebola outbreak in Congo the fastest in history - Urdu Point
article.articleSummary: As of July 16, 2026, the World Health Organization reports the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as the fastest-spreading on record, with 2,003 infections and 796 deaths in two months, ranking as the third-largest global outbreak. In Ituri Province, over 80% of new cases are detected outside standard contact-tracing lists, and most deaths occur in local communities far from treatment centers, hindering containment. The response has expanded testing and treatment capacity, and clinical trials for vaccines and therapies targeting the Bundibugyo strain have been launched to curb transmission and reduce fatalities.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関:コンゴのエボラ発生は史上最速 - ウルドゥポイント
triage.triage_reason: WHOが史上最速拡大と評価する大規模エボラ流行であり、致死率が高く、封じ込めが困難な状況が続いているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 致死率約40%(796/2003)、接触者追跡外での新規感染が8割以上を占め、地域社会内での死亡が多いため封じ込めが困難な状況。ワクチン・治療薬の臨床試験が開始されている。

article.articleHeadline: São Sebastião intensifica ações de conscientização e prevenção contra hepatites virais
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Sebastião Steps Up Awareness and Prevention Efforts Against Viral Hepatitis.
article.articleSummary: São Sebastião, Brazil — in July, the Prefeitura de São Sebastião, via Secretaria de Saúde (Sesau) and Fundação de Saúde Pública (FSPSS), is conducting Julho Amarelo to raise awareness about prevention, early diagnosis, and treatment of viral hepatitis.
