Activities run throughout the month, including on July 24 when the Family Health Unit Enseada (USF Enseada) will host lectures and rapid testing. Viral hepatitis, most commonly caused by Hepatitis A, B, and C viruses in Brazil, can be silent for years, with infection detected only after liver damage progresses to cirrhosis or cancer. Health teams emphasize that viral hepatitis is treatable and urge testing, which is available through free rapid tests in the public health network. Campaign efforts continue across all municipal units with discussions, guidance, and rapid testing.

triage.headline_ja: サンセバスティアン、ウイルス性肝炎の啓発・予防活動を強化
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は「黄色い7月」キャンペーンという定例の啓発・検査活動の紹介であり、アウトブレイクや異常な公衆衛生事象を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は特定のアウトブレイクではなく、恒例の啓発キャンペーン（Julho Amarelo）に関する内容。

article.articleHeadline: أوغندا تعلن خروج آخر مريض بإيبولا من المستشفى - بوابة الشروق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda announces the discharge of the last Ebola patient from the hospital - Al Shorouk Gate
article.articleSummary: Uganda reports the discharge of the last Ebola patient from hospital, a Congolese national who has fully recovered and can return to the Democratic Republic of the Congo. With the patient's release, a 42-day monitoring period per international guidelines begins, after which Uganda could declare the end of the Ebola outbreak if no new cases are recorded. Citizens are urged to remain vigilant for symptoms such as fever, vomiting, diarrhea, or unexplained bleeding. While Uganda eyes outbreak closure, Ebola continues to spread in neighboring Democratic Republic of the Congo, where since mid-May more than 2,000 infections have been confirmed (2,073 cases) with 796 deaths; about 737 patients are currently in treatment in hospitals and isolation facilities.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、最後のエボラ患者が退院したと発表 - アル・シュルーク・ゲート
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国では5月中旬以降2,073例・796人死亡という深刻なエボラ出血熱の流行が継続しており、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダでは患者退院により42日間の監視期間開始、終息宣言の可能性があるがウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。コンゴ民主共和国では依然として大規模な流行が継続中（2,073症例、796死亡、737人が治療中）で懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Mesma bactéria encontrada em produtos Ypê é detectada em marca de água
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Same Bacterium Found in Ypê Products Is Detected in a Bottled Water Brand
article.articleSummary: Two 350 ml cans of Mamba Water mineral water (lots 13 and 14), manufactured on April 3–4, 2026, were voluntarily recalled by Brazil’s Anvisa after detecting Pseudomonas aeruginosa—the same bacterium previously found in Ypê products—in mid-April 2026. The recall includes suspension of sale, distribution, and use for the two lots, which have expiration dates through April 2027. This represents the third recent Brazil episode involving Pseudomonas aeruginosa, with earlier detections in Ypê products and a Crystal mineral water lot in June 2026. Pseudomonas aeruginosa is an opportunistic microorganism, generally harmless to healthy individuals but capable of causing infections in immunocompromised people, including the elderly, children, cancer patients, transplant recipients, people with HIV, or those on immunosuppressive medications.

triage.headline_ja: Ypê製品で発見されたのと同じ細菌がボトル水ブランドからも検出
triage.triage_reason: 感染症のアウトブレイクではなく、ボトル水製品からのPseudomonas aeruginosa検出によるリコール事案であり、HIVは免疫不全患者への言及に過ぎない。公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常な感染症拡大は認められない。
triage.notes: 本イベントはHIV感染症のアウトブレイクではなく、ブラジルの飲料水製品（Mamba Water）からのPseudomonas aeruginosa検出による自主回収に関する報道。HIV等の免疫不全者はリスク因子として言及されているのみで、感染症シグナルとしての性質は薄いため対象国は該当なしとした。

article.articleHeadline: Quarentena dos EUA para norte-americanos que retornam do Congo prejudicará resposta ao Ebola, diz organização humanitária
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. quarantine for Americans returning from the Congo will hinder the Ebola response, says a humanitarian organization.
article.articleSummary: July 16, 2026 — A humanitarian organization operating Ebola treatment centers and mobilizing U.S. crisis-response staff in the Democratic Republic of the Congo says a new quarantine policy will force a substantial reduction in its mission and hinder recruitment of health workers. The current Congo Ebola outbreak is the 17th in the country, with 2,073 confirmed cases and 796 deaths, all linked to the Bundibugyo strain, ranking as the third-worst outbreak on record per the World Health Organization. U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio has pledged to block entry of Ebola into the United States, and Washington is building a quarantine center in Kenya. Reuters earlier disclosed a CDC policy that prevents Americans in Congo from boarding commercial flights to the United States. HHS/CDC says the measure aims to reduce import risk while supporting a safe, effective public health response.

triage.headline_ja: 米国が実施するコンゴ帰還者への検疫措置、エボラ対応を妨げると人道支援団体が指摘
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（2,073症例、796死亡、史上3番目の規模）であり、国際的対応・渡航制限措置が既に発生していることからIHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCにおける第17次エボラ流行と、米国の検疫政策がその対応に与える影響。米国・ケニアは対応措置の文脈で言及されているが、疾病の発生国ではないため対象国リストにはDRCのみを含める。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Warns DR Congo Ebola Outbreak Is Outpacing Response
article.articleSummary: As of July 16, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is the third-largest on record, with 2,273 cases and 796 deaths reported over a two-month period. It is spreading faster than any previous outbreak in DRC. The eastern Ituri province remains the biggest transmission hotspot, with intense community transmission. More than 80% of new infections are detected outside known contact lists, indicating ongoing, undetected transmission chains. About two-thirds of deaths occur among people who never receive treatment in a health facility. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned the outbreak is continuing to outpace response efforts, despite ongoing interventions by the government, WHO, Africa CDC and partners.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行が対応を上回っていると警告
triage.triage_reason: 史上3番目の規模のエボラ流行で死亡者796名、感染拡大が対応を上回っており、WHOが警告する重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長が直接警告を発しており、感染追跡の80%が接触者リスト外であることから未検出の伝播網が拡大している可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: États-Unis Durcissent Contrôles Ebola depuis RD Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. Tightens Ebola Controls From DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo prompts the United States to tighten travel controls to prevent importation. Do Not Board procedures and direct flight restrictions now apply to Americans who have recently stayed in the DRC, with a 21-day voluntary quarantine required and assessed by the CDC in coordination with the Department of Homeland Security. Those who leave the DRC face potential boarding bans if they do not complete the observation period; exceptions depend on risk assessments. The move accompanies ongoing outbreak data: more than 2,000 cases and 754 deaths reported in the DRC. The Bundibugyo Ebola virus variant is driving transmission, with no licensed vaccine or approved treatment available for this strain. The World Health Organization has launched the first antiviral clinical trial. Plans for a cross-border quarantine center were considered and later suspended as authorities adapt to the evolving situation.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、コンゴ民主共和国からのエボラ流入阻止へ渡航管理を強化
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行（2000例超、754人死亡）に対し米国が渡航制限措置を導入しており、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 米国は流行発生国ではなく対応措置を講じている国であるため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含めた。Bundibugyo株による流行でワクチン・治療薬未承認、致死率も高く懸念が大きい。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda Hails Ebola Milestone, Urges End to Travel Restrictions - Internewscast Journal
article.articleSummary: Uganda discharged its last Ebola patient, a Congolese national, from Mulago National Referral Hospital in Kampala, triggering the WHO’s 42‑day monitoring window before Ebola‑free status can be declared. The outbreak in Uganda infected 20 people and caused 2 deaths, with 15 Congolese nationals among the cases; the patient’s case was described as imported. The risk remains at the border with the Democratic Republic of the Congo, where the Bundibugyo‑strain outbreak has grown to 2,073 confirmed cases and 796 deaths as of 14 July. Despite progress, 15 countries continue travel restrictions, and the United States maintains a level‑4 advisory. WHO rules require two consecutive 21‑day incubation periods with no new infections to end the outbreak. Trials for a Bundibugyo vaccine (BD‑Ebov) are underway; Uganda joined early‑stage studies and has dispatched 50 health workers and four laboratories to DRC.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、エボラ流行の節目を歓迎し渡航制限の解除を要請
triage.triage_reason: DRCで2,073症例・796死亡に拡大中のエボラ流行が背景にあり、国境を越えた輸入症例も発生。IHR基準を複数満たし、渡航制限や国際支援（ワクチン治験、人員派遣）も継続中のためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダでの流行終息プロセスを主に報じているが、根本的なリスク源はDRCで拡大中のBundibugyo株エボラ流行（2,073症例・796死亡）であり、対象国リストにはDRCのみが該当する。ウガンダ自体は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Andhra Pradesh Reports 4 Covid-19 Deaths, 12 Cases In Less Than A Month
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 in Andhra Pradesh: 12 infections and 4 deaths reported between June 26 and July 16, 2026. Deaths: three in Kadapa district and one in Kakinada; all had severe comorbidities (hypertension, diabetes, renal issues, etc.). The first 2026 infection was logged in Kadapa on June 26; between July 1–16, 11 more infections were reported. District breakdown: Kadapa eight cases, Guntur two, Visakhapatnam one, Kakinada one; all cases arose in different mandals, not a single cluster. Of the 12 infections, 67 tests were conducted June 26–July 15; 11 positives in Andhra Pradesh, with the 12th case detected at Christian Medical College in Vellore, Tamil Nadu. Among the infected, three are in home isolation, two in hospital, three recovered and discharged. Nationwide (July 1 onward) total: 339 cases, led by Kerala (115).

triage.headline_ja: アンドラ・プラデーシュ州、1ヶ月足らずでCOVID-19死亡4人・感染12人を報告
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の散発的な小規模発生であり、死亡者は全員重度の基礎疾患を有していた。単一クラスターではなく複数地域で発生しているが、規模は限定的で現時点で緊急対応は不要と考えられる。
triage.notes: COVID-19は既に流行が確立した疾患であり、本記事は地域内の低レベルの継続的発生を報告するもの。死亡例は基礎疾患を有する高リスク患者に限られる。全国で339例（7月以降）、ケララ州が最多115例と分散している。

article.articleHeadline: Casos suspeitos de leptospirose em Catanduva são descartados pelo Instituto Adolfo Lutz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected leptospirosis cases in Catanduva ruled out by the Adolfo Lutz Institute
article.articleSummary: As of 16 July 2026, suspected leptospirosis cases in Catanduva, specifically in the Nova Catanduva neighborhood, were ruled out after analyses by the Adolfo Lutz Institute, the official reference laboratory for São Paulo's State Health Secretariat. The investigation began following a preliminary screening test at a private lab; such tests are not definitive and require confirmation by an official reference method. Additional samples were collected by the Municipal Health Secretariat and sent to Adolfo Lutz. Results were negative for leptospirosis; one assay was inconclusive and is undergoing routine supplementary testing. Nevertheless, preventive actions and surveillance remain in place: the Zoonoses Surveillance Unit conducts rodent-focus inspections and educates residents, while the local health unit continues monitoring. The Health Secretariat reiterates rigorous investigation per Ministry of Health protocols. Residents are advised to keep yards clean, properly manage waste, avoid rodent habitats, and seek care if compatible symptoms appear after potential exposure.

triage.headline_ja: カタンドゥヴァでのレプトスピラ症疑い例、アドルフォ・ルッツ研究所により否定される
triage.triage_reason: 疑い症例は公式検査で否定され、実際の感染事例は確認されていないため、シグナルとして扱う必要はない。
triage.notes: 疑い例は検査で陰性と判定され、1件のみ再検査中。ブラジル・サンパウロ州カタンドゥヴァ市の地域ニュースであり、確定感染事例なし。

article.articleHeadline: Anvisa determina recolhimento de lotes de água mineral por contaminação bacteriana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anvisa orders recall of mineral water batches due to bacterial contamination.
article.articleSummary: Brazil's Anvisa ordered the recall of two batches of 350 ml Mamba Water mineral water after Pseudomonas aeruginosa was detected in tests conducted by the manufacturer. The recall, published as Resolution No. 2,783 in the Official Diário da União, targets batches with final lot numbers 13 and 14, produced on April 3 and 4, 2026 and expiring on April 3 and 4, 2027. Consumers should not consume the affected units and verify lot numbers, seeking replacement or refunds through official company channels; the firm has initiated a voluntary recall and is cooperating with health authorities. P. aeruginosa can thrive in moist environments and may cause infections in vulnerable groups—elderly, newborns, hospitalized patients, and immunocompromised individuals—though poses lower risk to healthy people. Anvisa also suspended sales of all Mister Hemp energy drinks pending investigations, and will monitor for further contaminated products or lots.

triage.headline_ja: Anvisa、細菌汚染によりミネラルウォーターのロット回収を命令
triage.triage_reason: 特定製品ロットの予防的自主回収であり、健康な人への影響は低く、感染拡大や公衆衛生上の重大な影響を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 規制当局による製品回収措置であり、実際の感染症発生・症例報告は記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Число смертей от Эболы в ДР Конго увеличилось до 828
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from Ebola in the DRC has risen to 828.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 2,124 confirmed cases and 828 deaths. On July 15, 51 new cases were reported in the eastern provinces of Ituri and North Kivu. The outbreak began in May and is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there are currently no vaccines or specific treatments. Cases have also been reported in Uganda, with the World Health Organization noting that the last patient in Uganda was discharged the day before. The DRC outbreak is described as the third-largest in the history of Ebola surveillance. Health authorities continue to monitor transmission and cross-border risks, as cases and exposure risk extend beyond the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ死者数、828人に増加
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（症例2,124件、死者828人）で国境を越えたウガンダへの拡大も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの症例拡大が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。ワクチン・特異的治療法がないBundibugyo株による流行で、史上3番目に大規模なエボラ流行とされる。

article.articleHeadline: OMS advierte que el ébola avanza a un ritmo sin precedentes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization warns that Ebola is advancing at an unprecedented pace.
article.articleSummary: As of July 16, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 2,003 cases and 796 deaths, spreading faster than any previous outbreak. It is the third-largest Ebola epidemic on record, with transmission especially rapid in Ituri province (northeast), where more than 80% of new cases are detected outside known contact lists. There is no vaccine or treatment for the Bundibugyo strain driving this outbreak, though clinical trials began this month with two therapies—the monoclonal antibody MBP134 and the antiviral remdesivir—used separately or in combination. By comparison, the 2018–2020 outbreak in DRC reached about 3,500 cases and nearly 2,300 deaths, taking more than 10 months to reach 2,000 cases. Health authorities note gaps in contact tracing and emphasize ongoing testing of treatments to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ出血熱がかつてない速さで拡大していると警告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が過去最速のペースで拡大しており、致死率も高く、ワクチン・治療薬が未確立であるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大な公衆衛生上のシグナルである。
triage.notes: WHOが公式に警告を発しており、過去最大級の流行規模（史上3番目）、接触者追跡の網から外れた症例が8割超という点から、ヒト-ヒト感染拡大リスクと管理困難性が高い。ワクチン未承認・治療薬の臨床試験段階であることも懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil entrega banco nacional de antígenos para febre aftosa na Argentina, confira - CompreRural
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil delivers the national antigen bank for foot-and-mouth disease in Argentina, check it out.
article.articleSummary: Brazil delivers the first National Antigen Bank for Emergency Response to Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD) to Argentina, bolstering regional contingency readiness. The ceremony on July 17, in Garín, Buenos Aires Province, Argentina, at Biogénesis Bagó's plant (Ruta Panamericana Km 38.5) marks the handover and is scheduled for 9:00 a.m. The antigen bank, Brazil's owned structure, was developed through a partnership of MAPA (Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock), Tecpar, and Biogénesis Bagó, with participation from Argentina's Senasa and the Brazilian Embassy in Buenos Aires. Its purpose is to support responses to potential FMD sanitary emergencies under official contingency plans. This event represents Brazil’s inaugural antigen facility dedicated to FMD response and strengthens cross-border cooperation in Latin America.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、アルゼンチンに口蹄疫抗原バンクを引き渡し
triage.triage_reason: 記事は口蹄疫の発生報告ではなく、ブラジルとアルゼンチン間の抗原バンク引き渡し（緊急対応能力強化）に関する協力ニュースであり、実際の感染事例の記述はない。
triage.notes: 記事はアルゼンチン・ブラジル間の家畜衛生協力（抗原バンク供与）に関するものであり、対象国リストに含まれる国での口蹄疫発生を報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch Ebola: Bệnh nhân cuối cùng xuất viện, Uganda đếm ngược đến ngày hết dịch
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: the last patient discharged, Uganda counts down to the day the outbreak ends.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 July 2026, Uganda reports the last Ebola patient has been discharged after testing negative for Bundibugyo Ebola virus, with a 42-day window to declare the outbreak ended if no new cases emerge. If no new infections are detected in that period, Uganda could officially terminate the outbreak. WHO Uganda representative Kasonde Mwinga praised preparedness and response efforts, noting the outbreak’s mortality rate as under 10%. The outbreak began on 15 May after a patient who traveled from eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri Province) was infected with Bundibugyo Ebola. Since then, Uganda has recorded 20 cases (15 Congolese nationals and 5 Ugandan nationals) and two deaths. The virus is believed to have crossed the border from eastern DRC into Uganda, while the Democratic Republic of Congo situation remains complex.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行:最後の患者が退院、ウガンダは流行終息の日をカウントダウン
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱のアウトブレイクであり、DRCからウガンダへの越境感染が確認されている。終息に向かっているものの、IHR基準の複数(深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大)に該当するためフルRRAでの確認が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダでのエボラ流行終息だが、Ugandaは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。感染源であるDRC(イトゥリ州)由来の越境感染であり、DRC側の状況も『複雑』と言及されているためDRCのみを含めた。ウガンダでは20症例(うちコンゴ国籍15名)、死亡2名、致死率10%未満、42日間の監視期間中。

article.articleHeadline: RD Congo activa 11 laboratorios y 22 centros médicos frente a brote de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC activates 11 laboratories and 22 medical centers in response to an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri province, with transmission to Alto Uélé and Tshopo). As of mid-May, 2,011 confirmed cases and 754 deaths. The epicenter remains Ituri, though spread has reached neighboring territories. Uganda has instituted a 42‑day epidemiological surveillance after discharging its last patient in Kampala. UN OCHA activated a contingency plan: 11 decentralized laboratories capable of processing about 250 diagnostic samples per day, and 22 treatment centers providing 700 hospital beds. Operations in Bunia and Mongbwalu are strained by armed conflict in North Kivu and Ituri, jeopardizing humanitarian access; more than 100 healthcare workers have been infected. A July 15 strike in Bunia interrupted sanitation, surveillance, and contact tracing, with a 72‑hour deadline for the government to resolve pay arrears and PPE supply, increasing transmission risk across five provinces.

triage.headline_ja: RD Congo activa 11 laboratorios y 22 centros médicos frente a brote de ébola（DRC、エボラ発生に対応し11の検査室と22の医療センターを稼働）
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（確定2,011例、死亡754例）が複数州に拡大し、ウガンダへの越境事例や医療従事者100名超の感染、武力紛争による人道アクセス阻害・ストライキによる対策中断など、公衆衛生・国際拡大双方でIHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境例は記事上「最後の患者が退院し42日間の監視体制」との記述のみで、現時点でウガンダ国内での確定症例発生は明示されていないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含めた。武力紛争・スト・医療従事者感染などにより流行制御が困難な状況が続いており、続報の注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 洪涝过后健康小贴士 防范疾病风险
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Post-Flood Health Tips: Preventing Disease Risks
article.articleSummary: As of 17 July 2026, post-typhoon and flood conditions heighten infection risks from floodwater contaminated with microbes in garbage, feces, and animal carcasses. The National Health Commission advises drinking only boiled or disinfected water; avoid spoiled, moldy, or flood-soaked foods; wash fruits and vegetables with clean water and separate raw from cooked foods to prevent enteric diseases. Maintain a clean living environment by removing mud, standing water, garbage, and animal carcasses; disinfect surfaces and utensils, keep indoor areas ventilated, and ensure intact screens; use mosquito nets and coils to reduce vector exposure. In schistosomiasis-endemic areas, fever, diarrhea, or skin rash after floodwater contact should seek prompt medical care. Before summer travel, plan routes, monitor weather alerts, and avoid valleys or unfamiliar water bodies; if bitten by dogs or snakes, seek medical attention and note bite details. Wear easily removable clothing to prevent heat-related illness and hypothermia.

triage.headline_ja: 洪水後の健康アドバイス:疾病リスクの予防
triage.triage_reason: 特定の感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、洪水後の一般的な公衆衛生上の注意喚起・予防啓発記事であるため、シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は住血吸虫症を含む複数疾患への一般的注意喚起で、具体的な症例数や発生報告は含まれない。国家衛生健康委員会による季節性の予防啓発情報。

article.articleHeadline: WHO kêu gọi hỗ trợ tài chính ứng phó dịch Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO appeals for funding to respond to the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: WHO says only about 40% of the $115 million needed for the Ebola response in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo has been mobilized, risking core activities such as surveillance, contact tracing, and community engagement. As of July 15, the country reported 2,011 confirmed Ebola cases and 754 deaths, marking the fastest-spreading outbreak on record in DR Congo. WHO appeals to international donors to quickly release pledged funds to ensure the response remains adequately resourced. The funding gap threatens outbreak control efforts in Ituri province, the epicenter of the outbreak, where healthcare worker strikes over wage arrears, delayed pay, and harsh working conditions have intensified. Provincial authorities are meeting striking groups to resolve the disputes, but continued labor action could further hinder control measures.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがエボラ出血熱流行対応のための資金支援を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で史上最速のエボラ流行が継続し、2,011症例・754死亡と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、資金不足により対応が危機に瀕しているためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: Ituriは州（ADM1）のため対象国リストにはDRC本体のみを記載。医療従事者のストライキが対応をさらに困難にしている点も留意。

article.articleHeadline: エボラ熱の感染2000人超・死者約800人　WHO発表、コンゴで急速拡大に危機感
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over 2,000 Ebola infections and about 800 deaths; WHO reports rapid spread in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 2,073 confirmed infections and 796 deaths as of July 16, 2026, according to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. The outbreak’s spread in the past month is faster than previous crises, raising alarm. About 80% of new infections were not previously identified as contacts, indicating gaps in contact tracing and surveillance. The WHO Emergency Declaration was made two months ago, and the situation is characterized by 17 days into the outbreak’s current phase with ongoing tracing challenges. In the eastern Congo outbreak epicenter, health capacity has expanded to over 800 beds and 16 diagnostic laboratories, up from an initial single facility. However, continued conflict between government forces and armed groups, plus attacks on treatment centers, hinder outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱の感染2000人超・死者約800人　WHO発表、コンゴで急速拡大に危機感
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が2000人超感染・約800人死亡と急速拡大しており、WHOが緊急事態を宣言済み。公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクからIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 接触者追跡の80%が未特定接触者からの感染であり、サーベイランスの限界と紛争による対応阻害が指摘されている。フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 伏天食物中毒事件高发 警惕这几类饮食风险
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Food poisoning incidents surge during the dog days of summer; beware of these types of dietary risks.
article.articleSummary: During peak summer heat, foodborne illness risk rises as microbes proliferate in foods. Three major risks: (1) Ready-to-eat foods susceptible to Listeria monocytogenes, including packaged items (meats, ice cream), freshly prepared salads, and raw items like sashimi, oysters, and fresh-pressed juices. (2) Mycotoxin poisoning from home-made or small-batch fermented foods (mi酵菌酸 poisoning) with examples such as sour soup dumplings (酸汤子), fresh river rice noodles, Liangpi, diao-jiangba, and glutinous rice dumplings; also spoiled white fungus and long-soaked wood ear. Norovirus summer spread linked to dirty or unclean water. (3) Poisoning from wild mushrooms and toxic plants during rainy seasons; no antidote—avoid picking or eating wild mushrooms. Toxic plants to beware include Man-sang fruit, Datura, and Aconite; undercooked green beans also pose risk. Safety steps cover procurement, processing, and storage, plus balanced, hydrating diet for vulnerable groups. Published 2026-07-17.

triage.headline_ja: 夏の土用の時期に食中毒事件が多発、これらの食事リスクに注意
triage.triage_reason: 特定の集団感染事例ではなく、夏季の食品安全に関する一般的な注意喚起・啓発記事であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は具体的な発生事例の報告ではなく、季節性の食中毒予防に関する一般啓発情報であるため、地域特定の感染症イベントとしては扱わない。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: تفشي "إيبولا" في الكونغو الأسرع في التاريخ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Ebola outbreak in Congo fastest in history
article.articleSummary: As of July 17, 2026, the World Health Organization states the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has become the third-largest globally, with 2,003 infections and 796 deaths in two months, the fastest-spreading outbreak on record. More than 80% of new infections in Ituri Province are identified outside known contact-tracing lists, and most deaths occur in local communities far from treatment centers, hindering containment efforts. In response, health authorities report expanded testing and treatment capacity, and clinical trials have been launched for vaccines and therapeutics targeting the Bundibugyo strain, aiming to curb transmission and reduce mortality.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：コンゴでのエボラ出血熱の流行は史上最速
triage.triage_reason: WHOが史上最速の流行と発表し、感染者2,003人・死者796人、接触者追跡外の感染が8割超と制御困難な状況であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株を標的としたワクチン・治療薬の臨床試験が開始されており、国際支援の動きが既にあることが伺える。

article.articleHeadline: Επιδημία Έμπολα στο Κονγκό: Ξεπέρασαν τους 820 οι νεκροί
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo: the death toll has surpassed 820.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 2,124 laboratory-confirmed cases and 828 deaths, with the outbreak declared on May 15, 2026. World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that the crisis is spreading at an unprecedented pace, noting it took two months to exceed 2,000 cases, far faster than the more-than-ten-month emergence during the 2018 outbreak. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is currently no vaccine or approved treatment. Ebola causes hemorrhagic fever and has killed more than 15,000 people across Africa in the past five decades. The deadliest DRC outbreak occurred in 2018–2020, with about 2,300 deaths among roughly 3,500 confirmed cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行、コンゴで死者820人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が急速に拡大し、2,124症例・828人死亡と重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、ワクチン・承認済み治療法が存在しないため国際的拡大・支援の必要性が高い。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長が過去の流行より速いペースでの拡大を警告しており、ワクチン・治療薬未承認のブンディブギョ株による流行のため、フルRRAへの移行が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Caxias promove ação de teste rápido contra hepatites virais | Duque de Caxias | O Dia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Caxias promotes rapid testing for viral hepatitis | Duque de Caxias | O Dia
article.articleSummary: Duque de Caxias, as part of the Julho Amarelo campaign for viral hepatitis awareness, will conduct rapid, free hepatitis testing across multiple health units in four districts to promote early diagnosis and treatment and prevent liver damage from viral hepatitis, which is often asymptomatic. Transmission varies by hepatitis type and can occur through unprotected sex, contact with contaminated blood, sharing sharp objects, and mother-to-child transmission during pregnancy or birth. The testing schedule includes: July 23 at José de Freitas Primary Health Unit (9:00-12:00); July 28 at Pantanal Family Clinic (9:00-12:00); July 28 at Taquara Family Clinic (13:00-16:00); July 29 at Campos Elíseos UPH (9:00-12:00); July 30 at Xerém UPH (10:00-12:00); July 31 at Vila Ideal Family Clinic (8:00-12:00); and July 31 at Saracuruna UPH (9:00-11:00). Permanent hepatitis testing and services continue within the Municipal Health Network.

triage.headline_ja: カシアス市、ウイルス性肝炎に対する迅速検査キャンペーンを実施
triage.triage_reason: 通常の啓発・検査キャンペーンに関する記事であり、異常な公衆衛生上の脅威やアウトブレイクの兆候は見られない。
triage.notes: 記事は定期的な公衆衛生啓発キャンペーン（Julho Amarelo）に関するもので、アウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα στο Κονγκό: Πάνω από 800 οι νεκροί - Συναγερμός για τη νέα έξαρση
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: More than 800 dead - Alarm over the new outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of July 16, 2026, Ebola remains active in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with deaths exceeding 800. The outbreak mainly hits eastern provinces where access is hindered by conflict, remoteness, and fragile health systems. Authorities report new confirmed and suspected cases across several provinces, with contact tracing and testing in high-risk areas continuing, and vaccination of contacts underway. Major challenges include limited health infrastructure, population displacement, distrust toward medical teams, and ongoing clashes that hinder safe access. The WHO and international partners provide staff, vaccines, diagnostic equipment, and supplies to support rapid patient isolation, risk communication, and protection of frontline workers. Ebola presents with high fever, severe weakness, muscle pain, vomiting, diarrhea, and in severe cases, bleeding. Early diagnosis, isolation, and contact tracing are critical to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱：死者800人超―新たな流行に警戒
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国東部で継続的に拡大し死者800人超と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、紛争地域でのアクセス困難や国際支援の必要性からIHR基準複数に該当する。
triage.notes: WHOおよび国際パートナーが支援活動を実施中。紛争や住民の医療不信が対応を困難にしている。

article.articleHeadline: Hà Tĩnh tăng cường giám sát dịch tả lợn châu Phi tại các cơ sở chăn nuôi - Ảnh thời sự trong nước - Kinh tế - Thông tấn xã Việt Nam (TTXVN)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ha Tinh Province strengthens surveillance of African swine fever at livestock farms - Domestic news photo - Economy - Vietnam News Agency (TTXVN).
article.articleSummary: Ha Tinh Province, Vietnam, is boosting sampling surveillance to track African swine fever (ASF) virus circulation at pig farms, slaughterhouses, and high-risk areas as ASF continues to pose challenges nationwide. With over 351,000 pigs in the province, authorities aim for early detection, rapid containment, and minimizing farmer losses. In the first six months of 2026, ASF appeared in 31 of 69 communes/wards, triggering the culling of nearly 1,600 pigs (about 133 metric tons). The enhanced surveillance is part of a broader effort to prevent spread, restrain outbreaks, and safeguard the livelihoods of livestock producers.

triage.headline_ja: ハティン省、養豚場でのアフリカ豚熱の監視を強化 - 国内ニュース写真 - 経済 - ベトナム通信社（TTXVN）
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾病（アフリカ豚熱）であり人への直接健康影響はないが、ベトナム国内で広範に発生し続けており、経済・食料安全保障への影響から継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: アフリカ豚熱は動物疾病でありヒトへの感染性はないため、公衆衛生上の直接的リスクは低い。経済的影響と畜産業への被害拡大の観点から監視継続が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: 伏天食物中毒事件高发，警惕这几类饮食风险
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Food-poisoning incidents surge during the dog days of summer; beware these types of dietary risks.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-07-17, Beijing Daily App warns of a surge in food poisoning during the hot, humid Dog Days, urging dietary safety. Three risk categories are outlined: (1) ready-to-eat foods with no heating, prone to microbial contamination, especially Listeria monocytogenes; (2) rice fermentation mycotoxin poisoning (米酵菌酸中毒) and Norovirus infection, with Norovirus commonly spread by contaminated bottled water or raw water; (3) poisoning from wild mushrooms and toxic wild plants due to misidentification, including Masang fruit, Datura (Jimson weed), and Aconite, as well as undercooked green beans. Prevention and handling emphasize procurement from regular supermarkets, avoiding bulk stocking, and not foraging unfamiliar flora; processing should use separate cutting boards and thorough hand washing, with wood ear and white fungus soaking not kept overnight, and thorough washing or blanching of wild greens. Storage advises eating cooked foods promptly, refrigerating leftovers correctly, and preventing cross-contamination; dietary tips call for balanced nutrition, adequate hydration, and special caution for elderly, children, pregnant, and immunocompromised individuals.

triage.headline_ja: 伏天(酷暑期)に食中毒事件が多発、これらの飲食リスクに警戒を
triage.triage_reason: 特定の発生事例ではなく、夏季の食中毒予防に関する一般的な啓発・注意喚起記事であり、具体的な症例数やアウトブレイクの報告がない。
triage.notes: 具体的な感染事例やアウトブレイクの報告ではなく、季節的な食品安全に関する啓発記事のため、シグナルとしての追跡対象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda Approaches Ebola-Free Status After 21 Days Without New Cases
article.articleSummary: Uganda is 21 days without new Ebola Bundibugyo Virus cases, nearing the 42-day WHO required period to declare the outbreak over. The last patient was discharged from the Ebola Treatment Unit at Mulago National Referral Hospital; no new confirmed cases since the outbreak declaration on May 15, 2026. Total Uganda cases: 20, with 2 fatalities attributed to late presentation; 15 cases were imported from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). Uganda is aiding DRC with four Ebola treatment centers approved by President Museveni and over 50 Ugandan specialists deployed; joint surveillance and border laboratories are established at Arua and Kasese. Border closures with the DRC and prohibition of community markets remain in effect, with intensified awareness campaigns in border communities. Uganda is engaging with countries that imposed travel restrictions on Ugandans. Shadow Health Minister urges improved public communication. The 42-day window aligns with two full incubation periods per WHO guidelines.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、新規感染者ゼロ21日目でエボラ終息宣言に近づく
triage.triage_reason: エボラという重篤な感染症であり、DRCからの越境感染や他国による渡航制限が既に発生しているため、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダの終息状況だが、感染源であるDRCでの継続的なエボラ発生・対応（治療センター設置、専門家派遣等）が明記されているためDRCを対象国として計上。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Число жертв Эболы в ДР Конго достигло 828 человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola death toll in DR Congo has reached 828.
article.articleSummary: As of 17 July 2026, DR Congo's Ebola outbreak has reached 2,124 cases and 828 deaths, with a case-fatality rate near 40%. In the last 24 hours, 51 new cases and 32 deaths were reported. So far, 390 people have recovered (13 in the last day). There are 725 patients under observation and 389 suspected cases; 12,693 registered contacts are under surveillance, with 10,195 under monitoring (80.3% coverage). The hardest-hit area is Ituri Province, although the outbreak has expanded to five provinces and 46 health zones. Doctors Without Borders (MSF) warns that stopping transmission is increasingly difficult as the epidemic accelerates and calls for immediate, stricter, and synchronized global actions, according to data from the National Institute of Public Health (INSP).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ死者数、828人に達する
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国5州46保健地域に拡大し、致死率約40%、症例・死者数が急増しており、IHR基準の複数項目に該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: MSFが感染拡大の抑制困難と国際的な迅速・協調対応の必要性を警告しており、既存のエボラ流行がさらに悪化している状況。

article.articleHeadline: Число жертв вспышки Эболы в ДР Конго приблизилось к 800
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from the Ebola outbreak in the DR Congo has approached 800.
article.articleSummary: As of 17 July 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has 2,073 reported cases and 796 deaths, according to World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. In a briefing at WHO headquarters, he said the current outbreak is the third-largest Ebola outbreak recorded in the DRC and that transmission has accelerated over the past month, faster than during any previous outbreak. The report highlights ongoing transmission and high mortality, though the article does not specify the affected provinces or cities within the DRC, or list common symptoms. The rapid rise underscores a substantial and evolving public health crisis in the region.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴでのエボラ流行、死者数が800人に迫る
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（症例2,073件、死亡796件）で、WHO事務局長が過去最速の感染拡大と言及しており、深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスクが複数該当する。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長が公式ブリーフィングで言及した大規模アウトブレイク。DRC史上3番目に大きい規模で、感染拡大速度が過去のどの流行よりも速いとされる。具体的な発生州・都市、症状の詳細は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Konqoda Ebola xəstələri xəstəxanaya hücumdan sonra qaçıblar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola patients in Congo fled after the hospital was attacked.
article.articleSummary: An attack by an angry crowd at Nyakunde hospital in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri Province forced Ebola patients and health workers to flee. The violence followed the death of a woman during childbirth from severe anemia; relatives attacked the facility, throwing stones and damaging fencing. The hospital’s medical biologist, Fransua Berokan Uderos, said blood transfusions could not be performed during the Ebola outbreak. In the chaos, hospital staff fled, the energy generator stopped, and several Ebola patients escaped. Reuters reports the country has 2,073 confirmed Ebola infections and 796 deaths. The Guardian adds that the current outbreak is linked to the Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain, with WHO issuing an outbreak notice on May 17. The incident underscores security and operational challenges during active Ebola transmission in the region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ患者、病院襲撃後に逃走
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱のアウトブレイク下で病院が襲撃され、患者が逃走・行方不明となる事態が発生。国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生上の深刻な影響があり、WHOも既に注意喚起を出していることからフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 病院襲撃によりエボラ患者が地域社会に拡散するリスクが高まっており、治安と感染制御の両面で緊急対応が必要。2,073例・796死亡という大規模アウトブレイクであり、WHOも5月17日にアウトブレイク通知済み。

article.articleHeadline: WHO cảnh báo: Dịch Ebola tại CHDC Congo lan rộng với tốc độ chưa từng thấy
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading at an unprecedented rate.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading at an unprecedented rate, according to the World Health Organization on July 16, 2026. In the two months since the outbreak was declared, more than 2,000 cases have been confirmed and at least 796 people have died. The WHO notes this is the third-largest Ebola outbreak on record globally, signaling a major public health emergency for the Central African nation and region. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that transmission is outpacing control efforts and urged intensified international support and resources to curb the spiral. The United States, responding on July 14, imposed travel restrictions to limit Ebola importation, while Uganda and nearby areas in Central Africa face spillover concerns. The article underscores urgent international action to halt further spread.

triage.headline_ja: WHO警告：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、前例のない速さで拡大
triage.triage_reason: 史上3番目に大きい規模のエボラ流行で死者796人以上、拡大速度が制御を上回り、米国が渡航制限を導入するなど国際的懸念が高いためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: 米国・ウガンダは渡航制限や波及懸念の文脈で言及されているが、実際の流行発生地はDRCのみ。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 6月新冠新增7.9万例，专家：空调房成传播隐患
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In June, 79,000 new COVID-19 cases; experts say air-conditioned rooms have become a transmission risk.
article.articleSummary: June 2026 nationwide COVID-19 saw 79,000 new cases, 130 severe, and 1 death; after about eight and a half months in a low transmission inter-epidemic period since Oct 2025, overall activity remains controlled though sentinel positivity rose slightly. The dominant domestic lineage is NB.1.8.1; no new variant with heightened public health risk has been detected. Overseas importation continues to raise local transmission risk. Dengue fever and chikungunya outbreaks remain a concern in southern provinces during summer given travel and vector activity. Public health guidance emphasizes ventilation, hand hygiene, and cough etiquette; high-risk groups should wear masks in hospitals/fever clinics and limit time in poorly ventilated spaces like board game rooms and basements. Beijing YouAn Hospital reports mild symptoms among current patients, with waning immunity and time since last infection driving seasonal fluctuations.

triage.headline_ja: 6月新冠新増7.9万例、専門家：エアコン部屋が感染リスクに
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19は既知の低伝播期における通常の季節変動であり、新規変異株も検出されていない。デング熱・チクングニア熱も定例の夏季注意喚起レベルであり、いずれも通常の公衆衛生モニタリング範囲内と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性COVID-19動向の定例報告であり、重症例・死亡数も低水準。デング熱・チクングニア熱は南部省での夏季恒例の注意喚起として言及されているのみで、具体的な発生地域や規模の記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola cases tops 2,100 as WHO warns further spread
article.articleSummary: As of 17 July 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 2,100 confirmed cases, making it the fastest-growing Ebola epidemic on record. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned at a Geneva press briefing that active armed conflict, insecurity, and community resistance are hindering access to affected areas and constraining response operations. Transmission continues to outpace advances in surveillance, treatment and research, despite notable gains in these areas. The briefing highlights that ongoing violence and local resistance in the DRC are critical obstacles to containment, elevating the risk of further spread within the country and potential spillover, underscoring the need for safer access and intensified public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染者数が2,100人を超え、WHOがさらなる拡大を警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱が過去最速のペースで拡大し2,100人を超える確認例に達し、WHOが公式に懸念を表明していることから、深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大リスクの複数のIHR基準に該当する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にGenèveやSwitzerlandが含まれるが、これはWHO本部の記者会見場所であり、実際の発生国はDRCのみ。武力紛争・治安不安・地域住民の抵抗が対応を妨げており、封じ込めの遅延と越境拡大のリスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Больные лихорадкой Эбола в ДР Конго сбежали из больницы после нападения толпы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Patients with Ebola fever in DR Congo escaped from a hospital after a mob attack.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri Province) at Nyankunde Hospital. On 2026-07-17, patients with Ebola fever and healthcare workers fled the facility after a mob attacked the hospital; relatives of a woman who died in childbirth from severe anemia pelted the building, damaged fencing, and prompted abandonment. A hospital biologist noted that blood transfusion is prohibited during Ebola outbreaks, limiting care. Following the attack, staff evacuated; a generator failed, power cut, and several Ebola patients escaped. As of 17 July 2026, Reuters reports 2,073 confirmed Ebola cases in the DRC and 796 deaths. The Guardian links the current outbreak to the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, and the World Health Organization reportedly announced the outbreak on May 17.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴでエボラ熱患者が暴徒の襲撃を受け病院から逃走
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確認済み2,073症例・796死亡という大規模エボラ流行が継続中に加え、患者が病院から逃走する感染管理上の重大インシデントが発生しており、国際的拡大・公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が懸念されるためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: WHOは本流行を5月17日に宣言済みとされ、Bundibugyo株との関連が報じられている。病院からの患者逃走は感染拡大・接触追跡の困難化につながる重大なインシデントであり、続報の即時フォローが必要。

article.articleHeadline: 'Áo giáp' đầu đời giúp trẻ dưới 1 tuổi giảm nguy cơ bệnh nặng do virus RSV
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 'Early-life armor' helps infants under one year reduce their risk of severe disease caused by RSV.
article.articleSummary: RSV infection in early infancy causes severe disease such as bronchiolitis and pneumonia, with risk persisting throughout the first year. Transmission occurs year-round via respiratory droplets and contaminated surfaces (toys, cribs, door handles). Infants aged 6–12 months remain vulnerable; a US study found 6–11 months had emergency department visits at nearly 77% of the rate seen in 0–5 months, and pediatric outpatient visits were about 14% higher. Data from Vietnam’s National Children’s Hospital show 6–12 months account for a high share of visits and hospitalizations, and natural immunity to RSV is not long-lasting, allowing reinfection. Prevention focuses on maternal vaccination to confer passive protection and monoclonal antibodies that directly protect newborns, including immediately after birth. Widespread protection can reduce infant hospitalizations, cut medical costs, and lessen healthcare system strain during peak respiratory seasons.

triage.headline_ja: 生後1年未満の乳児がRSVウイルスによる重症化リスクを軽減する「人生最初の鎧」
triage.triage_reason: 特定のアウトブレイクや異常事態を報じるものではなく、RSV感染症に関する一般的な医学啓発・予防知識を伝える記事であるため。
triage.notes: 季節性RSV感染症とワクチン・モノクローナル抗体による予防に関する一般啓発記事であり、特定の国での異常な発生報告ではない。米国のデータ引用があるが、これは研究結果の紹介であり発生地域ではない。ベトナムの国立小児病院データも通常の季節性統計の紹介にとどまる。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC: un centre de traitement pris pour cible à Nyankunde
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: A Treatment Center Targeted in Nyankunde.
article.articleSummary: On July 15, 2026, in Nyankunde, 45 km southwest of Bunia in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of Congo, security incidents disrupted the Ebola response: militiamen clashed near the Ebola Treatment Center and angry locals pelted its buildings, causing panic. A militiaman leader reportedly died. Four Ebola patients initially fled the center but later returned; one suspected case fled. On July 16, medical response teams from WHO, Africa CDC, and Samaritan’s Purse evacuated Nyankunde for Bunia, reducing on-ground response capacity. The exact circumstances remain unclear. Officials warn that ongoing insecurity prevents health workers from accessing the area, risking delays in outbreak response and potentially impacting control of the Ebola outbreak in the region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ:ニャンクンデの治療センターが標的に
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の治療センターが襲撃され、対応能力が低下し感染拡大リスクが増大しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準共に複数該当しフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 治安不安により医療従事者のアクセスが妨げられ、エボラ対応が中断されている。WHO、Africa CDC、Samaritan's Purseが撤退したことで現地対応能力が著しく低下している点が重大。

article.articleHeadline: Petugas kemanusiaan dipindahkan selepas keganasan tercetus di pusat rawatan Ebola DRC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Humanitarian workers relocated after violence erupted at an Ebola treatment center in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Violence at the Nyakunde General Hospital Ebola treatment center in Ituri, Democratic Republic of Congo, erupted after the death of a pregnant woman, with gunfire directed at the facility. Local safety sources say humanitarian workers were relocated as security deteriorated; several casualties were reported, though details remain unclear. It is also believed some Ebola patients undergoing treatment at the center fled. The outbreak response faces ongoing challenges due to unstable security, attacks on health workers and medical facilities, community distrust, patients leaving before completing treatment, and front-line staff protesting unpaid working conditions and allowances. As of 17 July 2026, DRC authorities say 119 health workers and frontline staff have been infected with Ebola, including 60 deaths. The incident compounds the wider Ebola outbreak response in Ituri, hindering containment and risk communication.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ治療センターで暴力事件発生後、人道支援活動員が避難
triage.triage_reason: DRCイツリ州のエボラ治療センターで暴力事件が発生し患者が逃亡、医療従事者119名感染・60名死亡という深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際的拡大リスクがあり、IHR基準複数該当のためフルRRAへ。
triage.notes: 治療センターでの暴力・患者逃亡・医療従事者の高い感染死亡率により、封じ込め対応が著しく妨げられている点が重大。続報でのアウトブレイク規模拡大の有無を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: 关于新冠 国家疾控发声 疫情呈上升趋势
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: National CDC issues a statement on COVID-19 as the outbreak trends upward.
article.articleSummary: Across China in June 2026, the National CDC reported 79,000 newly confirmed COVID-19 cases, 130 severe cases, and 1 death (with underlying disease), across 31 provinces and Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps. In weeks 23–26, influenza-like illness visits positive for SARS-CoV-2 rose to 2.9%, 4.1%, 5.3%, and 6.4%. Genomic surveillance from those weeks covered 3,741 local cases, all Omicron variants, with NB.1.8.1 and sublineages dominant (98.5%, 98.1%, 98.8%, 95.9%). No evidence of new variants with additional public health risk. Jan–May 2026 local confirmed cases by province: 17,916; 19,453; 26,306; 23,477; 21,861. Common symptoms: sore throat, cough, fever; others include myalgia, anosmia/ageusia, nasal congestion, diarrhea, conjunctivitis. Elderly and immunocompromised remain at higher risk; current trend is fluctuating upward. Public health measures emphasize indoor transmission risk with air conditioning and limited ventilation; seek care promptly for fever, cough, chest tightness, or shortness of breath and start antiviral treatment.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナウイルスに関する国家疾病対策センターの発表：疫病流行は上昇傾向
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のCOVID-19症例増加であり、既知のOmicron系統（NB.1.8.1等）が主体で新たな公衆衛生リスクを持つ変異株の証拠はなく、重症・死亡例も少数にとどまるため、通常のサーベイランス範囲内と判断される。
triage.notes: 国家疾病対策センターが定例的な疫学統計・ゲノムサーベイランス結果を発表した内容であり、新規変異株の出現や異常な重症化傾向は報告されていない。季節性変動として経過観察の対象にも至らないレベルと判断。

article.articleHeadline: 海漂死豬驗出非洲豬瘟　金門豬肉暫停輸出　加強邊境管控及查驗
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dead pigs washed ashore test positive for African swine fever; Kinmen pork exports suspended; Strengthen border controls and inspections.
article.articleSummary: On 14 July, a 70-kg dead pig carcass washed ashore at the Xintou shoreline in Jinhu, Kinmen. Samples were collected and, on 16 July, PCR confirmed African swine fever virus nucleic acid. A 10-km radius around the site includes 25 pig farms with 5,033 pigs, all clinically healthy upon inspection. The carcass was incinerated and the surrounding area disinfected. Officials link the event to weather, noting Typhoon Bavi’s outer circulation and sea currents may have carried the carcass to Kinmen, which lies near Fujian, Xiamen, and the Jiulong River. Enhanced biosecurity and disinfection of contacts, vehicles, and equipment were implemented. The Agriculture Ministry extended the suspension of Kinmen pork and pork products exports to Taiwan’s main island and other offshore islands from 16–22 July, awaiting at least one week without an outbreak to lift. The public is urged to avoid bringing pork or animal products into Taiwan, as ASF remains a regional threat.

triage.headline_ja: 海に漂着した死んだ豚からアフリカ豚熱を検出　金門の豚肉輸出を一時停止　国境管理と検査を強化
triage.triage_reason: 動物のみに影響する事例で、対象国（台湾・金門島）はスクリーニング対象国リストに含まれず、ヒトへの公衆衛生上の影響も報告されていないため見送りと判断。
triage.notes: 本事例は台湾・金門島で発見された死豚からのASF検出であり、中国本土での発生は台風・海流による死骸漂着の推測に留まる。対象国リストに台湾は含まれず、中国本土での実際の発生も確認されていないため、verified_locationsは空とした。動物衛生上のイベントであり、ヒトへの感染性はない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC: un centre de traitement pris pour cible à Nyankunde
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: a treatment center targeted in Nyankunde.
article.articleSummary: Two separate violent incidents targeted the Ebola Treatment Center in Nyankunde, Democratic Republic of Congo, exacerbating the Ebola response. Local militiamen fired on the Nyankunde center, with one of their leaders killed. In a separate confrontation, the death of a pregnant woman at the medical center sparked anger and stone-throwing at the facility. Panic led four Ebola patients to flee, though all four later returned; one suspected case fled. On Thursday morning, WHO, Africa CDC, and Samaritan's Purse personnel evacuated Nyankunde for Bunia, leaving about 15 responders. Dr. Yap Boum of Africa CDC warned that unsafe security conditions hinder outbreak response, risking limited access to the health zone and potentially impeding transmission control in areas with significant case loads.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ:ニャンクンデの治療センターが襲撃の標的に
triage.triage_reason: エボラ治療センターへの武力攻撃により患者が逃走し、WHO・Africa CDC等の対応要員が退避するなど、アウトブレイク対応そのものが深刻に阻害されており、感染拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 治安悪化により患者の逃走・接触者追跡困難化のリスクが高く、続報でのケース数・感染拡大状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Число жертв лихорадки Эбола в ДР Конго приблизилось к 800
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has approached 800.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo totals 2,073 cases and 796 deaths as of July 16, 2026, with the World Health Organization noting faster spread than in previous outbreaks. By comparison, the 2018–2019 epidemic surpassed 2,000 cases after 10 months. In Uganda, the last patient with a confirmed Ebola infection was discharged on July 16, 2026, initiating a 42-day countdown to end the outbreak in the country; Uganda has recorded 20 cases and 2 deaths during the outbreak. Initial warnings emerged from the DRC in early May, and WHO subsequently declared the situation a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). The report underscores ongoing cross-border transmission and the rapid escalation of cases relative to past Ebola outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴでのエボラ出血熱の死者数が800人に迫る
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（2,073症例、796死亡）でWHOがPHEICを宣言し、過去の流行より急速に拡大、国境を越えた伝播も継続していることから、IHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ただし記事内容としては越境感染の文脈で言及されている。WHOがPHEICを宣言済みであり、既にフルRRA相当の重大事案である可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: 专家：空调房成传播新冠隐患，注意这些日常防护措施→
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Experts: Air-conditioned rooms have become a hidden risk for spreading COVID-19; pay attention to these daily protective measures.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 in China remains at low transmission; from June 1–30, 2026, 79,000 new confirmed cases, 130 severe, and 1 death reported across 31 provinces and Xinjiang. Sentinel hospital positivity rose slightly but did not exceed low-level thresholds. The dominant local strain remains NB.1.8.1; no new variant with public health risk detected. The pandemic has shifted to a common respiratory illness with periodic fluctuations. Dengue fever and chikungunya outbreaks pose risks in southern provinces, with imported cases maintaining potential for local spread. Beijing YouAn Hospital expert Li Tongzeng notes mild symptoms in most current COVID-19 patients; summer air-conditioning in enclosed spaces elevates indoor transmission. Public advised to ventilate regularly, wear masks in high-risk settings, practice hand hygiene, and minimize time in poorly ventilated venues. For common human coronavirus, continue routine precautions: hygiene, ventilation, masking, and healthy lifestyle.

triage.headline_ja: 専門家:エアコンの効いた部屋が新型コロナウイルス感染拡大の隠れたリスクに、日常的な予防対策に注意
triage.triage_reason: 中国国内でのCOVID-19は低水準の流行が継続し、新規変異株や公衆衛生上のリスク上昇は認められず、季節性の一般的な呼吸器疾患として扱われている段階であり、特段のシグナルとは言えない。
triage.notes: デング熱・チクングニア熱については南部省での輸入例と局地的拡大リスクに言及されているが、具体的な症例数や規模の記載がなく詳細不明。COVID-19は既知株(NB.1.8.1)で重症例・死亡例も低水準。
